    • iPad Pro - www.macobserver.com/...
      • iPad Pro -v- Microsoft Surface 3 - www.wired.com/...
      • Apple Pencil -v- Wacom Cintiq - www.lindadong.com/... & www.cultofmac.com/...
    • New Apple TV - www.macobserver.com/... & arstechnica.com/...
      • supports 3rd party controllers - www.cnet.com/...
      • VLC Media Player will be coming to the new Apple TV - www.imore.com/...
      • RELATED - Amazon remove Apple TV & Google ChromeCast from their store and market place - www.macobserver.com/...
    • iPad Mini gets quietly updated - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple quietly lowers iCloud pricing - tidbits.com/...
  3. iOS 9 - www.imore.com/...
    • Works as far back as the iPhone 4S and iPad 2 - arstechnica.com/... & arstechnica.com/...
    • Content blockers - www.macobserver.com/...
      • The Peace Fiasco - www.marco.org/...&utmcontent=FeedBurner&utmmedium=referral&utm_source=loopinsight.com)
      • Apple propels an Ad-Blocking Cottage Industry - www.wsj.com/...
    • App Thinning - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple change how Enterprise apps are installed, closing a loophole exploited by malware - www.imore.com/...
  4. WatchOS 2 - www.imore.com/... & www.imore.com/...
  5. OS X El Capitan released
    • Apple's list of new features - www.apple.com/...
    • Detailed review from Ars Technica - arstechnica.com/...
    • Overview of security features - www.intego.com/...
    • Instructions for making an El Capitain boot drive - arstechnica.com/...
    • Office 2016 seems to have problems with El Capitain - www.imore.com/...
  6. Apple re-vamp their privacy policy - social.techcrunch.com/...
Quick Stories
  • Former Boeing CFO James Bell joins Apple's Board - www.imore.com/...
  • Apple Music Launches in China - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Apple Q4 earnings call will be on October 27 - www.imore.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 26 (October 2015)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Nick Riley - @spligosh
  • Gazmaz from the My Mac Podcast - @gazmaz
  • Chuck Joiner from MacVoices - @chuckjoiner

The show starts with a quick look at some interesting numbers and a quick review of the month's legal news before getting stuck into the five main stories of the month: 'chip gate', Apple's Q4 earnings call, new desktop hardware from Apple (iMacs, keyboards, trackpads & mice), the new Apple TV, and a collection of security-related stories. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in October.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP26-October2015.mp3"]
Notable Numbers
  • Android Development 30% more expensive than iOS development - infinum.co/...
  • Only 5% of Mac users at IBM required technical support, compared to 40% of Windows users - appleinsider.com/...
  • Every PC swapped for a Mac saves IBM $270 - www.zdnet.com/...
Legal Latest
  • As requested by the DOJ, Judge Cote did not expand the term for Apple's Anti-Trust monitor beyond the originally decreed two years, so his time at Apple is done - www.macobserver.com/...
  • As expected, Apple asked the US Supreme Court to review the eBook Price Fixing case - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Apple loses paint law suit to University of Wisconsin - daringfireball.net/...
  • Apple & GT Advanced reach a deal - ending their long-running dispute - www.imore.com/...
Main Stories
  1. 'chip gate'
    • Apple have two suppliers for their A9 chips - Samsung & TSMC. Both manufacturers chips are a little different, even in physical size.
    • researchers found that in certain very specific situations, the Samsung chips have 10% lower battery life
    • Apple, and independent researchers say that in realistic tests, the difference is much smaller, 2 to 3%, which is entirely within industry norms - arstechnica.com/... & www.consumerreports.org/...
  2. Apple's Q4 earnings call - another record quarter to wrap up a record year - www.macobserver.com/..., www.imore.com/... & www.apple.com/...
    • The numbers:
      • Q4 revenue of $51.5Bn (up from $42.1Bn YAQ)
      • Q4 earnings of $11.1Bn, or $1.96 per diluted share (up from $8.5Bn, or $1.42 YAQ)
      • Annual revenue of $234Bn (up 28% YOY)
      • Apple will pay a $0.52 dividend on Nov12 2015
      • Apple sold 48M iPhones in Q4 (up 36% 39.2M YAQ)
      • Apple sold 9.9M iPads in Q4 (down 20% from 12.3M YAQ)
      • apple sold 5.7M Macs in Q4 (down 4% from 5.5M YAQ)
    • During call, Tim Cook mentions that Apple have a $25Bn enterprise business - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Tim also said that 30% of customers replacing a smart phone with an iPhone in the quarter were replacing an Android with an iPhone - www.macobserver.com/...
    • A transcript of all Tim's comments on the call - www.imore.com/...
    • Venture Beat highlight 11 interesting detail in Apple's SEC filing - venturebeat.com/...
  3. New Apple Desktop Hardware
    • Apple refreshes the iMac lineup with an updated 5K model, and a new 4K model - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple releases new Magic Keyboard, Magic Trackpad 2, and Magic Mouse 2 - www.imore.com/...
  4. New Apple TVs ship
    • Hands-on review by Jim Dalrymple - www.loopinsight.com/...
    • Plex app arrives in ATV App Store - www.macobserver.com/...
    • BBC iPlayer coming to ATV - www.macobserver.com/...
  5. Apple, Security & Privacy:
    • Tim Cook tackles the importance of encryption in NPR interview - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple comes out against the Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act (CISA) in the US - www.imore.com/...
    • Tim Cook blasts encryption back doors at WSJDLive - arstechnica.com/...
    • RELATED - "Apple can't Decrypt your iPhone: Why it Matters" - www.macworld.com/...
    • A new security exploit brokerage company offers a million dollars for an iOS hack, and pays out. They will now sell the attack to world governments and other trusted customers, but not share it with Apple, because they want iOS to remain insecure for as long as possible - tidbits.com/...
Quick Stories
  • Apple offers Restricted Stock Units to all Apple employees - 9to5mac.com/...
  • Apple Music now has 6.5M paying customers - arstechnica.com/...
  • iWork apps get updated, and iWork for iCloud exits beta - www.imore.com/... & arstechnica.com/...
  • Apple acknowledges MBP anti-reflective coating issue - www.imore.com/...
  • The Steve Jobs movie is out, but there was too much real news to dedicate time to it.

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 27 (November 2015)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Allister Jenks - @zkarj
  • Dr. Robert Carter from the Tech Doctor Podcast - @robert_carter
  • Tim Robertson from the Tech Fan Podcast - @mymac

The show starts with a quick look at some interesting Apple-related numbers released in November before moving on to a quick review of the month's legal news. The five main stories for the month were: The iPad Pro, a good month for Apple Pay, Amazon coming to the new Apple TV, Adobe's moves away from Flash, and finally Tim Cook's comments that Apple will not merge iOS and OS X. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in November.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP27-November2015.mp3"]
Notable Numbers
  • Apple's share of global smartphone profits up from 85% last year to 94%, while only selling 14% of total volume - appleinsider.com/...
  • Apple spend much less on R&D (as a percentage of revenue) but get as good or better outcomes - www.bloomberg.com/...
  • Consumer Reports study finds Apple laptops the most reliable and most satisfying - www.consumerreports.org/... & www.zdnet.com/...
  • Interesting numbers of why people who are don't like the Apple Watch are dissatisfied with it - techpinions.com/...
  • In a notice to developers about the App Store's closing dates over the holidays, Apple threw in a sentence to say that the App Store has crossed 100Bn downloads - developer.apple.com/...
Legal Latest
  • A US Federal Judge has dismissed a class-action suit against Apple by Apple Store employees over un-paid time spent on enforced bag searches - www.imore.com/...
  • US Appeals Court shoots down Samsung's latest appeal in the Apple -v- Samsung saga - next step is probably the US Supreme Court - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Samsung agrees to pay Apple $548M in damages, though reserves the right to ask for it back if it wins future appeals - www.fosspatents.com/...
  • British man successfully sues Apple for deleting his data without asking him if he had a backup - nakedsecurity.sophos.com/...
  • German Government launches anti-trust investigation into audiobook agreement between Apple & Amazon - www.imore.com/...
  • Book sellers and authors back Apple in their eBook Price Fixing Appeal - www.macobserver.com/...
Main Stories
  1. the iPad Pros ship
    • iFixit teardown find that the iPad Pro supports USB 3, but you'll need an adapter that doesn't exist yet - www.imore.com/...
    • John Gruber's detailed review - daringfireball.net/...
    • Serenity Caldwell compares the drawing capabilities of the iPad Pro and Surface Book - www.loopinsight.com/...
    • Apple is working to fix an issue that causes some iPad Pros to become unresponsive - www.imore.com/... & support.apple.com/...
    • A wonderful satyrical piece by Fraser Spiers - "Can the MacBook Pro Replace Your iPad" - www.speirs.org/...
  2. A Good Month for Apple Pay
    • Apple Pay now supports nearly 800 US banks - www.imore.com/...
    • Square rolls out new ApplePay enabled contactless readers - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple Pay coming to Dominos and Cinnabon in the US - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple Pay comes to TSB & Tesco Bank in the UK - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple Pay comes to Canada & Australia via American Express - www.imore.com/...
    • According to anonymous sources within the Chinese banking system, Apple Pay will Launch in China in February 2015, including four of the country's major banks - http://www.macobserver.com/tmo/article/apple-targets-february-for-china-apple-pay-launch
  3. Amazon apparently making a video app for new ATV - arstechnica.com/...
  4. Adobe moves to deprecate Flash - Fash Professional CC becomes Animate CC, and Adobe advise that it is best to use web standards when ever possible rather than flash - www.theverge.com/... & blogs.adobe.com/...
  5. Tim Cook says iOS and OS X will not merge - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Said in Ireland while visiting to announce 1,000 jobs in Apple's Cork office - www.macobserver.com/...
Quick Stoires
  • Steve Jobs movie is a flop - dropped from cinemas - www.cultofmac.com/...
  • A beta version of Apple Musics released for Android - www.imore.com/...
  • Tim Cook will receive the Ripple of Hope Award from the Robert F. Kennedy Center for Justice & Human Rights on December 8 for his work on behalf of social change - recode.net/...
    • Related - Tim Cook's letter to staff on the racist incident in an Australian Apple Store - www.buzzfeed.com/...
  • As previously promised - Apple have open-sourced Swift - arstechnica.com/...
  • Register your kids for Apple's 2015 Hours of Code - www.imore.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 28 (December 2015)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Guy Serle from the My Mac Podcast - @Macparrot
  • Gazmaz from the My Mac Podcast - @gazmaz
  • Nick Riley - @spligosh
  • Victor Cajiao from the TerraTech Podcast - @victorcajiao

The show starts with a quick look at some interesting Apple-related numbers released in December before moving on to a quick review of the month's legal news. The five main stories for the month were: the fight over encryption, executive team changes at Apple, the Apple iPhone battery case, some mobile payment developments, and the abandonment of Apple's talks with the TV networks. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in December.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP28-December2015.mp3"]
Notable Numbers
  • Apple says Apple Maps now used 3x more often than it's next leading competitor (presumably Google Maps) - www.imore.com/...
Legal Latest
  • Apple reaches €318M settlement with Italian government in tax investigation. This does not end the country's criminal investigation into Apple executives though - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Apple -v- Samsung:
    • Samsung agrees to pay Apple $548M, but reserves the right to ask for it back if any of the patents get overturned - www.fosspatents.com/...
    • Samsung files a motion requesting the US Supreme Court review the case - www.fosspatents.com/...
    • Apple files a motion for supplementary damages in it's case against Samsung - these damages are for interest on money awarded to Apple but not paid promptly, and for continued use of the patented technology after the judgement - www.macobserver.com/...
    • BGR reminds us that fighting this case has forced Appel to make public a whole lot of internal secrets, including pictures of iPhone prototypes - bgr.com/...
  • Apple & Ericsson end their patent fight with a Patent Licensing deal - www.macobserver.com/...
Main Stories
  1. The Battle over Privacy heats up, and the UK is the front-line of the battle
    • Apple lobbies the British government directly, proposing changes to the controversial Investigatory Power Bill which is making it's way through the British parliamentary process - www.imore.com/... & www.macobserver.com/...
    • Tech industry group warns that current wording of the bill would allow the government to hijack toys to spy on people - nakedsecurity.sophos.com/...
    • Meanwhile in the US, the director of the FBI calls for tech companies to 'change their business models' so they're no longer selling privacy - theintercept.com/...
    • We've been here before - Ars Technica reminds us of what we should remember from the disastrous clipper chip back in the 1990s - arstechnica.com/...
    • A good FAQ on the wider topic from Ars Technica - arstechnica.com/...
  2. Executive Team changes at Apple - Jeff Williams promoted to COO, Phil Schiller put in charge of App stores - www.apple.com/... & arstechnica.com/...
  3. Apple launch iPhone battery case - Apple Fandom collectively lose their minds!
    • www.imore.com/...
    • A good description of the advantages of the hump - www.imore.com/...
    • John Gruber's thoughts on the case - daringfireball.net/...
  4. Mobile Payment developments:
    • Apple announce Chinese Apple Pay deal - will partner with Union Pay in China as soon as regulatory approval is granted - hopefully in 2016 - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Walmart launch Walmart Pay - www.imore.com/...
    • Google Wallet updated to allow sending of money to friends via SMS (previously only via email) - www.imore.com/...
    • Target rumoured to be working on it's own mobile payment system which may or may not be launched, and if it is, it may or may not happen in 2016 - www.imore.com/...
  5. It's rumoured that Apple have suspended talks on their rumoured US TV streaming plans because TV companies were insisting on bundling their channels - www.bloomberg.com/... & www.imore.com/...
Quick Stories
  • Mozilla kills the FireFox OS - social.techcrunch.com/...
  • The Steve Jobs biopic may have tanked at the box office, but it did get four Golden Globe nominations - www.imore.com/...
  • Apple raises iTunes Match and iCloud Music song cap from 25K to 100K - www.macworld.com/...
  • As promised, Apple Music comes to Sonos - www.macobserver.com/...
  • BBC iPlayer comes to the new Apple TV in the UK - www.imore.com/...
  • CNN airs controversial Steve Jobs documentary The Man in the Machine on Jan 3 - www.macobserver.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 29 (January 2016)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Gazmaz from the My Mac Podcast - @gazmaz
  • Lynda Gousha - @llg4cdg
  • Scott Willsey - @scottaw

The show starts with a quick look at some interesting Apple-related numbers released in January before moving on to a quick review of the month's legal news. The six main stories for the month were: Apple's Q1 2016 earnings call, the rumoured demise of the 3.5mm jack, Donald Trump's comments on Apple, developments in the on-going encryption/privacy war, the partial demise of iAd, and Amnesty International's report on child labour in Apple, Samsung & Sony's supply chain. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in January.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP29-January2016.mp3"]
Notable Numbers
  • Research by Juniper finds that the Apple Watch has captured 52% of the smartwatch market - www.imore.com/...
  • Numbers from Custora show that 77% of mobile online shopping was done from iOS, with only 23% from Android - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Apple Store has biggest holiday ever with record $1.1Bn in revenue - www.macobserver.com/... & www.apple.com/...
  • Court documents from Oracle's case against Google over Android's uses of Java reveals that Google paid Apple $1Bn to be the default search engine on iOS for 2014 - www.imore.com/...
Legal Latest
  • Apple wins injunction against obsolete Samsung devices - www.imore.com/...
Main Stories
  1. Apple's Q1 2016 Earnings Call - www.apple.com/...
    • Transcript of the call - www.imore.com/...
    • The Numbers
      • Revenue: $75.9Bn up 2% from YAQ (at constant currency would have had an extra $5Bn so would have been up 8%) - international sales accounted for 66% of revenue
      • Net Income (Profit): $18.4Bn (about same as YAQ)
      • Gross Margin: 40.1% (was 39.9% YAQ)
      • Earnings per diluted share: $3.28 (up from $3.06 YAQ) - Apple will pay a dividend of $0.58 per share
      • iPhone Unit Sales: 74.8M (about same as YAQ) - that's over 34,000 iPhones an hour!
      • iPad Unit Sales: 16.1M (down 25% YAQ)
      • Mac Unit Sales: 5.3M (down 4% YAQ)
      • Other Products (includes Apple Watch): $4.5Bn revenue (up 62% YAQ)
    • There are now a billion iOS devices in use (including Apple TVs) - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Apple's Guidance for Q2:
      • Revenue between $50Bn and $53Bn (was $58Bn last year)
      • Gross Margins between 39% and 39.5%
    • Tim Cook expects iPhone unit to decline in Q2 - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Tim Cook reiterated Apple's policy of investing during downturns - www.macobserver.com/...
    • iPhones sales in India up 76% - www.imore.com/...
  2. The rumour mill is awash with rumours that the next iPhone will not have a 3.5mm jack - www.imore.com/...
    • Vague Statements in the Cirrus Logic earnings call are being interpreted as hints that the earbuds in the iPhone 7 will be noise-cancelling - www.imore.com/...
  3. Donald Trump says he will get Apple to build their 'damn computers and things' in America, and impose a 35% tariff on companies manufacturing outside the US - www.macobserver.com/...
    • 'How Donald Trump Got Everything Wrong About Apple in One Sentence' - recode.net/...
    • Gruber on why Apple (and indeed all the tech giants) manufacture in China - daringfireball.net/...
    • Gruber explains why the one computer Apple do manufacture in America is the exception not the rule - daringfireball.net/...
    • Brazil tried what the Donald is presumably proposing (as usual, he's big on what, but small on how) - daringfireball.net/...
  4. The Encryption Wars Continue
    • Tim Cook reportedly berates White House officials for being 'wishy-washy' on encryption at a private meeting in the White House - theintercept.com/...
    • New York Law Maker proposes bill to ban sale of backdoor-free smartphones - nakedsecurity.sophos.com/...
    • A Californian law maker proposes a similar bill - arstechnica.com/...
    • The Dutch government rule out mandating back doors - nakedsecurity.sophos.com/...
    • France follows suit - nakedsecurity.sophos.com/...
    • Former NSA boss General Michael Hayden says FBI is wrong on encryption - money.cnn.com/...
    • Current NSA chief Admiral Mike Rogers takes a pro-encryption stance "encryption is foundational to the future" - theintercept.com/...
    • The Woodrow Wilson International Centre for Scholars is developing a Congressional Cybersecurity Lab to help educate US law makers and their staff on all things cybersecurity - www.macobserver.com/...
    • AT&T CEO won't join Apple in the fight for cryptography - arstechnica.com/...
      • Gruber points out that AT&T helped the US spy on the internet - daringfireball.net/...
    • A great article by Rich Mogull on TidBITS explaining why this debate matters, and why Apple is front-and-centre in it - tidbits.com/...
  5. Apple Cutting back iAds
    • Apple has announced it will discontinue the iAd App Network on June 30 - 9to5mac.com/...
    • Apple reportedly disbanding iAd Sales team - www.buzzfeed.com/...
  6. Amnesty International expose the long and convoluted path through which Cobalt mined by children makes it's way into batteries used by companies like Apple, Samsung and Sony - www.bbc.com/... & www.amnesty.org/...
Quick Stories
  • Apple ends it's ad-supported iTunes Radio offering - Apple Music Radio, Beats One, or bust! - www.imore.com/...
  • Apple is recalling some European power adaptors (included in their world travel kit too) because in rare cases they can break and pose a shock hazard - www.macobserver.com/...
  • tvOS 9.1.1 brings Podcasts back to the Apple TV - tidbits.com/...
  • Steve Jobs movie does well at awards:
    • Kate winslet & Aaron Sorkin win Golden Globes - www.imore.com/...
    • Kate Winslet & Michael Fassbender pick up Oscar Nominations - www.imore.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 30 (February 2016)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Guy Serle from the My Mac Podcast - @Macparrot
  • Dr. Robert Carter from the Tech Doctor Podcast - @robert_carter
  • Nick Riley - @spligosh

The show starts with a quick look at some interesting Apple-related numbers released in February before moving on to a quick review of the month's legal news. The three main stories for the month are: Apple's legal battle with the FBI, Error 53, and Apple Pay's launch in China. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in February.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP30-February2016.mp3"]
Notable Numbers
  • According to IDC, Apple's iPad Pro out-sold Microsoft's Surface Pro over the holidays - Apple are estimated to have sold 2M iPad Pros, and Microsoft 1.6M Surface Pros - www.imore.com/...
  • Apple Pay passed another major milestone - now available at over 2 million locations - www.businesstimes.com.sg/...
  • Strategy Analytics estimates that there were about 8.1 million smart watches shipped in the 2015 holiday quarter, and that about 5.1 million of them were Apple Watches - www.imore.com/...
Legal Latest
  • VirnetX -v- Apple retrial
    • VirnetX awarded $625M by East-Texas jury - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Apple have filed for a miss-trial - www.imore.com/...
  • Samsung -v- Apple II
    • Samsung have won their appeal - the $120 jury verdict has been overturned, the panel of appeals judges finding that Samsung did not infringe one of the patents in question, and that the other two are invalid - www.reuters.com/... & arstechnica.com/...
Main Stories
  1. FBI -v- Apple
    • The Sequence of Events
      • Apple ordered to create a custom version of iOS that strips out critical security features that form part of the encryption system on iPhones - www.reuters.com/...
      • A direct link to the court order: assets.documentcloud.org/...
      • Tim Cook writes an open letter explaining why Apple will challenge the order - www.apple.com/...
      • The US DOJ files papers in support of the FBI requesting that Apple be forced to comply with the order - www.macobserver.com/...
      • Apple confirmed they have been helping the FBI, that they have handed over iCloud backups, and that their plan to get the data via a new iCloud backup was foiled by the iCould password being reset by county officials AFTER the San Bernardino attacks (later revealed to be at the request of the FBI) - www.macobserver.com/... & arstechnica.com/...
      • A petition has been started on WhiteHouse.gov asking the government to stop asking Apple for back doors - www.macobserver.com/...
      • Tim Cook follows up open letter with letter to employees and public FAQ - www.imore.com/...
      • FBI Director James Comey publishes open letter - www.macobserver.com/... & daringfireball.net/...
      • Apple secures the services of legendary attorney Ted Olsen - www.imore.com/...
      • FBI director admits Apple case could set precedent - www.macobserver.com/...
      • San Bernardino police chief admits that there's a "reasonably good chance that there is nothing of any value on the phone" - arstechnica.com/...
      • The US DOJ has 9 more iPhones they want unlocked, and Manhattan DA Cyrus Vance says he has about 175 he wants unlocked - www.nytimes.com/...
      • Apple file their response to the court order, citing both first and fifth amendment rights - tidbits.com/...
      • Apple & FBI testify before congress - www.macobserver.com/... & nakedsecurity.sophos.com/...
      • Apple files a formal objection to court order (in addition to their previous filed response) - www.imore.com/...
      • A judge in a similar case in NY finds that the FBI can't use the All Writs Act to force Apple to create a custom OS to facilitate hacking - www.macobserver.com/...
      • Congressman Jolly (Republican, FL) has introduced a bill to ban the government from buying Apple phones - arstechnica.com/...
      • A French law maker has proposed a law that would fine Apple & Google €1m if they refuse to hack smartphones - www.thelocal.fr/...
      • The San Bernardino District Attorney invents a baseless "dormant cyber pathogen" that might exist on the phone, though provides zero evidence to substantiate his invented concept - arstechnica.com/... & arstechnica.com/...
      • Amicus Briefs and letters start flowing in in support of Apple - Apple start an online list so we can all keep track - www.apple.com/...
        • Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Facebook & others - www.imore.com/...
        • UN Special Rapporteur for Freedom of Expression David Kaye - www.buzzfeed.com/...
        • The American Civili Liberties Union (ACLU) - 9to5mac.com/...
        • AT&T - www.imore.com/...
      • Samsung state their position, which is in line with Apple's, but do not explicitly support Apple - www.imore.com/...
      • A few amicus briefs also filed in favour of the FBI, but not many Philip Elmer-DeWitt puts collates a lit of amicus briefs both for and against Apple - ped30.com/...
    • Notable Expert Opinions
      • Security maven Bruce Schneier comes out in favour of Apple "either everyone gets security, or no one does" - www.washingtonpost.com/...
      • Security researcher Rich Mogull explains why the core question raised is "do we have a right to security" - securosis.com/...
      • Another piece from Rich Mogull explain why this is is the most important civil rights case for a decade - "the FBI need the precedent more than the evidence" - www.macworld.com/...
      • General Hayden, former director of the ICA and NSA has reiterated his support for unbreakable encryption, because it makes Americans "more secure" - www.macobserver.com/...
      • Security researcher Jonathan Zdziarski (we've talked about his work before) explains that what the FBI is asking for is MUCH more onerous than you might think - www.zdziarski.com/...
      • Security researcher Nicholas Weaver explains why this is not so much a slippery slope as a cliff - www.lawfareblog.com/...
      • Brian Krebs gives his view of the case - krebsonsecurity.com/...
    • Other Notable Opinions:
      • Mark Cuban gives Apple "a standing ovation" for their stand against the FBI, and explains why it is imperative that Apple win this case - blogmaverick.com/... & blogmaverick.com/...
      • Dan Goodin explains why it is appropriate to call what the FBI as demanding a back door - arstechnica.com/...
      • The New Your Times editorial board chimes in with support for Apple - www.nytimes.com/...
      • US congressman Ted Lieu from California comes out in support of Apple, asks the FBI to stop trying to force Apple to create a compromised version of iOS - www.macobserver.com/... & lieu.house.gov/...
      • John Gruber points out that in a 1987 ruling Justice Scalia came down in favour of law enforcement not getting everything they want when there are larger liberties at steak - "The constitution sometimes insulates the criminality of a few in order to protect the privacy of us all" - daringfireball.net/...
      • The New Yorker explains how dangerous a precedent it would set if the interpretation of the All Writs Act were expanded as far as the FBI are trying to push it - www.newyorker.com/...
      • Chairman of ThoughtWorks publishes open letter in support of Apple - www.thoughtworks.com/...
      • John Gruber points out that there have alway been "warrant proof places" - daringfireball.net/...
    • Other Relevant Links
      • No - Apple has not done this 70 times before - social.techcrunch.com/...
      • A nice FAQ on the whole thing from iMore - www.imore.com/...
  2. Error 53 - nakedsecurity.sophos.com/...
    • Apple acknowledged the problem, and explained that it was caused by failed TouchID security checks - appleinsider.com/...
    • A class action suit was launched - arstechnica.com/...
    • Apple issues an update to iOS & iTunes that will fix Error 53 and stop it happening again. They also explain that the error bricking phones was not intentional, and apologised. For security reasons, Touch ID sensors that fail their integrity checks will still be bricked, but NOT the entire phones - social.techcrunch.com/...
    • iFixIt Confirm that Apple's updates do indeed un-brick iPhones bricked by Error 53 - ifixit.org/...
  3. Apple Pay Launches in China
    • Initial demand was high, and some users ran into problems when registrations failed to complete - tidbits.com/...
    • Two days after launch there were reportedly over 3 millions cards added - www.imore.com/...
Quick Stories
  • Apple rolls out a 2013 Mac Pro graphics repair program - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Apple rolls out a replacement program for some USB-C charging cables - www.imore.com/...
  • Apple Support joins Twitter - www.macobserver.com/...
  • FoxCon nearly bought Sharp this month, but put the purchase on hold at the very last second, reportedly over surprise liabilities - www.macobserver.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 31 (March 2016)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Adam Christianson from The Mac Cast - @maccast
  • Allister Jenks - @zkarj
  • Nick Riley - @spligosh

There were no notable numbers month, so the show starts with a quick review of the month's legal news. The six main stories for the month are: Apple's legal battle with the FBI, Apple's March special event, 40 years of Apple and 15 years of OS X, North Carolina's LGBT discrimination law, and some new on Apple News. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in March.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP31-March2016.mp3"]
Legal Latest
  • Apple lost an important patent case in Germany - it may have to license video technology from a Swiss company, or strip some video streaming services from its products - www.reuters.com/...
  • The US Supreme Court will hear Samsung's appeal in the 2011 case they lost to Apple - this will be the first design patent case the court has heard in a century - www.macobserver.com/... & arstechnica.com/...
  • The Apple -v- Samsung damages re-trial that was due to start on March 28th has been put on hold pending the supreme court's ruling - www.macobserver.com/...
Main Stories
  1. Apple -v- FBI
    • the FBI become openly hostile towards Apple - threaten to go after their source code and private key if Apple don't write GovtOS - www.theguardian.com/...
    • As expected, the DOJ have appealed the similar case they lost in NY recently - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Former CIA director James Woolsey comes out in support of Apple's side of the argument (not explicitly in support of Apple) - www.imore.com/...
    • Richard Clarke, former National Coordinator for Security, Infrastructure Protection and Counter-terrorism for the United States, comes out in support of Apple, slamming the FBI's pursuit of weaker encryption - www.macobserver.com/... & daringfireball.net/...
    • Harvard Law professor Susan Crawford says the Law is Clear - the FBI cannot make Apple rewrite its OS - daringfireball.net/...
    • In a surprise move, the FBI have changed the hearing scheduled for Tuesday 22 March into an Evidentially Hearing (being interpreted by commentators as a sign of weakness) - www.macobserver.com/.... Apple's product security expert will give evidence at the hearing - www.theverge.com/...
    • The judge in the case makes it clear that despite the FBI's rhetoric, Apple were at no point 'flouting' the order - www.politico.com/...
    • At the last minute, the FBI canceled the March 22 hearing - they believed they had found a way into the phone without Apple's help, and wanted to give it a go before continuing with the case - www.macobserver.com/...
    • The FBI succeeded in breaking into the phone, and ended the case - nakedsecurity.sophos.com/...
    • We don't officially know how the FBI broke into the phone, but it seems clear it was this Israeli security firm Cellebrite who broke into the phone, presumably using a zero-day exploit - www.macobserver.com/..., arstechnica.com/... & www.bloomberg.com/...
    • Apple released a statement on the dismissal to the media - www.loopinsight.com/...
    • Apple requested a delay in the other, similar, case in New York, arguing that the FBI should use the same method they used in the San Bernardino case, the case is now on hold until April 11 - www.macobserver.com/... & www.reuters.com/...
    • The EFF warns that the battle for privacy is far from over with the dropping of this one case - www.macobserver.com/...
    • As if to underline the ACLU's point, the US DOJ vows to continue using the courts to compel tech companies to defeat encryption - www.macobserver.com/...
    • The ACLU released an interactive map showing the 63 times the All Writs act has been used against Apple & Google - www.macobserver.com/... & arstechnica.com/...
    • The FBI have agreed to use their new iPhone unlocking technique in an Arkansas homicide case - bigstory.ap.org/...
    • The next battle in this bigger war may already be underway, in secret, in a Boston court - motherboard.vice.com/...
    • The emotions in this on-going fight get ratcheted up again as an Italian father begs Apple to help unlock his dead 13 year old son's iPhone to get the photos off it - arstechnica.com/...
    • Related Stories
      • It's official, the NSA will start sharing data it said it was only collecting to prevent terrorism with other US law enforcement agencies - www.washingtonpost.com/...
      • Apple reportedly designs its own servers to be sure there are no snooping devices embedded in them - arstechnica.com/...
      • Reddit's Warrant Canary just died - boingboing.net/...
      • The NYT is reporting that the attackers in Paris last November used burner phones to evade detection, not encryption - arstechnica.com/...
      • Bloomberg did some great reporting on the back-story to the San Bernardino case - San Bernardino was when a battle that had been going on for years finally became public - www.bloomberg.com/...
  2. Apple's March Media Event
    • Apple is making good progress on it's environmental goals
      • Apple has a robot called Liam for disassembling iPhones for recycling - mashable.com/...
    • Apple introduce CareKit, and open source framework for health apps - arstechnica.com/...
    • The new Apple TV gets an OS update featuring folders and Siri enhancements - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Apple Watch Sport gets a $50 price drop, and Apple release new Nylon bands, and add more colours to their regular sports band range - www.macobserver.com/...
      • Apple launches a cool new interactive Apple Watch gallery to help you pick your watch and bands - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple release iOS 9.3, including powerful new features for the education sector, and a new Night Shift mode - www.macobserver.com/... & www.apple.com/...
      • There were some initial problems with iOS 9.3 bricking some older iPads, Apple released an updated version of the OS to fix this problem - www.macobserver.com/...
      • Some users also experienced a bug clicking on links that seemed to be related to iOS 9's Universal Links feature - Apple released iOS 9.3.1 to address this bug - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Apple introduce the iPhone SE - www.macobserver.com/...
      • According to CNBC iPhone SE pre-orders in China topped 3.4M - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Apple release a 9.7" iPad Pro - www.macobserver.com/...
    • We now know both the iPhone SE and 9.7" iPad Pro have 2GB of RAM - the same as the iPhone 6S, but less than the 4GB in the 12.9" iPad Pro - arstechnica.com/...
    • RELATED - Apple released a new app for the ATV 4 for Apple Events - www.macobserver.com/...
  3. 40 years of Apple, and 15 years of OS X
    • March 24 2016 was OS X's 15th birthday - A nice look back at OS X's beginning - www.computerworld.com/...
    • On April 1 Apple turned 40 - a nice retrospective - www.macrumors.com/...
    • Apple flew the Mac team's famous pirate flag to celebrate the company's 40th birthday - appleinsider.com/...
  4. Apple released it's latest Supplier Responsibility Report - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple carried out 640 audits covering 1.6M workers in 25 countries
    • Apple found 97% compliance with it's 60 hour work week limit (an 'unprecedented number' in the industry according to Apple)
    • Since 2008 Apple has trained over 9.2M workers in their rights (3M in 2015)
    • Apple graduated 1,000 workers through their Supplier Employee Education and Development program (SEED)
    • Apple's supply chain lowered it's carbon emissions by more than 13,800 metric tons
    • Apple's supply chain diverted more than 73,000 metric tons of waste away from landfills
    • Apple is making progress on so-called conflict-minerals, all their smelters and refiners are now being monitored by an outside 3rd party - www.buzzfeed.com/...
  5. Apple and other tech companies (including Google & Facebook) challenge North Carolina on a new law enabling LGBT discrimination which was rushed through as an "emergency measure" - www.macobserver.com/...
    • The law out-laws local anti-discrimination bills which cities like Charlotte have passed, and makes it illegal for trans people to use bathrooms for genders that are not their birth gender
    • Being denied access to bathrooms is no small thing - as Zach Stafford explains in the Guardian, it is a big deal, and will drive up the already high suicide rate among trans teens - www.theguardian.com/...
  6. Apple News Quietly Evolves
    • Apple have opened up publishing through the platform to everyone, even bloggers - www.computerworld.com/...
    • Business Insider reports that Apple have the back-end tech in place to start including 'native' ads (sponsored posts) in News - uk.businessinsider.com/...
Quick Stories
  • Foxconn to buy out Sharp after all, but for $3.5Bn rather than $5Bn - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Apple finally allows re-downloads of audio books purchased from the iTunes store - www.mcelhearn.com/...
  • Apple releases a new Technology Preview version of Safari - arstechnica.com/...
  • Apple strikes a deal with the MLB to provide all teams with iPad Pros - www.theverge.com/...
  • Apple tells an EU panel that it 'every cent' due in Ireland - www.bloomberg.com/...

Adam at the UK Gadget Show in 2005 - www.maccast.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 32 (April 2016)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Chuck Joiner from MacVoices - @chuckjoiner
  • Nick Riley - @spligosh
  • Lynda Gousha from the Silicon Valley MUG - @llg4cdg

The show starts with a quick look at some notable numbers that were released in April. The five main stories for the month are: the on-going encryption wars, Apple's Q2 2016 earnings call, the update to the 12" MacBook, Apple's battles in China and India, and TIME declaring the iPhone the most influential gadget of all time. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in April.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP32-April2016.mp3"]
Notable Numbers
  • ID & Gartner numbers agree - the PC market is in decline, but Macs are declining slower than the rest, resulting in a rising market share - now between 7 and 7.5% - www.macobserver.com/... & www.imore.com/...
Main Stories
  1. The Encryption Wars Continue
    • The San Bernardino Case
      • FBI discloses their secret hack to senators - www.imore.com/...
      • FBI Director James Comey says the hack the FBI bought can only attack a 'narrow slice of phones' - iPhone 5S and newer are not affected (editorial from Bart - that strongly implies the secure element protects from the hack) - www.imore.com/...
      • At a security conference in London, FBI director Comey says the FBI paid a lot for the San Bernardino iPhone hack - "More than I will make in the remainder of this job, which is seven years and four months for sure" - Comey's salary is public information, so if you do the math, that gives you a number greater than $1.3M - arstechnica.com/...
      • An anonymous FBI source later contradicted this number, saying the FBI paid less than $1m for the hack - www.imore.com/...
      • New reporting form the Washington Post calls into question earlier reports that it was security firm Cellebrite that hacked the San Bernardino iPhone for the FBI - www.imore.com/... & www.washingtonpost.com/...
      • Law enforcement say they found nothing of value of Syed Farook's iPhone - www.macobserver.com/...
      • The FBI decides not to share the details of the iPhone hack they bought with Apple - www.reuters.com/...
    • The New York Case
      • The US DOJ decided to proceeding with it's appeal - www.imore.com/...
      • The DOJ pulls the plug in the NYC case - they say someone gave them the passcode so they don't need Apple's help anymore - www.imore.com/...
    • The secret Boston case ends with a hollow victory for the FBI - Apple ordered to do what they already do, and not required to create a backdoor into iOS - www.macobserver.com/...
    • The Burr-Feinstein encryption bill is published - described by the tech world as 'Ludicrous, Dangerous, Technically Illiterate' and tech companies express 'deep concerns' - daringfireball.net/... & www.imore.com/...
    • RELATED - The White House will not back the Burr Feinstein bill - www.macobserver.com/...
    • The CA phone decryption bill has been defeated - www.sacbee.com/...
    • Apple & the FBI testify before congress again - http://www.imore.com/apple-fbi-head-back-congress-another-encryption-fight
    • RELATED - In the congressional hearings Apple confirm they were asked for their source code by the Chinese government, but they refused to hand it over - fortune.com/...
  2. Apple's Q2 2016 Earnings Call - www.apple.com/...
    • The Numbers:
      • Revenue: $50.6Bn (down 13% from $58Bn YAQ)
      • Net Income: $10.5Bn, or $1.9 per diluted share (down from $13.6Bn, or $2.33 per diluted share YAQ)
      • Gross Margins: 39.4% (down from 40.8% YAQ)
      • Unit Sales:
        • iPhone: 51.8M (down 16% from 61.2M YAQ)
        • iPad: 10.3M (down 19% from 12.6M YAQ)
        • Mac: 4M (down 12% from 4.6M YAQ)
      • International sales accounted for 67% of revenue
      • $50Bn added to investor return program - more shares will be bought back, and a higher dividend paid - $0.57 per share (up 10%)
      • Guidance for Q3:
        • Revenue between $41Bn and $43Bn
        • Gross Margins between 37.5% and 38%
      • Apple music now has 13M subscribers (up 2M from last earnings call) - www.macobserver.com/...
    • First year-over-year revenue decline in 13 years - tidbits.com/...
    • Apple meets own guidance, but misses Wall St. Expectations - www.macobserver.com/...
    • The results graphed in context - sixcolors.com/...
    • Transcript of Tim's contributions to the call - www.imore.com/...
    • Related:
      • Tim Cook interviewed on CNBC'sAMd Money with Jim Cramer - www.imore.com/...
      • What does Apple look like without the iPhone? - www.imore.com/...
      • John Gruber call for some perspective on the results - daringfireball.net/...
  3. Apple updates the 12" MacBook - www.imore.com/...
    • The new MacBook includes tamper-evident screws, so Apple know if you've been poking around inside - www.zdnet.com/...
    • RELATED - at the same time Apple released the updated MacBook, they also bumped the standard spec on the 13" MBA to 8GB of RAM - www.imore.com/...
  4. Apple's Battles in China & India
    • Apple denied permission to sell refurbished iPhones in India - www.bloomberg.com/...
    • Indian court rules that Apple cannot use the term 'Split View' in India due to a trademark violation - www.imore.com/...
    • Indian government panel recommends Apple be exempted from 30% sourcing requirements - a step towards Apple stores in India - tech.economictimes.indiatimes.com/...
    • Chinese Government shuts down iBooks and iTunes Movies in China - www.macobserver.com/...
    • A Chinese court rules that Apple nolonger has the exclusive rights to the iPhone name in China - a company that makes leather pouches and cases can use the name too - qz.com/...
    • Activist investor and Apple critic Carl Icahn sells his stake in Apple over concerns over Chinese government actions - www.reuters.com/...
  5. TIME puts the iPhone at the top of their list of the 50 most influential gadgets of all time (the Macintosh comes in at 3, the iPod at 9, the iPad at 25, and the iBook at 38) - time.com/...
Quick Stories
  • Former Apple exec and board member Bill "the coach" Campbell has passed away - Apple paid tribute to him on their home page - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Tim Cook joins the board of Robert F. Kennedy Human Rights - www.imore.com/...
  • Tim Cook named now of Time's 100 most influential people (again) - www.imore.com/...
  • CareKit makes it's debut with four apps, but no sign of it yet on Apple's open Source page - www.imore.com/... & developer.apple.com/...
  • Apple's support site gets a make-over - www.imore.com/...
  • Date set for WWDC 2016 - June 13 to 17 - developer.apple.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 33 (May 2016)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Chuck Joiner from MacVoices - @chuckjoiner
  • Allister Jenks - @zkarj
  • Gazmaz from the My Mac Podcast - @gazmaz

The show starts with a quick look at some notable numbers that were released in May, followed by a look at some Apple-related legal stories. The four main stories for the month are: Tim Cook's visit to India and China, CurrentC gets postponed again, Google's IO Conference, and Microsoft's streamlining of their phone business. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in May.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP33-May2016.mp3"]
Notable Numbers
  • Apple tops JD Power Tablet Customer Satisfaction Survey - www.jdpower.com/...
  • Despite calling for a boycott of Apple, Donald Trump's latest financial disclosure reports shows he has at least $1.1M of Apple Stock - www.imore.com/...
Legal Latest
  • Apple being sued by Patent holding company because the iPhone can make calls! (no, it's not April 1st, the US patent system really is that broken) - www.macobserver.com/...
  • VirtneX, who won a $626M patent suit against Apple over FaceTime & iMessage, requests those services be shut down - arstechnica.com/... & www.macobserver.com/...
  • Apple makes ground in its fight against a $533M verdict against it in favour of Smartflash - two patents at the centre of the case have been rules invalid - www.bloomberg.com/... & www.imore.com/...
Main Stories
  1. Tim Cook Goes to India & China
    • Apple announce software lab to be opened in Bengaluru - www.reuters.com/...
    • Tim meets with Indian Cellphone Carriers - www.imore.com/...
    • Apple opens Maps Development centre in Hyderabad, will create 4,000 jobs - www.imore.com/... & www.apple.com/...
    • In interview with Indian media, Tim Cook says Apple are in India for the next 1,000 years - www.thehindu.com/...
    • Tim Cook meets with Indian Prime Minister Modi - www.mercurynews.com/...
    • Apple release update to GarageBand with new Chinese instruments, Tim Cook jams with Chinese musician JJ Lin - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Apple failed to get waiver on India's 30% local sourcing rule - www.livemint.com/...
      • Apple might be able to get around this with a franchise strategy - www.bloomberg.com/...
    • In a meeting with Tim Cook, Chinese regulators stress the importance of security - www.reuters.com/...
    • Apple invests $1Bn in Didi - China's answer to Uber - www.macobserver.com/...
  2. MCX postpones CurrentC, lays off 30 employees - social.techcrunch.com/...
    • John Gruber translates the MCX press release from PR into English - daringfireball.net/...
  3. Google IO - tidbits.com/...
    • Google Now becomes Google Assistant
    • Google Home announced (Amazon Echo competitor)
    • Allo - a new cross-platform messaging app what has Google Assistant listening in by default (slated for simultaneous release on iOS & Android)
    • Duo - a new cross-platform FaceTime competitor (slated for simultaneous release on iOS & Android)
  4. Microsoft Streamlines Phone business - www.prnewswire.com/... & www.macobserver.com/...
    • Pulling out of consumer smartphone business to focus on enterprise
    • Cutting 1,850 jobs in the process
Quick stories
  • Apple teams up with SAP - www.reuters.com/...
  • Support for Burr Feinstein encryption bill evaporates - bill is seen as dead - www.macobserver.com/... & www.reuters.com/...
  • WWDC keynote set for 10am PT on June 13 - www.imore.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 34 (June 2016)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Guy Serle from the My Mac Podcast - @Macparrot
  • Dr. Robert Carter from the Tech Doctor Podcast - @robert_carter
  • Ewen Rankin from The British Tech Network - @EwenRankin
  • Nick Riley - @spligosh

The show starts with a few followups to some stories from May, before having a quick look at two Apple-related legal stories which broke in June. The five main stories are changes to the App store announced before WWDC, WWDC itself, the probable removal of the headphone jack from the next iPhone, Apple's withdrawal from the Republican National Convention in protest at Donald Trump, and Senator Warren's criticism of Apple and other tech companies for practices that make it hard for competition to thrive. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in June.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP34-June2016.mp3"]
Followups
  • India change the rules on local sourcing, ask Apple to re-submit their application - www.imore.com/...
  • China:
    • A local patent court in Beijing has found that Apple is violating a design patent owned by a local company. Apple are appealing, and all iPhone models remain on sale while the appeal is in process - arstechnica.com/...
      • The company who claims to own the patent proves very difficult to track down - www.cnbc.com/...
    • New regulations could co-opt Apple into the Chinese surveillance machine - the rules require that App Store operators keep records for 60 days, and that they inform the government about any 'postings' that contain illegal material - www.macobserver.com/...
  • CurrentC ends beta, and 'postpones' future releases indefinitely - consumerist.com/...
  • Walmart launches Walmart Pay in Alabama - www.imore.com/...
Legal Latest
  • Judge dismisses Error 53 iPhone 'bricking' lawsuit - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Man who claims to have invented the iPhone in 1992 sues Apple for $10bn - www.telegraph.co.uk/...
Main Stories
  1. Apple announces App Store changes - faster reviews, pad search ads, subscription pricing opened up, and reduction to 15% revenue share on subscriptions after first 12 months - www.imore.com/...
    • Interview with Phil Schiller on the changes - arstechnica.com/...
    • Another interview with Phil Schiller on the changes - daringfireball.net/...
    • Details of how search ads will work - www.imore.com/...
    • Google offer the same subscription revenue share, but without the first 12 months remaining at 70/30 - www.recode.net/...
  2. WWDC 2016
    • Keynote recap - tidbits.com/...
    • watchOS 3 - www.imore.com/...
      • Why watchOS 3 will be fast - tidbits.com/...
      • how watchOS 3 will make things better for wheel chair users - www.imore.com/...
    • TV OS 10 - www.imore.com/...
    • macOS Sierra - www.imore.com/...
      • Supported hardware - arstechnica.com/...
      • How to use Tabs in macOS Sierra - www.macworld.com/...
      • Gatekeeper updated to include Path Randomisation to properly close a security hole that has been just crudely bandaged until now - weblog.rogueamoeba.com/...
    • iOS 10
      • Details on SiriKit - arstechnica.com/...
      • How built-in App 'deletion' will work - www.imore.com/...
      • iOS 10 to support taking RAW photos - social.techcrunch.com/...
    • Apple Pay comes to the web
      • Stripe and Shopify to support Apple Pay on the web - www.imore.com/...
    • Differential Privacy - blog.cryptographyengineering.com/...
      • Even data collection with differential privacy will be opt-in - www.recode.net/...
    • Swift Playgrounds - tidbits.com/...
    • Apple give developers a preview of a new File System planned for release next year, which they are calling APFS - arstechnica.com/...
      • A detailed overview from Adam Leventhal (filesystem expert) - dtrace.org/...
      • A review from ZFS developer - arstechnica.com/...
    • Safari 10 on both iOS and OS X will get new more powerful extensions using Apple's newer App Extensions framework. This will allow App Store apps add functionality to Safari - appleinsider.com/...
    • The Apple Design Award winners for 2016 - www.imore.com/...
  3. Support grows for the rumour that the next iPhone will not have a headphone jack - now coming from the WSJ - arstechnica.com/...
    • Gruber compares the headphone jack to the floppy disk - daringfireball.net/...
    • The Verge have graphed the life-time of I/O standards on Apple devices - www.theverge.com/...
    • why the iPhone will not switch to USB-C - daringfireball.net/...
    • Sirius Logic has released a new hardware dev kit for creating lightning headphones - arstechnica.com/...
    • Bluetooth 5 announced - twice the speed and quadruple the range - will be out in late 2016 or early 2017 - www.imore.com/...
  4. Apple declines to offer support to GOP National Convention in protest of Donald Trump - www.politico.com/...
    • Historically, Apple (and many other corporations) have supported both party conventions - daringfireball.net/...
    • Tim Cook holds fundraiser for US House Speaker Paul Ryan (R) - www.imore.com/...
  5. Senator Elisabeth Warren accuses Apple, Amazon, and Google of trying to 'lock out' the competition (she accused Apple of making it hard for streaming music rivals) - www.recode.net/...
    • Spotify accuse Apple of not approving an update to their app that would cut out Apple's 30% fee for anticompetitive reasons (of using the App Store as an offensive weapon) - www.recode.net/...
Quick Stories
  • Apple is retiring their Thunderbolt display without announcing a replacement - arstechnica.com/...
  • Payouts from the Apple eBook case start arriving into people's amazon accounts - arstechnica.com/...
  • The iPhone was 9 years old this month, having first gone on sale on June 29th 2007 - www.imore.com/...
  • Apple will hold their Q3 2016 earnings call on July 26 at 2pm Pacific Time - www.imore.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 35 (July 2016)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Gazmaz from the My Mac Podcast - @gazmaz
  • Lynda Gousha from the Silicon Valley MUG - @llg4cdg
  • Nick Riley - @spligosh

The show starts with a few follow-ups to some stories from June, before having a quick look at some notable numbers and Apple-related legal stories which broke in July. The four main stories are Apple's Q3 2016 earnings call, Apple Watch's place at the top of the J. D. Power Smart Watch Satisfaction survey, some staffing changes at Project Titan, and the sale of ARM to SoftBank. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in July.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP35-July2016.mp3"]
Followups
  • India's cabinet have reportedly given Apple the green light to open stores in India - www.bloomberg.com/...
  • Walmart roll out Walmart Pay US-wide - www.imore.com/...
    • A review of the interface - tidbits.com/...
Notable Numbers
  • Apple ships their Billionth iPhone - www.macobserver.com/...
    • How long it took Apple to reach different iPhone sales landmarks ("Apple took about 2,450 days to sell the first 500 million iPhones and only 836 days to sell the second 500 million") - www.loopinsight.com/...
    • Numbers from Asymco show that the iPhone is not just the most popular phone, but the most popular product of any kind ever - www.asymco.com/...
    • How many of every product Apple sell every second - www.everysecond.io/...
Legal Latest
  • 68 major corporations, including Apple, challenge North Carolina's anti-Trans bathroom law in court - www.recode.net/...
  • Apple settle a patent case in East Texas for $25M. The patents cover Spotlight, Cover Flow, and the Time Machine - arstechnica.com/...
  • The US Supreme Court agrees to hear Samsung's appeal against Apple on October 11 - www.imore.com/...
Main Stories
  1. Apple report Q3 2016 Results - www.apple.com/...
    • The numbers:
      • Revenue: $42.4Bn (49.6Bn YAQ, -15%)
      • Net Income: $7.8Bn or $1.42 per diluted share ($10.7Bn or $1.85 per diluted share YAQ)
      • Gross Margin: 38% (39.7% YAQ, )
      • 63% of revenue came from international sales
      • Dividend of $0.57 per share announced
      • iPhone Sales: 40.4M (47.5M YAQ, -15%)
      • iPad Sales: 9.95M (10.9M YAQ, -9%)
      • Mac Sales: 4.25M (4.8M YAQ, -11%)
    • Despite a 27% drop in profit, Apple beats analysts expectations - arstechnica.com/...
    • Apple Pay sees 450% YoY growth, and accounts for 75% of all contactless payments in the US - www.imore.com/...
    • Tim Cook hints that Apple have big things in mind for Apple TV - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Transcript of Tim Cook's remarks - www.imore.com/...
  2. Apple Watch tops J.D. Power smartwatch satisfaction rankings - www.macobserver.com/...
  3. Project Titan (car project) Staff Changes
    • Apple have reportedly taken Bob Mansfield out of retirement and put him in charge of project Titan - www.imore.com/... & daringfireball.net/...
    • Apple reportedly poaches former QNX chief engineer from BackBerry for project Titan - www.imore.com/... & daringfireball.net/...
  4. ARM, the company that licenses the chip design Apple use in their A-series SOCs is to be sold to SoftBank for $32Bn - www.macobserver.com/...
    • A nice review of ARM's history and importance - mondaynote.com/...
Quick stories
  • Having hosted a fundraiser for Republican House Speaker Paul Ryan, Tim Cook to host a fund raiser for Hillary Clinton on 24 August - www.imore.com/...
  • Parkopedia to provide parking services to Apple globally - www.prnewswire.com/...
  • Apple improve Apple Music by giving DRM-free matching like Apple Match already gives - www.macworld.com/...

item.title: Let's Talk Apple - Ep. 36 (August 2016)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Gazmaz from the My Mac Podcast - @gazmaz
  • Elaine Giles from MacBites Learning - @elainegiles
  • Nick Riley - @spligosh

The show starts with a quick look at some notable numbers and Apple-related legal stories which broke in August. The three main stories are the EU's fight with Ireland and Apple, Samsung's Galaxy Note 7 recall, and some changes to the App Store. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other shorter stories that made the news in August.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP36-August2016.mp3"]
Notable Numbers
  • Apple have now paid $50Bn to App Store developers - www.macobserver.com/...
Legal Latest
  • US Federal Judge voids VirnetX's $626.6M verdict against Apple - two cases were unfairly combined into one, confusing the Jury, and need to be re-tried separately - www.reuters.com/...
  • Apple settle a patent dispute in Germany with the owners of OpenTV with a 'comprehensive patent license agreement' - www.reuters.com/...
  • Apple & Broadcom counter-sue Caltech to have the Wifi patents they are allegedly infringing invalidated - www.macrumors.com/...
  • Apple settle out of court with Dot23 Technologies over claims Siri infringes their patents - www.macrumors.com/...
  • Designers file Amicus brief in support of apple in their Supreme Court case against Samsung - www.reuters.com/...
  • Judge throws out Monster's case against Beats regarding their acquisition by Apple - www.macobserver.com/...
Main Stories
  1. EU Competition Commissioner Rules that Apple got unfair state aid from the Irish Government in the form of tax breaks - the Commissioner says Apple owes €14.5Bn in back-taxes, and claims Apple's effective tax rate is just 0.005% - www.bloomberg.com/...
    • Ireland and Apple to appeal the ruling - www.reuters.com/...
    • The US Treasury department is also on Apple and Ireland's side - www.macobserver.com/...
    • Apple release a public letter on the matter - www.apple.com/...
    • Tim Cook gives a number of interviews - www.independent.ie/..., www.rte.ie/... & arstechnica.com/...
      • Tim calls the ruling "political crap", saying the commission "just picked a number from I don't know where", and that Apple actually paid $400m in tax in 2014, making it the largest tax payer in Ireland
      • Tim disputes the Commissioner's numbers, saying Apple pay a global tax rate of 26.1%, and that 1 in every 14 Euro paid in corporate tax in Ireland was paid by Apple in 2014 -
      • Tim Cook says Apple plans to re-patriate billions from Ireland to the US next year, which it will pay US tax on
    • A good FAQ regarding the ruling - www.bloomberg.com/...
    • A good description of the bigger-picture within which this ruling sits - www.vox.com/...
  2. Samsung recalling 2.5M Galaxy Note 7s because of wide-spread reports of the devices catching fire - money.cnn.com/...
  3. Apple announce App Store improvements - old outdated apps will get cleaned out of the store, and stupidly long app names will be banned - arstechnica.com/... & developer.apple.com/...
Quick Stories
  • Apple release new iOS remote app for controlling new Apple TVs - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Apple release their latest diversity report - tidbits.com/... & www.apple.com/...
  • Apple will open a new R&D centre in China before the end of the year - www.macobserver.com/...
  • Intel licence ARM so they can manufacture ARM chips for customers - www.bloomberg.com/...
  • Apple unveils a new 2TB iCloud option priced at $19.99 per month - appleinsider.com/...

Reminder - bit Apple Event on September 7 - www.macobserver.com/...
