item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 89 (January 2021)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Lynda Gousha from the Silicon Valley MUG - @llg4cdg

The show starts with a the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by a few quick updates on some Apple-related legal cases, some Apple HR news, an overview of developments in Apple's various service offerings, and the highlights from Apple's push into original content. The four main stories are Apple's Q1 2021 earnings, the rumoured Apple Car, A privacy push, and a racial equity push. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in January.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP89-January2021.mp3"]

Followup

  • More Anti-trust Rumblings:

Beginning in 2021, an environmental, social, and governance modifier based on Apple Values and other key community initiatives will be incorporated into our annual cash incentive program.

  4. In the run-up to Black History Month in the US, Apple focuses on Racial Equality:

    • Relive the Billie Eilish: ‘The World’s A Little Blurry’ Premiere Event — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple drops limited edition gift card to celebrate Billie Eilish doc — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple TV+ Wins Awards
    • CODA, the movie Apple purchased the rights to won the grand jury prize, the directing prize, the audience award, and a special jury prize in the U.S. Dramatic Competition category at the Sundance Film Festival — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Apple TV+ film ‘Wolfwalkers’ earns 10 nominations for the Annie Awards — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: ‘For All Mankind’ and ‘Palmer’ take top spots in streaming last week — www.imore.com/…
  2. Epic Continues to Expand it’s War on Apple
    • 🇦🇺 Epic has lodged an anti-trust complaint against Apple with Australia’s Competition and Consumer Commission — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇪🇺 Epic Games files EU antitrust complaint against Apple — www.imore.com/… & Fortnite fight expands as Epic claims Apple broke EU competition law — arstechnica.com
    • 🇺🇸 Epic add State Legislatures into the mix:
      • North Dakota lawmakers jump into Apple/Epic fight with new app store bill — arstechnica.com & North Dakota Votes No on Third Party App Store Bill Backed by Epic Games — www.macobserver.com/…
      • New Minnesota Bill takes aim at Apple’s App Store fees — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple: Arizona bill government mandate to give away the App Store — www.imore.com/… & In a close vote, Arizona House passes bill that goes after the Apple and Google app stores — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Developments in the primary US Case:
      • Valve refuses Apple subpoena in Epic Games antitrust lawsuit — www.imore.com/… & Valve will have to produce Steam information in Epic Games suit, rules judge — www.imore.com/…
        • Related: Apple ‘Salted The Earth With Subpoenas’ in Case With Epic Games, Says Judge — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Epic Games wants former iOS chief Scott Forstall to testify in Apple lawsuit — www.imore.com/…

    • Developments in other on-going Cases:
      • 🇬🇧 Epic Games Cannot Contest Apple Fortnite Ban in UK, Says Court — www.macobserver.com/…
  3. Apple hearing study reveals 25% of participants exposed to too much noise — www.imore.com/… & Apple Hearing Study Shares Concerning Statistics — www.macobserver.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple’s indoor mapping format now recognized as a community standard — www.imore.com/…

  • Apple Creates First Entrepreneur Camp for Black Founders, Developers — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple celebrates Women’s History Month with the help of Apple Music, Fitness+, and more — www.imore.com/…

  • 🇺🇸 Apple donates $1 million and products to Utah-based LGBTQ+ charity Encircle — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Target to open mini Apple shops inside 17 stores in latest move to woo customers — www.cnbc.com/…
  • 🇫🇷 Apple adds repairability scores to iPhone and Mac in France — www.imore.com/…

item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 91 (March 2021)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Charles Edge from the Mac Admins Podcast - @cedge318
  • Simon Parnell from the Essential Apple Podcast - @serenak
  • Nick Riley from the Essential Apple Podcast - @spligosh
  • Gazmaz from the My Mac Podcast - @gazmaz

The show starts with a the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by a few quick legal stories, some Apple HR news, and some highlights from Apple's push into original content. The three main stories are Apple discontinuing the iMac Pro, some other iMacs and the HomePod, Intel's very mixed messaging towards Apple, and the compromise Apple managed to strike with Russia over their App Pre-installation law. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in March.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP91-March2021.mp3"]

Followup

  • COVID Update:
    • Apple Maps gets COVID–19 airport information at over 300 destinations — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple Maps now includes COVID vaccination locations — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: Apple offering paid time off for employees to get COVID–19 vaccine — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇫🇷 France’s Apple Stores are all closing again thanks to a COVID–19 lockdown — www.imore.com/…
  • The build-up to App Tracking Transparency Continues:
    • Former Facebook employees call BS on Facebook’s claim that ATT will harm small businesses — www.imore.com/…
    • Zuckerberg now says Facebook may benefit from iOS 14 privacy changes — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇫🇷 France’s Competition Authority rejected a request from French media companies that ATT be blocked from going into effect, but they will investigate if Apple violates its own rules — www.bloomberg.com/…
    • Apple is warning app developers not to skirt its privacy changes in iOS 14 — www.imore.com/…
    • Snapchat Finds a Workaround for iOS 14 App Tracking Transparency — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple Starts Blocking Apps That Use ‘Adjust SDK’ for Tracking — www.macobserver.com/…
    • LinkedIn to stop collecting tracking data before Apple shames it — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: as promised: Apple launches a single hub for privacy labels on its own native apps — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple expands Independent Repair Provider program globally — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: 🇺🇸 Apple amongst companies lobbying against [Nevada] Right to Repair bill over data concerns — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: 🇺🇸 A right-to-repair advocate has set up a GoFundMe page to raise money for a ballot initiative in Massachusetts — www.imore.com/…
  • Anti-trust authorities around the world continue to focus their attention on Apple:
    • 🇬🇧 UK to investigate Apple’s App Store over ‘suspected anti-competitive behavior’ — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇫🇷 French startup lobby to file privacy complaint against Apple — www.reuters.com/… & France Digitale Says Apple Users are Shown Personalized Ads Without Consent — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇦🇺 Australia extends tech giant probe to Google and Apple browser domination — www.zdnet.com/…
    • 🇰🇷 Apple referred for prosecution in Korea, fined for hampering antitrust investigation — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 The Arizona bill to force Apple and Google to allow third-party payments in app distributed through their stores passed in the State House, then died in the State Senate:
    • Arizona House advances bill targeting Apple, Google mobile app stores — arstechnica.com
    • Arizona bill that would change the App Store disappears during Senate vote — www.imore.com/…
    • Arizona App Store bill only had one definite yes vote before it was pulled, says Commerce Chair — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Google follows Apple in halving Google Play fees, with one major difference — www.imore.com/… (Everyone gets reduced fees on their first $1M)
    • Related: Apple only losing 3% of App Store revenue after cutting developer fees — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple Card investigation finds no evidence of gender bias — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇨🇳 🇺🇸 A US-China Trade War development: Huawei to start charging royalties to smartphone makers using its patented 5G tech — www.cnbc.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Epic -v- Apple:
    • 🇺🇸 Apple CEO Tim Cook and other execs to testify in Epic Games case — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Epic Games expert witness to endure gruelling 14-hour deposition in trial — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Judge limits courtroom attendance in Epic Games vs Apple case — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇬🇧 Epic Games files another antitrust complaint against Apple in UK — www.imore.com/…
    • Analysis: Epic Games vs Apple: How Economists Are Playing a Key Role in Crucial Case — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Valve releases Steam Link app on Apple’s Mac App Store — arstechnica.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Class Action Lawsuit Over Apple Providing Refurbished Replacement Devices Proceeding to Trial in August — www.macrumors.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple now faces a class action suit over its problematic butterfly keyboards — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 A Texas jury has awarded Personalized Media Communications, a non-practicing entity, over $300M of royalties over patent claims relating to Apple’s FairPlay DRM. Apple will appeal — arstechnica.com/…
  • 🇧🇷 Apple fined in Brazil for selling the iPhone without a charger — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇨🇦 Apple to settle Quebec class-action lawsuit over 2011 MacBook Pro for $5.3M — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇬🇧 Apple can’t stop Swatch trademarking ‘One More Thing’, says judge — www.imore.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple is hiring a senior cardiologist to help build future health products — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple TV+ hires another entertainment veteran as creative executive — www.imore.com/… & Executive Zennen Clifton Joins Apple TV+ Team — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Longtime App Store Developer Relations Boss Ron Okamoto is retiring, and being replaced by Susan Prescott — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Analysis: Apple has acquired the most AI companies over the last four years — www.imore.com/…

Apple Services Update

  • Apple TV+
    • More Awards Nominations:
      • ‘Servant,’ ‘For All Mankind,’ ‘Amazing Stories’ all nominated for Saturn Awards — www.imore.com/…
      • ‘Ted Lasso’ Earns Award Nominations from the Directors Guild of America and Producers Guild of America — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple TV+ Films ‘Greyhound’ and ‘Wolfwalkers’ Earn BAFTA Nominations — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple TV+ bags two Oscar nominations for ‘Greyhound’ and ‘Wolfwalkers’ — www.imore.com/…
    • More Awards!
      • ‘Ted Lasso’ wins all three Critics Choice awards it was nominated for — www.imore.com/…
      • ‘Ted Lasso’ wins Best Comedy Series and New Series at WGA Awards — www.imore.com/…
      • Jason Sudeikis wins a SAG Award for his role in ‘Ted Lasso’ — www.imore.com/…
      • ‘The Banker’ wins ‘Outstanding Independent Motion Picture’ from NAACP — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple continues to sign important deals:
      • Apple TV+ just announced a new partnership with activist Malala Yousafzai — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple have signed a first-look deal with Ron Howard’s Imagine Entertainment — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple signs first-look deal with Natalie Portman’s new production company — www.imore.com/…
    • Some recent Apple TV+ releases are a hits:
      • Billie Eilish documentary drives record Apple TV+ subscriptions — www.imore.com/…
      • ‘Cherry’ starring Tom Holland arrives on Apple TV+ — www.imore.com/… & ‘Cherry’, starring Tom Holland, topped the streaming charts last weekend — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple and Redford Center Launch Youth Filmmaking Challenge on Environmental Justice — variety.com/…
  • Apple has added Saylists to Apple Music to help kids with speech-sound disorders — www.bbc.co.uk/…
  • Apple Podcasts teams with Common Sense Media for kids recommendations — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Arcade gains more than 30 new games and two new categories — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Maps rolls its speed camera feature out to more countries — www.imore.com/… (The Netherlands, Belgium, Australia, New Zealand, Brazil, Norway & Sweden)

Main Stories

  1. Cleaning House
    • The iMac Pro has been discontinued — arstechnica.com
    • Apple has just discontinued more models of its iMac… — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple is discontinuing the original HomePod — www.imore.com/…
  2. Intel’s Mixed-messages to Apple
    • Intel has launched an incredibly misleading ‘PC vs. Mac’ website — www.imore.com/…
    • Intel slams Apple over MacBook Air battery lie, owns itself in the process — www.imore.com/…
    • After bashing M1 Macs, Intel wants to build Apple silicon chips — www.imore.com/…
    • Intel CEO says Justin Long attack ads are ‘competitive fun’ with Apple — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple’s M1 chip smashes Intel and AMD in new single-thread benchmarks — www.imore.com/…
    • Opinion: Does Intel’s new CEO not talk to his advertising team? All evidence suggests not. — www.imore.com/…
  3. 🇷🇺 Apple’s ‘Compliance’ with Russia’s App Pre-installation law
    • In 2019 Russia passed a law mandating that smartphones in Russia come with Russian apps pre-installed — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple appear to have found an interesting work-around — rather than actually pre-installing the apps they have added an extra screen to the first-boot process offering Russian users a list of Russian apps to Get.
    • Opinion: Apple bent its rules for Russia—and other countries will take note — arstechnica.com/…
    • Opinion: Has Russia opened an antitrust door that can never be closed? — www.imore.com/…

Quick Stories

  • New ‘Apple For Kids’ Page Helps Parents Control Children’s Digital Activity — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple launches ‘Apple Teacher Portfolio’, expands education curriculum — www.imore.com/…
  • The next version of iOS will have two new English-language Siri voices, and will no longer default to the female voice, but ask the user instead — techcrunch.com/…
  • Apple starts its build-up to Earth Day 2021 (22 April):
    • Apple says 1.2 gigawatts of clean energy produced by 2020 Green Bond projects — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple commits to build “grid-scale” energy storage in California — arstechnica.com & Apple is Building a Battery Farm Capable of Storing 240MW — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 110 Apple suppliers moving to 100 percent renewable energy — www.imore.com/…
    • ‘The Year Earth Changed’ to premiere on Earth Day on Apple TV+ — www.imore.com/… & David Attenborough Wildlife Documentary Coming to Apple TV+ — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Two sets of new digs in Europe:
    • 🇮🇪 Apple signs deal for new Cork office — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇩🇪 Apple announces new Munich facility focused on 5G and future wireless tech — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple announces WWDC 2021 for June 7–11, all-online format — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple releases new Apple Developer app ahead of WWDC 2021 — www.imore.com/…
    • Windows 10 developers can now bring WinUI 3 apps to iPhone and Mac — www.imore.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

Emoji Meaning
🎧 A link to audio content, probably a podcast.
flag The story is particularly relevant to people living in a specific country, or, the organisation the story is about is affiliated with the government of a specific country.
📊 A link to graphical content, probably a chart, graph, or diagram.
💵 A link to an article behind a pay-wall.

item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 92 (April 2021)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Lynda Gousha from the Silicon Valley MUG - @llg4cdg
  • Chuck Joiner from MacVoices - @chuckjoiner
  • Kelly Guimont from App Camp for Girls - @verso

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by a few quick legal stories, some Apple HR news, and some updates to Apple's various services. The four main stories are Earth Day 2021, Apple opening it's Find My network to third parties, Apple's Q2 2021 earnings call, and Apple's bumper Spring Loaded event. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in April.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP92-April2021.mp3"]

Followup

  • COVID Update:
    • 🇺🇸 Apple seeks dismissal of $800 million COVID app lawsuit — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Study to see if Apple Watch can detect COVID–19 now taking volunteers — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 All Apple Stores in Michigan have closed due to surge of COVID–19 cases — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple extends in-app purchase exemption for group events through 2021 — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple is launching its own COVID–19 vaccination effort — www.imore.com/…
    • Tim Cook says Apple will donate to support India COVID fight — www.imore.com/…
  • We now know that the firm that unlocked the San Bernardino shooter’s iPhone for the FBI was not Celebrite as suspected, but Australian company Azimuth — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇮🇳 iPhone supplier overhauls workings after factory riot — www.imore.com/… (Wistron)
  • Apple is letting Parler come back to the App Store — www.imore.com/…
  • Anti-trust woes continue:
    • 🇷🇺 Russia fines Apple $12 million for antitrust practices on the App Store — www.imore.com/… (from Kaspersky complaint about restrictions on parental control apps back in 2019, Apple will appeal)
    • 🇦🇺 Australia threatens Apple with regulation over App Store, default apps — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇫🇷 Apple Pay and Others Mean Banks Could be Squeezed Out, French Authorities Warn — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇪🇺 EU says Apple Music unfairly competes with Spotify in the App Store — www.imore.com/… (Preliminary finding, now the Commission talk to Apple) & EU says Apple’s 30% cut from rival music providers violates competition law — arstechnica.com
    • 🇺🇸 U.S. House Committee Approve Big Tech Report — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Activists Decry ‘Apple’s Stranglehold’ on iPhone Software Following Senate Hearing — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Analysis: Apple Is Not A Monopoly And 10-Year Growth Prospects Are Excellent — seekingalpha.com/…
  • Awards Season Continues:
    • Apple TV+ Content Recognized, But Doesn’t Win, at GLAAD Media Awards — www.macobserver.com/… (The son episode of Little America earned Special Recognition)
    • Apple TV+ film ‘Wolfwalkers’ takes five Annie Awards home — www.imore.com/…
    • ‘Servant’ and ‘Greyhound’ take home wins at 68th Golden Reel Awards — www.imore.com/…
    • ‘Greyhound’ and ‘Servant’ Win at Motion Picture Sound Editors Award Winners — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Pixar’s Soul Beats Apple TV+ Film Wolfwalkers in Oscars Animated Movie Battle — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Three Apple TV Plus original series earn BAFTA nominations — www.imore.com/… (Little America, Earth at Night in Color & Tiny World)
  • iOS 14.5 finally comes out of beta with two long-awaited features — arstechnica.com/…
    • Apple Watch unlock when wearing a facemask — www.imore.com/…
    • App Tracking Transparency
      • How Apple’s new App Tracking Transparency policy works — arstechnica.com
      • No incentives for iOS 14.5 app tracking allowed, says Apple — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple confirms iOS 14 app tracking option disabled in some cases — www.imore.com/…
      • iOS 14.5: Here’s How to Start Blocking App Tracking — www.macobserver.com/…
      • 🎦 Craig Federighi talks App Tracking Transparency with Joanna Stern — www.imore.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple Wins New Trial in $506 Million Patent-Damages Award — www.bloomberg.com/… (Over LTE patents, and judge agreed jury was not adequately allowed to consider FRAND)
  • A judge has rejected Apple’s motion to dismiss a case arguing that the word ‘buy’ is deceptive for iTunes content, the class action suit will go to trial — Lawsuit Challenges Apple Over ‘Buy’, ‘Rent’ Difference — www.macobserver.com/… & www.imore.com/…
  • Apple -v- Epic is about to go to trial
    • Apple, Epic Games lay out detailed arguments for upcoming legal battle — arstechnica.com
    • Apple denied pretrial sanctions against Epic Games over witness disclosure — www.imore.com/… (Judge rules Epic had not broken the rules)
    • Epic Games won’t call on Facebook Gaming Chief in Apple trial — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple scrambles to claw back Small Business Program emails ‘inadvertently’ sent to Epic — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Fortnite is not coming to Microsoft xCloud because Epic doesn’t want it to — www.imore.com/… & Epic says game streaming services compete with PC. Except when they dont. — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Microsoft follows Epic Games, boosts developer revenue share to 88% — www.imore.com/…
    • Analysis: How long can Epic afford to throw money at the Epic Games Store? — arstechnica.com
    • Analysis: Epic Games v. Apple: What to know about the biggest trial in tech — www.protocol.com/…
    • Analysis: Three questions that will decide the Epic Games case against Apple — www.theverge.com/…
      1. Is the exclusive App Store a necessary part of iOS?
      2. How is the iPhone different from a PlayStation?
      3. How much control can Apple exert over its hardware?
    • Analysis: Q&A: Experts weigh in ahead of Apple’s battle royale with Epic Games — www.imore.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple TV+ hires two new execs to develop non-scripted content — www.imore.com/… & Executives With Full CVs and Big Award Wins Join Apple TV+ Unscripted Team — www.macobserver.com/… (Erika Clarke from Spotify Studios & Colleen Grogan formerly from Lifetime)
  • Diogo Rau, Head of Engineering for Apple Retail, is moving to Eli Lilly — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple launches new ‘Careers at Apple’ website — www.imore.com/…

Apple Services Update

  • 🇨🇦 🇬🇧 Apple Music TV Arrives in the UK and Canada — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple Music City Charts go live, and you don’t need a subscription to see them — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple TV+ has highest average IMDb score of any streaming service — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Earth Day: Apple celebrates Earth Day across Apple TV, Podcasts, Apple Watch, more — www.imore.com/… & Apple Celebrates Earth Day 2021 With Curated Content for Customers — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple backs President Biden’s climate plans and calls for SEC-backed emissions disclosure — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple announces new $200 million carbon removal initiative — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Releases 2021 Environmental Progress Report — www.macobserver.com/… (Basically “we’re on target to meet our ambitious goals”)
    • David Attenborough’s The Year Earth Changed tops the unscripted program charts — www.imore.com/…
  2. Apple Opens the Find My network to third parties — www.imore.com/…
    • VanMoof S3 and X3 e-bikes now support Apple’s Find My network — www.imore.com/…
    • Chipolo becomes first item tracker to support Apple’s Find My network — www.imore.com/…
  3. Q2 2021 Earnings Call — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple Q2 2021: Apple sees $89.6 billion in revenue in March quarter — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Crushes Earnings and Revenue for Record March Quarter — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Facing uncharted waters, Apple reports 54% year-over-year revenue increase — arstechnica.com
    • Apple’s Jaw-Dropping Q2 2021 by the Numbers — tidbits.com/…
    • 75% of Apple Watch purchases were from first-time users last quarter — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple now has 660 million paid subscriptions for its services — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Earnings Call Transcripts: Apple CEO Tim Cook on the company’s Q2 2021 earnings — www.imore.com/…
  4. Apple’s Spring Loaded Event — www.imore.com/…
    • How to rewatch the April 2021 ‘Spring Loaded’ Apple event — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple announces Apple Card Family — www.imore.com/…
      • Shared Apple Card Users Can Now Build Credit Together — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple announces new Purple finish for the iPhone 12 in time for spring — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Unveils Podcast Subscriptions And Redesigns App — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple Podcasts Subscriptions: Everything you need to know! — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple will take a 30% cut on its new Podcast Subscriptions service — www.imore.com/…
      • Some of the finer points in Apple’s Podcasters Program Agreement — nathangathright.com/…
      • Related: Spotify begins rolling out new Podcast subscriptions platform — www.imore.com/… (US-only for now, with 100% for podcasters to start, but 5% fee from 2023)
    • Apple announces new Apple TV 4K with A12 Bionic, new remote, and more — www.imore.com/…
      • The new and improved Apple Siri Remote works with your old Apple TV — www.imore.com/…
      • You can’t use that new Siri Remote to play some Apple TV games — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple offers AppleCare Plus for the Apple TV for the first time — www.imore.com/…
      • tvOS 14.5 adds color balancing, new controller support, and more — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple finally releases AirTag, a brand new tiny tracking device for $29 — www.imore.com/… & Apple takes on Tile with AR-ready AirTags tracking devices — arstechnica.com
      • Here’s what happens if you lose an AirTag — www.imore.com/…
      • How Apple designed AirTags to be privacy-first and stalker-proof — www.fastcompany.com/…
      • What to do if you find an AirTag or get an alert that an AirTag is with you — support.apple.com/…
      • AirTag is splash, dust, and water-resistant with a replaceable battery — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple and other brands release slew of AirTags accessories — www.imore.com/…
      • How to replace an AirTag battery — www.imore.com/…
      • Don’t use AirTags to track your kids, says Apple — www.imore.com/…
      • 🎧 an excellent interview with some of the AirTag team: Rene Ritchie: Apple Answers YOUR AirTag Questions! — overcast.fm/…

item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 93 (May 2021)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Simon Parnell from the Essential Apple Podcast - @serenak
  • Mark chappell from the Essential Apple Podcast - @oceanspeed

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by some Apple HR news, and some highlights from Apple's original content. The four main stories are the Apple -v- Epic trial, Apple Music going lossless, the Matter smart home standard, and Apple's pre-announcement of some new accessibility features. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in May.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP93-May2021.mp3"]

Followup

  • Some Apple Podcast Subscriptions Developments:
    • Podcast subscription service Wondery+ joining Apple Podcasts Subscriptions — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple launches affiliate program for Apple Podcasts Subscriptions — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple has delayed Apple Podcasts Subscriptions until June — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple shares more details on how Apple Card Family works — www.imore.com/…
  • More regulatory rumblings all around the world:
    • 🇪🇺 The Bureau Européen des Unions de Consommateurs (BEUC) has backed the EU’s anti-trust case against Apple over streaming music — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇪🇺 EU Apple Pay probe moves forward as antitrust issues pile up — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 The FTC has accused Apple and others of anticompetitive repair restrictions — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple slams antitrust claims in letter to Senate subcommittee — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇬🇧 The UK will investigate whether the iPhone Upgrade Program discriminates against disabled people — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple Dismisses UK App Store Allegations as ‘Meritless’ — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Awards Season isn’t quite over yet!
    • ‘Ted Lasso’ and ‘Stillwater’ Earn Peabody Awards Nominations — www.macobserver.com/…
    • ‘Servant’ From Apple TV+ on TV Choice Awards Longlist — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Daytime Emmy Awards 2021: Apple TV+ Shows ‘Ghostwriter’ And ‘Helpsters’ Earn Nominations — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple TV Plus lands ‘The Big Door Prize’ from ‘Schitt’s Creek’ writer — www.imore.com/…
  • Some AirTag/FindMy Updates:
    • iOS 14.5 Adds Beats Headphones Into the ‘Find My’ App — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Amazon Partners With Tile to Create Location Trackers — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple announces privacy update to AirTag and promises an Android app — www.imore.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple have hired Samy Bengio, another former Google engineer, who will be joining John Giannandrea’s AI team — www.imore.com/…
  • Stella Low to joins Apple as VP for Worldwide Corporate Communications, she’s previously worked in the communications departments of Cisco & Dell — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple have hired Scott Croyle, formerly referred to as HTC’s Jony Ive to lead the Beats design team — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple briefly hired a former Facebook exec:
    • Apple hires former Facebook exec Antonio Garcia Martinez to ads team — www.imore.com/…
    • A petition is circulating among Apple employees regarding the company’s ‘misogynistic’ new hire — www.imore.com/…
    • ‘Misogynistic’ Apple hire is out hours after employees call for investigation — www.theverge.com/…
  • Apple Health executive Myoung Cha is leaving the company for a startup — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple hiring for ‘Alternative Payments’ business manager — www.imore.com/… & Apple Looks to Hire Business Manager With Cryptocurrency Experience — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple Loses Several Top Managers From Self-Driving Car Division — www.bloomberg.com/…

Apple Original Content Highlights

  • Prince Harry and Oprah’s mental health docuseries debuts on Apple TV+ — www.imore.com/…
    • Oprah and Prince Harry docuseries number one TV+ program, says Apple — www.imore.com/…
  • ‘Who Are You, Charlie Brown?’ debuts on Apple TV+ June 25 — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple -v- Epic Goes to Trial
    • Two superb summaries of the lead-up to the trial:
      • Epic vs. Apple trial starts today—here’s what to expect — arstechnica.com
      • Epic Versus Apple: The MacStories Overview - MacStories — www.macstories.net/…
    • The Trial Itself:
      • An excellent summary of the opening arguments: Epic vs. Apple opening arguments suggest a bitter battle over iOS’ future — arstechnica.com
      • Epic Games would have accepted special deal with Apple, says CEO — www.imore.com/…
      • At trial, Epic and Apple squeeze Microsoft over Xbox, xCloud restrictions — arstechnica.com
      • Epic vs Apple judge dumbfounded over Apple’s xCloud policy — www.imore.com/…
      • App Store chief on Epic Games payment hotfix: ‘I was blindsided’ — www.imore.com/…
      • App Store head says Apple promotes competitors’ apps ‘all the time’ — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple says less than 1% of app rejections appealed by developers — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple files motion to label testimony from Microsoft’s Lori Wright not credible — www.imore.com/…
      • Epic Games says iOS is its own market with high switching costs and lock-in — www.imore.com/…
      • Epic v. Apple judge floats potential compromise over App Store payments — www.imore.com/…
      • Phil Schiller details why Microsoft’s xCloud game service isn’t on the App Store — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple slams ‘unspeakable’ Itch.io content hosted on Epic Games Store — www.imore.com/…
      • Phil Schiller reveals $50M cost for WWDC, App Store Small Business Program details, more — 9to5mac.com/…
      • Apple’s Small Business Program dates back to 2016, says Phil Schiller — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple seeks early trial win against Epic over denial of access to iOS — www.imore.com/…
      • Craig Federighi defends iPhone security by throwing the Mac under the bus — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple accuses Microsoft of being in league with Epic during trial — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple CEO faces tough questioning as Epic Games trial wraps up — arstechnica.com
      • Tim Cook says Apple would still collect commission on alternative App Store payments — www.imore.com/…
      • Tim Cook faces barrage of tough questions in frantic final minutes of testimony — www.imore.com/…
      • The Epic v. Apple trial is over - here’s what’s next — www.imore.com/…
    • Analysis:
      • 10 quotes that could reveal the outcome of the Apple vs Epic Games trial — www.imore.com/…
      • Epic Games v. Apple by the numbers: Fortnite is worth that much money? — arstechnica.com
      • Nine things we learned from the Epic v. Apple trial — www.theverge.com/…
      • Why Roblox’s definition of “games” is key to the Epic vs. Apple case — arstechnica.com
    • As expected, the evidence presented revealed some interesting behind the scenes info:
      • Apple and Epic Games worked out details of a Fortnite subscription bundle in the past — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple’s Phil Schiller talked about reducing App Store fees a decade ago — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple debated whether or not to bring ads to the App Store back in 2015 — www.imore.com/…
      • Internal emails reveal Epic concerns ahead of ‘Project Liberty’ — www.imore.com/…
      • Microsoft’s feud with Apple over xCloud on iOS got a cloud gaming rival kicked from the App Store — www.theverge.com/…
      • Email reveals Apple had given Hulu special access to App Store API — www.imore.com/…
      • 128 Million Apple Users Unknowingly Downloaded Malware in 2015 — www.macobserver.com/… & Apple brass discussed disclosing 128-million iPhone hack, then decided not to — arstechnica.com
      • Internal docs reveal project ‘Columbus’, Apple’s huge push to improve App Review — www.imore.com/…
    • Related Apple Press Releases:
      • App Store prevented $1.5bn in fraud last year, removed 150,000 spam apps — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple touts $643 billion in App Store billings and sales in 2020 — www.imore.com/…
    • Related News:
      • Developers have a new way to advertise apps on the App Store — www.imore.com/…
      • Spotify exec brands Apple ‘ruthless bully’ in scathing article — www.imore.com/…
      • Snap CEO happy to pay Apple 30%, says they wouldn’t exist without iPhone — www.imore.com/…
  2. Apple Music gets a free upgrade – Lossless Audio and Dolby Atmos — arstechnica.com/…

    • What Apple devices are compatible with Apple Music Lossless? — www.imore.com/…

      ‘Apple Music lossless audio is supported on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV on iOS 14.6, iPadOS 14.6, macOS 11.4, or tvOS 14.6. However, you can’t listen to lossless audio without a wired headphone. So, no Apple wireless headphones will work, including the AirPods Max, even if using them wired.’

    • Apple’s support document explaining Lossless Audio in Apple Music — support.apple.com/…
    • Apple confirms lossless audio is coming to the HomePod lineup — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Music Dolby Atmos and Lossless Audio: Everything you need to know — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Amazon make their lossloss option a free upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited (same price as Apple music) — www.imore.com/…
  3. The new Matter Smart Home connectivity standard is launched — www.imore.com/… & tidbits.com/…
    • What was the Zigbee Alliance becomes the Connectivity Standards Alliance (Apple, Amazon & Google are all members)
    • What had been in development as CHIP (Project Connected Home over IP) has been released as the Matter standard
    • Certified devices will be able to securely interact with each other and the leading home assistants (Siri, Alexa & OK Google)
    • The first Matter-certified devices are expected later this year
  4. International Accessibility Awareness Day (20th May)
    • Apple celebrates Global Accessibility Awareness Day across its services — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Fitness+ Getting Closed Captioning Coming And Other Accessibility Features — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple pre-announced a slew of new accessibility updates that will be coming out over the remainder of the year — www.apple.com/…
      • A nice summary: Apple Announces Upcoming Accessibility Features — tidbits.com/…
      • SignTime rolled out immediately in the US, UK, and France, and allows customers to communicate with Apple using their local sign language (ASL, BSL & LSF)
      • Assistive Touch will be rolled out in the autumn and will allow the Apple Watch be used to detect gestures that can then control the user’s iPhone
      • Apple is also improving voiceover and adding hardware support for bi-directional hearing aids and eye trackers

Quick Stories

  • Apple has published its supplier responsibility report for 2021 — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple awards Corning, iPhone 12 Ceramic Shield maker, $45 million from its Advanced Manufacturing Fund — www.imore.com/…
  • You’ll soon be able to Fast Pair your Beats headphones to Android devices — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple announces two new Apple Watch Pride bands and a watch face — www.imore.com/…
    • The New Pride Apple Watch Faces Have an Easter Egg Feature — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple celebrates Pride Month across Apple Music, Apple Fitness Plus, more — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple confirms its WWDC21 schedule, beginning with June 7’s keynote — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple announces the 2021 Apple Design Award finalists across six categories — www.imore.com/…

item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 94 (June 2021)

item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Steve Harris from Reinvented Software - @steveharris

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by some Apple HR news, and some highlights from Apple's subscription services. The three main stories are scrutiny from regulators and law makers on both sides of the Atlantic, WWDC, and Windows 11. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in June.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

Followup

Apple Services Update

    • Solitaire Stories makes solitaire cool and it’s on Apple Arcade today — www.imore.com/…
    • Destroy the competition in Detonation Racing on Apple Arcade ‘soon’ — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple TV+ grows up – 1 year trials (with many extensions) replaced by a 3 month trial, and those of us on the ever extending extensions will finally be billed — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple TV+ has 112 wins, 389 award nominations and it’s just getting started — www.imore.com/… — and awards Season is not quite done yet!
      • Oprah and ‘1971’ Score Wins For Apple TV+ at Critics Choice Real TV Awards — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple TV+ Animated Series ‘Stillwater’ Earns Peabody Award — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple TV+ grabs a whopping 25 Daytime Emmy Awards nominations — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple preview their summer lineup — www.macrumors.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Anti-Trust
    • Europe
      • 🇬🇧 The UK Competition and Markets Authority have launched an investigation into whether Apple & Google’s market power is detrimental to user and other businesses — www.macobserver.com/…
      • 🇩🇪 Apple is going to have to deal a new German antitrust probe into its platforms — www.imore.com/…
      • 🇳🇱 Access to NFC technology like Apple Pay needs new rules, says Dutch market authority — www.imore.com/…
      • 🇪🇺 EU identifies areas of antitrust concern in smart home sector, names Apple — www.imore.com/…
        1. Exclusivity and tying practices
        2. Voice assistants & smart devices OSes are intermediaries between users and devices
        3. Extensive access to data
        4. Lack of interoperability
    • 🇺🇸 US
      • National right to repair legislation introduced in the House — appleinsider.com/…
      • House lawmakers introduce five bipartisan bills to unwind tech monopolies — www.theverge.com/…
        1. Empower DOJ & FTC to break up tech firms by forcing the sale of parts of their businesses that create conflicts of interest (e.g. Amazon Basics)
        2. Ban companies boosting their own services over rivals (e.g. Google services in Google search results)
          • Related: Apple Pre-Installed Apps Would Be Banned Under Antitrust Package — www.bloomberg.com/…
        3. Block acquisitions of nascent rivals (i.e. don’t let another Instagram happen)
        4. Boost merger filing fees for large companies (to fund anti-trust regulators)
        5. Force data interoperability
      • House Committee approves huge antitrust bill, but it was close… — www.imore.com/…

    • Interesting Little details from the rest of the conference and the betas:

item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 95 (July 2021)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

Apple Services & Original Contents Highlights

item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 96 (August 2021)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Tom Merritt from DTNS - @acedtect

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by some notable numbers, some Apple-related legal news, and some highlights from Apple's original content and subscription services. The three main stories are Apple's new child protection features, continuing pressure on the App Stores, and open discontent among Apple employees. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in August.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="http://www.mymac.com/podcast/lta/LetsTalkApple-EP96-August2021.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple continued to address issues with its new Safari design throughout August, and people now seem much happier with where the design has ended up:
    • iOS 15 Developer Beta 6 is Out with Another Safari Redesign — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple has made its controversial Safari redesign optional in the latest betas of iOS 15 and iPadOS 15 — www.imore.com/…
    • Our Long National iOS 15 Safari Beta Nightmare Is Over — daringfireball.net/…
  • iCloud Private Relay will only be available as a beta feature when iOS 15 launches this fall — www.imore.com/…
  • Microsoft have released Windows 365 (Windows 10 & later 11 in the cloud, accessible from Macs & iPads) — pricing starts at $20 per month (1 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 64GB storage & 12GB out-bound data) — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple to spend ‘millions’ helping homeless encampment residents — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple-backed smart home standard ‘Matter’ delayed until 2022 — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Pulls SharePlay from Initial iOS 15 Release this Fall — www.macobserver.com/…
  • The Chipolo One (the one that uses Apple’s Find My Network) has started shipping — tidbits.com/…
  • On a recent show Kelly Guimont noted how she was looking forward to learning lots of juicy new details thanks to the discovery process in Apple’s many law suites, the Verge have assembled an excellent collection of 107 such nuggets: www.theverge.com/…

Notable Numbers

  • Apple Pay accounted for 92% of 2 billion U.S. mobile wallet purchases last year — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Card ranked No. 1 in customer satisfaction by J.D. Power — www.imore.com/…

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 Apple’s attempt to have a patent case regarding it’s heart-rate detection in AppleWatch dismissed on a technicality has failed, the case will now go forward — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 A Texas jury has found against Apple and ordered it to pay $300M to Optis Technology over alleged wireless patent infringements, Apple will appeal — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple -v- Corellium (security company selling virtual iOS devices for use by security researchers)
    • Apple Reaches Settlement With Corellium, Dropping its Lawsuit — www.macobserver.com/… (Details secret but Corellium’s virtual iOS devices remain on sale)
    • Apple has appealed its lawsuit against Corellium — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 DRM Patent Claim Against Deemed Unenforceable, in Major Legal Win For Apple — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇦🇺 Apple vs Epic trial to go ahead in Australia in November 2022 — www.imore.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Maps continues to improve:
    • 🇺🇸 Apple Maps has expanded its built-in ratings and photos feature to the United States — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇳🇱 Apple Maps gets accident reporting in the Netherlands — www.imore.com/…
  • ApplePay continues to roll out internationally
    • 🇿🇦 South African bank FNB adds support for Apple Pay — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇧🇪 ING Belgium adds Apple Pay support to 1.4 million cards — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇶🇦 Qatari bank QNB adds support for Apple Pay via iPhone and Apple Watch — www.imore.com/…
  • New Apple News benefit gives publishers more cash on in-app purchases — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Arcade Continues to release titles: There are now 200 games on Apple Arcade — www.imore.com/…
    • Monster Hunter Stories is now available for free as part of Apple Arcade — www.imore.com/…
    • One-button platformer Super Leap Day is now playable in Apple Arcade — www.imore.com/…
    • The excellent Super Stickman Golf 3 is now in Apple Arcade — www.imore.com/…
    • Musical Puzzle Game ‘Tetris Beat’ Arrives on Apple Arcade — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Smash Hit Asphalt 8: Airborne Racing to Apple Arcade — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Zelda-like adventurer Baldo is now available in Apple Arcade for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Music
    • Apple Music artists can now share their ‘Milestones’ with fans — www.imore.com/…
    • After three rather Apple Music live events in the lead up to the album’s release, Kanye West’s Donda was streaked over 60M times in the US within its first 24 hours of release — 9to5mac.com/…
    • Apple acquires Primephonic, plans to incorporate its classical music into Apple Music and launch new app — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple’s Press Release — www.apple.com/…
  • Apple TV+
    • Yet more nominations and awards
      • Apple TV+ nabs eight Imagen Award nominations across five Apple Originals — www.imore.com/… (for The Mosquito Coast, Mariah Carey’s Magical Christmas Special, Ted Lasso, Little Voice & Ghostwriter)
      • Apple TV+ originals ‘For All Mankind’ and ‘Calls’ take home awards at the 73rd Emmys — www.imore.com/…
      • ‘Ted Lasso’ wins big as Apple TV+ picks up five HCA TV Awards — www.imore.com/… (Hollywood Critics Association)
      • Related: ‘Ted Lasso’ most-watched show on all streaming platforms, says Reelgood — www.imore.com/…
    • The Sundance-award-winning movie CODA has been released on Apple TV+ (and in select theatres) — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple debuts 9/11 documentary on TV+, features exclusive George Bush testimony — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple Announces Three new Child Protection Features — www.apple.com/…
    • Good explanations of what Apple actually announced:
      • FAQ: Apple Child Safety — what is Apple doing and should people be concerned? — www.imore.com/…
      • FAQ about Apple’s Expanded Protections for Children — tidbits.com/…
    • Poorly Executed Announcement puts Apple on the Back-foot:
      • Apple reassures employees over child protection measures in internal memo — www.imore.com/… & Apple employees express privacy concerns with the company’s new child protection features — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple publishes Child Safety FAQ to address CSAM scanning concerns and more — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple shares a security threat review for its new CSAM detection feature — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple says it will refuse gov’t demands to expand photo-scanning beyond CSAM — arstechnica.com
      • Apple confirms CSAM checks will be carried out on photos already in iCloud — www.imore.com/…
      • Interview: Apple’s head of Privacy details child abuse detection and Messages safety features — techcrunch.com/…
      • Apple software chief admits child protection measures have been ‘widely misunderstood’ — www.imore.com/…
      • New CSAM Detection Details Emerge Following Craig Federighi Interview — tidbits.com/…
    • Thanks to documents revealed during discovery in Apple’s lawsuits, we now have a better idea of why Apple chose to tackle this problem: Apple’s fraud chief knew it had a child porn problem, messages reveal — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple photo-scanning plan faces global backlash from 90 rights groups — arstechnica.com
    • A developer found code in iOS 4 that hashes images, reverse-engineered it, and published an implementation of it in Go to GitHub. This hashing code is not suitable for CSAM detection because it’s too prone to collisions, but there was never any reason to assume it was the code Apple would be using, and Apple let it be known that it is not — www.vice.com/…
    • Related: Apple Is Already Scanning iCloud Mail for CSAM — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Opinion: Apple’s New ‘Child Safety’ Initiatives, and the Slippery Slope — daringfireball.net/…
  2. Pressure Continues to Mount on the App Store
    • 🇺🇸 Senators target Apple’s App Store exclusivity in new bill — www.theverge.com/…
      • Apple and Google seem spooked by bill requiring more app stores and sideloading — arstechnica.com
      • New App Store bill mistakes ‘great products for market power’, says group — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple and developers reach agreement to bring changes to U.S. App Store — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple will finally let devs tell users about non-App Store purchase options — arstechnica.com

      The settlement term would not let developers tell users about non-App Store purchase options within apps themselves, requiring such communication to take place outside the apps

      • The Coalition for App Fairness is unimpressed by Apple’s App Store ‘sham’ settlement — www.imore.com/…
      • Spotify slams Apple’s App Store ‘concessions’ as a distraction — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇰🇷 South Korea passes law that will mandate alternative iOS App Store payments — www.imore.com/…
      • Epic Games and Spotify-backed coalition lobbies against Apple in Korea — www.imore.com/…
      • Epic Games-backed coalition hails new South Korea App Store laws — www.imore.com/…
      • Spotify welcomes South Korea App Store bill targeting ‘abusive’ Apple — www.imore.com/…
      • Opinion: Let’s Consider Some of the Implications of Third-Party Payment Processing for In-App Purchasing on iOS and Android — daringfireball.net/…

    • Related: Big Tech spends €100 million every year lobbying EU — www.brusselstimes.com/…

    • Related: Tim Cook says competition ‘inherently good’ in sweeping new interview — www.imore.com/…

    • Related: 🇺🇸 🇪🇺 EU and U.S. discuss ‘mutual interest’ in antitrust legislation, digital market cases — www.imore.com/…

  3. Apple Employee Discontent Seems to be Rising
    • Apple places senior engineering program manager on leave after tweeting about sexism at work — www.imore.com/…
    • An informal employee survey shows a 6% wage gap between men and women at Apple — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple shut down a Slack channel created by employees to discuss pay equity — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple says it pays everyone fairly—employees want receipts — arstechnica.com
    • A group of Apple employees have launched a new organizational effort under the #AppleToo banner — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple employee organizing group #AppleToo says it has received over 500 stories of abuse in the workplace — www.imore.com/…
    • How workers at Apple are building a movement — The people, power and politics of tech — www.protocol.com/…
    • Report details how Slack makes it easier for Apple employees to break ranks — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple cares about privacy, unless you work at Apple — www.theverge.com/…
    • Related: Apple’s Mass Turnover in iCloud, Health, AI Teams — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple has delayed its controversial return to office plans again — www.imore.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple launches ‘no sound issues’ service program for the iPhone 12 and iPhone 12 Pro — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple has released iCloud for Windows 12.5 with a new password manager — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple’s Magic Keyboard with Touch ID, Magic Trackpad, more now on sale — www.imore.com/… (M1 Macs only)
  • Apple adds very expensive new graphics options to Mac Pro — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple launches redesigned online store with dedicated Store tab — www.imore.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

Emoji Meaning
🎧 A link to audio content, probably a podcast.
flag The story is particularly relevant to people living in a specific country, or, the organisation the story is about is affiliated with the government of a specific country.
📊 A link to graphical content, probably a chart, graph, or diagram.
💵 A link to an article behind a pay-wall.

item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 97 (September 2021)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Allison Sheridan from the NosillaCast Podcast - @podfeet
  • Adam Christianson from The Mac Cast - @maccast

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by some some Apple-related legal news, some Apple HR news, and some highlights from Apple's original content and subscription services. The four main stories are Apple's on-going Antitrust woes, The EU's proposed USB-C mandate, Apple's 'California Streaming' event, and reflections on the decade since Steve Jobs's death. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in September.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta97.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple Delays CSAM Detection Launch — tidbits.com/…
    • Privacy Advocates Deliver 59,000 Petition Signatures to Apple Over CSAM Detection — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇬🇧 Priti Patel (UK Home Secretary) says Apple should see through CSAM photo scanning measures — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple have announced more details of their up-coming digital IDs — www.apple.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Arizona & Georgia will be the first states to support the IDs, followed by Connecticut, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Oklahoma & Utah, and the TSA (Transport Safety Authority) will deploy readers are some airports.
    • Apple released a lot of technical detail, and seem to have thought of all the most likely attacks/risks, and countered them
    • The technology is based on a new ISO standard Apple helped develop that has now been published — www.macobserver.com/…
  • The employee discontent story rumbles on:
    • AppleToo Workers File First Two Labor Law Complaints — www.macobserver.com/…
    • #AppleToo calls for change in open letter to Tim Cook — www.imore.com/…
    • People chief Deirdre O’Brien tells Apple employees to talk to their managers about pay and other concerns — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple shareholders seek huge upheaval over employee NDA agreements — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple fires employee who complained about harassment over leak — www.imore.com/…
    • Tim Cook addresses pay, diversity, privacy, and more at internal Apple meeting — www.imore.com/…
    • Tim Cook says employees who leak memos do not belong at Apple, according to leaked memo — www.theverge.com/…
      • Related: Former Apple employee faces criminal charges over trade secrets leak — www.imore.com/…
    • According to Business Insider, things are not good in Apple’s health division: Apple dreamed of making healthcare easy. Then it silenced its medical experts. — www.businessinsider.com/… & Apple refutes report that claims its health team is in turmoil — www.imore.com/…
  • Some more Pegasus/NSO Group Developments:
    • Apple patches “FORCEDENTRY” zero-day exploited by Pegasus spyware — arstechnica.com
    • 🇩🇪 Germany Secretly Purchased NSO Group Spyware ‘Pegasus’ — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇫🇷 Pegasus spyware found on 5 French cabinet members’ phones - The Mac Security Blog — www.intego.com/…
  • 🇮🇪 Ireland commits to global minimum corporation tax of 15% — www.imore.com/…
  • More Authoritarian Troubles:
    • 🇷🇺 Russia accuses Apple of election interference over Navalny app — www.imore.com/… & Apple removes Navalny app from App Store hours before Russia election — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Apple appears to have disabled iCloud Private Relay in Russia for reasons unknown — www.imore.com/…
  • Work to get Linux onto M1 Macs is progressing faster than many expected: Linux is now ‘usable’ on Apple’s M1 Macs — www.imore.com/…
  • Most of Apple’s new OSes for the year are out (but not macOS): iOS 15, iPadOS 15, watchOS 8, and tvOS 15 Now Available — tidbits.com/…
    • Apple Releases iOS 15 With Live Text, Shared With You, Focus, and More — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple Releases iPadOS 15 With Widgets, Quick Note, App Library, and More — www.macobserver.com/…
    • watchOS 8 review: Letting you accomplish more from your wrist — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple releases Safari 15 with its controversial tab redesign — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇮🇹 Siri will speak Italian on Apple TV and HomePod once tvOS 15 is released — www.imore.com/…

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 A federal judge has allowed a lawsuit against Apple over privacy violations caused by human review of unintentional activations to proceed, though he did dismiss the other claim in the suit related to CA’s unfair competition law — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • The apparently struggling Apple Car project gets another change of leadership:
    • Head of Apple Car project Doug Field leaves the company for Ford — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Watch Software Chief Kevin Lynch Takes Over Apple Car Group — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple taps Mercedes engineers for ‘special project’, likely Apple Car — www.imore.com/…
  • Long-Time Indie Developer Wil Shipley Joins Apple — www.macobserver.com/…
  • One retirement and some promotions — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple’s Corporate Treasurer Gary Wipfler is retiring, and is being replaced from within by Michael Shapiro
    • Alan Gilchrist becomes vice president of engineering for custom silicon and battery technology
    • Eden Sears has been promoted from senior director of brand marketing for the iPhone and iPad to * vice president of brand*
    • Two members of Craig Federighi’s team have been promoted to VP, Stacey Lysik & Ron Huang
  • TIME names Tim Cook one of the world’s most influential people — www.imore.com/… & Deirdre O’Brien and Lisa Jackson among Fortune’s ‘Most Powerful Women’ — www.imore.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • The nominations and awards keeping coming for Apple TV+:
    • Apple TV+ Shows ‘Trying’ And ‘Ted Lasso’ Earn Edinburgh TV Awards Nominations — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple TV+ earns seven Creative Emmy Awards for ‘Ted Lasso,’ ‘Calls,’ more — www.imore.com/…
    • ‘Ted Lasso’ wins big at the Television Critics Association Awards — www.imore.com/… (‘Outstanding New Program’, ‘Outstanding Achievement in Comedy’ & ‘Program of the Year’)
    • ‘Ted Lasso’ Scores Historic Win at 2021 Primetime Emmy Awards — www.macobserver.com/… (‘Outstanding Comedy Series’, Jason Sudeiki for ‘Outstanding Lead Actor in a Comedy Series’, Brett Goldstein for ‘Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series’ & Hannah Waddingham for ‘Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series’)
  • More Apple TV+ Device Support: 2016/17 LG TV owners can now use a new Apple TV+ app for their ‘Ted Lasso’ fix — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Arcade keeps expanding: Hit game Crossy Road+ is now available for download in Apple Arcade — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Music now supports dynamic head tracking with Spatial Audio — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Maps keeps improving:
    • Apple details iOS 15 Maps improvements, plans for 3D view expansion — www.imore.com/…
      • London, LA, NYC & the San Francisco Bay Area get 3D maps now
      • Philadelphia, San Diego & Washington, D.C will get 3D maps later this year
      • More cities including Montreal, Toronto & Vancouver will get 3D maps next year
    • 🇮🇹 Apple rolls out huge Maps upgrade in Italy and Andorra — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. A Lot of Anti-trust Developments
    • 🇰🇷 Apple and Google Told to Submit Compliance Plans For New South Korea App Store Law Within Days — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇯🇵 Apple reached as settlement with Japanese regulators, agreeing to end it’s anti-steering provision for reader apps — daringfireball.net/…, www.imore.com/… & arstechnica.com
      • Related: Spotify says further App Store concessions still not enough — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Judge Gonzalez Rogers issued her ruling in the Epic -v- Apple case: daringfireball.net/… & tidbits.com/…
      • Apple won on 9 out of 10 counts, and are ruled not to be monopolists
      • Apple lose on their anti-steering provision, and there’s an injunction opening up referrals to outside payments to all apps (not just reader apps like in the Japanese case)
      • Many initial media reports cast it as a win for Epic, but that soon shifted as it became clear Epic are very unhappy and are appealing (making Fornight fans cranky) — www.imore.com/… & www.imore.com/…
      • Apple immediately declared victory, stressing the fact that they were not found to be monopolists — www.imore.com/…
      • Epic asked for their app store account back, Apple said no, in keeping with the judge’s ruling that Epic broke their contract with Apple when they snuck their own payment system into the store to trigger the case. Epic were also ordered to pay Apple $6M for commission it lost as a result — www.imore.com/…, www.imore.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple have appealed the part of the ruling leading to the injunction, and, asked for a stay on the injunction while the work out proposed changes the say will make the injunction unnecessary. The filing also officially explains their decision not to let Epic back into the store ATM — www.imore.com/… & www.imore.com/…
      • Popular software sales platform Paddle have announced an API to facilitate 3rd-party ‘in app’ purchases. Details are sparse, but it seems it would work by adding a link or button in the app that takes the user to Paddle’s website in the user’s default browser — daringfireball.net/…
        • In-app purchase alternative from Paddle will see apps rejected, says expert — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: Microsoft Store For Windows Available to Third Parties – Including Epic Games — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Related Opinion: Marco.org — marco.org/…
    • 🇳🇱 Dutch watchdog finds Apple app store payment rules anti-competitive - sources — www.reuters.com/…
    • 🇮🇳 The non-profit group Together We Fight Society has filed an anti-trust suit against Apple in India over Apple’s cut of App Store revenues — www.macobserver.com/… (another App Store case)
    • 🇮🇹 Italy Calls iCloud Terms and Conditions Illegal — www.macobserver.com/…
  2. The European Commission have published a directive to mandate USB-C as a universal charging port for mobile devices (and the un-bundling of chargers from devices) — www.brusselstimes.com/… & www.imore.com/…
    • The commission’s press release — ec.europa.eu/…
    • The directive needs to be approved by both the European Parliament and the Council of Ministers before it goes into effect.
    • When it goes into effect a 2-year transition period will start, giving tech companies time to transition
    • Related: Brazil Fines Apple For Not Including a Charger in iPhone 13 Boxes — www.macobserver.com/…
  3. Apple’s ‘California Streaming’ Event — www.imore.com/…
    • Here’s all the ways you can re-watch Apple’s ‘California Streaming’ event — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Fitness+ expands to 15 more countries, new workouts added — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple announces Apple Watch Series 7 with larger display and more — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple Watch Series 7 comes in 41mm and 45mm sizes and your old bands will fit fine — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple Watch Series 7 shares the same chip as the current model — don’t expect a performance bump this time around — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple refreshes entry-level $329 iPad with faster chip, 64GB of storage — arstechnica.com
    • Apple announces a refreshed iPad mini with huge new upgrades — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple says the ‘jelly scroll’ issue on the iPad mini is ‘normal behavior’ — www.imore.com/…
      • iFixit dives into the iPad mini’s ‘jelly scroll’ issue in its new teardown — www.imore.com/…
      • The new iPad mini powers through Pixelmator ML upscaling tasks quicker than an iMac Pro — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple announces iPhone 13 in 4 flavors: mini, regular, Pro, and Pro Max — arstechnica.com
      • iPhone 13 Pro Camera Features Include All-New Macro Photography — www.macobserver.com/…
        • Apple promises new iPhone 13 setting to fix macro mode switching — www.imore.com/…
        • New iOS 15.1 beta lets you manually control Macro mode for iPhone 13 Pro — www.imore.com/…
      • ProRes for iPhone 13 Pro coming in “future iOS 15 update” — www.imore.com/…
        • iPhone 13 Pro does not support ProRes 4K video in 128GB storage option — www.imore.com/…
        • One measly minute of 4K ProRes video eats 6GB of an iPhone 13 Pro’s storage — www.imore.com/…
        • Related: iMovie and Clips updated with support for Cinematic mode and ProRes video — www.imore.com/…
      • The iPhone 13 is thicker and heavier than the iPhone 12 — arstechnica.com
      • iPhone 13 is the first iPhone to feature support for Dual eSIM — www.imore.com/…
      • Early iPhone 13 benchmarks confirm all are fast, but the Pro models are monsters — www.imore.com/…
      • Filing reveals iPhone 13 battery increases — www.imore.com/… & iPhone 13 battery life tests show huge improvements over iPhone 12 — www.imore.com/…
      • iPhone 13 ProMotion has 12 different refresh rates, 7 more than iPad Pro — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple finally upgrades the base storage of the iPhone and iPad — www.imore.com/…
  4. A decade without Steve Jobs
    • Apple marks 10th anniversary of Steve Jobs’ death with touching tribute — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple releases ‘Celebrating Steve’ short film on its YouTube channel — www.imore.com/…
    • Tim Cook remembers Steve Jobs in memo to Apple employees — www.imore.com/…
    • Jony Ive on Steve Jobs — daringfireball.net/…

Quick Stories

  • iWork Update Adds Pivot Tables, Mobile Improvements, and Collaborative Presenting — www.macobserver.com/…
  • AppleCare+ Now Covers Cracked Back Glass on iPhone 12 and iPhone 13 Models for Reduced $29 Fee — www.macrumors.com/…
  • 🇬🇧 🇦🇺 AppleCare+ Theft and Loss comes to UK, Australia — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇫🇷 🇮🇹 🇪🇸 AppleCare+ renewals come to France, Italy, and Spain — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple launches Advanced Fraud Protection for Apple Card — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple releases redesigned iCloud Mail for the web — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple confirms iCloud+ upgrades with iOS 15 rollout — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple’s updated MagSafe Leather Wallet has Find My smarts built in — www.imore.com/…
  • Some Headphones Developments:
    • Beats launches A-Cold-Wall* limited-edition Studio3 headphones — www.imore.com/…
    • Find My support rolls out to AirPods Pro and AirPods Max — www.imore.com/…
    • Firmware update brings new Conversation Boost feature to AirPods Pro — arstechnica.com
  • Two small App Store Improvements:
    • Apple confirms return of ‘Report a Problem’ button in some international App Stores — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple: Apps that create accounts must let people delete them by February 2022 — www.imore.com/…
  • 📌 Apple schedules its Q4 2021 earnings call for Thursday, October 28 — www.imore.com/…
