item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 98 (October 2021)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Chuck Joiner from MacVoices - @chuckjoiner
  • Lynda Gousha from the Silicon Valley MUG - @llg4cdg

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by some some Apple-related legal news, and some highlights from Apple's original content and subscription services. The three main stories are Apple's 'Unleashed' event, the release of macOS Monterey, and Apple's Q4 2021 earnings call. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in October.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta98.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Ecobee make use of the new features announced at WWDC to add Siri to their SmartThermostats — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple backpedals on almost all changes made to Safari — www.imore.com/…
  • As promised in last month’s keynote: Apple Fitness+ expands to fifteen new countries — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: The Apple One Premier subscription bundle rolls out to 17 new countries — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: The new countries are not getting Apple News+, but three more American cities are getting local news via News (Washington DC, Charlotte NC & Miami FL) — www.imore.com/…

  • AppleToo developments:

    • Apple have fired Janneke Parrish, one of the leaders of the #AppleToo movement for interfering in an investigation into product leaks. Their supporters are portraying the ground as a technicality, but that’s just one side of the story, and Apple are not commenting — www.imore.com/… & daringfireball.net/… (The accusation is interfering in a company investigation into product leaks)
    • Parrish went on to file labor charge against Apple — www.theverge.com/…
  • Pegasus Spyware/NSO Group developments:
    • 🇪🇺 Pegasus Project: European Parliament awards journalism prize to investigation of use of spyware — www.brusselstimes.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Pegasus spyware maker NSO added to Entity List as a national security threat — www.imore.com/…
  • The fallout from iOS 14’s App Tracking Transparency continues:
    • Snap shares plummet 25% as it reveals Apple privacy changes crushed ads — www.imore.com/…
    • Facebook, Google earnings show mixed impact of iOS 14 changes — www.imore.com/…
    • Peloton says Apple privacy changes partly to blame for revised outlook — www.imore.com/…
    • Customer feedback on iPhone tracking changes ‘overwhelmingly positive’ — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple continue their fight against side-loading:
    • Apple have released a 47-page white paper detailing the dangers as they see them — www.tomsguide.com/…
      • The PDF — www.apple.com/…
    • Craig Federighi spoke strongly and passionately against side-loading at the Web Summit in Lisbon — www.imore.com/… & arstechnica.com/…
  • 🇨🇳 China’s authoritarian regime continues to cause headaches for Apple & other tech companies:
    • Did China just force Apple to remove a Quran app from the App Store? — www.imore.com/…
    • Audible App Unavailable in China App Store [Updated] — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Yahoo Finance and Bible App Amongst Latest to be Removed From China App Store — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Yahoo Exits China Due to ‘Challenging’ Environment — www.macobserver.com/…

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 Apple -v- Epic:
    • Epic Games files opposition to Apple appeal in App Store case — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple updated it’s developer guidelines in line with the Epic ruling, allowing developers to ask for contact information to contact users outside the app, and announcing a new in-app events API — www.imore.com/…
      • The actual changes — developer.apple.com/…
      • In-app events will come to the App Store on October 27 — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple filed paperwork with the court describing the changes above as complying with part of the court order, and asking for a stay on implementing the provision to allow steering — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Mark Zuckerberg unveils plan to bypass Apple’s 30% fees — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇰🇷 South Korean -v- Google & Apple:
    • Google unveils South Korea alternative billing system, fees still attached — www.imore.com/…
      • Opinion: John Gruber points out that Google’s move to charge commission even via alternative payment providers will prove an interesting test case — daringfireball.net/…
    • Related: Apple South Korea head resigns amidst App Store payments scrutiny — www.imore.com/… (It’s not at all clear there is any connection)
    • Related: Google has reduced it’s PlayStore cut from 30% to 15%, and as low as 10% for some kinds of in-app content — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇷🇺 Russia opens antitrust case against Apple’s App Store — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇫🇷 Apple says $1.3 billion France fine should be overturned — www.imore.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+ continues to go strong as it reaches its second birthday
    • Apple TV+ breaks into weekly streaming charts with ‘Ted Lasso’ — www.imore.com/… & Apple TV+’s ‘Ted Lasso’ finale sees strong viewership but can’t compete with Netflix’s ‘Squid Game’ — www.imore.com/…
    • ‘Finch’, ‘Dickinson’ Season Three, and ’Hello, Jack! The Kindness Show Out Now on Apple TV+ — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Mariah Carey returns for Apple TV+ Christmas special — www.imore.com/…
    • Access to Apple TV+ continues to get easier:
      • LG offers its smart TV customers a free three-month Apple TV+ trial — www.imore.com/…
      • Latest Amazon TVs Will Support AirPlay 2, HomeKit — www.macobserver.com/…
      • 🇺🇸 Apple TV Plus Is Coming to Comcast’s Xfinity and Other Video Platforms — variety.com/…
      • 🇬🇧 🇮🇪 🇩🇪 🇦🇹 🇮🇹 Apple TV+ coming to Sky Glass and Sky Q — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: New report says Apple is battling TV+ piracy online — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple TV+ bags 20th Television’s Erin May as a new senior creative executive — www.imore.com/…
  • New games continue to flow into Apple Arcade regularly
    • Tiny Wings+ has flapped its way into Apple Arcade — download now! — www.imore.com/…
    • ‘NBA 2K22 Arcade Edition’ Now Available to Play on Apple Arcade — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Official Crayola Game ‘Crayola Create and Play+’ Now on Apple Arcade — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Transformers: Tactical Arena has rolled out to Apple Arcade — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Netflix launches video games for members on Android — www.brusselstimes.com/…
  • Maps improvements continue to roll out around the world:
    • 🇦🇺 Improved Apple Maps rolling out in Australia — www.imore.com/…
  • ApplePay’s world-wide rollout continues:
    • 🇸🇪 Express Travel with Apple Pay comes to Skånetrafiken in Sweden — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇦🇿 🇨🇷 🇨🇴 Apple Pay comes to Azerbaijan, Costa Rica, and Colombia — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. “Unleashed” Event
    • Here’s how to re-watch Apple’s ‘Unleashed’ MacBook Pro event — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple announces new third-generation AirPods featuring Spatial Audio — www.imore.com/…
      • What Does the AirPods IPX4 Rating Mean? — www.macobserver.com/…
      • AirPods Pro are now available with the new MagSafe Charging Case — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple announces new HomePod mini colors and new Apple Music plan — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: Apple have re-hired Afrooz Familyto head the HomePod team – he left Apple in 2016 to co-found the audio startup Syng — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple announce a new Apple Music Voice Plan for Siri-only access to Apple’s entire catalogue with no ads and infinite skips for $4.99p.m. — www.apple.com/…
      • Apple Music Voice Plan: Everything you need to know — www.imore.com/…
      • Related:
        • Apple rolls out new Apple Music playlists — www.imore.com/… & A Comprehensive Guide to 250+ of Apple Music’s New Mood and Activity Playlists - MacStories — www.macstories.net/…
        • Apple Music is now officially available on PS5 — www.imore.com/…
        • Travis Scott ‘Astroworld’ Performance To Stream Exclusively on Apple Music — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Context: Spotify has nothing similar, but Amazon has an Amazon Music Echo plan for $4p.m. — daringfireball.net/…
      • Related Opinion: Trying to Understand Why The Apple Music Voice Plan Exists — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple M1 Pro and M1 Max chips: Everything you need to know — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: 🎧 🎦 Rene Richie interviewed Apple executives Tom Boger & Tim Millet about the new chips. You can watch the video on YouTube or listen to it on his podcast — youtu.be/… & podcasts.apple.com/…
    • Apple intros 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pros with display notches, M1 Pro, and M1 Max — arstechnica.com
      • Apple’s new MagSafe cable now comes separate from power adapter — www.imore.com/…
      • MacBook Pro’s 140W adapter is Apple’s first GaN charger — www.imore.com/…
      • It Costs Another US$20 to Get Fast Charging For The New 14-Inch MacBook Pro — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple updates Final Cut Pro and Logic Pro for new MacBook with M1 Pro and M1 Max — www.imore.com/… & iMovie gets update for iPhone 13’s cinematic mode, new MacBook Pro chips — www.imore.com/…
      • The notch causes controversy:
        • MacBook Pro Notch Menu Bar Issues Surface — www.macobserver.com/…
        • Apple’s new MacBook Pro can use the full screen around notch — www.imore.com/…
        • How to adjust an app’s settings to appear below the camera area on your 14-inch or 16-inch MacBook Pro — support.apple.com/…
        • Update for Menu Bar Organizer ‘Bartender’ Supports MacBook Pro Notch — www.macobserver.com/…
      • New MacBook Pro teardown reveals big internal upgrades — www.imore.com/…
      • Review: 2021 MacBook Pro review: Yep, it’s what you’ve been waiting for — arstechnica.com
    • Related: Apple cuts another Intel tie by discontinuing 21.5-inch iMac — arstechnica.com
    • Just for Fun: 🎦 A Song Made From Apple Sounds — www.macobserver.com/… (featured in the keynote)
  2. macOS Monterey is Now Available — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Universal Control was not ready to launch with the OS, it will come out later this fall — www.imore.com/…
    • How to Use Focus to Limit Notifications in iOS 15 and macOS Monterey - The Mac Security Blog — www.intego.com/…
    • 🎦 Apple Support: How to use Shortcuts on Mac — www.loopinsight.com/…
    • Apple rolls out fix for macOS Monterey bug that bricked some Macs with the T2 chip — 9to5mac.com/…
    • Trivial Fun: Apple didn’t release a photo background for Monterey, so a group of photographers did! — www.vyncher.com/… (I’m using it, and love it)
    • Related: iOS 15.1 Adds SharePlay, ProRes Video Capture, and Vaccination Cards in Wallet — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Reviews:
      • macOS Monterey review: A worthy update with some holes still to fill — www.imore.com/…
      • macOS 12 Monterey: The Ars Technica review — arstechnica.com/…
  3. Apple’s Q4 2021 Earnings Call — Apple announces record fourth quarter — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple Reports EPS of $1.24 on $83B in Revenues for September Quarter — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Despite huge iPhone sales, Apple misses the mark in Q4 earnings report — arstechnica.com
    • Apple experienced $6 billion in supply constraints in Q4 2021 — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple shares slide as Tim Cook warns of holiday supply constraints — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple earned $1 billion every day this financial year — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: Microsoft passes Apple as world’s most valuable company — www.imore.com/… (still higher on 6 Nov)

Quick Stories

  • As expected, Apple is doing it’s bit on climate change in time for COP26
    • Apple announces big environmental leaps ahead of COP26 — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple joins Imec’s new Sustainable Semiconductor research program — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple joins First Movers Coalition as part of company’s environmental goals — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: 🎧 Jane Goodall interviews Lisa Jackson on her excellent Hopecast — overcast.fm/…
  • Apple joins the Blender Development Fund, will help out with ‘engineering expertise’ — www.imore.com/…
  • Beats ditches the Powerbeats, Beats Solo Pro, and Beats EP as Fit Pro earbuds arrive — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple reportedly has hired CJ Moore, a former head of Tesla’s Autopilot team to join its car project under fellow Tesla alum Stuart Bowers who joined Apple last year — www.imore.com/…
  • Tile takes on Apple’s AirTag with its new item tracker lineup — www.imore.com/…

item.title: Let's Talk Apple — Ep. 99 (November 2021)
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Charles Edge from the Mac Admins Podcast - @cedge318

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by some some Apple-related legal news, quite a bit of Apple HR news, and some highlights from Apple's original content and subscription services. The four main stories are Apple's new self service repair program, Apple's renewed focus on business and enterprise customers, Apple's suit against the NSO Group (makers of the Pegasus spyware), and the faux-scandal around Apple buying ads for apps they sell in their App Store. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in November.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta99.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • ATT/Privacy: Apple Adds Private Click Measurement to In-App Advertising in iOS 15.2 — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Digital IDs: Apple delays iOS 15’s driver’s license support until ‘early 2022’ — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Report details the control Apple has over states & their digital ID card rollout — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇦🇺 🇳🇿 🇦🇹 🇫🇷 🇩🇪 🇮🇪 🇮🇹 🇪🇸 🇬🇧 The colourful new HomePods are now available in Australia, New Zealand, India, Austria, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Spain & the UK — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Continuing Scrutiny from Regulators:
    • 🇰🇷 South Korea lawmakers ‘not satisfied’ with Apple’s IAP compliance — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇪🇺 The DMA comes closer to being a reality: EU countries agree on common stance on new rules for U.S. tech giants — www.reuters.com/…
    • 🇮🇹 Apple fined $150M over Italy sales agreement with Amazon — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇮🇹 Italy’s antitrust regulator fines Google, Apple over data use — www.reuters.com/…
    • 🇬🇧 Apple questioned over app age ratings in the UK — www.imore.com/… (Google questioned too)
  • Continuing Friction with Authoritarian Regimes:
    • 🇷🇺 Russia demands Apple must set itself up in the country by the end of 2021 — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇨🇳 Popular flight tracker Flightradar24 removed from app stores in China — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: 🇺🇸 🇨🇳 Apple seeks exemptions from tariffs on Apple Watch, Mac Pro parts — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple’s worldwide national security report shows drop in data requests during 2020 US election — www.cnet.com/… (The reporting period ends just before the January 6th insurrection in the US, so the numbers are not all that interesting)

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Epic:
    • 🇺🇸 The US Case:
      • U.S. District Judge Yvonne Gonzales Rogers rejected Apple’s request for a delay on the December 9th deadline for the App Store changes she ordered in her recent ruling —arstechnica.com & www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple have appealed that rejection to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇦🇺 Apple vs Epic to proceed in Australia after bid to delay rejected — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Netflix have rolled out their subscription gaming service on iOS. Each game is listed on the App Store separately — www.imore.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple to pay retail workers $30 million over security bag checks — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple one step closer to settling $100M App Store lawsuit with developers — www.imore.com/…
  • After 10 people were killed in a crowd surge at the Travis Scott Astroworld Festival on November 5th, 125 survivors are suing Apple Music, Epic Records, Travis Scott, Drake & Live Nation for $750M for ‘the loss of mental and physical health, and human life’ (Apple Music streamed the ill-fated concert live) — www.imore.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple have updated their Return to Work plan – the current target is to return to the Office on the first of February, though the company have made some concessions to workers, testing a hybrid working model, and allowing workers to work from home for more full weeks each year — www.imore.com/…
  • Cher Scarlett, one of the driving forces behind the #AppleToo movement has resigned from Apple after agreeing a settlement with the company — www.imore.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple affirms employee rights to discuss working conditions externally — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Research reveals Apple salaries for engineers, developers, and more — www.imore.com/…
  • Johnson & Johnson CEO Alex Gorsky has joined Apple’s board as a director — www.imore.com/…
  • Sam Jadallah, Apple’s head of Home Services is leaving Apple after just 2 years, and we don’t know where he’s going, if anywhere — www.imore.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
  • AppleCare Senior Director Randy Teele Joins GameStop — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Former Tesla engineer Michael Schwekutsch has left Apple to become senior Vice President of Engineering at Archer, a VTOL electric air taxi startup — www.imore.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Music
    • Tencent Music Entertainment and Apple Music Strike Worldwide Deal For Chinese Catalog — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇫🇷 Apple celebrates 40 years in France with new Apple Music studio in Paris — www.imore.com/…
    • LG smart TVs now have an Apple Music app — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Arcade continues to roll out new games:
    • Grab Kingdom Rush Frontiers TD & Galaga Wars+ in Apple Arcade now — www.imore.com/…
    • LEGO Star Wars: Castaways is building something big on Apple Arcade today — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple TV+
    • Tom Hanks’ ‘Finch’ posts the biggest opening weekend ever for Apple TV+ — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple TV+ increased its market share by 1% in the third quarter of 2021 — www.imore.com/…
    • Yet more nominations and awards:
      • ‘CODA’ Receives Nine Hollywood Critics Association Film Award nominations — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple TV+ show ‘Tehran’ picks up Best Drama at 2021 International Emmy Awards — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple TV+ movie ‘CODA’ scoops two Gotham awards — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Amazon brings Prime Video to the Mac App Store, including purchases — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Continues to roll out Maps improvements around the world:
    • 🇺🇸 Apple Maps launches new 3D map in Washington D.C. — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇩🇪 🇪🇸 Apple Maps in Germany And Spain Lets Users Report Accidents and Hazards — www.macobserver.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple’s new Self Service Repair program – US-only at first, and starting with most common iPhone repairs, but expanding to more countries and more products over the next year — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple announces new Self Service repairs for iPhone 12, iPhone 13 — www.imore.com/…
    • iFixit hails ‘huge’ Apple repair changes, but wants more — www.imore.com/…
    • Analysts Find Not Many iPhone Owners Will Use Apple Self Service Repair — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Third-party iPhone 13 screen repairs won’t break Face ID after upcoming software update — www.imore.com/…
    • Opinion: Apple’s New Self Service Repair Program — daringfireball.net/…
  2. Apple’s renewed focus on Business & Enterprise customers:
    • New Apple Business Essentials Brings Device Management for Small Businesses — www.macobserver.com/…
      • 🎦 New Video Explains Apple Business Essentials — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple Rolling Out New MacBook Upgrade Program For Businesses — www.macobserver.com/…
  3. 🇺🇸 Apple sues the NSO group, the makers of the Pegasus spyware in the US — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple believe they have standing to take the case in the US because NSO Group signed up for hundreds of Apple IDs to spread their spyware, hence entering into a contract with Apple under California law.
    • Apple are asking that the NSO Group be forbidden to use any Apple products or services, seeking compensation for the work they had to put in to fighting Pegasus, and punitive damages.
    • Apple also announced that they are contributing $10M to organisations like Media Lab that seek out and expose spyware like Pegasus
    • Apple Lawsuit Goes After Spyware Firm NSO Group — tidbits.com/…
    • Related: Here’s how Apple will warn you if you’re under state-sponsored spyware attack — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: 🇺🇸 U.S. State Department phones hacked with Israeli company spyware - sources — www.reuters.com/…
  4. The Kerfuffle over the ads Apple buys for apps they sell in their app store
    • The original article: Apple Quietly Buying Ads Via Google For High-Value Subscription Apps To Capture App Publisher Revenue — www.forbes.com/…
    • Editorial by Bart:
      • There is nothing secret about these ads – they were clearly labeled as ads for the App Store, and they take users to the app store
      • Apple have been doing this for years, and far from being a nefarious plot, it’s a great value-add for developers — one of the value propositions Apple offers developers is publicity for their apps!
      • It’s completely normal for a shop to advertise what they sell!
        • I see ads for Merrell, Under Armour, Sketchers & New Balance hiking shoes & trainers from Sports Direct all over the place — web ads, email blasts, billboards, store-front posters, and more! Sports Direct know I’m hard on footwear because I do over 20K steps a day, and that I love those brands, so they advertise heavily at me to keep getting me to buy from their store, and it works! Is that a plot to somehow defraud Merrell or Sketchers? Hardly!

Quick Stories

  • Apple announced some awards of their own:
    • Apple announces third annual Apple Music Award winners including The Weeknd — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple hails best podcasts of 2021 — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple announces winners of 2021 App Store Awards — www.imore.com/…
  • New headphones in time for the holidays:
    • Beats partners with fragment design on limited-edition Beats Flex — www.imore.com/…
    • Beats announces limited-edition Beats Studio Buds in collab with Union — www.imore.com/…
  • Update to Apple Store App Lets You Save Products to Lists — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple says customers have raised $270 million for AIDS fight with RED — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple have also released new Product Red Apple Watch faces — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Releases iCloud for Windows 13 With Support for ProRes, ProRAW, and Strong Password Generation — www.macrumors.com/…
  • Targus’ unveils new EcoSmart Backpack with built-in Apple Find My support — www.imore.com/…
  • Canonical’s new Multipass 1.8 runs Ubuntu Linux in a VM on M1 Macs — www.imore.com/…

Legend

item.title: LTA 100: December 2021
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Allison Sheridan from the NosillaCast Podcast - @podfeet

The show starts with some reflections on making it to 100 shows. With the navel-gazing out of the way the show moves on to the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by some some Apple-related legal news, quite a bit of Apple HR news, and some highlights from Apple's original content and subscription services. The three main stories are Apple's secret deal with China in 2016, the problems in Apple's Indian factory, and the new features in Apple's latest OS updates. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in December.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta100.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • COVID is causing fresh problems for Apple:
    • 🇺🇸 COVID–19 outbreak closes Apple Store in Texas — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple covers up again as mask requirements return in US stores — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 🇨🇦 Apple closes three retail stores in U.S. and Canada due to COVID–19 — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 🇨🇦 Seven more Apple Stores close due to COVID–19 outbreaks — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple closes more stores in NYC, offering curbside pickup for online orders — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple delays employee return to office again, new date ‘yet to be determined’ — 9to5mac.com/…
  • Regulatory pressure continues to mount on Apple:
    • 🇬🇧 The UK’s Competition & Markets Authority (CMA) published a report strongly critical of Apple & Google’s ‘duopoly’, but recommend no action be taken, at least for now — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇵🇱 Poland opens investigation into Apple’s App Tracking Transparency feature — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇳🇱 Apple Must Let Dating Apps Offer Alternative Payment Options in the App Store, Dutch Regulator Says — gizmodo.com/… (Apple have 2 months to comply)
    • 🇮🇳 The India Competition Commission launching probe into Apple’s App Store payment system — www.imore.com/…
  • Fallout continues from the #AppleToo movement:
    • 🇺🇸 SEC rejects Apple’s bid to block three shareholder proposals — arstechnica.com & SEC blocks Apple’s bid to stop shareholders’ radical NDA proposal — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple shareholders seek civil-rights audit following employee controversies — www.imore.com/… (not one of the proposals covered by the SEC ruling)
    • 🇺🇸 #AppleToo organizer Cher Scarlett is no longer withdrawing her National Labor Relations Board complaint against the company — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 The US Department of Labour has opened an investigation into Apple, officially they have not said what they’re investigating, but reports say it’s related to potential retaliation against former employee Ashley Gjovik who was fired by Apple in September — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple employee group plans walkout on Christmas Eve — www.imore.com/…
      • As best as I can tell this was a bit of a damp squib with just 50 workers actually walking out: www.huffpost.com/…
  • Some more developments related to repairing Apple products:
    • iOS 15.2 Adds ‘Parts and Service History’ Feature to iPhone — www.macrumors.com/…
    • Apple Giving Customers a Second Chance to Buy AppleCare+ After Their iPhone or Mac is Repaired — www.macrumors.com/…
  • NSO Group/Pegasus:
    • Pegasus spyware maker NSO is burning cash and considering closure — www.imore.com/…
    • The secret Uganda deal that has brought NSO to the brink of collapse — arstechnica.com/…

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 Apple -v- Epic: Apple won a last-minute stay on the injunction ordering them to allow 3rd-party in-app payments by 9 December, the injunction lasts until Apple’s appeal is resolved — arstechnica.com/…
  • 🇷🇺 Apple are suing Russia’s Federal Antimonopoly Service to overturn a ruling issued against it in August regarding anti-steering rules in the App Store — www.imore.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • The Apple Car project has lost three more engineers — www.imore.com/…
    • Eric Rogers (chief engineer for radar systems) has moved to flying-taxi startup Joby Aviation Inc.
    • Alex Clarabut (battery team manager) & Stephen Spiteri (a hardware engineering team manager) have moved to Archer Aviation Inc, another flying-taxi startup.
  • Apple University dean Joel Podolny leaves company for startup — www.imore.com/…
  • Nick Law, Apple advertising VP, is leaving for pastures new — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple is building a new team to bring its wireless chip design in-house — www.imore.com/…
  • Related: Meta have reportedly been succeeding in hiring away about 100 Apple engineers in recent months, and Bloomberg now report Apple are responding by offering rare bonuses of up to $180k to senior engineers to keep them at Apple — www.bloomberg.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+
    • Yet more nominations & awards:
      • Apple TV+ Earns Nine Critics Choice Awards Television Nominations — www.macobserver.com/…
        • Best Drama Series – For All Mankind
        • Best Supporting Actor in a Drama Series – Billy Crudup (The Morning Show)
        • Best Comedy Series – Ted Lasso
        • Best Actor in a Comedy Series – Jason Sudeikis (Ted Lasso)
        • Best Supporting Actor in a Drama Series – Brett Goldstein (Roy Kent in Ted Lasso)
        • Best Supporting Actress in a Drama Series – Kristin Chenoweth (Schmigadoon!)
        • Best Supporting Actress in a Drama Series – Hannah Waddingham (Ted Lasso)
        • Best Movie Made for Television – Come From Away
        • Best Foreign Language Series – Acapulco
      • Apple TV+ earns Six Critics Choice Film Awards nominations — www.imore.com/…
        • CODA nominated for: Best Picture, Best Supporting Actor, Best Adapted Screenplay & Best Young Actor/Actress
        • The Tragedy of Macbeth nominated for: Best Actor & Best Cinematography
      • Apple TV+ won 4 American Film Institute Awards — www.afi.com/…
        • CODA & The Tragedy of Macbeth were listed in the top 10 films of 2021
        • Ted Lasso & Schmigadoon! were listed in the top 10 TV shows of 2021
      • Related: A ‘Ted Lasso’ Animated Short Holiday Special Just Dropped — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇫🇷 Apple TV+, Netflix, Disney+, more agree to pump $330m into French content — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Maps:
    • Apple rolls out its new 3D map in Philadelphia — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. 🇨🇳 Apple in China
    • The Information have revealed details of a deal Apple struck with China in 2016: Inside Tim Cook’s Secret $275 Billion Deal with Chinese Authorities — www.theinformation.com/…
      • Good summary and analysis from John Gruber — daringfireball.net/… & daringfireball.net/…
    • Related: Apple became the dominant phone brand in China in October of 2021 — www.imore.com/…
  2. 🇮🇳 Trouble in India: Worker protests, mass illness lead Apple to put iPhone plant on probation — arstechnica.com (the plant in question is run by Foxconn)
    • Living and Working Conditions at India iPhone Plant Truly Reprehensible — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Women force change at Indian iPhone plant, sick from bad food, crowded dorms — www.reuters.com/…
  3. Significant OS Feature updates — arstechnica.com/…, www.macobserver.com/… & arstechnica.com/…
    • SharePlay arrives on the Mac: How to Use FaceTime Screen Sharing and SharePlay — tidbits.com/…
      • Related: Disney+ adds support for SharePlay on iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple’s voice-only Apple Music subscription goes live: How to use the Apple Music Voice Plan — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: 21+ things you can ask Siri to do in Apple Music Voice Plan — www.applemust.com/…
    • iOS/iPadOS get the promised App Privacy Report feature: Understanding iOS and iPadOS App Privacy Report - The Mac Security Blog — www.intego.com/…
    • iOS get support for Digital Legacy (Legacy Contacts can restore your iCloud backup to an iOS device of theirs when they provide Apple a death certificate): How to set up a Legacy Contact on iPhone and iPad — www.imore.com/… & Apple Digital Legacy: Everything you need to know! — www.imore.com/…
    • The non-controversial Child Protection features go live (Siri answers & parental control for nudity warnings in Messages)
      • Related: Apple Updates ‘Child Safety’ Webpage to Remove Mention of CSAM Fingerprint Matching, But Feature May Still Be Forthcoming — daringfireball.net/… & Apple scrubs controversial CSAM detection feature from webpage but says plans haven’t changed — www.theverge.com/…
    • You can enable a toggle for macro mode on iOS on supported iPhones 13.
    • Related: Apple officially delays macOS Monterey’s Universal Control until spring ’22 — www.imore.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple celebrates 10th anniversary of Employee Giving, $725 million raised — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple joins Boys & Girls Clubs of America to ‘bring new coding opportunities’ to kids — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple launches new open source website for developers — www.imore.com/…

item.title: LTA 101: January 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Rosemary Orchard from various podcasts - @RosemaryOrchard

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by some some Apple-related legal news, a little Apple HR news, and some highlights from Apple's original content and subscription services. The four main stories are Intel's new I9 mobile processor, the controversy around AirTags, more AppStore issues, and Apple's Q1 2022 earnings call. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in January.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta101.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • 🇮🇳 The Foxconn plant that was forced to close by a workers revolt last month has re-opened — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇫🇷 Apple Stopping Providing HeadPhones With iPhones in France — www.macobserver.com/… (A miss-guided law forcing all smartphones to have headphones to save kids from cellphone radiation has been repealed)

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 Apple’s $95 Million Settlement Over Refurbished Replacement Devices Not Being ‘Equivalent to New’ Moves Forward — www.macrumors.com/… (affected customers can now register for inclusion in the settlement, or reject it, allowing them to launch their own suit if they want)
  • Apple -v- Ericsson: (5G patents)
    • 🇺🇸 Ericsson sues Apple over patent infringement as licensing talks break down — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple Countersues Ericsson Seeking Base Station Import Ban — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇧🇷 🇩🇪 🇳🇱 🇧🇪 Ericsson files more lawsuits against Apple in Europe and Brazil — www.imore.com/… & Apple comes under more pressure from Ericsson in patent dispute — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇩🇪 Apple files countersuit against Ericsson in Germany — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple -v- Epic:
    • Epic Games says court got App Store ruling wrong in opening appeal filing — www.imore.com/… (Epic has filed its opening brief in its appeal of last year’s ruling mostly against it)
    • U.S. states, DoJ, and Microsoft declare support for Epic Games in Apple trial — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Fortnite is coming back to iOS through NVIDIA GeForce Now — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 An app developer’s lawsuit over rejections and scammers is allowed to proceed, judge rules — techcrunch.com/… (this is the FlickType case)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Tim Cook 2021 Pay Totals Over US$98 Million — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Basic Salary: $3M
    • Bonus: $12M (for hitting financial and environmental sustainability goals)
    • Stock Awards: $82.35M worth of shares
    • Other Compensation: ~$1.4M (security, travel, pension, life insurance, vacation cash-out etc.)
  • Joe Bass, apparent head of software engineering on Apple’s car project has left Apple for Meta: Almost the entire Apple Car management team from a year ago has left the company — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple has expanded the team testing its self-driving cars in California — www.imore.com/…
  • Microsoft has hired semiconductor designer Mike Filippo away from Apple — www.imore.com/…
  • Key M1 engineer Jeff Wilcox is leaving Apple to return to Intel — www.tomshardware.com/…
  • Apple have reportedly hired Andrea Schubert away from Meta’s AR group — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple Names Kristin Huguet Head of PR — daringfireball.net/… (Huguet has been an Apple spokesperson since 2005, and replaces Stella Low who only joined Apple from Cisco in May 2021!)
  • 🇩🇪 Award-winning producer Dr. Franziska An der Gassen signs on at Apple TV+ — www.imore.com/…

Subscription Services Highlights

  • Programming Note: starting this month award nominations, regular Apple Arcade releases, and run-of-the-mill service rollouts in new countries won’t make the cut anymore.
  • Apple touts its services achievements in tub thumping press release — www.imore.com/…
    • Now more than 200 games on Apple Arcade
    • 90M lossless songs on Apple Music
    • 745M paid subscriptions
  • Apple Fitness+ Introducing New ‘Time to Run’ And ‘Collections’ — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple TV+
    • Jason Sudeikis wins a Golden Globe Award for his ‘Ted Lasso’ performance — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple snags two Technology & Engineering Emmy Awards for its streaming service — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Intel launch their new i9 ‘mobile’ CPU (faster than the M1, but much more power-hungry, and hence, heat producing)
    • Intel says its new Core i9 processor is faster than Apple’s M1 Max — www.imore.com/…
    • Benchmarks Confirm Intel’s Latest Core i9 Chip Outperforms Apple’s M1 Max With Several Caveats — www.macrumors.com/…
    • Opinion: Intel Braggadocio — daringfireball.net/…
  2. AirTag abuses spark debate/controversy
    • Anecdotes:
      • Driver finds a hidden AirTag in his car ahead of likely theft attempt — www.imore.com/…
      • Model says she was tracked by an AirTag that was left in her coat pocket — www.imore.com/…
      • Military families are using AirTags to track their stuff during station moves — www.imore.com/…
    • Analisys & Opinion:
      • Are AirTags Causing Stalking or Making Us More Aware of It? - MacStories — www.macstories.net/…
      • AirTags: Hidden Stalking Menace or Latest Overblown Urban Myth? — tidbits.com/…
    • Apple adds new AirTag tips to a revised Personal Safety User Guide — www.imore.com/…
    • AirGuard Lets You Detect AirTags on Android Smartphones — www.macobserver.com/… (A third-party app!)
  3. The App Store continues to cause trouble for Apple
    • Context: App Store Earnings for Developers has Reached $260 Billion Since 2008 — www.macobserver.com/… & App Annie: Global app stores’ consumer spend up 19% to $170B in 2021, downloads grew 5% to 230B — techcrunch.com/…
    • Regulatory Pressures Continue:
      • 🇺🇸 Developers able to submit claims in $100 million Apple lawsuit settlement — www.imore.com/…
      • 🇰🇷 Apple have told South Korean authorities that they will provide an alternative payment system for App Store developers at ‘a reduced service charge’ — www.imore.com/…
        • Opinion: Apple Presents Plan to Allow External Payment Processing in Apps to South Korea Regulator, Details Currently Scant — daringfireball.net/…
      • 🇳🇱 Apple to allow dating apps to use third-party payments in Dutch App Store — www.imore.com/…
        • Apple’s promise is too little too late, the regulator didn’t just expect Apple to make an announcement by their deadline, they expected Apple to actually implement it too, so they’ve now stated fining Apple — www.imore.com/…
      • 🇺🇸 The senate version of the ‘Open App Markets Act’ has been voted out of committee:
        • Apple are not happy about it — www.imore.com/…
        • The Information Technology and Innovation Foundation (ITIF) agree with Apple — www.macobserver.com/…
        • As does Michael Bloomberg — www.imore.com/…
        • Related: Tim Cook spent 40 minutes on the phone with Ted Cruz over antitrust bill — www.imore.com/…
      • 🇺🇸 Illinois latest state to try and legislate against Apple’s App Store — www.imore.com/…
    • The Wordle Kefuffle
      • Popular word game ‘Wordle’ plagued by App Store clones — www.imore.com/…
      • Developer behind Wordle App Store clone admits he ‘crossed a line’ after being called out — www.imore.com/…
      • The New York Times Acquires Wordle — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Related: an older app named Wordle! that’s not any kind of clone has seen a massive boost in downloads (from 1–2 per day to >200K per week), and the developer has responded by donating the proceeds to charity — www.imore.com/… & arstechnica.com/…
      • Opinion/Analysis: The App Store Is (Well, Was) Lousy With Blatant Wordle Rip-Offs, but One of Them Takes the Cake — daringfireball.net/… & A Five-Letter Word for ‘Rip-Off’ — daringfireball.net/…
      • Related: other problematic apps highlighted by the controversy:
        • Scam app AmpMe rakes in $13 million on the back of thousands of fake reviews — www.imore.com/…
        • Shameless Unpacking Clone Is The App Store’s Top Download — kotaku.com/… (Apple deleted the app after it made news)
    • Apple are continuing to support developers:
      • 🇪🇺 Apple’s App Store Foundations program is expanding to 29 new countries — www.imore.com/…
      • Developers can now use Custom Product Pages with Apple Search Ads — www.imore.com/…
      • https://arstechnica.com/?p=1830317
  4. Apple’s Q1 2022 Earnings Call
    • The lead-up & Context:
      • Breaking: Apple Becomes First U.S Firm Worth US$3 Trillion — www.macobserver.com/…
      • The Mac grew more than any other PC brand in 2021 — www.imore.com/… (based on Canalys numbers)
      • Apple takes top spot in China smartphone sales for first time since 2015 — www.imore.com/… (based on Counterpoint numbers)
      • Numbers from IDC show Samsung shipping the most phones for 2021 as a whole, but Apple shipping the most in Q4 — www.imore.com/…
    • The Earnings Call:
      • Apple Earnings Call Transcripts: Apple CEO Tim Cook on the company’s Q1 2022 earnings — www.imore.com/…
        • Apple now commands an active install base of 1.8 billion devices — www.imore.com/…
        • Apple added 165 million paid subscribers for its services last year — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple Posts Another $100 Billion Plus Quarter — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple just had the biggest holiday quarter in its history — arstechnica.com
      • Apple Q1 2022: Growth for iPhone, Mac, and services sees $123.9 billion in revenue — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple’s M1 processor drives an $11 billion quarter for the Mac — www.imore.com/…
      • Supply chain issues killed iPad sales in the first quarter of 2021 — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: iPad deliveries still as high as nine weeks as Apple prioritizes iPhone 13 — www.imore.com/…
    • After:
      • Apple shares leap nearly 5% in pre-market following all-time earnings record — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple share price soars 7% following stunning Q1 earnings — www.imore.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple announces Black History Month celebration across its products and services — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple’s new Black Unity Braided Solo Loop has begun to appear in Apple Stores — www.imore.com/…
  • The grace period for iOS 14 is over, to stay secure, users need to update to iOS 15 now — www.imore.com/… & www.imore.com/…
  • HomePod appears to be getting ready for a substantial expansion:
    • 🇳🇱 🇧🇪 Siri gains Dutch support on HomePod, hinting at a HomePod mini launch — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇸🇪 Apple seeds HomePod minis to testers in Sweden ahead of official release — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇩🇰 🇳🇴 HomePod mini is being tested in Denmark and Norway amid rumored expansion — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Releases iPhone Macro Challenge for iPhone 13 Pro Users — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 📌 Apple’s annual shareholder meeting will take place on March 4 — www.imore.com/…

Legend

item.title: LTA 102: February 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Rod Simmons from the SMR Podcast - @rodsimmons

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by one notable number, some some Apple-related legal news, a little Apple HR & acquisitions news, and some highlights from Apple's original content and subscription services. The three main stories are updated safety protections for AirPods, the effects of Russia's invasion of Ukraine on the Apple world, and a preview of Apple's annual shareholder meeting. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in February.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta102.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • The dust continues to settle on App Tracking Transparency (ATT):
    • Facebook says iOS privacy changes will cost $10 billion, shares plunge — www.imore.com/…
      • Related Opinion: Facebook Accuses Apple of ‘Browser Carve-Out’ on Tracking Prompts, Hoping No One Will Remember That Safari Is Heavily Biased Toward Privacy — daringfireball.net/…
    • Snapchat shares rocket 50% as company touts iOS privacy change recovery — www.imore.com/…
    • Twitter profit falls but company dodges impact of iOS 14 privacy changes — www.imore.com/…
  • Pressure continues on Apple (& Google’s) App Stores:
    • 🇰🇷 South Korea still not happy with Apple’s plan to comply with App Store laws — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇳🇱 The Dutch dating apps story continues to unfold:
      • 27%: Apple reveals commission rate for alternative App Store payments in Netherlands — www.imore.com/…
      • 8 Feb: Apple fined again over Dutch App Store issues — www.imore.com/…
      • 14 Feb: Dutch authorities have fined Apple another €5 million over third-party App Store payments — www.imore.com/…
      • 21 Feb: Apple racks up its fifth $5.7m file as Dutch consumer watchdog digs in — www.imore.com/…
      • 28 February: Apple argues it’s complied with Dutch watchdog App Store requirements in a new letter — www.imore.com/… & Apple hit with its sixth $5.7m App Store fine as Dutch watchdog says nothing’s changed — www.imore.com/…
      • 🇪🇺 Related: EU Chief slams Apple for choosing fines over compliance — www.imore.com/… (EU Competition Commissioner Margrethe Vestager)
      • Related Analysis: Going Dutch — daringfireball.net/…
      • Related: A Dutch foundation lead by Alexander Klopping, a tech journalist and entrepreneur, is mounting a legal challenge against Apple & Google, claiming their monopolies on app stores have host Dutch citizens a €1Bn in excessive fees — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Microsoft pressures Apple with new Open App Store principles, but some don’t apply to Xbox — www.imore.com/…
      • Opinion: Microsoft’s ‘Principled Approach to App Stores’ That Doesn’t Apply to Xbox — daringfireball.net/…
    • Related: App Store developers can now transfer apps and still be part of the Small Business Program — www.imore.com/…

Notable Numbers

  • Health insurance company says people with Apple Watches move 51% more — www.imore.com/… (🇦🇺 The report is from insurer AIA Australia)

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 Ericsson -v- Apple: the US case will go to trial in June 2023 — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 CalTech + Broadcom -v- Apple: a US federal appeals court has invalidated the $1.1Bn jury verdict against Apple over WiFi patents from January 2020 because the damages awarded were not justified. The judge has ordered a new trial — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple sued by SpaceTime3D over three-dimensional screen display — www.imore.com/… (unusually, this is a suite from a real software company, not a non-practicing entity)
  • 🇺🇸 Apple to face class action suit over claims it misled shareholders — www.imore.com/…
    • The case relates to statements by Tim Cook in the earnings call before Apple were forced to issue a profit warning which knocked 8% off the share price in January 2019 — www.wired.co.uk/….
    • 🇬🇧 The suit is filed in the US, but lead by Norfolk County Council from the UK

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple has bought AI Music, a UK company that have developed AI software that takes in royalty-free music and generates custom music that changes in response to some input — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple is improving employee benefits to try to attract and retain workers — www.imore.com/… (improved sick pay arrangements, and vacation days for part-time workers)
  • 🇺🇸 Apple Store employees in the United States are getting a raise — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple Store Workers Want to Unionize to Fight for Higher Wages — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Music:
    • Apple Music Free Trial Now Just One Month — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Kanye West Will Not Make “Donda 2” Available on “Opressive” Platforms Like Apple Music — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Kanye West reveals he turned down $100M Apple Music deal, confirms official beef with company — www.imore.com/…
    • The Beatles album ‘1’ gets the spatial audio treatment for Apple Music — www.imore.com/…
  • AppleTV+:
    • 2022 Oscars: Apple scoops six nominations including best picture — www.imore.com/…
      • CODA: Best Picture, Best Supporting Actor (Troy Kotsur), & Best Adapted Screenplay (Siân Heder)
      • The Tragedy of Macbeth: Best Lead Actor (Denzel Washington), Best Cinematography (Bruno Delbonnel) & Best Production Design
      • Related: Apple TV+ hit ‘CODA’ is coming back to cinemas and it’ll be free for all — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Originals Won 4 SAG Awards With CODA, Ted Lasso — www.macobserver.com/…
      • CODA: Outstanding Performance by a Cast in a Motion Picture & Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Supporting Role (Troy Kotsur)
      • Ted Lasso: Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Comedy Series & Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Comedy Series (Jason Sudeikis)
    • Apple TV+ podcast ‘The Line’ wins duPont-Columbia Award — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple TV+ thriller ‘Severance’ sneaks into streaming’s top 10 on debut — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Books launches new book club with George Stroumboulopoulos — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇨🇦 Apple News launches local news coverage in Canada — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. More AirTag Developments:
    • Apple released details of improvements they plan to make to their AirTag protections — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Near term changes:
        • New privacy warnings during AirTag setup (for tracking your stuff not other people, Apple will help the police etc.)
        • Improved messages when a tracker that’s not yours is detected moving with you (unknown item to be replaced with useful description like AirPods when the device is not an AirTag)
        • Updates to support docs
      • Longer term changs:
        • Add the ability to use precision finding on trackers that trigger an alert.
        • Phones will display an alert when the device emits a warning sound.
        • Continued tweaks to the algorithms.
        • Tweaks to the sound so it’s easier to hear
      • Apple’s press release: An update on AirTag and unwanted tracking — www.apple.com/…
    • Latest beta of iOS 15.4 includes anti-stalking changes for AirTag — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Related: New York Attorney General Warns of Malicious AirTag Tracking — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Tests by NYT reporter Kashmir Hill illustrate how other trackers are ‘way worse’ than AirTags wen it comes to stalking protections — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple AirTag anti-stalking protection bypassed by researchers — nakedsecurity.sophos.com/…
      • The original research: Find You: Building a stealth AirTag clone — positive.security/…
  2. 🇺🇦 🇷🇺 The effects of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine on the Apple universe:
    • Apple to support local humanitarian efforts in response to Ukraine invasion — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Apple Stops Apple Pay Transactions in Russia — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇺🇦 Ukraine requests that Apple stop product sales and access to the App Store in Russia — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Apple stops selling iPhones, iPads, Macs, and other products in Russia — www.imore.com/… & Apple responds to the Russian invasion of Ukraine, pulls RT & Sputnik apps and disables Apple Maps features in Ukraine — www.imore.com/…
    • Read Tim Cook’s email to employees on Ukraine — www.theverge.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Apple product prices skyrocket in Russia as resellers battle sanctions — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Russia’s biggest Apple premium reseller closes stores — www.imore.com/… & Apple premium reseller reopens in Russia ahead of March Apple event, prices up 50% — www.imore.com/… (the reseller is re:Store)
    • 🇺🇦 Apple Maps Now Includes Crimea as Ukraine Outside of Russia — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related Analysis: Russian Invasion of Ukraine Impacts Apple World — tidbits.com/…
      • Ukraine is home to major Apple developers including MacPaw (Setapp, Clean My Mac X, Gemini, and more), BeLight Software (Live Home 3D, Swift Publisher, and more), Readdle (PDF Expert, Spark, and more) & CS Odessa (ConceptDraw).
      • Readdle, the Ukrainian developer of productivity apps, reassures customers service is unaffected amidst Russian attack — www.imore.com/… & Readdle removes apps from Russian App Store, pledges support for Ukraine — www.imore.com/…
      • MacPaw vows user support will continue as war breaks out in Ukraine — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Ukrainian Mac App Developer Asks for Help for Ukraine — www.macobserver.com/… (Eugene Krupnov, developer of Mac app Unclutter)
  3. Preview of Apple’s up-coming share holders meeting (March 4th):
    • Inspired by the #AppleToo movement there will be a shareholder motion voted on to require “that the Board of Directors prepare a public report assessing the potential risks to the company associated with its use of concealment clauses in the context of harassment, discrimination and other unlawful acts”
      • 🇺🇸 Related: 8 US state treasurers are accusing Apple of abusing NDAs to silence workers about discrimination within the company, and are asking the SEC to take a more active role, and to expand protections to all workers, not just those in CA where the recently passed Silenced No More Act outlaws the use of NDAs to conceal workplace discrimination and other illegal activity (About the act: ‘Silenced No More Act’ becomes law in California, crippling NDAs — www.marketwatch.com/…)
      • Related: Former Apple employee and #AppleToo member Cher Scarlett alleges that Apple’s “bizarre if not unique” (according to a HR expert) process of changing all former employee job titles to ‘Associate’ in a DB the HR industry use to vet job applicants cost her a new job — www.imore.com/…
    • Shareholders urge Apple to adopt revised transparency reports for App removals — www.imore.com/…
    • Shareholder group raises ‘significant concern’ over Tim Cook’s pay — www.imore.com/… & 🇳🇴 Norway’s sovereign wealth fund to vote down Apple executive pay — www.imore.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple Launches Entrepreneur Camp for Latin Founders — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple announces iPhones will soon accept Tap to Pay payments using Apple Pay and contactless — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Stripe rolling out beta program to support Apple’s new Tap to Pay feature — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple gives Siri a less gendered voice — www.axios.com/… (in the betas for iOS 15.4)
  • Beats and the NBA announce 75th anniversary Powerbeats Pro — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: AirPods and Beats make up half of the U.S. headphone market — www.imore.com/… (based on Statista numbers)
  • Apple removed 12 suppliers from chain over responsible mineral sourcing in 2021 — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇸🇦 Apple opens first all-female Developer Academy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Support App Now Offers Some Repair Estimates — tidbits.com/…
  • Apple to offer Face ID repairs on iPhone without swapping whole device — www.imore.com/…
  • 📌 “Peek performance”: Apple’s next hardware event happens on March 8 — arstechnica.com

Legend

item.title: LTA 103: March 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Charlotte Henry from The Addition - @charlotteahenry

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by one notable number, some some Apple-related legal news, a little Apple HR & acquisitions news, and some highlights from Apple's services. The three main stories are the EU Digital Markets Act (DMA), a great night for Apple at the Oscars, and Apple's 'Peek Performance' event. The show ends with a quick rundown of some smaller Apple-related stories that made the news in March.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta103.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • 🇷🇺 🇺🇦 Russia’s invasion of Ukraine continues to affect the Apple community:
    • Apple adds Ukraine UNICEF donation buttons to News app and apple.com — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Apple suspends advertising on the App Store in Russia — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Russian cards to stop working on the App Store March 10 — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Apple Keeps App Store Open for Russia, Sparks Controversy — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Russia threatens to nationalize Apple, seize assets — www.imore.com/…
    • Ukrainian developer MacPaw has released a free Mac app for checking apps for links to Russia — research.macpaw.com/…
    • 🇷🇺 Apple returns opposition voting app to App Store in Russia — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple’s 2022 annual shareholders meeting:
    • Shareholders approve Apple’s executive pay despite protests — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple shareholders defy company, approve civil rights audit plans — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: 🇺🇸 Apple Now Employs 50% of US Staff from Underrepresented Communities — www.macobserver.com/… (🌍 also 89% increase in women employed globally)
  • 🇺🇸 Arizona First State to Accept ID in Apple Wallet at TSA Security — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple Business Essentials Rolls Out to All SMBs in the US With AppleCare+ Option — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Asahi Linux Publishes First Alpha Release for Mac M1 Products — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple-backed smart home standard Matter delayed until Fall 2022 — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Regulatory pressure continues on Apple: The US Department of Justice (DoJ) has backed the American Innovation and Choice Online Act which is working its way through the Senate. The bill aims to make it illegal for platforms to “unfairly preference” their own products/apps in their stores — 9to5mac.com/… & arstechnica.com/…
  • AirTag Competitor Tile Launches Scan and Secure Feature to Fend Off Suspicious Tracking — www.macobserver.com/… (It does less than Apple’s Android app)
  • 🇮🇳 Apple doing more manufacturing in India
    • iPhone 13 production to start in India next month as Foxconn probation ends — www.imore.com/…
    • Pegatron to begin iPhone 12 production in India next month — www.imore.com/…

Notable Numbers

  • 🇺🇸 New survey reveals staggering commitment of U.S. teens to Apple — www.imore.com/… (87% own an iPhone, 87% expect next phone to be an iPhone, and 72% have AirPods)

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 🇨🇦 🇩🇪 WiLAN and Apple have settled their long-running patent dispute (filed in 2014) with a ‘multi-year licensing deal’. While Apple lost the case, they’ve twice succeeded in having the penalty itself overturned ($145M in 2018, and $85M in February), which explains the motivations for both sides to settle — www.reuters.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Epic -v- Apple:
    • Apple have filed their 135-page submission on their appeal of the limited aspects of the case they lost in the initial judgement — it’s longer and more detailed than most such submissions — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple backed by Roblox, Koch group, security experts in Epic Games fight — www.imore.com/…
    • California Attorney General Files Brief in Epic v Apple Row, More Groups Support Apple — www.macobserver.com/… (The CA AG supports neither side, simply stresses the importance of competition)
  • 🇺🇸 Apple To Pay $14.8 Million to Paid iCloud Storage Subscribers for Class Action Settlement — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • 🇬🇧 Apple have acquired the UK banking startup Credit Kudos in a move appears to lay the foundations for AppleCard being rolled out in more countries (🤞) — www.cnbc.com/…
  • Ford poaches Apple’s ‘vice president of people business partners’ — www.imore.com/… (Jennifer Waldo)
  • Apple is paying up to $200,000 in bonuses to try and keep its talent — www.imore.com/…

Apple Services Highlights

  • Apple Maps:
    • 🇨🇦 Apple have rolled out their improved maps for the three Canadian cities Montreal, Toronto & Vancouver — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇬🇧 Apple Maps teams with mapping backpacks are working their way through pedestrian-only parts of London, Birmingham & Manchester in the UK — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple partners with Haas Alert to add real-time safety data to Appel Maps — www.imore.com/… (As best as I can tell Haas only cover the US)
    • Related: Google Maps for iOS Updated with Better Navigation and Apple Watch Support — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple Fitness+: Apple Adds Postpartum Workouts to Fitness Plus — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple Music: You can now share a clip from Apple Music in an Instagram message — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Podcasts: Apple Podcasts will soon tell creators how many people follow them and more — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Pay:
    • 🇦🇷 🇵🇪 Apple Pay arrives in Argentina and Peru — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇲🇩 Apple Pay arrives in Moldova — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. 🇪🇺 The EU Commission, EU Parliament & Council of Ministers strike a deal on the Digital Markets Act (DMA), an EU directive aimed at tackling anti-trust concerns around big tech.
    • The law will only apply to gatekeepers that provide core platform services (browsers, OSes, market places, app stores, messaging services, etc.)
    • To be designated a gatekeeper a company must both:
    • Have a market cap of €75Bn or annual revenue of €7.5Bn
    • Have at least 45M active weekly users in the EU
    • Have at least 10K active business customers in the EU
    • Gatekeepers will have extra responsibilities, and there will be explicit prohibitions
    • While there is agreement between the three parties needed to pass the act, the technical wording has not been finalised.
    • The most significant impacts on Apple appear to be:
      • Additional choices on iOS/macOS since gatekeepers must “allow users to freely choose their browser, virtual assistants or search engines”.
      • Apple may be forced to provide APIs to allow smaller messaging services interoperate with Messages. EU officials have said they want end-to-end encryption to be a part of these integrations.
      • It seems clear Apple will be forced to allow alternative payment mechanisms, and probably some kind of alternative to the app store, but probably not wild-west side-loading, with Commission staff talking about “multiple safe and secure app stores” rather than full-on side-loading.
      • Apple may also have to share more AppStore sales data with developers.
      • The ban on ‘self preferencing’ will probably have some effect on how Apple treats its own apps in the AppStore.
      • Apple will probably be forced to open up access to things like the NFC chips in iPhones & iPads since gatekeepers are required to give developers ‘fair’ access to ‘supplementary functionalities’ on mobile devices. (I wonder if that could extend to the W1 radio too?)
    • The Commission’s Press Release — www.europarl.europa.eu/…
    • A good summary: Europe says yes to messaging interoperability as it agrees on major new regime for Big Tech — techcrunch.com/…
    • EU doubles down on new law that could force Apple to allow side-loading and more — 9to5mac.com/…
    • Apple Needs to Promote Cross-Platform Messaging, Make iMessage Play Nicely with ‘Smaller’ Apps — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple have announced a new entitlement developers of so-called Reader Apps (provide magazines, newspapers, books, audio, music, or video as primary app functionality) can apply for to allow them add a link for users to sign up and manage their account outside of the app (this is to comply with a recent Japanese 🇯🇵 court ruling) — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: 🇳🇱 the Dutch case rumbles on:
      • Apple racks up NINTH Dutch fine over App Store, submits new proposal — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple to face yet another fine in the Netherlands, still doesn’t comply with App Store laws — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple makes fresh bid to comply with Dutch App Store rules, still plans to appeal — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple submitted updated compliance plans — daringfireball.net/…
        • No more separate binary
        • Clearly defined criteria for external payment providers
        • Improved warning modal dialogue (more factual, less hyperbolic)
    • Related: 🇪🇺 🇳🇱 A newly formed non-profit foundation, the Consumer Competition Claims Foundation, headquartered in the Netherlands has filed a class-action suit against Apple on behalf of all EU Apple users, claiming the AppStore rule have cost EU consumers €5Bn since 1 September 2009 (based on an assumption that prices would be 25% lower if iOS was open). As best as I can tell this foundation was set up in March 2022, and the only thing it’s doing is this case — www.imore.com/…
  2. Apple TV+ movie ‘CODA’ wins three Oscars including Best Picture — www.imore.com/…
    • Best Picture (first ever streaming service win), Best Supporting Actor (Troy Kotsur), and Best Adapted Screenplay (Siân Heder)
    • ‘CODA’ topped the streaming charts last week after its Oscar win — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Rereleases CODA in Theaters, Features Captions for Deaf and Hard of Hearing — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related — Other Apple TV+ Awards:
      • Troy Kotsur wins Best Supporting Male for ‘CODA’ at Film Independent Spirit Awards — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple TV+ film ‘CODA’ makes yet more history with two BAFTA Film Awards — www.imore.com/… (Best Adapted Screenplay & Best Supporting Actor for Troy Kotsur)
      • Apple TV+ show ‘Ted Lasso’ sweeps the 2022 Critics Choice Awards comedy categories — www.imore.com/… (Best Comedy Series, Best Actor in a Comedy Series for Jason Sudeikis, Best Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series for Hannah Waddingham, and Best Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series for Brett Goldstein)
      • Apple TV+ bags two PGA Awards for ‘Carpool Karaoke’ and ‘For All Mankind’ — www.imore.com/… (The For All Mankind award was for their AR/VR companion experience For All Mankind: Time Capsule)
      • Apple TV+ titles scoop WGA, PGA, CAS awards — www.imore.com/…
      • ‘Ted Lasso’, ‘CODA’, scoop Artios Awards for Apple TV+ — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇬🇧 Related: Sky offers three months of free Apple TV+ for Sky VIP customers — www.imore.com/…
  3. Apple’s Peek Performance Event
  4. How to re-watch Apple’s ‘Peek Performance’ special event — www.imore.com/…
  5. Here’s everything Apple announced at its March 8, 2022 ‘Peek Performance’ event — www.imore.com/…
  6. New green versions of the iPhones 13 & 13Pro released — www.imore.com/…
  7. Apple Unveils Fifth-Generation iPad Air with M1, 5G, and Center Stage — tidbits.com/…
    • New iPhone SE with same design but A15 chip & 5G — www.imore.com/…
      • New iPhone SE benchmarks reveal massive leap in performance — www.imore.com/…
      • New iPhone SE does not support the fastest 5G technology — www.imore.com/…
      • New iPhone SE 3 survives drop tests just like an iPhone 13 — www.imore.com/…
      • 🌱 The new iPhone SE will be Apple’s first product to use carbon-free Aluminium produced in Canada 🇨🇦 by ELYSIS using hydro power and a new process that releases oxygen rather than CO2. This is the first time carbon free aluminium is being produced at an industrial scale anywhere in the world — www.imore.com/…
  8. 🇺🇸 🇨🇦 🇦🇺 🇧🇷 🇯🇵 🇲🇽 🇵🇷 🇰🇷 🇬🇧 AppleTV is getting Friday Night Baseball (matches and a live sports show), and at least initially, it’s free, though only available in a small handful of countries (USA, Canada, Australia, Brazil, Japan, Mexico, Puerto Rico, South Korea & the UK) — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple and Major League Baseball announce first 12 weeks of “Friday Night Baseball” doubleheader schedule beginning April 8 — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple paid $87 million annually to bring ‘Friday Night Baseball’ to Apple TV+ — www.imore.com/…
  9. Studio Mac & Display replace 27" iMac, at least for now
    • Apple revealed details of a new ultra-fast chip, the M1 Ultra, made up of two M1 Max chips directly connected by an interconnect so the OS sees them as one big chip — www.imore.com/… * Leaked benchmark confirms M1 Ultra Mac Studio is the fastest Mac… ever — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple announced a new MacStudio computer with M1 Max or M1 Ultra chips — arstechnica.com/… * Clarifying the Lack of Mac Studio SSD Upgradability — tidbits.com/… * Real-life performance tests reveal staggering power of M1 Ultra Mac Studio — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Studio Display: Release date, price, features, and more! — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple says it is working to fix poor Studio Display webcam performance — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Studio Display To Offer Basic Functionality for Incompatible Devices — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple’s Studio Display brings ‘Hey Siri’ support to some older Macs — www.imore.com/…
    • Turns out Apple can swap your Studio Display’s stand after purchase after all — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple can remove the Studio Display’s power cable, but you really shouldn’t — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple updates Logic Pro & MainStage with support for new Mac Studio — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple updates Boot Camp to add support for its new Studio Display — www.imore.com/…
    • The display proves to be an iOS device with 64GB storage, only 2GB of which are in use — www.imore.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple ditches the 27-Inch LG UltraFine 5K Display from its online store — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Samsung undercuts Apple’s Studio Display with new M8 monitor — www.imore.com/…
    • iFixit’s teardown gives the MacPro a 6/10 repairability rating (high for Apple products), and shows the Studio Display has a very iMac-like cooling system to deal with all the heat from that big internal power supply — arstechnica.com/…
    • Apple releases new colors for Magic Keyboard, Mouse, and Trackpad — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple discontinues 27-inch iMac following Apple event — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple confirms new Mac Pro is on the way in rare tease at March 8 event — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: Apple’s Mac Pro claims a quiet spec bump Radeon Pro W5500X GPU, 512GB SSD — www.imore.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple released iOS 15.4 & macOS 12.3 with some notable new features — arstechnica.com/…
    • FaceID unlock with a mask on iOS
    • Universal Control on both
  • Apple have released a new Cosmophones version of the Beats Studio3 headphones in partnership with entertainer Kerwin Frost — www.imore.com/… (I think they look very pretty 🙂)
  • 🇧🇪 🇨🇭 🇳🇱 Apple rolls out HomePod mini in Belgium, Switzerland, the Netherlands — www.imore.com/…
  • Some Education News:
    • 🇺🇸 Apple has announced Apple Learning Coach, a program to teach teachers to teach teachers to use Apple technology to teach — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple School and Business Manager will soon support Google Workspace — www.imore.com/…
  • 🌱 🇩🇰 Apple to expand its Viborg, Denmark data center and capture heat energy for the city — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple publishes 2022 Supplier Responsibility Progress Report — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple announces $50 million Supplier Employee Development Fund — www.imore.com/…
  • Peloton now allows heart rate monitoring with Apple Watch — www.imore.com/…
  • 📌 Apple will hold its Q2 2022 earnings call on Thursday, April 28 — www.imore.com/…
  • 📌 Apple announces an online WWDC 2022 for June 6 through June 10 — www.imore.com/…
    • Applications now open for WWDC’s Swift Student Challenge — www.imore.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

🎧 A link to audio content, probably a podcast.

📊 A link to graphical content, probably a chart, graph, or diagram.
