item.title: LTA 104: April 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Elaine Giles from MacBites - @elainegiles
  • Scott Willsey from the Friends with Beer Podcast - @scottaw

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by two short Apple-related legal stories, one Apple hire, and some highlights from Apple's services. The four main stories are continued crankiness in Apple's work force resulting in an open letter and three unionisation drives, some crankiness from video pros expressed in another open letter, Apple's Q2 2022 earnings call, and the limited launch of Apple's Self Service Repair program in the US. The show ends with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in April.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta104.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • 🇷🇺 Russia Legalizes Shady ‘Gray Market’ For Tech Products In Effort To Skirt Sanctions — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Adyen joins Stripe to become the second official partner for iOS’s up-coming Tap-to-Pay functionality — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple Commits to Shareholder-Requested Civil Rights Audit — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Developers can apply for the Apple Park WWDC shindig starting May 9 — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple have released a firmware update for AirTags to make their unknown tracker noise easier to locate — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇪🇺 Implementation of the Digital Markets Act (DMA) postponed until early 2023 — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Xbox Cloud Gaming Brings Fortnite Back to iOS With No Subscription Needed — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇪🇸 It’s emerged that both Catalan independence leaders and the Spanish government were targeted by the Pegasus malware last year — www.imore.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple’s tussles with regulators continue:
    • 🇪🇺 The EU’s long-running investigation into Apple’s restrictions of NFC have made it as far as an official Statement of Objections, the ball us now in Apple’s court to reply — arstechnica.com/… & www.imore.com/…
    • 🇳🇱 Apple’s moves to appease Dutch App Store watchdog declared ‘insufficient’ ahead of new penalty — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇯🇵 Apple disagrees with Japanese claims that built-in apps harm competition — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Sideloading and Web App Restrictions On iOS Under Investigation by U.S. Government — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇨🇳 China’s COVID policy brings and unwelcome return of uncertainty to Apple:
    • New COVID–19 Lockdowns in China Further Impact iPhone and iPad Production — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Latest China COVID Lockdown May Have Limited Effect on Apple iPhone Production, Thanks to Foxconn — www.macobserver.com/…
    • iPhone supply warning issued as major factories hit by COVID lockdowns in China — www.imore.com/…
    • Delay in Shipment of High-End MacBook Pro Could Be Due to COVID–19 Lockdowns in China — www.macobserver.com/…
    • World’s largest iPhone factory brings back mandatory COVID tests — www.imore.com/…
    • COVID–19 Lockdowns in China Decrease iPhone Supply — www.macobserver.com/…
    • World’s largest iPhone factory operational despite COVID lockdowns — www.imore.com/…
    • Half of Apple’s suppliers at risk in China COVID lockdown areas — www.imore.com/…
    • Foxconn Halts New Hiring Blitz at Zhengzhou Factory Amid COVID–19 and iPhone 14 Delay Concerns — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Workers Riot At Quanta Factory Due To Strict COVID–19 Lockdowns — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple Experiencing Delays On Custom Mac Studio and MacBook Pros, Delivery May Take Months — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: 🇮🇳 Apple secures Foxconn expansion in India to cope with iPhone demand — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: 🇧🇷 Apple Starts Assembling iPhone 13 in Brazil — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇮🇳 New regulations cause headaches for Apple as they’e forced to stop accepting credit and debit cards for subscriptions — www.imore.com/…

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 Apple Reaches Settlement in iPhone 4S Class-Action Suit, Will Pay $15 to Impacted Users — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇧🇷 Brazil Orders Apple to Pay iPhone Buyer $1,000 For Not Including Charger — www.macobserver.com/… (🏆 Bart’s Award for the Dumbest Judgement of the Month 😉)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple have hired former Ford exec Desi Ujkashevic, her most recent role at Ford was Global Director of Safety Engineering, but she also has experience the with electric cars — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Maps:
    • 🇺🇸 Apple Maps adds cycling directions to Chicago, Detroit, more — www.imore.com/… (Chicago, Detroit, Indianapolis, Cleveland, Columbus, Cincinnati & Charleston)
    • 🇸🇬 🇩🇪 Apple rolls out all-new maps to Singapore, Germany — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Music: Starting Today Apple Music Now Available on Roku — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple TV+:
    • More Apple TV+ Awards:
      • Apple TV+ bags its first BAFTA TV Awards for two documentaries — www.imore.com/… (Editing for 9/11: Inside the President’s War Room & Sound for 1971: The Year Music Changed Everything)
      • Apple TV+ host John Stewart wins a prestigious Mark Twain Prize for American Humor — www.imore.com/…
      • Adam Scott wins a Webby Best Actor award for his role in ‘Severance’ on Apple TV+ — www.imore.com/…
      • ‘The Year Earth Changed’ is the recipient of the Television Academy Honors — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple TV+ wins a GLAAD Media Award for a special episode of ‘The Oprah Conversation’ — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple TV+ branches out with Run, Bambi, Run, a true-crime podcast — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Subscribers say Apple TV+ is worth $6.90 per month — it costs just $4.99 — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Return to the Office & Unionisation Efforts:
    • Apple’s return to the office has begun, but not without some pushback:
      • Apple Employees Show Mixed Emotions Over Apple’s Return to Office Decision — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple corporate employees head back to the office — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple slammed over working from home policy in employee open letter — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 For the first time ever in the US, Apple retail employees are attempting to unionise:
      • Grand Central Apple workers demand $30 an hour as part of unionizing effort — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple Store Workers in Atlanta File First Ever Petition for Union Election — www.macobserver.com/… & First Apple Store in the U.S. to hold union election on June 2 — www.imore.com/… (Cumberland Mall in Atlanta)
      • Third Apple store launches bid to create union — www.imore.com/… (Towson Town Center store in Maryland)
      • Apple Hires Anti-Union Lawyers to Bust Retail Store Workers’ Unionization Efforts — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Related: Apple reportedly cutting Genius Bar headcount at some stores — www.imore.com/…
  2. Video Pros are not Happy with Apple Despite the recent rejuvenation in Pro hardware:
    • Filmmakers write open letter to Tim Cook begging for Final Cut Pro commitment — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple releases second beta for Studio Display 15.5 firmware — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple release incremental updates for their video apps:
      • New Final Cut Pro update adds enhanced support for Mac Studio and more — www.imore.com/…
      • iMovie for iPhone & iPad updated with new Storyboards and Magic Movie features — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple PR focuses on video pros:
      • Apple shows how the people behind Star Wars create iconic sounds using Macs — www.imore.com/… & 🎦 Behind the Mac Film: Skywalker Sound Available Now on YouTube — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple gifts ‘Dream Studio Makeover’ to aspiring documentary filmmaker — www.imore.com/…
  3. Apple’s Q2 2022 Earnings Call — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple reports another record quarter with revenue record of $97.3 billion — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple services reaches new record of 825 million subscribers — www.imore.com/… & Apple’s Services Revenue Exceeds Mac and iPad Sales Combined — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple has made nearly $100 billion so far this year — arstechnica.com
    • Tim Cook says more iPhone buyers switched from Android last quarter — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Estimates of the Numbers Apple don’t give us (anymore):
      • The PC mark appears to be shrinking, but the Mac market continues to grow — www.imore.com/…, www.imore.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
      • Gartner: PC market 🔻–7.3%🌎 & 🔻16.5%🇺🇸, Mac ⬆️ 500K units🌎
      • Counterpoint: PC shipments 🔻–4%🌎 & Mac shipments ⬆️8%🌎
      • Strategy Analytics: Notebook market 🔻–7%, Macs ⬆️4%
    • Canalys: Apple leads tablet market with 38.6% Q1 share — www.imore.com/…
    • Numbers for iPhone looks good too:
      • Smartphone Shipments of Top Brands Decline in 1Q22, Except the iPhone — www.macobserver.com/… (Strategy Analytics, Canalys & ICS: Smartphone market 🔻–11.3%🌎, iPhone ⬆️8%🌎)
      • Apple’s iPhone 13 Models Sell Well Except for the Mini in Q1 2022 — www.macobserver.com/… (CIRP: 🇺🇸 71% market share, mini 3%)
      • 🇮🇳 Apple shipped almost one million ‘Made in India’ iPhones in Q1 2022 — www.imore.com/… (Business Standard)
      • 🇮🇳 India Sees 50% Increase In iPhone Production as Apple Brings in iPhone 13 — www.macobserver.com/… (CyberMedia Research)
  4. 🇺🇸 Apple’s promised Self-Service Repair portal goes live — www.macobserver.com/… & arstechnica.com/… (limited initial launch)
    • US-only
    • Modern iPhones only for now (3rd-gen iPhone SE, iPhone 12 & iPhone 13)
    • Includes commonly needed repairs like screen & battery replacement
    • Requires serial number for part-pairing
    • Needed tools can be bought out-right or rented for 7 days
    • Repair manuals published freely on the website
    • Next-step will be M1-based Macs

Quick Stories

  • On World Password Day the FIDO Alliance announced that Apple, Microsoft & Google will be implementing a new cross-platform standard developed in conjunction with the W3C to allow password-less authentication and support for website auth over bluetooth — arstechnica.com/… & fidoalliance.org/…
  • Earth Day 2022:
    • Apple donated $1 from each Apple Pay transaction on an Apple store/site for the week running up to Earth Day — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple suppliers avoided almost 14 million metric tons of carbon emissions in 2021 — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple reveals 20 percent of materials used in products in 2021 recycled — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: 🎦 When Dietschy met Daisy — Apple’s iPhone-recycling robot makes it to YouTube — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple celebrates grant protecting mangroves in India on Earth Day — www.imore.com/…
    • Foxconn improved its emissions reduction pledge, now promising to reduce emissions by 21% by 2025, a further 63% by 2035, and continued reductions to reach net-zero by 2050 — www.imore.com/…
  • The Beats Studio Buds are now available in three gorgeous new colors — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple’s MagSafe Battery Pack can now charge at 7.5W speeds — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple expands fraud protection features to more than just Apple Card — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇬🇧 🇨🇦 Apple bringing its child safety features in iMessage to UK and Canada — www.imore.com/… (just the un-controversial parental controls, not the postponed CSAM scanning)

item.title: LTA 105: May 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Allison Sheridan from the NosillaCast Podcast - @podfeet

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by two short Apple-related legal stories, two Apple departures, and some highlights from Apple's services. The four main stories are continued COVID chaos, continued crankiness in Apple's work force, some nice new accessibility features, and a fond fare-well to the iPod. The show ends with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in May.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta105.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple releases Studio Display Firmware 15.5 with improved webcam performance — www.imore.com/…
  • Starting Today Apple Stores Begin Accepting iPhone-to-iPhone Contactless Payment — www.macobserver.com/… & Square announces a Tap to Pay on iPhone early access program launching today — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇬🇧 🇨🇦 🇦🇺 🇳🇿 Apple rolls out the non-controversial child protection measures for iMessage to the UK, Canada, Australia & New Zealand — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Regulatory pressure continues to mount on Apple:
    • 🇦🇺 Apple Responds to Proposed Antitrust Regulations by Australian Authorities — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇮🇳 The Alliance of Digital India Foundation report on app stores slams Apple & Google and calls for urgent regulation — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇪🇺 EU Looking to Force Apple to Give Developers Access to All Software and Hardware Features — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 US Senate Bill Would Ban App Stores From Hosting Apps That Accept China’s Digital Yuan — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple Developers Will Soon Be Able to Offer Auto-Renewable Subscription Price Increase — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple Highlights the Success of Smaller Businesses and Entrepreneurs on the App Store — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple highlight that $1.5 billion in fraudulent transactions were stopped by their App Store in 2021 — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Apple’s Fraud Prevention Analysis Notes 1.6M Risky Apps Prevented from Defrauding Users — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple Spent Millions Attempting to House Homeless in San Jose, Yet Issues Linger — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇮🇳 Apple Stops Accepting Card Payments in India Due to New Banking Regulations — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple responds to Final Cut Pro open letter, here’s what it said — www.imore.com/…

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 Optis -v- Apple: A district court in Texas has rejected Apple’s request for a third trial over whether or not they breached Optis’ 4G patents. Apple lost the original case and was fined $500M, but the jury were not told the patents were FRAND, so a re-trial for damages only was granted, and the judgement was reduced to $300M, which Apple now has to pay unless gets an appeal heard by a higher court — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 A CA judge has thrown out a class action suit that alleged Apple’s iCloud storage pricing is deceptive — www.imore.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • JP Richards, Head of Apple TV+ film marketing resigns, no successor announced, and not clear where Richards is off to next — www.imore.com/…
  • CJ Moore, the director of Apple’s car project has left after just 6 months to join LIDAR company Luminar — www.imore.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Health:
    • Apple introduces ‘Audio Hints’ for Apple Fitness+ — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇲🇽 watchOS 8.6 is bringing the ECG app to Apple Watch users in Mexico — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Fitness+ launches ‘Meditations to Strengthen Relationships’ program — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Podcasts Brings New Features Including Download Control, Annual Subscriptions and Distribution System — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Music:
    • Audi to add Apple Music to ‘nearly all’ of its new vehicles with update — www.imore.com/…
    • Waze Adds Apple Music to its Built-In Audio Player — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple Music 1 Features K-Pop Sensation BTS on Limited Series Prior to New Album Launch — www.macobserver.com/… & BTS radio smashes Apple Music record for biggest show — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple Maps:
    • 🇯🇵 Apple Maps AR directions arrive in Tokyo — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇯🇵 Apple Maps Japan receives cycling directions, Look Around expansions — www.imore.com/…
  • Apple TV+:
    • Apple are really promoting their new dinosaur series Prehistoric Planet, e.g.: T.Rex footprints on Welsh beach tease Apple’s latest release — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Google TV App Arrives for iOS to the Apple App Store — www.macobserver.com/…

Main Stories

  1. More COVID Chaos
    • Direct Impact
      • Apple delays plans to force employees into the office 3 days per week amid COVID concerns — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple employees in some U.S. stores must now wear masks, but not customers — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple intensifies COVID–19 protocols for WWDC 2022 attendees — www.imore.com/…
    • Supply Chain Effects
      • 🇨🇳 Major iPhone supplier cuts production because of COVID lockdowns — www.imore.com/…
      • 🇨🇳 MacBook Pro Manufacturer, Quanta Faces Revolt From Workers Who Are Getting Tired of Lockdowns — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple dealing with HUGE Mac delays across its lineup — www.imore.com/…
      • Thanks to Supply Chain Control, Apple To Be Least Impacted As Global Smartphone Shipments To Decline by 3.5% — www.macobserver.com/… (IDC forecast)
      • Apple is looking to expand manufacturing outside of China — www.imore.com/…
      • 🇻🇳 Apple to move iPad production out of China for the first time ever — www.imore.com/… (to Vietnam)
        • Related: 🇻🇳 Vietnam PM meets Tim Cook at Apple Park — www.imore.com/…
  2. More HR Troubles
    • Apple’s Director of Machine Learning, Ian Goodfellow, Leaving Over In-Person Work Policy — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple executive who left over remote work policy joins Google — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Unionisation Update:
      • Anti-Union Talking Points in a Leaked Apple Memo Say Employees Can Lose Benefits and Career Opportunities — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Former Apple Employees Help Unionization Efforts As Deirdre O’Brien Visits Stores to ‘Listen’ — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple interrogated staff, restricted flier posting, and held mandatory anti-union speeches, body claims — www.imore.com/…
      • Kentucky Apple store workers announce union effort led by 20-year-old specialist — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple’s VP of people talks down benefits of unions in a leaked internal video — www.imore.com/…
      • Labor group pulls Atlanta store union vote, says Apple is interfering — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: Apple store workers get surprise pay rise as union pressure grows — www.imore.com/…
  3. Apple previews new accessibility features — www.imore.com/…, www.macobserver.com/… & arstechnica.com/…
  4. Fare Well iPod — arstechnica.com/…
    • iPod touch already starting to sell out less than 24hrs after being discontinued [Update] — www.imore.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Some stylish new products:
    • Apple unveils new Pride Edition bands and watch faces — www.imore.com/…
    • Beats drops new Powerbeats Pro collaboration with paria /FARZANEH — www.imore.com/…
    • Special edition Beats Studio Buds with Daily Paper collab go on sale May 26 — www.imore.com/…
  • Some Open Source goodies for Apple users:
    • KDE Connect Brings iPhone Connectivity to Linux — tidbits.com/…
    • 🎧 An excellent interview with the creator of Asahi Linux where he explains how well the Linux distro for M1 Macs is coming on — overcast.fm/…
  • Apple expands its training offerings:
    • Apple expands its Today at Apple Creative Studios to new cities worldwide — www.imore.com/… (🇺🇸 Nashville & Miami, 🇩🇪 Berlin, 🇮🇹 Milan, 🇹🇼 Taipei, 🇯🇵 Tokyo, and 🇦🇺 Sydney)
    • 🇺🇸 Apple Introduces Professional Training to Help Growing IT Workforce — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇮🇪 Apple to expand Cork campus with new building for 1,300 employees — www.imore.com/… (Editorial by Bart: just to hammer home my point that Apple actually does business and employs people here in Ireland, it’s not a P.O. Box in the Cayman Islands!)
  • Reminder: Apple announces WWDC22 program in full ahead of June 6 — www.imore.com/…
    • Relate: Lucky Swift Student Challenge winners begin receiving their Apple swag — www.imore.com/…
    • Plug: Allison will be hosting a live chat with her listeners (including Bart) on her Discord server — instructions at podfeet.com/live

item.title: LTA 106: June 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Allison Sheridan from the NosillaCast Podcast - @podfeet
  • Adam Christianson from The Mac Cast - @maccast

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by a notable number, a collection of Apple-related legal stories, one Apple HR story, and some highlights from Apple's services. The four main stories are four aspects of WWDC — the future of CarPlay, goodies for developers, goodies for users, and new hardware. The show ends with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in June.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta106.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Pegasus/NSO Group: 🇪🇺 An interim report from an EU investigation into the Pegasus spyware finds that at least 5 EU countries used the software — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: 🇮🇹 iPhone users targeted by Italian spyware, says new report — www.imore.com/… & Apple Shuts Down Hermit Spyware Distributed as Fake Enterprise App on iOS Devices — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Regulatory pressure continues:
    • 🇬🇧 The UK Competition & Markets Authority (CMA) has opened an investigation into Apple & Google’s market power via their app store. On the Apple side, the CMA are focusing on mobile gaming and Apple’s requirement that all browsers use WebKit — www.imore.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇩🇪 Germany joins the list of countries investigating App Tracking Transparency on competition grounds — www.imore.com/…
      • Opinion: German Regulators Open Investigation Into Apple’s App Tracking Transparency — daringfireball.net/…
    • 🇺🇸 Spurred by Roe overturn, senators seek FTC probe of iOS and Android tracking — arstechnica.com (based on a total misunderstanding of IDFA 🙁)
      • Opinion: Four Democratic Lawmakers Want the F.T.C. to Investigate Apple and Google Over Mobile Surveillance Advertising — daringfireball.net/…
    • Related: Two cases resolved:
      • 🇳🇱 The Dutch competition authority now consider Apple in compliance with their orders, so no more weekly fines in the Netherlands — www.imore.com/…
      • 🇰🇷 Apple Now Allows Third-Party Payment Systems in the South Korean App Store — www.macobserver.com/… (Limited set of pre-approved processors & 26% commission!)
  • Apple Employee Relations Developments:
    • 🇺🇸 Apple Proposes Flexible Retail Store Working Schedules Amidst Workers’ Unionization Efforts — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Atlanta Apple Store Union Vote Just Postponed, Not Cancelled — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 CWA, not Workers United now helping Apple Store Grand Central union — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇬🇧 Glasgow Apple store staff seeking to form Apple’s first UK union — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple TV+ workers join growing number trying to unionize — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple Retail Store in Towson, Maryland Becomes the First to Have a Worker’s Union in the US — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Report: Apple to bargain with Maryland store that has formed a union — www.imore.com/…
      • First unionized Apple Store in U.S. now ready to bargain with the company — www.imore.com/…
      • Analysis: For New Apple Store Workers Union in Towson, Maryland, the Journey Has Only Begun — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Related: President Biden is ‘proud’ of the first Apple Store to unionize — www.imore.com/…
    • Tim Cook admits Apple’s remote work policy could change — www.imore.com/… (“the mother of all experiments”)
  • USB-C Mandates continue to gather pace:
    • 🇪🇺 The EU parliament & council of ministers have agreed to go forward with legislation mandating that phones, tablets and other portable devices must support USB-C charging by the end of 2024, with laptops to follow later (40 months after the policy is formally adopted) — arstechnica.com/…
    • 🇧🇷 Brazil Proposes USB-C as the Standard Charging Port for iPhone — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 US Senators Want a Universal Charger Standard, Similar to EU — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: 🇬🇧 The UK will not be following suit — www.macobserver.com/…

Notable Numbers

  • HomePod mini Was Single Best-Selling Smart Speaker for 1Q22 — www.macobserver.com/… (Worldwide estimates from Strategy Analytics)

Legal Latest

  • 🇺🇸 Judge Approves $100 Million Settlement Between Apple and Developers, Questions $27 Million Attorney Fee — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇪🇺 Apple deal with Qualcomm vindicated in massive EU court ruling, $1 billion fine overturned — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇬🇧 Apple -v- Ericsson: Apple Faces 5G Patent Infringement Case from Ericsson in UK — www.macobserver.com/…

item.title: LTA 107: July 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Jeff Gamet - @jgamet
  • Chuck Joiner from MacVoices - @chuckjoiner

The show starts with the usual followups and updates on long-running stories. That's followed by a few Apple-related legal stories, a few Apple HR stories, and some highlights from Apple's services. The four main stories are Apple's Q3 2022 earnings, the end of Jony Ive's relationship with Apple, 15 games leaving Apple Arcade, and Apple's new Lockdown Mode for iOS & macOS. The show ends with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in July.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta107.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • 🇪🇺 The EU Parliament has approved the Digital Markets Act (DMA) & Digital Services Act (DSA), they now just need formal ratification by the council of ministers to become law, which is expected to happen before the end of the year — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇷🇺 Apple’s relationship with Russia continues to deteriorate:
    • Apple Receives Fine From Russia over Alleged iCloud Storage Violation — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Russia Set to Fine Apple for App Store Policy’s Violation of Antitrust Laws — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Netflix has finally taken advantage of Apple’s liberalised App Store policies and added an external subscription link — www.macobserver.com/…
    • The warning displayed to users: > “Any accounts or purchases made outside of this app will be managed by the developer “Netflix.” Your App Store account, stored payment methods, and related features, such as subscription management and refund requests, will not be available. Apple is not responsible for the privacy or security of transactions made with this developer.”
  • Apple showcases Veterans Square, one of its investments to combat the housing crises — www.imore.com/…
  • More trouble for Studio Display owners: Studio Display owners are frustrated with speaker, microphone problems — www.cultofmac.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Ericsson: 🇨🇴 5G iPhones and iPads BANNED in Colombia by court in patent dispute — www.imore.com/…
  • Three class-action suits over App Store pricing:
    • 🇬🇧 A panel of 3 judges has ruled that a £1.5Bn class action suit against Apple for anticompetitive pricing in its app store can proceed to trial in the UK’s Competition Appeal Tribunal — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇵🇹 Portugal Law School Professor Files Class Action Suit Against Apple for Excessive App Commission Rate — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇫🇷 Apple sued by French developers because of its App Store fees — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 Apple Gets Another Antitrust Lawsuit, This Time For Charging Apple Pay Fees to Card Issuers — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple is one of the companies benefiting from the recent wave of redundancies at Tesla — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple poaches Lamborghini designer to work on Apple Car — www.imore.com/… (Luigi Taraborrelli)
  • 🇮🇱 Apple has announced that it will open a chip development office in Jerusalem, and has started hiring engineers — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: 🇺🇸 Apple have bought a 7-building site in San Diego that belonged to HP until 2016 for $445M, apparently it will house Apple’s cellular modem team — www.imore.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV & Apple TV+
    • You can now use the Apple TV app to pause and rewind live sports — www.imore.com/…
    • $50 Apple TV gift card promotion expands to international countries — www.cultofmac.com/… (Speculation that Apple are trying to get rid of inventory in preparation for launching new hardware soon)
    • 🇬🇧 Apple TV finally gets a native Sky Go app for live and on-demand streaming — www.imore.com/…
    • Awards season is starting up again:
      • Hollywood Critics Association Awards Recognizes Apple TV+ As Most Nominated Streaming Service With 53 Nominations — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple beats its own previous record with 52 Emmy nominations — www.imore.com/…
      • Apple lands its first ever News & Documentary Emmy nominations — www.imore.com/…
  • Volvo will be pushing CarPlay support to over 200K vehicles via an OTA update (these cars run the Android Automotive OS) — www.imore.com/…
    • Related: Spotify’s weird ‘Car Thing’ CarPlay rival is now a discontinued thing — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇬🇧 A report from the UK’s Competition & Markets Authority has found that the state of the Music Streaming market in the UK is healthy, with plenty of competition and no monopolies. The reports shows Apple with a 10–20% market share — www.imore.com/…
  • 🇫🇷 🇲🇨 🇳🇿 The new Apple Maps experience rolls out to France, Monaco & New Zealand (now in 16 countries) — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇨🇳 🇹🇼 🇭🇰 🇯🇵 🇸🇪 🇳🇴 As well as adding official support for Mandarin Chinese, Cantonese, and Japanese, HomePod OS 15.6 also silently added Swedish and Norwegian — www.imore.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple’s Q3 2022 Earnings — www.apple.com/…
    • Opinions are mixed
      • Apple reports only slight growth in Q3 2022 earnings report — arstechnica.com
      • Apple Outperforms in Q3 2022 Despite a Rocky Road — tidbits.com/…
      • Apple’s Q3 2022 Earnings Narrowly Beat Wall Street Expectations - MacStories — www.macstories.net/…
      • Apple announces record third-quarter 2022 revenue despite growing inflation — www.imore.com/…
      • An ounce of iPhone and no Macs makes a bitter Apple ‘cocktail’ — www.macworld.com/…
    • The usual excellent graphs from Jason Snell: Apple announces $83B fiscal third quarter – Six Colors — sixcolors.com/…
    • This is Tim: Complete Q3 2022 analyst call transcript – Six Colors — sixcolors.com/…
    • Tim Cook says Apple is making ‘deliberate decisions’ about hiring right now — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple could reach a billion paid subscribers by next year — www.imore.com/…
    • Analysis: Apple Q3 2022 Results — daringfireball.net/…
    • Related: According to a report from Strategy Analytics Apple recorded its best ever Q2 global smartphone shipments, managing to increase their shipments by 3% while the market contracted by 7% — www.macobserver.com/…
  2. Jony Ive’s relationship with Apple appears to be over — daringfireball.net/… & arstechnica.com/…
    • The original NYT article — Apple Ends Consulting Agreement With Jony Ive, Its Former Design Leader — www.nytimes.com/…
  3. Apple Arcade Loses 15 games in one go — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple Explains What Happens to Games Leaving Apple Arcade — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: New Oregon Trail Update Brings Apple Arcade and Apple Health Together — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Apple Arcade gets new castle defense exclusive, other content updates this week — www.imore.com/…
  4. Apple have announced that the next versions of iOS & macOS due out this autumn will support an optional Lockdown Mode for users under threat from state-level attackers. The mode will trade off functionality for security — tidbits.com/… & arstechnica.com/…
    • Apple’s Press Release: Apple expands industry-leading commitment to protect users from highly targeted mercenary spyware — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple are offering bug bounties of up to $2M for breaching Lockdown Mode — www.imore.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple Expanding App Store Advertisements to ‘Today’ Tab and App Pages — www.macobserver.com/…
  • More good deals for students
    • 🇺🇸 🇬🇧 US & UK students who sign up for Apple Music for the first time can get a free pair of Beats Flex earbuds — www.imore.com/…
    • 🇬🇧 Apple Back to School goes live in the UK, up to £120 gift cards on offer — www.imore.com/…
    • Apple Launches Back to School Promo in More Countries in Europe, Asia and the Middle East — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Latest VMWare Fusion tech preview brings Windows 11 to Apple Silicon Macs — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple have added coloured MagSafe 3 chargers to their lineup so owners of non-silver MacBook Pros can now get colour-matched charging cables — www.imore.com/…

item.title: LTA 108: August 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

For the first time in the show's long history, there is no panel — it's just Bart sharing his take on the news while all the regulars are off enjoying the last few days of summer. The new Gods also seem to have gone to the beach because there were only two main stories — troubling reports of poorly handled HR complaints, and a potentially problematic move to add more ads into iOS. There are also the usual followups on long-running stories, some legal news, some Apple HR and acquisition news, an update on some of Apple's services, and a few quick stories to round out the show.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta108.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Studio Display Speaker Issue Fixed by Latest Firmware Update — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple Adds M1 MacBooks to Self Service Repair — tidbits.com/…
  • First public iPadOS 16 release will actually be iOS 16.1, in October — appleinsider.com/…
  • Xcode Cloud subscriptions now available for developers — appleinsider.com/…
  • The NSO Group (makers of the Pegasus Spyware that infected some Apple devices) appears to be preparing to be acquired, they’re laying off 100 workers and their CEO is stepping down — appleinsider.com/…
  • Continuing Anti-trust developments:
    • 🇯🇵 Thanks to Apple’s settlement with Japan: Netflix’s iOS App Now Has an External Subscription Button — daringfireball.net/…
    • 🇰🇷 South Korea suspects Apple, Google of violating in-app payment law — appleinsider.com/…
    • 🇫🇷 French Publishers Seek Injunction Against Apple’s App Tracking Transparency Program — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇮🇳 Tinder-owner Match ups antitrust pressure on Apple in India with new case — www.reuters.com/…
  • Epic Games versus Apple appeals to be heard on October 21 — appleinsider.com/…
  • 🇮🇳 India the latest country that may require Apple to shift to USB-C for the iPhone — appleinsider.com/…
  • Continuing Supply Chain Issues:
    • 🇨🇳 Apple experience a whole new problem in China, factory closures due to droughts — www.macobserver.com/… & appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: 🇻🇳 Apple Plans to Move Manufacturing of Apple Watch and MacBooks to Vietnam — www.macobserver.com/…

Legal Latest

  • 🇪🇺 Europe’s General Court Rules Qualcomm Won’t Have to Pay $1 Billion Fine for Paying Apple to Use Its Chips Exclusively — www.macobserver.com/… (Case closed, the Commission will not be appealing)
  • 🇺🇸 Apple settles lawsuit with developer over App Store scam apps — appleinsider.com/… (FlickType)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple radically cuts down on acquiring firms for technology and talent — appleinsider.com/…

Apple bought seven times more firms in 2020 than it now has across both 2021 and 2022 so far

  • 🇨🇳 Apple quits board of Chinese ride-hailing firm Didi — appleinsider.com/…
  • Chief Privacy Officer Jane Horvath to Leave Apple to Work at a Private Law Firm — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • 🇺🇸 Apple Card

  • Goldman Sachs credit card practices under investigation by US watchdog — appleinsider.com/… * Popularity of Apple Card Blamed for Goldman Sachs Woes — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Apple Card issuer Goldman Sachs ranks first in credit card satisfaction survey — appleinsider.com/…

  • AppleCare+
    • 🇫🇷 🇮🇹 🇪🇸 Loss and theft coverage now available in France, Italy & Spain — appleinsider.com/…
    • 🇦🇺 🇨🇦 🇯🇵 Apple has expanded the annual AppleCare+ feature to Australia, Canada & Japan— appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Pay: 🇲🇾 Apple Pay Now Available in Malaysia in Partnership in MayBank, AmBank and Standard Chartered Bank — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Maps: 🇺🇸 Apple Maps extends cycling directions to all 50 states — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Podcasts: Apple Signs Deal with Pulitzer Prize-Winning Production Company to Beef Up Its Original Podcast Content — www.macobserver.com/… (Futuro Studios)
    • Related: Apple Podcasts Marketing Tool for Social Media Released - MacStories — www.macstories.net/…
    • Related: Paid Apple Podcast subscriptions grow by 300% in a year — appleinsider.com/…
  • AppleTV+

    • 🇨🇴 🇩🇴 🇩🇪 🇮🇹 Apple TV+ Announces September ‘Friday Night Baseball’ Schedule, Availability in New Countries — www.macobserver.com/… (Colombia, Dominican Republic, Germany & Italy)

    • Apple TV+ Announces a Wealth of Family and Kid-Friendly Content Arriving This Fall — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Awards Season Again!
      • ‘Severance’ and ‘Ted Lasso’ clean up at the Hollywood Critics awards — appleinsider.com/… (53 nominations → 7 awards)

      “Apple TV+ today was recognized as the most-winning streaming service by the Hollywood Critics Association Streaming TV Awards,” announced Apple, “scoring seven wins including Best Drama ‘Severance’ and Best Comedy ‘Ted Lasso.’”

      • Apple TV+ wins first Edinburgh Television Festival award with ‘Pachinko’ — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. More HR Strife at Apple
    • Apple under fire for how HR handles women who complain about abuse — appleinsider.com/… & Female Employees Call Out Apple’s Handling of Complaints on Misconduct — www.macobserver.com/…
      • 💵 The (paywalled) original report: The women calling out Apple’s handling of misconduct claims — www.ft.com/…
    • Other Apple HR News:
      • Apple lays off 100 recruiters as hiring becomes more ‘deliberate’ — appleinsider.com/…
      • Once again, Apple calls workers back to the office—once again, workers fight back — arstechnica.com
      • As Big Tech grapples with caste-based discrimination, Apple explicitly bans it — arstechnica.com
    • Unionisation rumbles on:
      • 🇺🇸 Apple Store union distributes job surveys in preparation for negotiations — appleinsider.com/…
      • 🇦🇺 Apple Together Australia Invites Workers to Attend the Apple Store Unionization Briefing — www.macobserver.com/…
  2. Apple apparently preparing to sell more Ads
    • Apple ad exec wants to more than double ad revenue with new ads across iOS — arstechnica.com

    Gurman wrote in his email newsletter this week that Apple advertising VP Todd Teresi began reporting directly to Apple services head Eddie Cue a few months back. He also wrote that Teresi plans to increase Apple’s advertising revenue from $4 billion annually to billions in the double digits.

    • Opinion: Apple has never been against advertising — it’s against invasive data collection — appleinsider.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Beats partners with Kim Kardashian on new neutral Beats Fit Pro colors — appleinsider.com/…& Kim Kardashian Beats edition sells out in US, most countries — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple launches Education Community in beta with free teaching resources — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple extends repair program for iPhone 12 models affected with ‘no sound issue’ — appleinsider.com/…
  • USB4 2.0 jumps past Thunderbolt to an amazing 80 Gbps — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • 🇪🇺 A draft Commission proposal that’s part of the EU’s on-going e-Waste initiative would require smartphone makers to keep providing spare parts for 5 years and make batteries last for 500 charge cycles — appleinsider.com/…
  • 📌 Apple Schedules Media Event for September 7, 2022 — www.macstories.net/… (‘Far Out’)

item.title: LTA 109: September 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Gazmaz from the My Mac Podcast - @gazmaz

The show starts with some followups from previous shows, one notable number, some legal and regulatory stories, some HR news, and some news from Apple's various services before moving on to the two main stores — Apple's new hardware (AirPods Pro 2, Apple Watch SE 2, Apple Watch Series 8, Apple Watch Ultra & the iPhones 14), and Apple's new software (WatchOS 9 & iOS 16). The show ends with a quick rundown of some other Appple-related stories that made the news in September.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta109.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Expansion of Ads becomes more concrete: App Store to gain new ad slots in time for holiday season — appleinsider.com/…
  • Home automation standard Matter one step closer to use — appleinsider.com/…
  • 🇪🇺 European Union Passes Common Charger Rule, iPhone Must be USB-C By 2024 — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Unionisation Efforts Rumble on:
    • 🇺🇸 Apple Workers in Oklahoma City File Petition to Unionize Store — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple faces labor board complaint over anti-union tactics — appleinsider.com/…
    • 🇦🇺 Apple agrees to negotiate with unions in Australian Apple retail stores — appleinsider.com/…
  • ‘Tap to Pay on iPhone’ feature officially available for Square merchants — appleinsider.com/…
  • Cloudflare Releases API That Will Bring iOS 16 Feature Bypassing CAPTCHAs to More Websites — www.macobserver.com/…
  • More iPad Models Will Get Stage Manager, but External Display Support Is Delayed and Will Be M1 iPad-Only - MacStories — www.macstories.net/…
  • Apple continues to diversify its supply chain:
    • 🇮🇳 Apple starts making iPhone 14 in India — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • 🇮🇳 Apple wants to make AirPods and Beats headphones in India — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Apple is tentatively stepping into more manufacturing in the US — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Report: It Would Take Eight Years to Remove 10% of Apple’s Dependence on China — www.macobserver.com/…

Notable Numbers

item.title: LTA 110: October 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Allison Sheridan from the NosillaCast Podcast - @podfeet
  • Scott Willsey from the Friends with Brews Podcast - @scottaw

The show starts with some followups from previous shows, some regulatory and legal news, some HR news, and some news from Apple's various services before moving on to the four main stores — Apple's Q4 earnings, Apple's Ads expansion, new OSes (iPad OS 16.1 & macOS Ventura), and new hardware (Apple TV, 10th Gen iPad & M2 iPad Pro). The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in October.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta110.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Greg Joswiak confirms iPhone’s future move to USB-C — appleinsider.com/…
  • Crash Detection got off to a rocky start:
    • Rollercoaster repeatedly triggers iPhone 14 Crash Detection — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple says there’s no single ‘silver bullet’ behind crash detection — appleinsider.com/…
    • iOS 16.2 asks for feedback on accidental Emergency SOS activation — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple’s battle against unionisation rumbles on
    • 🇬🇧 Glasgow Apple Store staff become first in UK to unionize — appleinsider.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 First US Union of Apple Retail Workers Files Labor Complaint Against Apple Over Withholding Benefits — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 🇺🇸 Second Apple Retail union will be at Penn Square, Oklahoma City store — appleinsider.com/…
    • 🇦🇺 Australian Apple Employees Vote to Strike Due to Wage Negotiations Failure — www.macobserver.com/…, Australia Apple Store workers go on strike — appleinsider.com/… & Unionized Australian Apple Store employees set to strike again — appleinsider.com/…
  • 🇨🇳 COVID hasn’t just not gone away in China, it’s resurgent:
    • Covid–19 sweeping through Foxconn’s main iPhone factory — appleinsider.com/…

    • Employees at Foxconn’s iPhone Factory Vent About Strict COVID–19 Restrictions — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Workers flee Foxconn’s COVID-hit iPhone factory over poor conditions — appleinsider.com/…
    • Foxconn quadruples bonuses to keep staff at COVID-hit iPhone factory — appleinsider.com/…
    • China imposes new week-long lockdown on Foxconn over COVID–19 — appleinsider.com/…
    • Foxconn to dodge China lockdown, move iPhone production to India — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple Supplier Pegatron Starts Assembling iPhone 14 in India — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇮🇳 Apple continues to target the Indian market: Apple confirms next iOS 16 beta will bring 5G to India — appleinsider.com/…
  • Matter is finally out 😀: With 190 products certified, Matter smart-home standard looks ahead — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • An excellent overview of the current lay of the land: A realistic roundup of what today’s Matter launch means for your smart home — arstechnica.com

Regulatory Rundown

  • Apple seems determined to provoke regulators into action 🙁
    • Spotify Calls Apple’s Rejection of Its Audiobook Offerings Anti-Competitive — www.macobserver.com/…
      • 🇬🇧 Spotify adds audiobook debacle to Britain’s Apple App Store investigation — appleinsider.com/…
    • Social media apps must pay App Store 30% for boosts — appleinsider.com/…
      • Meta lashes out about Apple’s new charge for social media boosts — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple ‘destroys dreams’ says Telegram, as it shuts down monetization plans — appleinsider.com/…
  • 🇬🇧 UK considering antitrust regulations on Apple Card & other big tech financial programs — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • 🇧🇷 Brazilian Courts continue to rule against Apple — arstechnica.com/… & appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple additionally fined the equivalent of $19m
    • Apple ordered to start including chargers in iPhones 12 & 13 in Brazil
    • Apple ordered to give existing customers free chargers
  • Apple Files Lawsuit Against Medical Tech Company Masimo for Allegedly Copying the Apple Watch — www.macobserver.com/… (the company is suing Apple over alleged patent infringement in the AppleWatch)
  • AirPods Max noise isolation reduction may be related to ongoing court battle — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple design chief Evans Hankey leaves, 3 years after succeeding Jony Ive — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Two key execs are leaving Apple — www.cultofmac.com/… (Anna Matthiasson is VP of Retail Online & CIO Mary Demby)
  • Apple Pauses Hiring for Jobs Outside of Research and Development, Apparently to Cut Costs — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Is Raising Apple Music, Apple TV+, and Apple One Subscription Costs — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Windows 11 getting iCloud Photos support plus Apple Music & TV apps — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Music is now available on Xbox — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Music gains Spatial Audio support on select Mercedes-Benz vehicles — www.cultofmac.com/… (The really expensive ones with 31-speaker sound systems)
  • Apple will release For All Mankind, The Morning Show, Truth Be Told & See on Blue-ray & DVD — appleinsider.com/…

      • Counterpoint: Apple’s iPhone Shipments Grow By 2% As Global Market Suffers from Lowest Q3 Level — www.macobserver.com/…
  2. Apple’s Reported Push into Advertising Becomes Real 🙁
    • New ad placements in App Store Today and product pages are live — appleinsider.com/…
      • New App Store ad slots heavily promote gambling apps — appleinsider.com/…
      • Gambling App Store ads are showing up next to addiction recovery apps — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple halts gambling ads in App Store — appleinsider.com/…
      • Developers don’t like Apple’s intrusive new App Store ads — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Related Reports:
      • Apple in talks to run ads on Apple TV+ shows — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: Netflix’s $6.99 Basic With Ads tier rolls out today — appleinsider.com/… & Fix is on the way for Apple TV users who can’t access Netflix ad-supported plan — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Related: Apple have replaced the top row on the Apple TV app with a new Featured row, making many quite cranky — sixcolors.com/… (feels like an ad placement to me)
    • Opinon Pieces:
      • Why the App Store’s tone-deaf gambling ads make me worry about Apple — arstechnica.com/…
      • Apple’s lack of care with gambling app ads is a symptom of a bigger problem — appleinsider.com/…
      • App Store Ads Gone Wild — daringfireball.net/…
  3. OS Releases
    1. Updates for all OSes

        • Set Up and Use iCloud Shared Photo Library — www.macobserver.com/…

  4. New Hardware

item.title: LTA 111: November 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Scott Willsey from the Friends with Brews Podcast - @scottaw

The show starts with some followups from previous shows, some regulatory and legal news, some HR news, and some news from Apple's various services before moving on to the three main stores — China's very bad COVID month, Elon Musk's spat with Apple, and Apple delivering the promised iPhone satellite SOS feature and AppleWatch Ultra dive computer app. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in November.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta111.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • 🇺🇸 IT was another rocky month for Apple’s labour relations in the US:
    • Shareholders challenging Apple on unions & alleged slave labor — appleinsider.com/…
    • Bloomberg interviews Apple Retail workers to gauge their feelings, and they’re not happy, they feel under pressure to up-sell which they never felt before, and they are interested in unionising to get back to the old ways — www.macobserver.com/…
    • St. Louis Apple Store second to seek IAM union membership — appleinsider.com/…
      • St. Louis Galleria Mall Apple Store has stopped unionization efforts — appleinsider.com/…
      • AppleTogether asks about Apple’s union busting for possible class action suit — appleinsider.com/…
      • Union Organizers Plan Class Action Lawsuit Against Apple for Union-Busting Tactics — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Related: Anti-union talks continue at Apple Store in Reston, VA — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple’s remote work policy makes it hard for employees to avoid abortion bans — appleinsider.com/…
  • The new iCloud web interface is already out of beta — appleinsider.com/…
  • As winter arrives season starts we’re discovering another thing that triggers Apple’s Crash detection – skiiing, but first responders don’t want people to disable the feature — www.macobserver.com/…

    • “Somebody could ski and hit a tree and be knocked unconscious and not be visible to other skiers. We do not want you to turn the feature off. We would rather have you be safe. We don’t mind taking that call because if something really did happen, we want to be able to get to you.”

    • Related: Apple releases iOS 16.1.2 with crash detection improvements — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • 🇦🇺 An interim report from the Australian Competition & Consumer Commission (ACCC) recommends major regulatory reforms to curb the power of Apple, Google, and other big tech companies in app stores, search, ads, and social media — appleinsider.com/…
  • 🇬🇧 The UK’s Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has officially launched an investigation into the smartphone browser market — appleinsider.com/…
  • 🇧🇷 Brazilian regulator seizes iPhones from retail stores for not including chargers in box — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • 🇰🇷 Apple Promises to Fix App Store Policy that Oddly Charges Korean Developers More Than the 30% App Sale Commission — www.macobserver.com/…
  • 🇬🇧 Musicians aren’t losing out from streaming music, UK regulator says — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Epic: Oral arguments were heard in the appeal against the original ruling that mostly favoured apple. Nothing unexpected happened — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple -v- Ericsson: 🇨🇴 Colombia lifts ban on 5G iPhones and iPads after appeal — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple’s new patent countersuit against AliveCor aims to ‘set the record straight’ — appleinsider.com/… (second counter-suit over AppleWatch ECG patent claim)
    • Related: Mayo Clinic Study Highlights One More Way Apple Watch Can Save Lives — www.macobserver.com/… (highlighting cardiac issues)
    • Related: AirPods perform almost as well as premium hearing aids in new study — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple & Pinn settle their lawsuit over AirPods charging cases on the eve of the scheduled retrial — appleinsider.com/…
  • 🇺🇸 iCloud class action settlement payout won’t even buy a cup of coffee — appleinsider.com/… (payments start to arrive from March’s settlement for having iCloud data on non-Apple servers)
  • 🇺🇸 Court approves Apple’s $50M settlement to end Butterfly Keyboard lawsuit — appleinsider.com/… & Apple will pay up to $395 to people with broken MacBook butterfly keyboards — arstechnica.com

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Key staff driving Apple search engine leave to rejoin Google — appleinsider.com/… (Anand Shukla, Srinivasan Venkatachary & Steven Baker, left Google to found Laserlike in 2015, bought by Apple in 2018)
  • Apple executive John Stauffer poached by Roblox — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple hires Facebook exec to lead its information systems department — appleinsider.com/… (Timothy Campos)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+:
    • Apple and Major League Soccer Announce MLS Season Pass to Arrive This February — www.macobserver.com/… ($14.99 per month, or $99 for the whole season)

    • The Kid Laroi and Bieber top Apple Music’s Top 100 Songs of 2022 — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

    • Apple’s iPhone Production Could Be Reduced by 6 Million Due to Worsening Situation at Foxconn iPhone Plant in China — www.macobserver.com/… & Apple’s iPhone 14 Pro shipments may drop by 20M in Q4 says Kuo — appleinsider.com/…
    • Rare Civil Disobedience in China Shows Country’s Frustration With COVID–19 Restrictions — www.macobserver.com/…

      • “In the first quarter, Apple was the top advertiser on Twitter, spending $48 million on ads on the social network, according to a document reviewed by The Washington Post that was compiled from internal Twitter data. Apple’s spending accounted for more than 4 percent of Twitter’s revenue that quarter.” — Washington Post

item.title: LTA 112: December 2022
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Adam Christianson from The Mac Cast - @maccast
  • Nick Riley from the Essential Apple Podcast - @spligosh
  • Simon Parnell from the Essential Apple Podcast - @serenak

The show starts with some followups from previous shows, some regulatory and legal news, and some news from Apple's various services before moving on to the four main stories — Apple's continuing efforts to diversify its supply chain, three iCloud security enhancements, some new OS features (Sing, Freeform & Stage Manager on external displays on iPadOS), and Apple's overhaul of App Store pricing. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in December.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta112.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple Pay South Korea launch delayed by regulators — appleinsider.com/…
  • China’s on-going COVID outbreak
    • Foxconn could resume full iPhone production by early January — appleinsider.com/…
    • China Abandons Key Parts of Zero-COVID Strategy After Protests — daringfireball.net/…
    • iPhone Maker Foxconn Urges China Government To Ease Zero-COVID Policy — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Foxconn lifts Covid restrictions at the main iPhone factory — appleinsider.com/…
    • Foxconn forcing sick workers to stay on iPhone production lines — appleinsider.com/…
    • Foxconn hopes to retain workers by offering cash bonuses — appleinsider.com/…
    • iPhone 14 Pro lead times have returned to after-launch levels — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related Opinion: Apple’s business under growing threat from China’s Covid wave — arstechnica.com
  • Apple’s Employee Relations Strugles Continue
    • US Labor Prosecutors Find Apple Violated Federal Law By Coercing and Interrogating Atlanta Workers — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple employees in the St. Louis Galleria store have released a press statement contradicting the Union’s statement that the vote was pulled due to intimidation, the Union is standing by their statement — www.macobserver.com/…
    • The newly unionised Apple Store workers in Towson (Maryland) will start formal negotiations (collective bargaining) with Apple in early 2023 — appleinsider.com/…
    • London Apple Store at White City unionizing with UTAW — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple accused of creating illegal pseudo-union at Ohio store — appleinsider.com/… (Workers organisation run by managers!)
    • Australia Apple Store workers go on strike over conditions and pay — appleinsider.com/…
    • Former patent attorney sues Apple over harassment & discrimination — appleinsider.com/… (Can’t verify the details, but if accurate, it makes Apple look bad IMO)
    • Apple’s internal report says that it doesn’t stifle employee speech — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Will Remove NDA Clauses Related to Discrimination and Abuse — www.macobserver.com/…
  • New Apple Car rumor suggests 2026 debut at less than $100,000 — appleinsider.com/… & Apple Car Plans Scaled Back Considerably to Ensure Launch by 2026 — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple have rolled out Emergency SOS via Satellite to France, Germany, Ireland & the UK — www.apple.com/…
    • Related: a couple were able to call for help via satellite when their car fell into a 300ft canyon in CA — www.nytimes.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
  • Crash Detection is continuing to have some teething problems, but it is also working as intended:
    • Crash Detection causing problems for Canada’s helicopter rescue teams — appleinsider.com/…
    • iPhone 14 crash detection still sending deluge of false alarms from skiers — appleinsider.com/…
    • iPhone 14 Crash Detection gets man to wife’s accident before ambulance — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • Paris Commercial Court fines Apple over ‘abusive’ App Store policy — appleinsider.com/… (The ruling doesn’t require Apple to make any changes immediately because the up-coming Digital Markets Act will take care of the problem!)
  • Apple should be fined $6.4 million over iOS 14 privacy, says French advisor — appleinsider.com/… (Issue with iOS 14 version of App Tracking Transparency, was resolved in iOS 15)
  • New York State has passed a Right to Repair bill that gives users more rights, but isn’t enough to satisfy critics — appleinsider.com/… (It sounds like a good compromise to be, pairing is vital for security!)

Legal Latest

  • Apple and Ericsson settle global patent disputes, sign new deal — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple -v- AliveCor (ECG patent dispute)
    • Three heart rate measuring patents used in suit against Apple invalidated — appleinsider.com/…
    • ITC finds Apple guilty of heart rate monitoring patent infringement — appleinsider.com/… (yes, this ruling rests on the three patents invalidated earlier in the month, so if AliveCor’s appeal of that ruling fails, this ruling probably falls too. ATM it us suspended, and its not clear it will ever come into force)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Give out more Awards
    • Apple reveals the top podcasts of 2022 — appleinsider.com/…
    • NBA 2K22 and Sneaky Sasquatch make Apple Arcade’s list of year’s best games — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Apple Music rolls out to Tesla cars in holiday software update — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple TV+:
    • More international recognition: ‘Slow Horses’ Earns Television Nomination at UK Writers’ Guild Awards, a First for Apple TV+ — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Next Major League Soccer season starts Feb. 1 on Apple TV+ — appleinsider.com/…
      • Customers without Apple TV+ can pay $14.99 per month, or $99 for the whole season
      • Customers with AppleTV+ can pay $12.99 per month, or £79 for the season
    • Mythic Quest spinoff Mere Mortals coming to Apple TV+ — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • The Apple Maps redesign has been rolled out to Belgium, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, the Netherlands & Switzerland — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Big trend of 2022 — Apple continue to diversify their supply chain
    • Apple speeds up plans to move iPhone assembly out of China — www.cultofmac.com/… (Apple have reportedly asked Indian & Vietnamese suppliers to increase their capacity)
      • India may account for 5% of iPhone production volume by spring 2023 — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple plans to make MacBooks in Vietnam from mid–2023 — appleinsider.com/…
    • TSMC triples Arizona chip factory investment to $40 billion — appleinsider.com/… & Tim Cook confirms Apple will use TMSC chips made in Arizona — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple looks to Luxshare for iPhone 15 Pro Max assembly — appleinsider.com/… (still in China, but diversifying number of suppliers)
  2. Apple announce 3 iCloud Security Enhancements: Apple advances user security with powerful new data protections — www.apple.com/…
  3. The features: 1. iMessage Contact Key Verification (ability for users to check there is no key-shenanigans going on, will probably be similar to what Signal does already) — coming “in 2023” 2. Support for Hardware keys for iCloud 2FA — coming “in early 2023” * Physical Security Key Support Arrives in iOS 16.3, macOS Ventura 13.2 Beta — www.macobserver.com/… 3. Optional End-to-End encryption of all most all iCloud data (basically all but groupware data like mail, contacts & calendars) — already in beta in the US, roll out to the rest of the world “starting in early 2023”
    • How to use Advanced Data Protection & Apple’s other new security features — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple’s Advanced Data Protection feature is here - what you need to know — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple’s plan to scan iPhone photos for child abuse material is dead — appleinsider.com/…
    • FBI ‘deeply concerned’ about Apple’s new security protections — appleinsider.com/…
  4. New OS Features — www.macobserver.com/…
    1. Karaoke with your favorite songs with new Apple Music Sing — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Apple’s press release with all the details: Apple introduces Apple Music Sing — www.apple.com/…
      • Hands on with Apple Music Sing on iPhone, iPad, & Apple TV — appleinsider.com/…
    2. Apple launches Freeform: a powerful new app designed for creative brainstorming and collaboration — www.apple.com/…
      • Freeform Leverages the Freedom and Flexibility of a Blank Canvas — www.macstories.net/…
      • Blank Canvas: Hands on with Apple’s new Freeform app — sixcolors.com/…
    3. Get way more done with full external display support in iPadOS 16.2 — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Related Review: iPadOS 16.2 and Stage Manager for External Displays: Work in Progress, But Worth the Wait — www.macstories.net/…
  5. Apple announces sweeping changes to App Store pricing — arstechnica.com
    1. Many more price points become possible (effectively all useful prices)
    2. The minimum reduces to $0.29, and the maximum to $10,000
    3. Developers can set different prices in different regions, choosing for themselves how to respond to exchange rate changes

Quick Stories

  • Apple’s rollout of Matter support has hit a snag:
    • Some Apple HomeKit setups are breaking after iOS 16.2 update — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple halts update to HomeKit’s new Home architecture — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Adds New Home Architecture to Major Issue List — www.macobserver.com/… (Unofficial report about and internal data structure)
  • Some minor new hardware releases from Apple:
    • HomePod mini arrives in Finland, Norway, South Africa, Sweden — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple offers limited-edition AirTags for Japan Year of the Rabbit — appleinsider.com/…
    • Year of the Rabbit AirPods Pro on sale in China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Expands its repair program:
    • ( ) Apple expands its self service repair program for iPhones 12 & 13 and Apple Silicon MacBooks to 8 European countries (Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Spain, Sweden & UK) — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple has added Apple Silicon desktop Macs to its Self Service Repair program in the US — sixcolors.com/…
  • Apple prepares to roll out 5G support in India before 2023 — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple have released their annual report on their charitable work — appleinsider.com/…
    • Since it was started in 2011 Apple’s Employee Giving program has raised over $880M to help over 44K organisations around the world
    • Over 76,000 employees have logged over 2.1 million volunteer hours
    • Apple matches the donations and makes payments to match the hours
    • The company also directly supports organisations working towards equality and responding to crises around the world
    • Apple’s press release: Across the globe, Apple and its teams find new ways to give — www.apple.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

Emoji Meaning
A link to audio content, probably a podcast.
