item.title: LTA 113: January 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This month it's a rare solo show with just Bart. The show starts with some followups from previous shows, some regulatory and legal news, some Apple HR news, and some news from Apple's various services before moving on to the five main stories — Apple's introduction of AI-based audio book narration, SpotHero & Apple Business Connect improving Apple Maps, the new M2 Pro & M2 Max chops and the updated MacMini and MacBookPros containing them, the new full-sized HomePod, and Apple's Q1 2023 earnings. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in January.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta113.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple ID security key support added in iOS 16.3, macOS 13.2 – Six Colors — sixcolors.com/…
    • How to protect your Apple ID account with Security Keys on iPhone, iPad, or Mac - The Mac Security Blog — www.intego.com/…
    • Five best security keys for iOS 16.3 — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple’s new Crash Detection feature continues to cause problems for emergency services:
    • Apple Crash Detection now causing problems in Minnesota — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple seeks 911 dispatcher feedback over Emergency SOS skier misfires — appleinsider.com/…
    • iPhone 14 Crash Detection false positives are now a problem in Japan — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple is following through on commitments from last years’s annual shareholders meeting:
    • Apple will start releasing more details about app store removals — appleinsider.com/…
    • Following a consultation process with shareholders, Tim Cook cuts his own salary by 40%, down to ‘just’ about $49M — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Related: Apple shareholder meeting to be held on March 10 — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple agrees to audit labor practices ahead of shareholders meeting — appleinsider.com/…
  • Complaints against Apple’s anti-union tactics continue to escalate, the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) have “found merit to charge alleging statements and conduct by Apple — including high-level executives — […] violated the National Labor Relations Act.”, the NLRB try to mediate disputes, so the next step is for the board to try agree remediations with Apple — appleinsider.com/…
  • We’ve discussed Apple’s successes with European shows in recent episodes: Apple TV+ is expanding its European production teams — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple continues to diversify its supply chain: Apple starts making AirPods components in India — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple’s first retail store in India takes one step closer to opening — www.cultofmac.com/… (Apple have started hiring)

Regulatory Rundown

  • Brazil watchdog investigates Apple over App Store payment rules — appleinsider.com/…
  • Spotify have written an open letter to the EU demanding swift action against Apple — appleinsider.com/…
  • A report from The US National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) finds that Google & Apple’s app store policies are “harmful to consumers and developers.” — appleinsider.com/…
  • The US Federal Reserve are investigating whether Goldman Sachs provide their consumer credit card customers (including Apple Card customers) sufficient consumer protections — appleinsider.com/…
  • Related: Apple hit new record high for lobbying in 2022, but still behind peers — appleinsider.com/… (2022 44% higher than 2021, $9.4M, compared to $9.8M for MS & $10.9M for Google)

Legal Latest

  • Masimo -v- Apple: a US administrative law judge in Washington DC has ruled that the Apple Watch infringes on Masimo’s pulse oximeter patent, Apple disagrees, and the case now goes to the US International Trade Commission who will decide what, if anything, to do about the infringement — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Caltech -v- Broadcom & Apple: The US Supreme Court has asked the Solicitor General (executive branch) for their input as they consider Apple & Broadcom’s appeal to be allowed to challenge a lower court’s decision not to allow them question the validity of Caltech’s patent, this is all happening as a re-trial for damages is pending in July in a lower court — appleinsider.com/…
  • Korea rejects $1.64 million battery throttling lawsuit — appleinsider.com/… ( Nice to see at least one country be sensible about this whole thing!)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Services VP Peter Stern leaves Apple after six years — appleinsider.com/… (Was apparently seen by some as a possible successor to Eddie Cue, played a big role in bringing sports to AppleTV+)
  • Apple Music chief Oliver Schusser will help lead Apple TV+ — appleinsider.com/… (Already VP of Apple Music & Beats, replacing Peter Stern’s input to Apple TV+)
  • Jeff Williams has taken control of Apple’s industrial design team — appleinsider.com/… (Jony Ives’ old role is not being replaced when Evans Hankey leaves)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Fitness+ adds kickboxing workout, Beyonce artist spotlight, more — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple make it easier for podcasters to publish paid content to ApplePodcasts as well as other platforms with Delegated Delivery – producers can now do the work once and reach paying subscribers on all of the major platforms — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Music and Apple TV apps launch for Windows 11 — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Apple TV+ short gets Oscar nominations, ‘Emancipation’ shut out — appleinsider.com/… (The Boy, the Mole, the Fox, and the Horse)
  • LG software update brings Apple services to hundreds of smart TV brands — www.cultofmac.com/… (webOS update bringing Apple TV+, Apple Music, AirPlay & the Home app)

Main Stories

  1. Apple launches AI narrators for some audiobooks — sixcolors.com/…
    • Only specific genres
    • Marketed to book authors as a cheaper way to get their books into audio
    • Using the feature does not require signing audio book rights to Apple, and the authors are still free to produce traditional audio books later if they wish
    • You can now listen to some of these books, they are labeled in the store as Narrated by Apple Books — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple says it is committed to book narrators, expands AI reading anyway — appleinsider.com/…
  2. Apple enhances Apple Maps
    • Apple Maps gets parking information with SpotHero integration — appleinsider.com/… (8K+ locations in US & Canada)
      • How to make parking in the city easier with Apple Maps and SpotHero — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple launches Apple Business Connect, its own service for businesses to add information about their locations to Apple Maps — www.apple.com/…
      • Businesses can now customize their Apple Maps info & more — appleinsider.com/…
      • With Business Connect, Apple escalates its competition with Google Maps — arstechnica.com
  3. New M2 Pro & M2 Max powered Macs
    • Apple produced an event video for M2 Mac mini & MacBook Pro — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple unveils M2 Pro and M2 Max: next-generation chips for next-level workflows — www.apple.com/…
      • First M2 Pro benchmarks prove big improvement over M1 Max — appleinsider.com/… & M2 Pro & Max GPUs are fast — but not faster than M1 Ultra — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple introduces new Mac mini with M2 and M2 Pro — more powerful, capable, and versatile than ever — www.apple.com/…
      • Apple launches powerful new Mac mini at a lower cost — www.cultofmac.com/… (base model now $599, $100 cheaper)
      • The M2 Mac mini vs the M1 and Intel Versions — www.macobserver.com/… & M2 Pro Mac mini vs Mac Studio - compared — appleinsider.com/…
      • Opinion: M2 Mac mini Review: Whatever you want it to be – Six Colors — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple unveils MacBook Pro featuring M2 Pro and M2 Max, with more game-changing performance and the longest battery life ever in a Mac — www.apple.com/… (14“ & 16” models)
      • How the new M2 Pro and Max MacBook Pros compare to M1 models — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Opinion: 2023 MacBook Pro Review: More of the same, in a good way — sixcolors.com/…
    • New M2-powered MacBook Pros and minis have 8K video, Wi-Fi 6E, dozens of cores — arstechnica.com
    • Entry level M2 Mac mini, 2023 MacBook Pro have slower SSD than predecessors — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Mac Pro is Apple’s last Intel computer standing — appleinsider.com/…
  4. Apple introduces the new HomePod with breakthrough sound and intelligence — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple resurrects full-size HomePod with hot new features, same old price — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple says popular demand brought back the HomePod — appleinsider.com/…
    • Second-Generation HomePod Supports Spatial Audio, Temperature/Humidity Monitoring, and Sound Recognition — tidbits.com/…
    • HomePod 2 can’t join in stereo pair with earlier models — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • New HomePod vs 2018 HomePod - compared — appleinsider.com/… & HomePod head-to-head: How Apple’s new smart speaker compares to original — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Early previewers praise new HomePod’s ‘just wow’ audio — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple are activating previously un-known temperature and humidity sensors in the HomePod Mini, and all HomePods are getting improved Siri functionality including access to FindMy — appleinsider.com/… & www.cultofmac.com/…
      • What new HomePod temperature and humidity sensors can do for you — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Opinion: HomePod Lives — daringfireball.net/…
  5. Apple’s Q1 2023 Earnings Call — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple results and charts: $117.2B quarter is still a step back – Six Colors — sixcolors.com/…
    • This is Tim: Apple Q1 2023 analyst call transcript — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple Reports First Year-Over-Year Earnings Drop Since 2019 — www.macstories.net/…
    • Tim Cook: iPhone manufacturing shortfall main reason for earnings miss — appleinsider.com/…
      • Related: iPhone 14 Pro finally reaches supply-demand parity — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple says 2 billion of its devices are in active use — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple services have more than 935 million paid subscriptions — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Services revenue hit an all-time high of $20.8 billion — appleinsider.com/…
    • Opinion: 5 upbeat takeaways from Apple’s optimistic earnings call — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple barely missed earnings targets, so analysts are still bullish — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related Analyst Estimates:
      • IDC: Mac shipments grew in 2022 while PC tanked — www.cultofmac.com/… (market down 16%, Mac up 2.5%)
      • Canalys: Global smartphone shipments fell 17% in the 2022 holiday quarter versus 2021, but the iPhone reclaimed the top spot — appleinsider.com/…
      • IDC: iPhone Christmas sales hit by 15% over production problems & weak demand — appleinsider.com/…
      • Counterpoint Research: Apple collects nearly all of the profit in the worldwide smartphone market — appleinsider.com/… (85%)
      • IDC: Apple made almost half the tablets sold in Q4 2022 (49.2%, up 28.8% YoY to 22.5M units) — www.cultofmac.com/…

Quick Stories

  • World Surf League declares Apple Watch as official sports equipment — appleinsider.com/… (Official app, and can be used during competitions)
  • Apple celebrate Black History Month — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple celebrating Black History Month with new Apple Watch band, content, donations — appleinsider.com/… (I got the band and I really like it )
    • Apple honors Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. with free book, homepage tribute — appleinsider.com/… (Stride Toward Freedom by King)
    • Apple TV celebrates Black History Month with curation by Dr. Jelani Cobb — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple racks up 21 nominations for the 2023 NAACP Image Awards — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Support app gains 3 languages, expands into 118 new regions — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple raising its non-AppleCare battery replacement costs across devices — arstechnica.com (starting March, $20 in general)
  • Apple’s MagSafe To Be Incorporated Into Qi2 Wireless Charging Standard — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple releases Lisa source code — sixcolors.com/…
  • 20 years of Safari: A visual history — www.cultofmac.com/…

item.title: LTA 114: February 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Allison Sheridan from the NosillaCast Podcast - @podfeet@chaos.social
  • Barry Fulk - @fulkb@friendsofdesoto.social

This month Bart is joined by Allison Sheridan from the NosillaCast Podcast and first-time guest Barry Fulk. The show starts with just one followup from the previous show, one piece of legal news, and a few stories from Apple's various services before moving on to the three main stories — Apple's HR re-organisation, the EU's updated anti-trust complaint against Apple, and Linux support for M1 processors. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in February.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta114.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Narrators from a smaller audio book firm are angry Apple seemingly snuck in a clause in their contracts saying their voices could be used to train AI have tasked their union with fighting for fair compensation for their work, and they have succeeded in having the problematic clause in their contracts suspended — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- AliveCor: President Biden has declined to step in a block the possible Apple Watch import ban on foot of AliveCor’s patent dispute with Apple. Appeals are on-going, and the ban is stayed until all appeals are exhausted — appleinsider.com/… & arstechnica.com/… (AliveCor won the ban, Apple have won a case to invalidate the patents, and AliveCor are actively appealing the invalidation)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Maps: Apple Maps brings Look Around to Finland, Norway, and Sweden — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple TV+:
    • Apple have rolled out some improvements to their Major League Soccer season pass — appleinsider.com/… (more and better camera angles, higher resolution, Dolby 5.1 audio, etc..)
    • Apple TV+ needs more content and they will train directors to get it — appleinsider.com/…
    • Awards:
      • Apple scores Bafta win for best British short animation — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple TV+ ‘The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse’ wins two Annie awards — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple re-organises HR, with Deirdre O’Brien returning to being just the head of Retail again, and Carol Surface has been hired as Apple’s first Chief People Officer — appleinsider.com/… & www.cultofmac.com/…

    • “Previously she was Chief Human Resources Officer at Medtronic, where she worked since 2013. Before then, she was head of HR at Best Buy and worked in the HR department at PepsiCo.”

    • Related: Apple signs union agreement for Glasgow Apple Store staff — appleinsider.com/… & Here’s what the Apple Glasgow retail store union negotiated for itself — appleinsider.com/…
    • Other Apple HR News:
      • Apple taps Swedish politician to advise on ‘global trends’ — appleinsider.com/…(former minister for foreign affairs Ann Linde)
  2. The EU has updated its anti-trust complaint against Apple — appleinsider.com/…
    • Summary: The European Commission has updated it’s Statement of Objections to shift the focus from in app purchases, to “the contractual restrictions that Apple imposed on app developers … which prevent them from informing iPhone and iPad users of alternative music subscription options at lower prices outside of the app and to effectively choose those”. Apple now have a right to reply before the Commission issue an actual ruling. The worst-case outcome would be a fine of 10% annual world-wide revenue!
    • Apple & Spotify have responded to the new Statement of Objections — appleinsider.com/…

      • Apple: Apple will continue to work with the European Commission to understand and respond to their concerns, all the while promoting competition and choice for European consumers. We’re pleased that the Commission has narrowed its case and is no longer challenging Apple’s right to collect a commission for digital goods and require the use of the In-App Payment systems users trust. The App Store has helped Spotify become the top music streaming service across Europe and we hope the European Commission will end its pursuit of a complaint that has no merit

      • Spotify: Today, the European Commission sent a clear message that Apple’s anti-competitive behavior and unfair practices have harmed consumers and disadvantaged developers for far too long … We urge the Commission to reach a swift decision in this case to protect consumers and restore fair competition on the iOS platform.

    • Related:
      • Apple and Google abuse market dominance, says Japan antitrust regulator — appleinsider.com/…
      • Biden demands antitrust action against Big Tech during State of the Union — appleinsider.com/…
      • DOJ escalates antitrust probe into Apple’s alleged anticompetitive practices — appleinsider.com/…
      • After attending a closed-door hearing with the European Commission, a coalition of Norwegian banks released a statement calling for the Commission to take urgent action against Apple to force them to open NFC on iOS to banking apps — appleinsider.com/…
  3. Basic support for M1 processors has been merged into the main line Linux kernel in version 6.2 — appleinsider.com/…, www.cultofmac.com/… & arstechnica.com/…
    • An important step towards Mac support from major Linux distros, but only a step — this is support for the M1 processors, not for Mac hardware!
    • This is up-streamed code from the Asahi Linux project — asahilinux.org/…
    • Still missing many important drivers, as can be seen on Asahi Linux’s feature status page — github.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple released new resources for Europe’s Safer Internet Day, including a new Today at Apple session named ‘Your Kids and Their Devices’ — appleinsider.com/… & www.apple.com/…
    • Related: Apple are rolling out iMessage child protection features to six more countries (Belgium, Brazil, Japan, the Netherlands, South Korea & Sweden) — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Apple appears to be trying to push their Car Key feature with the release of a testing app for use by auto makers looking to get certified for the feature — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • New App Store benchmarks let devs compare app performance to peers — appleinsider.com/…
  • Microsoft gives official blessing to Windows 11 for ARM on Parallels — appleinsider.com/…
  • Microsoft is bringing iMessage to Windows with the Phone Link app — appleinsider.com/…
  • Both Mozilla & Google, anticipating the enforced opening up of iOS to 3rd-parry browser engines thanks to the EU DMA, have started work on porting their browser engines to iOS — www.cultofmac.com/… & 9to5mac.com/…
  • Reminder: Apple’s annual shareholder meeting will be held on March 10th
    • Related: NLPC seeks to kick Tim Cook, Al Gore from Apple board of directors — appleinsider.com/…

Legend

item.title: LTA 115: March 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Allison Sheridan from the NosillaCast Podcast - @podfeet@chaos.social

The show starts with a few followups from previous shows, one quick regulation story, two short legal stories, three Apple HR stories, and a partridge ... err ... and some highlights from Apple's services and original content divisions. The three main stories are Apple's complicated relationships with China & India, Apple Pay Later, and Apple Music Classical. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in March.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta115.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Compared to previous months March was quiet in terms of labor relations at Apple, but there was some news:
    • The CWA (Communication Workers of America) accused Apple of illegally firing staff for union organising — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple is reportedly starting to use door access badge logs to enforce their return to work policy, with employees who are not complying facing possible termination — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple got everything it wanted at the annual shareholder meeting — appleinsider.com/…
  • The changes to Apple’s App Store pricing model Apple announced a few months ago have gone live, allowing developers much more control over their app pricing around the world — appleinsider.com/…
  • Wix & Stripe partner to take in-coming tap-to-pay payments on iOS out of beta and into the real world for US merchants — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple expands Emergency SOS via satellite to six more countries — appleinsider.com/… (Austria, Belgium, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands & Portugal)
  • ApplePay finally launches in South Korea — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple’s car project still seems to be bubbling away under the surface: Apple self-driving test program grows to over 200 drivers — appleinsider.com/… (Data from CA DMV)

Regulatory Rundown

  • UK antitrust case versus Apple’s browser dominance dies on a technicality — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Billion dollar Apple Watch patent fight goes to jury trial — appleinsider.com/… (Masimo, blood oxygen sensor)
  • Apple -v- VirnetX: Apple has won an appeal to invalidate the two patents at the heart of VirnetX’s 2010 case against Apple over FaceTime & iMessage — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Michael Abbott, Apple’s vice president of cloud engineering is leaving Apple in April — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple executive shuffle to emphasize India as a sales region — appleinsider.com/…
  • According to reports from Bloomberg, Apple are extending their hiring freeze and changing how they do promotions and bonuses in order to cut costs — appleinsider.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+
    • The Nominations & Awards keep rolling in both sides of the Atlantic:
      • Apple and BBC win Oscar for ‘The Boy, the Mole, the Fox, and the Horse’ — appleinsider.com/…
      • Severance wins both the Best Drama and Best New Series awards at the Writers Guild Awards — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Bad Sisters is the most-nominated show in the 20th Irish Film & TV Awards — appleinsider.com/…
      • Slow Horses & Bad Sisters get nominations from the Royal Television Society Awards — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple TV+ gains 15 nominations at UK’s Bafta Television Awards — appleinsider.com/… (Slow Horses & Bad Sisters)
      • Selena Gomez Apple TV+ film nominated for MTV’s Best Music Documentary — appleinsider.com/…
    • Friday Night Baseball returns to Apple TV+ for the 2023 season, no longer free, but with some tweaks: Apple TV+ baseball fans will get live looks into bad call appeals — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: tvOS 16.4 & iOS 16.4 have a new safety feature to protect epileptics — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Fitness+ spotlights Miley Cyrus, Mariah Carey, Shania Twain — appleinsider.com/…
  • PayPal adds Apple Pay support for small business payments — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. China, India & Apple — it’s complicated!
    • Apple, Foxconn convince Indian state to loosen labor laws — arstechnica.com & Apple & Foxconn amping up efforts for more labor reform in India — appleinsider.com/…
    • Foxconn wins first AirPods order & will make them in India — appleinsider.com/…
    • Even Foxconn says it’s looking to move away from China — appleinsider.com/…
    • Tim Cook among few US CEOs attending China business summit — appleinsider.com/… & Cook praises ‘symbiotic’ 30-year relationship with China — appleinsider.com/…
    • China tells Apple to beef up its data security practices — appleinsider.com/…
  2. Apple Pay Later soft-launches in the US
    • Apple Pay Later gives you 6 weeks to pay off interest-free loans — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple launches Apple Pay Later, but only for selected users — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Pay Later turns Apple into a full-on money lender — arstechnica.com
  3. Apple Music Classical finally launches — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple Music Classical waltzes onto iPhone — appleinsider.com/…
    • Here’s your introduction to Apple Music Classical — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Reviews/Opinion:
      • The overlap between Apple Music and Classical app is clunky — appleinsider.com/…
      • First Look: Apple Classical is tuned for the genre, but hits a few false notes – Six Colors — sixcolors.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Some minor new hardware announcements from Apple:
    • iPhone 14 and iPhone 14 Plus now available in yellow — appleinsider.com/…
    • iPhone 14 Silicone Cases & Apple Watch bands gain new spring colors — appleinsider.com/…
    • Beats by Dre is launching a ‘Girls Don’t Cry’ edition of Beats Flex — appleinsider.com/…
  • Some software tweaks to Apple’s OSes:
    • iOS 16.4 brings a second attempt at launching the new Matter-based HomeKit architecture — 9to5mac.com/…
    • iOS 16.4 brings voice isolation to regular cellular calls — www.macobserver.com/…
    • iPadOS 16.4 bring new tilt & azimuth support to the Apple Pencil’s hover mode — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple have updated the iWork suite with just a few nice little tweaks — tidbits.com/…
  • Apple debuts iPhone purchasing via video call — www.cultofmac.com/… (US only, at least for now)
  • Microsoft makes Outlook for Mac free for everyone — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Six 8BitDo Controllers Add Support for Apple Hardware — www.macstories.net/…
  • Apple will publish it’s Q2 earnings on May the 4th — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Announces WWDC 2023: June 5–9 with Special Event at Apple Park — www.macstories.net/…
    • Apple announces Swift Student Challenge for WWDC 2023 — appleinsider.com/… & Some Swift Student Challenge winners will go to WWDC23 — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Join the NosillaCastaways text chat during the WWDC Keynote by going to podfeet.com/chat

item.title: LTA 116: April 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots
  • Lynda Gousha from the Silicon Valley MUG - @llg4cdg

The show starts with a few followups from previous shows, a few quick regulation stories, a few short legal stories, just one Apple HR story, and some highlights from Apple's services and original content divisions. The four main stories are Apple's new savings account, the noticeable rise in malware targeting the Mac, Apple & Google's new anti-stalking standard for trackers, and Apple's Q2 2023 earnings call. The show finishes with a quick rundown of some other Apple-related stories that made the news in April.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta116.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple opened its first 2 stores in India in April:
    • Apple’s new India BKC store opening was met by massive crowds — appleinsider.com/…
    • Tim Cook opens first Apple Store in India — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Store in New Delhi: India’s Second Apple Store Opens in Saket — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Enormous crowds turn out for Apple’s second India store — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Tim Cook meets with India’s Prime Minister, as tour continues — appleinsider.com/… & India minister says Apple will at least double local investment in the next three years — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple expands in India with new 10-year office lease in Bengaluru, India — appleinsider.com/…
  • Support for accepting Tap-to-Pay payments on iPhones continues to roll out: GoDaddy rolls out support for Tap to Pay on iPhone for U.S. businesses — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • German regulators have ruled that Apple qualify for extra scrutiny under the country’s strengthened anti-competition laws — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple officially named as one of the 19 major tech companies that will be regulated under the DSA (Digital Service Act) — arstechnica.com/…
    • Related: After years of silence, Apple finally reveals how many App Store users it has in Europe — appleinsider.com/…
  • EU warns Apple not to limit iPhone features to MFi-certified USB-C cables — www.cultofmac.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Epic Games: the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals has upheld Apple’s victory over Epic Games, but more appeals are expected — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple -v- Masimo: Latest chapter of $2 billion Apple Watch patent battle ends in mistrial — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple have dropped their suit against Gerrard Williams III, a former Apple engineer who left to co-founder chip design startup Nuvia — appleinsider.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+:
    • UK’s Bafta honors ‘Bad Sisters’ and ‘The Essex Serpent’ — appleinsider.com/…
    • ‘Ted Lasso’ star Hannah Waddingham lands Christmas special — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple continues to role out it’s improved Maps experience with six central European countries getting the upgrade this time: Austria, Croatia, Czechia, Hungary, Poland, and Slovenia — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple adds 20 new games to its Apple Arcade catalog — appleinsider.com/…
  • ‘Baby Shark’ studio Pinkfong now has exclusive shows on Apple Podcasts — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Music Live returns for a brand-new season of exclusive live concerts with a special performance by Ed Sheeran — www.apple.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple launched their previously announced high-yield savings account in the US (4.15% Annual Percentage Yield, no minimum balance, no fees, provided by Goldman Sachs) — arstechnica.com/…
    • Apple Savings saw nearly $1 billion of deposits in first four days — appleinsider.com/…
    • How To Open and Manage an Apple Card Savings Account — www.macobserver.com/…
    • How Apple Savings compares vs other high-yield savings accounts — appleinsider.com/…
  2. Cyber Criminals are increasing their focus on the Mac:
    • Apple’s Macs have long escaped ransomware, but that may be changing — arstechnica.com
    • Security researchers found malware-as-a-service data stealer for Mac for sale on a cybercrime telegram group (Atomic macOS Stealer or AMOS) — nakedsecurity.sophos.com/… & www.intego.com/…
    • Security researchers have found a new data stealer trojan targeting the Mac which they’ve dubbed RustBucket that appears to be the work of the Advanced Persistent Thread (APT) group dubbed BlueNoroff which is believed to be tied to the infamous Lazarus Group who are believed to be the North Korean government — www.intego.com/…
    • Related: Apple issues first Rapid Security Response for macOS, iOS - The Mac Security Blog — www.intego.com/…
    • Related: the threat from iOS state-level spyware has not gone away either:
      • The NSO group is continuing to enhance & sell Pegasus, with three new zero-click exploits found to have been used in 2022 — appleinsider.com/…
      • The NSO group are also not alone: Another Pegasus-like spyware tool called ‘Reign’ was used to spy on iPhones — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Joanna Stern & Nicole Nguyen have expanded on their recent research to find that using just an iPhone and the passcode it’s possible for attackers to permanently lock users out of their iCloud account by setting up a recovery key — appleinsider.com/…
  3. Apple and Google introduce standard to combat AirTag and Tile tracker misuse — arstechnica.com
    • Related: New York City handing out AirTags in car theft crackdown — appleinsider.com/…
  4. Apple’s Q2 2023 Earnings Call — www.apple.com/…
    • This is Tim: Apple’s Q2 2023 analyst call, transcribed — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple Q2 2023 results: $94.8B revenue, better than expected (with charts!) – Six Colors — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple extends share buybacks by another $90 billion — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple brings in robust iPhone revenue but Mac and iPad are down — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Supply chain issue fixes, plus India expansion led to Apple’s excellent quarter, says Tim Cook — appleinsider.com/…
    • Tim Cook: Mass layoffs a ‘last resort’ and off the table for the moment — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple still didn’t give specific financial guidance, but hinted at what to expect for Q3 — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related Numbers:
      • Counterpoint Research has found that AppleWatches have the highest customer satisfaction (>70% ‘very satisfied’), and of those who own both an iPhone and a smart watch, 80% have an Apple Watch (stat for Android is 71%) — appleinsider.com/…
      • Despite global smartphone market contraction, Apple is thriving with 21% market share — appleinsider.com/… (Canalys)
      • Counterpoint Research numbers show Apple growing Chinese smartphone sales by 6% in Q2 (YoY), while the market as a whole contracted by 5%, that was enough to give them the highest market share in the country — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related Opinion Pieces:
      • Apple Q2 2023 results, charts — sixcolors.com/…
      • Opinion: 5 reasons to ignore Apple’s rare revenue dip — www.cultofmac.com/…

Quick Stories

  • As usual, Apple marked Earth Day with a series of announcements around the day, culminating in a long press release and the publication of their latest annual environmental report — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple expands it’s Restore Fund for nature-based carbon removal — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple commits to 100% recycled cobalt in batteries by 2025 — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple highlights strides toward limiting environmental impact in annual Environmental Progress Report — appleinsider.com/…
  • The Steve Jobs Archive have released a free ebook titled ‘Make Something Wonderful’ featuring various writings by Steve — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Jony Ive’s lifetime of design work honored with Edison Achievement Award — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple turns on HomePod’s smoke alarm recognition — appleinsider.com/…
    • How to detect smoke alarms on HomePod & HomePod mini — appleinsider.com/…
  • Ford will stick with CarPlay as GM exits for Google tech — appleinsider.com/…
  • iMessage comes to Windows via Microsoft Phone Link for iOS — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Hands on: iMessage on Windows 11 with Phone Link — appleinsider.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.title: LTA 117: May 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

In this solo show Bart starts by explaining some changes to the show, and then gets stuck into the usual apple news. First, some followups, a few notable numbers, a little regulatory and legal news, some HR news, some highlights from Apple's services an original content, and then the four main stories. First, it's still complicated for Apple in India, second, Google & Apple join forces to fight stalking, third, some up-coming accessibility features, and fourth, Apple's pro apps come to the iPad! Finally, the show finishes with some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in May.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta117.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple Music Classical gets two enhancements:
    • Apple has updated Shazam to add integration with Apple Music Classical — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Music Classical lands on Android before iPadOS and Mac — appleinsider.com/…
  • Some Apple Savings customers are experiencing delays (2 weeks in some cases) when withdrawing large sums of money from their accounts. Goldman Sachs says it’s not happening to many customers, and that it has to do with processes to protect accounts, and others have implicated anti-money-laundering procedures — Apple Savings customers hit with long delays when withdrawing money — appleinsider.com/…
  • Emergency SOS via Satellite lands in Australia and New Zealand — appleinsider.com/…
  • Georgia residents can now add a driver’s license to their iPhone — appleinsider.com/…

Notable Numbers

  • Apple brags about the App Store, a lot:
    • Small developers on the App Store grew revenue by 64 percent over the past two years — www.apple.com/… (Report commissioned and publicised by Apple)
    • App Store developers generated $1.1 trillion in total billings and sales in the App Store ecosystem in 2022 — www.apple.com/… (world-wide) & Economist Group Concludes Apple’s App Store Ecosystem Is Responsible for Facilitating $1.1 Trillion in Commerce — www.macstories.net/…
    • App Store stopped more than $2 billion in fraudulent transactions in 2022 — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple shares App Store Transparency report, detailing removals & data requests — appleinsider.com/… (for 2022)
      • approved 253,466 apps
      • 1,679,694 app submissions rejected
      • contains detail on government takedowns, including 1,276 games taken down in China because they didn’t have the needed license
  • Numbers from Canalys show Apple’s share of the US tablet market growing by more than 20% YoY to reach 50%, while every other vendor declined (market as a whole dropped by 7%, less than PC+Laptop which dropped by 28%) — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: iPad shipments more than doubled in China for Q1 versus 2022 — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • Italy’s antitrust agency opens probe into Apple App Store dominance — appleinsider.com/…
  • France doesn’t understand why different iPhone models have varying parts — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • US District Judge Edward Davila has approved the $50M butterfly keyboard class action settlement, deeming it ‘fair & reasonable’, so payments can now start flowing to the registered members of the class — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple’s $13 billion Ireland tax saga lurches back to life after yet another EU appeal — appleinsider.com/… (This appeal is to the highest court, so this really should be the last of it )

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Quite a few high-level departures this month:
    • Apple iCloud lead Mike Abbott, who has been at since 2018 is off to GM to head their new unified software division — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple’s senior director of Video, Sports & Apple TV+ Pete Distad has left, but it’s not know why or where to — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple’s head of Apple Pay business, Eric Hoffman, is leaving Apple after 8 years, and it’s not clear where he’s off to. The roll out of Tap-to-Pay on iOS was one of his big projects — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple is accelerating hiring efforts for generative AI engineers — appleinsider.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • ️‍ Apple Fitness+ debuts new Madonna Artist Spotlight series to celebrate Pride — appleinsider.com/…
  • Find live music with new features on Apple Maps and Apple Music — www.cultofmac.com/… & Apple launches new concert discovery features on Apple Maps and Apple Music — www.apple.com/…
  • Apple’s Tap to Pay on iPhone expands to Australia — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Apple TV+:
    • Severance severed: Writers strike starts to affect Apple TV+ production — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple TV+ takes top Irish honors for Bad Sisters — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • RELATED: Apple TV+ gains UK subscribers as Netflix, Disney+ dip — appleinsider.com/… (Investment in European shows paying off)
    • Two notable MLS Season Pass Offers:
      • Apple TV+ offers one-month free trial of MLS Season Pass — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple cut the price of an MLS season pass in half as half the season is now over — www.imore.com/…
      • Related: Apple TV+ launches multiview for ‘Friday Night Baseball’ and MLS Season Pass — appleinsider.com/… & Apple TV 4K now lets you watch 4 sports streams at once — www.cultofmac.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple & India — It’s Still Complicated
    • The openings of Apple’s first stores in the country we discussed last month seem to have gone well: Apple India’s record-breaking sales revealed thanks to unprecedented leak — appleinsider.com/…
    • Unable to make a profit, Wistron is giving up iPhone assembly in India — appleinsider.com/…
    • Foxconn starts work on building $500 million AirPods plant in India — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple supplier list shows gradual production shift from China to India — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple resists India regulator’s order to ban betting apps — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple petitioned India for slacker labor laws, and unions are fighting back — appleinsider.com/…
  2. Google & Apple join forces to develop a standard for detecting and alerting on the abuse of bluetooth LE trackers like AirTags & Tiles — Tracked by hidden tags? Apple and Google unite to propose safety and security standards… — nakedsecurity.sophos.com/…
  3. Apple previews up-coming accessibility improvements to mark Global Accessibility Awareness Day — www.apple.com/…, www.macstories.net/… & arstechnica.com/…
    • Live Speech (real-time text to speech on voice calls)
    • Personal Voice (personalised privacy-respecting AI voice)
      • Apple created its new voice feature for–and with–people with ALS — www.fastcompany.com/…
    • Point & Speak in Magnifier app
    • Assistive Access (customisable simplified UI)
  4. FinalCut Pro & Logic arrive on M1 iPads — www.apple.com/… & appleinsider.com/…
    • Subscription pricing only ($4.99pm or $49pa)
    • Final Cut Pro on iPad can’t open projects from the Mac, but the Mac can open projects from the iPad (unless you get into some serious hackery — appleinsider.com/…
    • Logic Pro projects can move back and forth between the iPad & Mac
    • How Final Cut Pro for iPad differs from Mac version — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Reviews:
      • Hands-On: Podcast Editing with Logic Pro for iPad — www.macstories.net/…
      • Hands on with Final Cut Pro and Logic Pro for iPad – Six Colors — sixcolors.com/…
      • First Impressions: Final Cut Pro for iPad — www.macstories.net/…

Quick Stories

  • ️‍ Apple role out a new band, watch face, and iPhone wallpaper to celebrate Pride month — www.apple.com/… & appleinsider.com/…
  • Beats Studio Buds+ now available to order with better ANC, transparent option — appleinsider.com/…
    • Review roundup: New Beats Studio Buds+ win with cool clear case and audio upgrades — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Apple’s support app goes to 5.0 with UI tweaks and a new interface for finding local service providers — appleinsider.com/…
  • Online Apple Store opens in Vietnam — appleinsider.com/…
  • Reminder — 5 ways to watch Apple’s WWDC23 Keynote on Monday — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Apple recognizes talented student developers in 2023 Swift Student Challenge — appleinsider.com/…

item.title: LTA 118: June 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This month there was so much Apple news Bart decided the only possible way to get through it all was as a solo show. The show's main top is WWDC, with the focus being on the new Macs, the OS updates, and of course, the entirely new computing paradigm Apple previewed — spatial computing!

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta118.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple’s union-woes continue: Apple World Trade Center anti-union practices ruled illegal by Labor Board — appleinsider.com/… & Apple to appeal NLRB ruling it ‘coercively interrogated’ staff about unions — appleinsider.com/…

Notable Numbers

  • Apple is the world’s biggest company at $3 trillion – again — appleinsider.com/… (First crossed $3T in Jan 2022, then fell back below $2T before climbing again, $3.05T when the show was recorded)

Regulatory Rundown

  • EU law requiring easier iPhone battery replacement inches closer to enactment — appleinsider.com/…
  • The EU Data Act moves a step closer, with agreement in principle between the parliament and the council of ministers on the rules the act will enforce. The aim is to make it easier for users to migrate their data from one cloud service to another, and would cover iCloud — appleinsider.com/… & www.consilium.europa.eu/…
  • Japan law will require Apple to allow alternate iPhone app stores — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple joins a long list of other tech companies in urging the government to abandon their misguided plans to ban End-to-End Encryption (and hence actual security) — appleinsider.com/…
  • Related: Apple expands Self Service Repair and updates System Configuration process — www.apple.com/… (now includes iPhone 14 & more Macs, and Apple say some processes have been simplified)

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Epic: Apple & Epic have jointly filed a request for an en banc (full 11 judge panel) review of the Federal Appeals Court’s most recent finding, which was almost, but not quite entirely, in Apple’s favour. Very few requests for and en banc review are granted, so the most likely outcome will be that the companies will need to appeal to the US Supreme Court — appleinsider.com/…
  • Judge denies Amazon’s, Apple’s motions to dismiss class action price-fixing suit — arstechnica.com (Relates to Amazon’s crackdown on unauthorised resellers of Apple products)
  • Judge rejects Apple’s bid to throw out China sales comment class-action lawsuit — appleinsider.com/… (Cranky shareholders claiming Tim Cook mislead them by being too optimistic in an answer on the November 2018 earnings call)
  • Caltech -v- Apple: the Supreme Court has declined to hear an appeal of the patent case Apple & Qualcom lost to CalTech over WiFi patents, so the $1.1Bn ruling stands — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple’s machine learning head departs to run AI thinktank — appleinsider.com/… (Ali Farhadi → CEO of the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence)
  • Apple Shortcuts engineering manager Ari Weinstein departs Apple — appleinsider.com/… (No word on why or where to)
  • Beats signs up A-Cold-Wall’s Samuel Ross for new design role — appleinsider.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • My Photo Stream is closing down, Apple are directing users to iCloud Photo Library instead — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple have tweaked their iCloud pricing, with rises in many countries, including the UK, but a fall in Iceland, and no change in major markets like the US — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple TV:
    • Based on numbers from US movie & TV search engine JustWatch, Apple make the highest rated content of any US streamer — Apple TV+ produces best-reviewed content of any streaming service — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Lionel Messi Is Coming to MLS, With a Revenue Sharing Deal From Apple — daringfireball.net/… (MLS = Major League Soccer)
      • Related: You can buy ‘Ted Lasso’ AFC Richmond shirts & scarves from Nike — appleinsider.com/…
    • The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (the Oscars people) have updated the requirements for films to be eligible for best picture in an apparent attempt to freeze out streaming companies. Given Apple’s recent moves to show more of their movies in US Theatres, this may affect Apple less than others — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories (WWDC)

  1. WWDC Tidbits
    • WWDC 2023: Apple Publishes Keynote Video — www.macstories.net/…
    • The Other Keynote: Platforms State of the Union — developer.apple.com/…
    • Apple Design Awards winners revealed at WWDC 2023 — appleinsider.com/… (Apple’s Press Release)
    • App Store Review Guideline updates go after fake apps, bad ads — appleinsider.com/…
    • There was no news about services in the keynote, that came later in a press release! — www.apple.com/…
      • Apple announces new Music, Podcasts, and Maps features coming in the fall — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple Services Preview: Better Integration, Increased Customization, and Sharing Options — www.macstories.net/…
      • iOS 17 brings offline navigation to Apple Maps — www.cultofmac.com/… (including in CarPlay)
      • Apple Podcasts Adds New Subcategories and Refreshes Recommendations — www.macstories.net/…
    • Apple is adding adaptive audio to AirPods Pro — arstechnica.com (Apple’s Press Release)
    • Opinion: Apple’s biggest reveals at WWDC23 — www.cultofmac.com/…
  2. New Macs — www.macstories.net/…
    • The MacBook Air gets bigger with new 15-inch model — arstechnica.com (Apple’s Press Release)
      • Apple’s new 15-inch MacBook Air with M2 processor is 12x faster than Intel’s version — appleinsider.com/…
      • Opinion:
        • Review: Apple’s 15-inch MacBook Air says what it is and is what it says — arstechnica.com
        • 15-inch MacBook Air review: Hits the sweet spot for portability and power — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple introduces M2 Ultra — www.apple.com/… & Apple unveils new Mac Studio and brings Apple silicon to Mac Pro — www.apple.com/…

item.title: LTA 119: July 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

For various reasons, this is another solo show with just Bart. The show starts with some followups, a little regulatory and legal news, some HR news, and some highlights from Apple's services an original content. The three main stories are Apple's Q3 2023 earnings call, some App Store changes to fight cross-app-tracking via fingerprinting, and a look at where things stand with Apple & AI. Finally, the show finishes with some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in July.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta119.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • The UK joins the list of countries cranky at Apple’s Crash Detection feature’s imperfections: Apple Watch emergency calls false positives slammed by UK police chiefs — appleinsider.com/…
  • More developments with Apple Savings:
    • Those customers we mentioned having troubles withdrawing money last time seem to have been made whole: Select Apple Savings customers credited $100 after over-long withdrawal requests — appleinsider.com/…
    • The service seems to be well received: Apple users have deposited more than $10bn in its savings product — www.siliconrepublic.com/… (Apple’s Press Release: Apple Card’s Savings account by Goldman Sachs reaches over $10 billion in deposits — www.apple.com/…)
  • Apple Opens Public Betas for macOS 14 Sonoma, iOS 17, iPadOS 17, watchOS 10, tvOS 17, and HomePod Software 17 — tidbits.com/…
  • Vision OS’s launch preparations continued a-pace this month:
    • TestFlight now supports visionOS apps — appleinsider.com/…
    • Unity Launches PolySpatial Beta Program for visionOS Developers — www.macstories.net/… & Unity’s visionOS support has started to roll out—here’s how it works — arstechnica.com
    • Apple Announces visionOS App Evaluation Process, Labs, and Developer Kits — www.macstories.net/… & How developers will test their apps before Vision Pro launches — arstechnica.com
      • Devs aren’t allowed to let Apple’s Vision Pro dev kits out of their sight — arstechnica.com
    • Apple Vision Pro visionOS beta 2 seeded to developers — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple announced that it, along with Pixar, Adobe, Autodesk, and NVIDIA, have formed the Alliance for OpenUSD (AOUSD) — www.macstories.net/… (OpenUSD is a 3D scene description language developed by Pixar)
  • Apple’s Game Porting Toolkit update boosts framerates — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple expands test driver team for its ‘Apple Car’ autonomous vehicle project — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: SEC sues Apple Car exec over securities rules at former employer — appleinsider.com/… (Ulrich Kranz, for unreasonable revenue projections while he was at Canoo)
  • It’s still complicated for Apple in China:
    • Apple continue to try expand their sales in China: Apple targets China sales growth with new WeChat storefront — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple also continue to try diversify production away from China:
      • TSMC delays Arizona plant, blames US labor shortage — appleinsider.com/…
      • Foxconn plans new $500 million investment in India — appleinsider.com/…
  • It’s also still complicated for Apple in India:
    • Tata Group will become the first India-native company to build the iPhone — appleinsider.com/… (Taking over the troubled Wistron plant with its history of riots!)
    • India becomes Apple’s fifth-largest iPhone market — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Without notice, India announced new import rules effective immediately that would require Apple and others to get an import license, then quickly adds a ‘transition period’:
      • India limits iPad and Mac imports in drive to boost local manufacturing — appleinsider.com/… & Apple forced to halt MacBook, iPad imports in India — appleinsider.com/…
      • India delays iPad and Mac import limits until October 31 — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • The big tech companies, including Apple, have officially confirmed that they are Gate Keepers under the EU’s new Digital Markets Act (DMA) — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple
    • Alphabet/Google
    • Amazon
    • Meta/Facebook
    • Microsoft
    • ByteDance/TikTok
  • New EU regulations mandate user-replaceable batteries in Apple products — appleinsider.com/…
    • Analysis: iPhone is never going to get an easy battery replacement door — appleinsider.com/…
  • French competition agency starts probe into Apple’s ATT — appleinsider.com/… (App Tracking Transparency)
  • Apple threatens to kill iMessage & FaceTime in UK if controversial law passes — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Epic:
    • Judge Milan D. Smith Jr. of the 9th US Circuit Court granted Apple leave to appeal to the US Supreme Court, and stayed the Anti-steering ruling from the original judgement, but criticised Apple harshly in the process — appleinsider.com/…

    “… while the arguments in Apple’s motion may not be technically frivolous, they ignore key aspects of the panel’s reasoning and key factual findings by the district court …”

    • Apple taps U.S. Supreme Court in Epic Games legal fight — appleinsider.com/…
    • Epic asks U.S. Supreme Court to enforce lower court’s App Store order — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple -v- Optis (4G patents): A UK Court of Appeals has rejected Apple’s motion to overturn 4G patents held by Optis, there will now be a trial to determine the amount of licensing fees Apple owes. Apple have threatened to pull out of the UK if the fees are excessive — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple hit with class action lawsuit on App Store fees — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple, Amazon hit with $218 million antitrust fine in Spain — appleinsider.com/… (Over limiting sales of Apple products on Amazon to authorised resellers in an attempt to fight counterfeiting)

  • ‘Apple Music’ can’t be trademarked, says appeals court — appleinsider.com/… (Technically speaking Apple were denied a re-hearing on a narrower claim of the case they already lost — a musician has been using Apple Jazz since 1985 and his objections have now blocked the trademark registration)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple continues to fight against their employees organising:
    • CORE Apple Store union negotiations hit a wall of Apple’s design — appleinsider.com/…
    • IAM CORE files another unfair labor practice charge against Apple with NLRB — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple guts internal communication tool, crippling union organization — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple’s wireless tech R&D offices in Irvine expand again — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple names ad industry vet as new creative director — appleinsider.com/… (Graham McDonnell, has worked on brands like the NYT & Time Magazine!)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+:
    • Apple are trying out some new marketing ideas:
      • Get started watching Foundation with gorgeous first episode free on YouTube — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Lionel Messi debuts on MLS on Apple TV+ tonight, and Apple is promoting it heavily — appleinsider.com/… (Apple’s Press Release)
        • MLS Season Pass sets new viewership record highs with Messi’s debut — appleinsider.com/…
        • Related: based on numbers from the Sports Business Journal the MLS deal seems to be going well with nearly 1M subscribers — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple TV+ series to be screened on Air Canada — appleinsider.com/… (Including Ted Lasso & Severance)
    • SAG-AFTRA, the US’s main actors union is now also on strike, joining the main writer’s union the WGA. This will obviously impact Apple’s productions — appleinsider.com/…
      • Strikes halting production on ‘Silo’ and ‘Foundation’ — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple agrees to deal that will keep ‘Tehran’ filming despite actors’ strike — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple celebrates its highest number of Emmy nominations — appleinsider.com/… (54, including for Still, Ted Lasso, Bad Sisters & The Problem with Jon Stuart)
      • Apple’s Press Release
  • Apple Pay:
    • Apple Makes Tap to Pay on iPhone Available for UK Merchants — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple Pay Express Mode comes to New South Wales — appleinsider.com/… (Public transit via the Opal Network)
    • Apple Pay has finally arrived in Morocco — appleinsider.com/… (via CIH Bank, though while officially announced, there’s no clear launch date!)
  • Apple Arcade:
    • Super-cute Hello Kitty Island Adventure is latest Apple Arcade exclusive — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple Arcade adds new games, including a Sega classic — appleinsider.com/… (Samba de Amigo: Party-To-Go)

Main Stories

  1. Ho-hum Q3 2023 Earnings — www.apple.com/…
    • The key numbers:
      • Revenue: $81.8Bn ($83Bn YAG)
        • iPhone: $39.7Bn ($40.7Bn YAG)
        • Mac: $6.8Bn ($7.4Bn YAG)
        • iPad: $5.8Bn ($7.2Bn)
        • Wearables etc.: $8.3Bn ($8.1Bn YAG)
        • Services: $21.2Bn ($19.6Bn YAG)
      • Earnings per Share: $1.26 ($1.20 YAG)
    • Causes of drop:
      • ‘Tough Compare’ — new iPads & Mac year-ago-quarter, but not this quarter
      • ‘exchange rate headwinds’ — on a constant currency basis Apple actually made revenue than last year, by about 3%
    • This is Tim: Apple’s Q3 2023 analyst call, transcribed — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple Q3 2023 Charts: $81.8B revenue, down 1% — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple Q3 2023 Earnings Down 1% on Exchange Rates — tidbits.com/…
    • 1 billion subscribers push Apple’s services revenue to all-time high — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • iPhone sales are down, but Apple’s subscriptions are growing fast — arstechnica.com
    • Apple’s latest dividend: $0.24 per share on Aug. 17, 2023 — appleinsider.com/… ($0.23 YAG)
    • Related: Apple TV+ has a lot more subscribers than you might realize — www.cultofmac.com/… (Numbers from Antenna, Apple’s numbers are now on a par with the other Netflix competitors, a little ahead of Paramount+ & Max, and little behind Disney+ in the US)
    • Related: Apple’s numbers are holding up well compared to others in contracting markets:
      • IDC: Mac shipments up while PC rivals go down in Q2 2023 — appleinsider.com/… (Global shipment estimates)
      • macOS adoption rates saw a dramatic upturn in 2022 — appleinsider.com/… (based on web stats by StatCounter, 21% of desktop browsing activity, with Windows down to ‘just’ 68%)
      • Apple is still coming out on top of an incredibly bad smartphone market — appleinsider.com/… (numbers by Counterpoint Research — global market down 8% YoY, but Apple only down 2%)
      • Apple holds strong as global smartphone market keeps shrinking — appleinsider.com/… (numbers from Canalys show world-wide shipments down 10%, with Apple down by the about the same, but holding their 17% market share second to Samsung with 21%, also un-changed YoY)
    • Opinion: If this is Apple struggling, everything is going to be just fine — www.macworld.com/…
  2. More App Store changes to fight cross-app tracking without consent:
    • Apple cracks down on apps that use device fingerprinting to track users — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple will require app devs to explain exactly why they use certain APIs — arstechnica.com
  3. Apple & AI
    • Two high-profile initiatives were launched this month to add guard-rails to AI, and Apple was conspicuously absent from both:
      • The White House secured voluntary commitments from Amazon, Anthropic, Alphabet, Inflection, Meta, Microsoft & OpenAI to cooperate on AI safety — appleinsider.com/…
      • Anthropic, Google, Microsoft & OpenAI have announced the Frontier Model Forum, a new industry group to promote the “safe and responsible development” of AI models — blog.google/…
    • Apple AI in the works leads to high R&D spend — appleinsider.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Beats Studio Pro arrives with Spatial Audio, massive battery life — appleinsider.com/…
    • Beats Studio Pro review roundup: ‘Almost AirPods Max Light’ for less — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Beats Studio Pro versus AirPods Max — compared — appleinsider.com/…
  • VMWare Tech Preview 2023 has full hardware 3D acceleration — appleinsider.com/… (DirectX 11 on Windows 11 Arm on M-series Macs)
  • The App Store Turns 15 — www.macstories.net/…
    • Related: Bart’s first apps — mstdn.social/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

Emoji Meaning
A link to audio content, probably a podcast.
flag The story is particularly relevant to people living in a specific country, or, the organisation the story is about is affiliated with the government of a specific country.
A link to graphical content, probably a chart, graph, or diagram.
A link to an article behind a pay-wall.
A pinned story, i.e. one to keep an eye on that’s likely to develop into something significant in the future.

item.title: LTA 120: August 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

Bart's throat is still not up to a full-length show, so it's another solo episode. The show starts with a few followups, one notable number, some regulatory and legal news, a little HR news, and the highlights from Apple's services an original content. The three main stories are Apple's support of a Right to Repair bill, the EU officially name Apple a 'Gate Keeper', and a mysterious Chinese iPhone ban that may not be real. Finally, the show finishes with some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in August.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta120.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • The NSO Group has not gone away: Exploit that delivered Pegasus spyware patched in iOS 16.6.1 update — appleinsider.com/… & Apple patches “clickless” 0-day image processing vulnerability in iOS, macOS — arstechnica.com

  • A new advocacy group has emerged to put pressure on Apple to revive the controversial hybrid CSAM scanning proposal they were forced to drop late last year

    • Child safety advocacy group launches campaign against Apple — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Explains Pullback from CSAM Photo-Scanning — tidbits.com/…

  • Lionel Messi seems to be working out well for Apple:

    • Apple MLS Season Pass subscriptions have doubled since Lionel Messi joined Inter Miami — appleinsider.com/… (Based on reports, not released figues)
    • Apple TV+ plans to milk all it can out of Lionel Messi — appleinsider.com/… (6-part documentary announced)
    • Related: MLS Season Pass gets significantly cheaper in time for the playoffs — www.cultofmac.com/… & Apple TV+ MLS Season Pass subscription discounted to $29 — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple's push to get developers ready for next year's Vision Pro launch continues: Developers can RSVP to attend a free, in-person workshop at the Apple Developer Center — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: Demeo is one of the first “immersive” games announced for Apple Vision Pro — arstechnica.com

Notable Numbers

  • iPhone 14 Pro Max tops worldwide smartphone sales in first half of 2023 — www.cultofmac.com/… (and iPhone 14 Pro was in second place and the regular iPhone 14 in third! Numbers from Omdia)

Regulatory Rundown

  • Saudi Arabia passes law requiring USB-C charges for smartphones — appleinsider.com/…

  • It looks like the UK is backing down from it's terrible idea to basically outlaw true encryption, though not on a clear-cut way — appleinsider.com/…

    • UK tries to claim it hasn't backed down on encryption at all — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Epic -v- Apple — the Supreme Court has denied a request by Epic to enforce a lower court's anti-steering injunction while the various appears in the case are still pending — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • The Throtle-Gate nonsense is finally coming to an end in the US, with a judge rejecting complaints from two iPhone owners that were blocking the settlement Apple agreed to in 2020 — appleinsider.com/… (I stand by my opinion that calling a feature added to extend the life of an old phone anti competitive or planned obsolescence is nuts!)
  • Apple has won a case taken against it by hardware maker One-E-Way claiming Apple's cool bluetooth pairing features infringe its patents — appleinsider.com/…
  • A U.S. District Judge has dismissed an attempted class-action suit against Apple claiming the Apple Watch was racist with prejudice, ending it — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Unionisation continues in UK Apple Stores:

    • 'Overworked and unhappy' Apple Southampton store staff want to unionize — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Glasgow union reaches agreement with Apple for pay raises — appleinsider.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Arcade:

    • Sega Releases Samba de Amigo: Party-To-Go on Apple Arcade — www.macstories.net/…
    • Apple Arcade adds four games with 40 set for September updates — appleinsider.com/… (including James Bond game Cypher 007) (Apple's press release)
    • Related: 'Final Fantasy VII Ever Crisis' releases on iOS on September 7 — appleinsider.com/…

  • Music:

    • Apple Music debuts new algorithmic Discovery Station radio — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Music acquires famed classical label BIS — appleinsider.com/… & Apple buys 50-year-old record label to grow Apple Music Classical app — arstechnica.com

  • Apple TV+:

    • Apple will give 'Killers of the Flower Moon' a global release on October 20 — appleinsider.com/…
    • Severance fans get ‘8 Hour Work Day Innie Mix’ of theme song — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple TV+ unveils its first German-language show — appleinsider.com/… (Dark comedy Where's Wanda)

  • Apple Pay:

    • Apple Pay launches in Vietnam — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Pay officially launches in Chile — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple brings Tap to Pay to Netherlands businesses — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple voices official support for California SB 244 right to repair bill — appleinsider.com/… & Hell freezes over as Apple supports right-to-repair bill — arstechnica.com/…

    • Related: Apple officially endorses California's Climate Corporate Data Accountability Act — appleinsider.com/… (Companies > $1Bn revenue must report full carbon footprint)

  2. Apple is a DMA gatekeeper, but less-so than expected; iOS, the App Store, and Safari have been officially labeled as such by the European Commission, but not iMessage — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Related: Setapp plans to launch EU-only alternative iOS App Store — appleinsider.com/…

  3. Chinese Government iPhone Ban?

    • Initial reports were of a complete ban in government: China completely bans use of iPhone for government business — appleinsider.com/… (based only on 'reports', not on any kind of official policy or announcement)

    • Rumours spiralled: China widens ban on officials using iPhones but isn't enforcing it — appleinsider.com/… & China's largest wireless carrier denies rumor that it will skip iPhone 15 sales — appleinsider.com/…

    • When the government finally speaks, they say nothing clear – "products and services of any country are welcome as long as they comply with China's laws and regulations", iPhones comply, so no ban? — appleinsider.com/…

    • China government iPhone ban will have almost no effect on sales, says analyst — appleinsider.com/… (Wedbush's Dan Ives)

    • Related:

      • China tightens its grip on foreign and independent app developers — appleinsider.com/… (All App Store developers must be based in China or partner with a local publisher, and provide business details including an address)
      • Germany approves $11 billion TSMC chip factory — appleinsider.com/…
      • iPhone 15 production reportedly begins in India — www.cultofmac.com/… (If correct, would be first time production starts in China & India simultaneously)
      • Apple joins protest against India's import restrictions — appleinsider.com/… (These are the restrictions announced last month then paused until Halloween)
      • Apple asks Indian government for more manufacturing support — appleinsider.com/… (No details, but senior Apple execs were reported to have met with officials from India's finance ministry)

Quick Stories

  • New deal puts Arm tech in iPhone and Mac processors beyond 2040 — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple opens up Back to School offers to university students — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Support app update adds info about Apple Store locations — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Podcasts rolls out new data analytics dashboard for content creators — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Card earns J.D. Power's top spot for co-branded credit card with no annual fee — appleinsider.com/…

  • Lots of activity around other OSes on Apple Silicon:

    • Linux for Apple Silicon adds first conformant M1 GPU driver — appleinsider.com/…
    • CrossOver update brings EA and DirectX 12 game support to Mac — appleinsider.com/…
    • New Parallels Desktop 19 arrives with Touch ID, macOS Sonoma support — appleinsider.com/…

  • Qi2, based on Apple's MagSafe is really taking off:

    • Anker unveils new Qi2 charging accessories ahead of iPhone 15 launch — appleinsider.com/…
    • Mophie announces Qi2 chargers for office, home, and car — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: MagSafe vs. Qi2 — Everything you need to know before the iPhone 15 launch — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple sets ‘Wonderlust’ iPhone 15 event for September 12 — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • How to watch Apple's iPhone 15 announcement event — appleinsider.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

For various reasons this is another solo show with just Bart. The show starts with a few followups, some regulatory and legal news, a little HR news, and the highlights from Apple's services and original content. The two main stories are the new hardware from Apple's Wonderlust event, and the release of this year's Apple OS upgrades. Finally, the show finishes with some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in September.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta121.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • The NSO Group are still at it: Exploit that delivered Pegasus spyware patched in iOS 16.6.1 update — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple warns Russian journalists of Pegasus iPhone infections — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: NSO group are not the only shady cybersecurity firm targeting Apple: Apple patches Predator-exploited vulnerabilities for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS — www.intego.com/…

  • CA has passed the law Apple surprised everyone by supporting: Calif. passes strongest right-to-repair bill yet, requiring 7 years of parts — arstechnica.com

Regulatory Rundown

  • Apple reluctantly coming into compliance with China's most recent app store regulations:

    • Apple bows to China, starts enforcing App Store rules — appleinsider.com/… (new apps must have a license from the Chinese government, which requires local offices or partners. There is a grace period in the law for existing apps until March 2024, so Apple still have time to also enforce the new laws on existing apps)

  • South Korea threatens to fine both Google & Apple for not allowing 3rd-party payments on their app stores — appleinsider.com/…

  • The Australian senate is launching a probe: Apple, Google, Amazon face Australian big tech influence probe — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Epic:

    • Epic have filed with the US Supreme Court requesting a review of case — appleinsider.com/…
    • The next day Apple filed its own petition asking for a review of just the anti-steering part of the ruling (the small part that went against them) — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple -v- Rivos: Rivos countersues Apple over employee intimidation with restrictive agreements — appleinsider.com/… (chip start-up by former Apple employees)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • French Apple Store staff will strike as iPhone 15 goes on sale — appleinsider.com/… (pay rises Apple are offering are below inflation)
