item.title: LTA 122: October 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This is another solo show with just Bart. The show starts with a few followups, some regulatory and legal news, a little HR news, and the highlights from Apple's services and original content. The four main stories are gaming on Apple's platforms, Apple's Q4 2023 earnings call, the USB-C Apple Pencil, and the M3-based hardware from Apple's 'scary fast' event. Finally, the show finishes with some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in October.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta122.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Disagreements over Apple's Carbon Neutral claim continued in October:

    • Tim Cook brought a Danish reporter into one of their data centres for an interview: Tim Cook defends Apple against greenwashing accusation — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple's climate change efforts far exceed rivals, says environmental report — appleinsider.com/…

      • The report: Pathways to Decarbonisation (by Stand.Earth, in PDF format)

    • Apple's 'carbon neutral' claims are misleading, say [European] groups — appleinsider.com/…

  • Some of the coming later features of this year's Apple OSes arrive

    • Apple Watch double tap gesture now available with watchOS 10.1 — www.apple.com/…
    • iOS 17.1 and watchOS 10.1 are here with useful new features — www.cultofmac.com/… (Biggest change is AirDrop over the internet)

  • Apple continue to support developers to get VisionOS apps ready for the Vision Pro's launch: Apple Vision Pro labs coming to New York City and Sydney in November — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple announces nationwide support for ‘right to repair’ bill — www.cultofmac.com/… (They support a national law like the recent CA one, and will comply with the CA one nation-wide)

  • Apple Pay Later now available to all in the US — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Things remain complicated for Apple in China & India:

    • China targets iPhone-maker Foxconn with probe into tax, land use — arstechnica.com & China's Foxconn tax probe is Taiwan election interference, claims candidate — appleinsider.com/…
    • India clears Apple, others after import imbroglio — appleinsider.com/…
    • Ta-ta, Wistron: Indian iPhone operations go local — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple sends iPhone threat alerts to India opposition politicians — appleinsider.com/…

 

Regulatory Rundown

  • India's antitrust regulator investigating Apple's & Google's business practices — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple objects to Australia plan to regulate Apple Pay — appleinsider.com/… (Regulators want to treat ApplePay as if it were a credit card, which makes no sense)
  • Apple defends IAP against Japanese government App Store report — appleinsider.com/…
  • The European Commission has ruled that the Digital Markets Act will cover Safari as a Gatekeeper, rejecting Apple's argument that it has three different browsers, not one, so it doesn't meet the threshold — appleinsider.com/… (This argument was patently ridiculous, and the ruling quotes Apple's own marketing: "Same Safari. Different device." — oops!)

Legal Latest

  • Caltech -v- Apple & Broadcom: this case has ended with an undisclosed settlement — appleinsider.com/…
  • Masimo -v- Apple: the US ITC (International Trade Commission) has found that Apple breaches Masimo's patents, and if nothing happens in the mean time, they would be banned from import into the US on December 26th — appleinsider.com/… & arstechnica.com/… (Presidents can theoretically overrule ITC rulings, but it rarely happens)
  • BatteryGate rises again: UK tribunal gives $2B iPhone battery lawsuit the go-ahead — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple's corporate reshuffle includes many VP promotions — appleinsider.com/…

    • Tracey Hannelly → VP of retail engagement and marketing, Karen Rasmussen → VP of online retail, and Vanessa Trigub → VP of retail operations (all reporting to head of retail Deirdre O'Brien)
    • Jeremy Sandmel → VP of graphics software technologies, and David Biderman → VP of audio and media software technologies (both reporting to SVP Craig Federighi)
    • Harry Guo → VP of video engineering (reports to Myra Haggerty who reports to Johny Srouji)
    • Rob Hardy -> VP of product operations, and Vashist Vasanthakumar → VP manufacturing design
    • Donny Nordhues → VP of hardware engineering (replacing Yannick Bertolus who's retiring)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Prices Increase for Apple TV+, Apple Arcade, Apple News+, and Apple One — tidbits.com/…

    • Related: Apple quietly kills off Siri-only Apple Music Voice Plan — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple TV+

    • 'The Problem With Jon Stewart' canceled after two seasons on Apple TV+ — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple TV+ has a big holiday lineup featuring 'Frog and Toad,' 'Charlie Brown Classics,' and more — appleinsider.com/…

    • Ted Lasso‘s Hannah Waddingham glams it up for Apple TV+ holiday special — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Related: 3 Ted Lasso cast members become Barbie dolls — www.cultofmac.com/… (Ted, Rebecca & Keely)

    • Apple lands 27 Children's & Family Emmy Award nominations — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Pay: iPhone Tap to Pay comes to Ukraine — appleinsider.com/…

  • Related: YouTube Music adds HomePod integration to its iOS app — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Games seem to be a big focus for Apple ATM:

    • Valve kills CS:GO on macOS, won't launch Mac Counter-Strike 2 either — appleinsider.com/…

    • 'Star Trek: Infinite' grand galactic strategy game lands on Mac — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple Arcade adds hit 'Dreamlight Valley', and more in November — appleinsider.com/… (Apple's Press Release)

      • Knotwords+ (Zach Gage): November 3
      • Football Manager 2024 Touch (SEGA & Sports Interactive): November 6
      • Downwell+ (Devolver Digital): November 17
      • Delicious - Miracle of Life+ (GameHouse): November 24
      • Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition (Gameloft): December 5
      • Sonic Dream Team (SEGA): December 5
      • Puzzle & Dragons Story (GungHo Online Entertainment): December 5
      • Turmoil+ (Gamious): December 5

    • Full version of Resident Evil Village launches for iPhone 15 Pro and iPad — www.cultofmac.com/…

  2. Apple's Q4 2023 Earnings Call — www.apple.com/…

    • Apple Q4 2023 financial results and charts — sixcolors.com/…
    • This is Tim: Apple Q4 2023 analyst call transcript — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple suffers fourth consecutive quarter of declining sales, beat Wall Street anyway — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple's full-year results drop for the first time since 2019 — appleinsider.com/…
    • Once again, neither Mac nor iPad sales grew in Apple’s latest earnings report — arstechnica.com
    • Apple Reports Record Q4 2023 Profits Despite 1% Revenue Drop — tidbits.com/…
    • Tim Cook highlights all-time record for Apple Services & quarterly best iPhone sales — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple paying out $0.24 per share Q4 dividend on November 16 — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple expects strong Mac growth but wearable deceleration in the holiday quarter — appleinsider.com/…
    • Analysis: Analyst Analysis: Q4 2023 was OK, Q1 2024 could be surprisingly good — appleinsider.com/…

  3. Apple announces new Apple Pencil with magnetic storage and USB-C port — sixcolors.com/… (Apple's Press Release)

    • Ultimate showdown: New Apple Pencil USB-C vs old Apple Pencils — appleinsider.com/… (Both existing pencils remain in the line, so things get confusing)

  4. Apple's 'Scary Fast' Halloween-eve Media Event

    • Apple's October 2023 Scary Fast Event: Replay Today's Keynote — www.macstories.net/…

      • If even the short event is too long: Watch Apple’s ‘Scary Fast’ event in just 90 seconds — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Apple's October 2023 Scary Fast Event: By the Numbers — www.macstories.net/…

    • Apple's October 2023 Scary Fast Event: All The Small Things — www.macstories.net/…

    • 3 new CPUs; M3, M3 Pro & M3 Max — www.apple.com/…

      • Apple M3, M3 Pro and M3 Max boost Mac performance up to 50% — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • First M3 benchmarks show big speed improvements over M2 — appleinsider.com/…

    • Updated 24" iMacs — www.apple.com/…

      • Apple’s M3 iMac still starts at $1,299, still doesn’t replace the 27-inch model — arstechnica.com

    • Updated MacBook Pros — www.apple.com/…

      • New 14-inch & 16-inch MacBook Pro sport M3, and come in black — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple’s cheaper 14-inch MacBook Pro is killing the old 13-inch version — arstechnica.com
      • RIP Touch Bar — Apple sends the 13-inch MacBook Pro to the grave — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple released a 'Behind the Scenes' video showing how the entire event was shot on iPhone — www.apple.com/…

Quick Stories

  • BMW’s wireless charging will screw up your iPhone 15 — www.cultofmac.com/… (Also affects some Toyota models, software patch on the way)
  • [Shazam Introduces Dedicated In-App Concerts Section](https://www.macstories.net/news/shazam-introduces-dedicated-in-app-concerts-section/)
  • Apple extends return policy through early January for holiday shoppers — appleinsider.com/…

Legend

item.title: LTA 123: November 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This is another solo show with just Bart. The show starts with a few followups, some regulatory and legal news, a little HR news, and the highlights from Apple's services and original content. The three main stories are RCS coming to iMessage, an apparent parting of the ways between Apple and Goldman Sachs, and Apple's end-of-year awards and charts. Finally, the show finishes with some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in October.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta123.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Followup from Halloween Media Event:

    • Apple released a Behind the Scenes press release and video showing how the entire media event was shot on iPhones and edited on Macs — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple confirms that there is no Apple Silicon 27-inch iMac in the works — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple gave CNBC access to one of their chip testing labs in CA, and access to Apple engineers — www.cnbc.com/…

  • Followup on Apple's Q4 2023 Earnings:

    • A witness in the DOJ's anti-trust case against Google accidentally revealed that Apple get 36% of search revenue generated through Safari, this must make up a significant part of Apple's soaring Services revenue, and might not be sustainable — arstechnica.com/…
    • That 36% cut Apple gets of Google's revenue is apparently 3x what typical Android OEMs get — arstechnica.com/…

  • The AppleTV Zoom app promised at WWDC has arrived — appleinsider.com/…

  • The final Qi2 wireless charging spec has been approved, devices are expected to launch very quickly — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • The drive to regulate Apple Pay as if it was a credit card itself continues in multiple countries:

    • Having flagged its intention to do so last month, the government has published a bill to regulate Apple Pay, Google Pay, and more — macdailynews.com/…
    • The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) has announced its intentions to regulate 17 firms including Apple for their digital wallets and pay-later services (no details yet) — appleinsider.com/…

  • In it's latest 10-k filing to the US Securities & Exchange Commission (SEC) Apple seem to accept the inevitability of 3rd-party app stores in Europe — appleinsider.com/…

    "The Company expects to make further business changes in the future, including as a result of legislative initiatives impacting the App Store, such as the [EU] Digital Markets Act, which the Company is required to comply with by March 2024"

    • Apple has not quite given up though: Apple files legal challenge over Europe's demand for third-party app stores — appleinsider.com/…

  • Japan to require companies like Apple to pay taxes in place of developers — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple may face $600 million tax demand from India — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • The EU Commission's epic case against the arrangements between Apple and Irish Tax Authorities appears to be far from over — the Advocate General reviewing the Commission's appeal has found "significant legal errors", an is recommending that the EU's General Court review the case, his advice is not binding, but usually followed, so expect to hear more about this nearly decade-old case in 2024 — appleinsider.com/…
  • London's Court of Appeals has overturned a ruling blocking the UK Competition & Markets Authority's (CMA) investigation into the effect of Apple & Goole's mobile market dominance on cloud gaming on a technicality. The investigation remains on hold for now because Apple has a right to appeal — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple joins other major tech companies in filing an appeal against Maryland's Digital Advertising Tax, and are asking for all the tax paid back — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple illegally denied benefits to union workers, says US labor board — appleinsider.com/… (Unionised workers in Towson store in Maryland denied new benefits announced for other staff)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Arcade: Apple Arcade's 'Hello Kitty Island Adventure' nominated for best mobile game at The Game Awards — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Music:

    • Apple Music users can now save TikTok songs directly to playlists — appleinsider.com/…
    • Your PS5 can get you free Apple Music subscription — www.cultofmac.com/… (Free 6 month trial for new and existing customers)

  • Apple TV:

    • Just in time for the holidays, Apple have released their first Peanuts movie: Snoopy and Charlie Brown embark on a big city adventure in new Peanuts film for Apple TV+ — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple's Michael J. Fox film tops Critics Choice Documentary Awards — appleinsider.com/… (won all 5 categories it was nominated in: Best Biographical Documentary, Best Documentary Feature, Best Narration for Michael J. Fox, Best Director for Davis Guggenheim & Best Editing for Michael Harte)

    • Apple TV app adds 3D movies ahead of Vision Pro release — appleinsider.com/…

      • Related: Spatial Video shot on iPhone for Apple Vision Pro previewed for a select few — appleinsider.com/… (John Gruber's experience)

  • Apple Pay: Tap to Pay on iPhone starts taking payments in France — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple Will Add RCS Support on iOS in 2024 — appleinsider.com/…

    • RCS will be augmenting SMS & MMS, so it will bring better 'green bubbles', not end them — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple's flavor of RCS won't support Google's end-to-end encryption extension — appleinsider.com/…
    • Opinion: John Gruber's Analysis of the News
    • Related earlier news: The FT reports that Google joined forces with some large EU carriers to send a letter to the European Commissioner for Internal Markets asking that Apple be forced to open up iMessage — appleinsider.com/… (Not and open letter)

  2. Confusion reigns over the future of Apple's unhappy relationship with Goldman Sachs with reports that Apple have offered to end the contract early, in about a year, and their statement when asked for comment said basically nothing nothing — appleinsider.com/…

    "Apple and Goldman Sachs are focused on providing an incredible experience for our customers to help them lead healthier financial lives. The award-winning Apple Card has seen a great reception from consumers, and we will continue to innovate and deliver the best tools and services for them"

    • Related Rumour: Legendary Apple leaker Mark Gurman suggests Chase are in the running to replace Goldman Sachs — appleinsider.com/…

  3. Apple doles out many end-of-year awards & charts:

    • Music:

      • Apple Music Artist of the Year for 2023: Taylor Swift — www.cultofmac.com/… & Apple Music to host event honoring Taylor Swift as its 2023 Artist of the Year — appleinsider.com/… (Apple's Press Release)
      • Apple also reminded us that we can listen back to our own top music of 2023 in Apple Music Replay: How to find your music stats with Apple Music Replay 2023 — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Apps:

      • Apple Announces Close to 40 App Store Awards Finalists — www.macstories.net/… (Apple's Press Release)

      • Apple reveals 2023 App Store Award winners, highlights AI as the year's biggest trend — appleinsider.com/… (Apple's Press Release)

        AllTrails nurtures community through comprehensive trail guides and outdoor exploration for everyone. Prêt-à-Makeup offers a true-to-life makeup sketchpad on iPad for professional artists and casual users, while fostering inclusivity and self-expression. Photomator’s machine learning-powered tools make advanced editing tasks streamlined and seamless. MUBI curates exceptional indie films and international documentaries with a human touch, and SmartGym shines on Apple Watch with its comprehensive library of exercises, routines, and robust fitness reporting.

        …

        In the gaming category, Honkai: Star Rail takes players through a narrative full of complex characters and tactically rich combat on iPhone, while Lost in Play invites players to tap into a charming, childlike imagination during an epic point-and-click adventure. Lies of P presents players with an exquisitely crafted dark fantasy world, and Apple Arcade’s Hello Kitty Island Adventure delivers an immersive gaming world with its main goal being as sweet as can be: making friends.

    • Podcasts & Books: Apple releases 2023 top charts for Podcasts, Apple Books — appleinsider.com/… (Apple's Press Release)

Quick Stories

  • Apple have launched the 2024 Swift Student Challenge, and 50 kids will earn trips to WWDC — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple Music Classical finally comes to the iPad — appleinsider.com/… (But it's still not available on the Mac, not even as an iPad app on M-series Macs )

  • Final Cut Pro November update incoming with improved navigation, ML Object Tracker — appleinsider.com/… (Apple's Press Release)

  • Apple have extended the free initial trial of SOS via Satellite by 1 year for iPhone 15 owners — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple and other tech companies launch Aliro, a new standard for smart locks that aims to bring and interoperability and security baseline to this developing market — appleinsider.com/… (or as Apple Inside put it "Aliro aims to be the Matter of smart locks")

  • Apple & Amkor have announced that Amkor will build a chip packaging foundry close to TSMC's Arizona factory, simplifying the manufacturing of Apple Silicon chips in the US (and creating 2,000 jobs) — appleinsider.com/… & arstechnica.com/… (a big problem for the TSMC plant was not having chip packaging available nearby)

    • Related: iPhone maker Foxconn plans extra $1.54 billion plant in India — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple gives guidance online for shipping ‘holidays gifts, just in time’ — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Related: Apple donating $1 to (RED) for all Apple Store purchases made with Apple Pay through December 8 — appleinsider.com/… (Too late now, but Apple also donated proceeds from some games to Product RED — appleinsider.com/…)

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.title: LTA 124: December 2023
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This solo show starts with a few followups, some regulatory and legal news, a little HR news, and the highlights from Apple's services and original content. The four main stories are Push Notification spying, the Beeper Mini saga, the US import ban on Apple Watches, and the Operation Triangulation iPhone hacks. Finally, the show finishes with some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in December.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta124.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple wasn't quite done with end-of-year lists/awards:

    • 'Wiser Than Me with Julia Louis-Dreyfus' is Apple's podcast of the year — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple highlights the 2023 top App Store apps and games — appleinsider.com/… (Apple's Press Release)

  • Features promised at WWDC continue to arrive:

    • Apple Releases iOS and iPadOS 17.2 with Journal App, Messages and Music Improvements, and More — www.macstories.net/… (Apple's Press Release for the Journal App)

      • How to start journaling with the new iPhone Journal app — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • VPN apps come to the Apple TV:

      • ExpressVPN brings its VPN app to the Apple TV — appleinsider.com/…
      • NordVPN releases app for Apple TVs running tvOS 17 — appleinsider.com/…

    • A promised fix is delivered: iPhone Users Will No Longer Face Wireless Charging Issues on Cars After iOS 17.2 Update — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Related: other un-pre-announced improvements arrive too:

      • Apple releases tvOS 17.2 with 3D movies and better system navigation — appleinsider.com/… (Apple's Press Release for the tvOS re-design
      • iPhones 15 Pro can now record spatial video for the up-coming Apple Vision Pro headset — www.apple.com/…

  • Apple beefs up Self Service Repair with new diagnostic, extended to iPhone 15 & M2 Mac — appleinsider.com/… (Apple's Press Release)

    • You can now access Apple’s official diagnostics tool online for DIY repairs — arstechnica.com

  • Apple's gaming push continues:

    • Sonic Dream Team races onto Apple Arcade — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Unity 6 announced with AI tools, plus Apple & Meta partnerships — appleinsider.com/… (Vision Pro support)
    • 'Resident Evil 4' now available on iPhone 15 Pro, iPad, & Mac — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple is pushing hard to make the Mac relevant in gaming — appleinsider.com/… (Mac execs made the case for how transformative Apple Silicon is for Mac gaming in a recent in-depth interview)

  • Apple continues to quietly work away on AI:

    • Apple demonstrates its commitment to AI with new open source code release — appleinsider.com/… (MLX, an ML framework for Apple Silicon)
    • Apple wants AI to run directly on its hardware instead of in the cloud — arstechnica.com (Published Research Paper)
    • Apple's 'Ferret' is a new open-source machine learning model — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple offers publishers millions to train AI on archives — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple continues to diversify its supply chain, and it remains complicated:

    • Apple isn't happy about India's demand to upgrade older iPhones with USB-C — appleinsider.com/… (Unlike EU, India wants Apple to back-port USB-C into older models)
    • Apple gets backlash from India after uncovering hacks on journalists — appleinsider.com/…
    • Rising star Luxshare secures major stake in Pegatron's iPhone factory — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple's iPad development moves from China to Vietnam — appleinsider.com/…
    • Foxconn pours another $1 billion into India expansion — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • European Commission grills Apple and Google on app store risks and ad practices — appleinsider.com/… (DSA implementation)
  • UK regulator prepares to restart Apple cloud gaming probe in January — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple and Corellium settle legal dispute over virtualized iPhone software — appleinsider.com/… (Terms not known)
  • Apple settles Family Sharing lawsuit with $25 million fund — appleinsider.com/… (claim was: "Apple misrepresented to users their ability to use Family Sharing to share subscriptions to certain apps with other members of their Family Sharing groups.")

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple's war on unions continues:

    • Apple refuses to recognize Southampton store union, staff pushes forward anyway — appleinsider.com/…
    • Barcelona Apple Store union will strike on December 23 — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple executive behind Touch ID, display multitouch is retiring — appleinsider.com/… (Steve Hotelling)

  • Tang Tan, Apple's VP of Product Design is leaving Apple to join Jony Ives' design firm LoveFrom to work with OpenAI on some kind of AI device — arstechnica.com/… & www.bloomberg.com/…

    • Related Insight: "More designers from Ive’s team at Apple now work at LoveFrom than remain at Apple" (John Gruber) — daringfireball.net/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+: Apple TV+ pulls five wins at the Children's and Family Emmy Awards — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple News+: Apple adds The Athletic to News+, Wirecutter coming soon — sixcolors.com/…
  • Porsche and Aston Martin preview gorgeous next-gen Apple CarPlay — www.cultofmac.com/…

Main Stories

  1. US Senator Ron Wyden reveals that both Apple & Google have been forced to silently participate in an entire type of spying we were not aware of — Push Notification Metadata

    • US senator: Govts spy on Apple, Google users via mobile notifications — www.bleepingcomputer.com/…
    • Apple admits to secretly giving governments push notification data — arstechnica.com/…
    • Apple Requires Only a Subpoena to Turn Over Push Notification Tokens to Law Enforcement; Google Requires a Court Order — daringfireball.net/…
    • Apple Updates Law Enforcement Guidelines to Require a Judge's Approval Before Handing Over Push Notification Records — daringfireball.net/…

  2. Beeper Mini briefly allowed Android users to access the iMessage infrastructure, a brief cat-and-mouse game ensued, and Apple won

    • Beeper Mini for Android sends and receives iMessages, no Mac server required — arstechnica.com/…
    • Android iMessage app Beeper mini isn't working, and Apple probably killed it — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple confirms it blocked Beeper Mini citing security risks — appleinsider.com/…
    • Beeper Mini developers say fix is 'coming soon' for iMessage Android app — appleinsider.com/…
    • Beeper Mini for Android lives again, but for how long is anybody's guess — appleinsider.com/…
    • Beeper Mini is down for 5% of users, but there's a fix — appleinsider.com/…
    • The slow death of Beeper continues, and more senators want to get involved — appleinsider.com/…
    • Not dead yet: Beeper Mini's new fix requires Mac access — appleinsider.com/…
    • Beeper has more ridiculous work-arounds for its iMessage bridge hack — forums.appleinsider.com/… (Requires jail-broke old iPhone, and Beeper say this is their last roll of the dice)
    • DOJ antitrust lawyers question Beeper over Apple's iMessage hack — appleinsider.com/…
    • Opinion: Beep Beep — daringfireball.net/…

  3. Apple's long-running patent dispute with Masimo over the blood oxygen monitor in recent Apple Watches came to a head in December — the sales ban warned about in November actually happened, for a while, and is now stayed rather than resolved:

    • Apple working on a software fix to prevent Apple Watch import ban — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple 'pausing' Apple Watch sales in US over patent dispute — www.cultofmac.com/… & Apple Watches being pulled from stores this week due to potential import ban — arstechnica.com
    • Masimo open to an Apple Watch settlement, if Apple would only call — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple's legal bid to pause Apple Watch sales & import ban fails — appleinsider.com/… (Appeal to ITC)
    • Apple won't offer Apple Watch service replacements on out of warranty devices — appleinsider.com/… (during import ban)
    • Apple halts sales of the Apple Watch Series 9, Apple Watch Ultra 2 in its online store ahead of Dec 25 ban — appleinsider.com/…
    • Biden administration confirms it won’t overturn Apple Watch ban — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • United States Apple Watch import ban has begun with no resolution in sight — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple appeals Apple Watch ban, citing 'irreparable harm' to its business — appleinsider.com/… (Appeal to US Circuit Court of Appeals)
    • Appeals court pauses ban on patent-infringing Apple Watch imports — arstechnica.com & Apple Watch Series 9 and Ultra 2 returning to select Apple Stores today, online tomorrow — 9to5mac.com/…
    • Apple still pursuing software fix to avoid Apple Watch import ban altogether — appleinsider.com/…
    • Masimo has spent $100M in Apple Watch patent infringement fight — appleinsider.com/…

  4. The highly sophisticated and carefully targeted 4-year Operation Triangulation hacking campaign:

    • 4-year campaign backdoored iPhones using possibly the most advanced exploit ever — arstechnica.com/…

      "Researchers on Wednesday presented intriguing new findings surrounding an attack that over four years backdoored dozens if not thousands of iPhones, many of which belonged to employees of Moscow-based security firm Kaspersky. Chief among the discoveries: the unknown attackers were able to achieve an unprecedented level of access by exploiting a vulnerability in an undocumented hardware feature that few if anyone outside of Apple and chip suppliers such as ARM Holdings knew of"

      …

      "the infections were delivered in iMessage texts that installed malware through a complex exploit chain without requiring the receiver to take any action"

      …

      "The exploit’s sophistication and the feature’s obscurity suggest the attackers had advanced technical capabilities"

    • The detailed report from Kaspersky Labs — securelist.com/…

      "Our guess is that this unknown hardware feature was most likely intended to be used for debugging or testing purposes by Apple engineers or the factory, or that it was included by mistake"

Quick Stories

  • Apple selling a standalone second-generation AirPod Pro USB-C case for $99 — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple pilots new way to allow developers to offer discounted subscriptions — appleinsider.com/… (Developers can offer discounts on one subscription to users who have another subscription)
  • PETA names Apple as the 2023 Company of the Year — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Podcasts comes to Teslas — appleinsider.com/…

Legend

item.title: LTA 125: January 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This marathon solo show starts with a few followups, some regulatory and legal news, some HR news, and the highlights from Apple's services and original content. The four main stories are Apple's Q1 2024 earnings, Apple's Cantankerous Compliance in the US & EU, the Mac at 40, and the launch of the Vision Pro in the US. Finally, this epic show finishes with some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in January.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta125.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple extends 5G modem deal with Qualcomm until 2027 — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Beeper Mini users find Macs banned from iMessage network — appleinsider.com/… & Apple is restoring Mac users that were banned after using Beeper on iPhone — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Savings Card interest rate jumps again — 5 Jan Apple Savings APY increases from 4.25% to 4.35% — appleinsider.com/… & 27 Jan Apple Card Savings interest rate shoots up again, now at 4.5% — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple's import ban battle with MASIMO rumbled on with quiet a few twists and turns, but the important change is that the stay on the ban was lifted, so Apple were forced to remove the blood oxygen app from newly imported Series 9 & Ultra 2 Apple Watches to keep them on the market, and that will remain the case while the litigation continues — arstechnica.com/…

    • Apple won't license Masimo's patents despite Apple Watch import ban — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple Watch blood oxygen detection used to save son's life at 14,000 feet — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • EU hits international big tech with new wave of user safety effort data requests — appleinsider.com/… (Questions regarding how the companies are safeguarding children, elections, and more. These questions are part of the on-going implementation of the Digital Services Act, DSA, not to be confused with the Digital Markets Act, DMA, discussed in detail in the main stories!)

Legal Latest

  • Apple finally settles iPhone 7 'loop disease' class action suit — appleinsider.com/… (iPhone 7 & iPhone 7 Plus with payouts of between $50 & $349)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Children's programming takes a hit as Apple TV+ lays off eight staffers — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple’s reorganization efforts within Siri team leading to layoffs — www.cultofmac.com/… (SanDiego office closing, staff can move to TX or take redundancy)

  • Apple finance executive departs to become CFO at Sonos — appleinsider.com/… (Saori Casey ♀)

  • 20-year veteran Apple VP of Engineering departs — www.cultofmac.com/… (VP of Engineering DJ Novotney ⚦ → Rivian)

  • Changes on Apple's Board:

    • Apple Board of Directors shuffle sees Al Gore & James Bell retire — appleinsider.com/…
    • Wanda Austin to join Apple’s board of directors — www.apple.com/…

  • Tim Cook's pay drops to $63 million for 2023 — appleinsider.com/… (Base salary un-changed at $3M, stock options reduced from previous year at Cook's own request)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Fitness+ launches new workouts and meditation for 2024 — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Music enhances music parties with collaborative playlists — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Music Classical will soon expand into Japan, China, Korea, and more — appleinsider.com/… ( Japan, China, Korea, Hong Kong, Macau & Taiwan)

  • AppleTV+

    • Major League Soccer returns to MLS Season Pass on the Apple TV app — www.apple.com/…

    • Awards season is in full swing again:

      • 'Still: A Michael J. Fox Movie' wins four Emmy Awards — appleinsider.com/… (including 'Outstanding Documentary or Nonfiction Special')
      • Apple nabs four Creative Arts Emmys in first ceremony — appleinsider.com/… — 2x Ted Lasso (including Ed Sheeran), Five Days at Memorial & Black Bird)
      • 'Black Bird' scores Apple TV+ it's sole major Emmy award — appleinsider.com/… (Paul Walter Hauser for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie)
      • 'Killers of the Flower Moon' lands single Golden Globe award for Apple — appleinsider.com/… (Lily Gladstone for 'Best Performance by a Female Actor — Motion Picture, Drama')
      • Apple TV+ falls flat at Critics Choice Awards — appleinsider.com/… (16 nominations, but just 1 win — Best Supporting Actor in a Drama Series for Billy Crudup in The Morning Show)
      • 'Killers of the Flower Moon' takes Best Picture at AARP Movies for Grownups awards — appleinsider.com/… (Association for the Advancement of Retired Persons)
      • Apple scores record 13 Academy Award nominations, as culture-moving feature Killers of the Flower Moon lands 10 historic nominations for Best Picture, Best Actress for Lily Gladstone, and Best Director for Martin Scorsese — www.apple.com/… (10 for Killers of the Flower Moon & 3 for Napoleon)

    • Related: Killers of the Flower Moon earns spot as most popular film on streaming — www.cultofmac.com/… (from ReelGood's top-ten)

Main Stories

  1. Apple's Q1 2024 Earnings Call — www.apple.com/…

    • This is Tim: Full transcript of Apple’s Q1 2024 analyst call — sixcolors.com/…

    • Apple reports nearly $120B quarter: Full charts — sixcolors.com/…

    • Apple Reports Quarterly Revenue of $119.6 Billion for Q1 2024 — www.macstories.net/…

    • Strong iPhone sales power Apple back to revenue growth — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Related: Apple overtakes Samsung in global smartphone shipments across 2023 — appleinsider.com/…

    • iPhone up, China down: 7 nuggets from Apple’s earnings call — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Apple R&D spending flat for the first time in over a decade — sort of — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple has one active device per four people on the planet — appleinsider.com/… (2.2Bn)

    • Cook 'incredibly excited' about generative AI coming to Apple gear later in 2024 — appleinsider.com/…

  2. Cantankerous Compliance ("bad-tempered, argumentative, and uncooperative")

    • SCOTUS declines to hear the Apple -v- Epic case, so the lower court's rulings stand — www.cultofmac.com/… & appleinsider.com/…

      • Post-SCOTUS Ruling, Apple Releases Guidelines for 'External Purchase Links' in iOS Apps (Spoiler: They Still Demand the Same Commissions) — daringfireball.net/… & Apple lets devs use alternate in-app payment options, still takes commissions — arstechnica.com

        • End of so-called anti-steering rule in the US App Store
        • US Developers can apply for a StoreKit External Purchase Link Entitlement
        • Apps must also offer IAP and still have to follow all Apple's rules
        • Developers still have to pay Apple a commission of 27% or 12% (3% less than normal)

      • Apple bills Epic Games $73 million in legal costs — appleinsider.com/…

      • It seems unlikely this is the end of the matter as Epic is definitely not happy: What's Next for Apple and Epic's Legal Disputes? — www.macstories.net/…

      • Epic says that Apple isn't doing enough to comply with US App Store court orders — appleinsider.com/…

      • Spotify Attacks Apple's 'Outrageous' 27 Percent Commission From External Links — daringfireball.net/…

      • Analysis: Coming to Grips With Apple’s Seemingly Unshakable Sense of Entitlement to Its Commissions From Third-Party iOS Apps — daringfireball.net/…

    • Apple has made some world-wide changes to coincide with it's EU-only changes to comply with the DMA (more on that later!)

      • Apps can now get an entitlement to stream games or other mini-apps within a master app, and can even charge for the child apps via IAP — sixcolors.com/…
      • Developers will get more detailed reports from the App Store

    • Ahead of the Digital Markets Act (DMA) coming into force in March, Apple have detailed how it will comply with big changes coming with iOS 17.4

      • Lead up:

        • EU anti-trust commissioner Margrethe Vestager met with Tim Cook in Apple HQ on 11 Jan — appleinsider.com/…
        • Apple insists to EU antitrust regulators that it runs five App Stores, not one — appleinsider.com/…

      • Apple is enhancing reports about what it knows about EU users in iOS 17.4 — appleinsider.com/… (EU users get more info about their App Store activity and can export it for sharing with 3rd-party app stores)

      • Apple Pay NFC hardware getting opened up to EU financial and banking app developers — appleinsider.com/… (and have provided a mechanism for EU devs to request access to other restricted hardware features)

      • Browsers like Chrome and Firefox can abandon WebKit in EU with iOS 17.4 — appleinsider.com/…

        • There will be a browser ballot on first-launch of Safari, similar to what Microsoft were required to do with Internet Explorer many years ago — www.macstories.net/…
        • Which browsers can be set to default for EU users in iOS 17.4 — appleinsider.com/…

      • 3rd-party app stores are coming within the EU — www.apple.com/…

        • Key points

          • Developers can choose to stay on the existing terms

          • Developers can opt into new EU-terms, within the App Store, within 3rd-party app stores, or both

            • Devs who stay within the App Store will pay lower traditional fees (17% & 10%)
            • All devs will pay a Core Technology Fee regardless of where they sell their app, the feel is currently €0.50 per install per user per year — registered non-profits and government agencies get the fee waived, and regular developers get it waived on the first 1M installs per user per year, with the exception of apps that are app stores
            • 3rd party app stores will be apps distributed via the App Store, and there are rules for acceptance into the App Store
            • All app will get notarised, and apps will be required to continue to abide by the OS's APIs (including ATT), use of private APIs is prohibited, as are attempts to break out of the app sandbox
            • Content moderation of apps in 3rd-party stores is 100% the responsibility of the App Store operator, and Apple's notarisation process will not cover that
            • Compliance is absolutely minimal, with 3rd-party app stores being for iOS only (not iPadOS, watchOS, or tvOS), and confined to the EU (Apple's new App Store rules apply to these 27 countries — appleinsider.com/…)

        • Apple is offering confused Developers 30 minute consultations — appleinsider.com/… (Apple have also provided a fee calculator)

        • Apple's TestFlight system will remain open to all EU developers — appleinsider.com/…

        • The EU's Internal Markets Commissioner Thierry Breton has warned that 'strong action' is coming if the EU find Apple's plans for compliance are insufficient — appleinsider.com/… (the EU will start evaluating the various compliance efforts by all the designated 'Gate Keepers' when the law goes into effect in March)

        • Good Summaries/Explainers:

          • Best short summary: The EU Forces Open Apple’s Walled Garden — tidbits.com/…
          • Apple Details How It Plans to Comply with the EU's Digital Markets Act — www.macstories.net/…
          • Apple has new App Store rules, business terms, and sideloading conditions for EU developers — appleinsider.com/…

        • Analysis & Opinion:

          • Who should stay on and who should leave the EU App Store — appleinsider.com/…

          • Apple changes App Store rules in the EU, and the world watches — sixcolors.com/…

          • John Gruber's takes: Apple’s Plans for the DMA in the European Union — daringfireball.net/… & Two Additional Observations Regarding Apple's Core Technology Fee — daringfireball.net/…

          • Understanding Apple's Response to the DMA — www.macstories.net/… ("A DMA-Shaped Response")

          • Wall St. doesn't seem spooked by the changes: Apple to see little impact from EU regulations, says investing firm — appleinsider.com/… (J.P. Morgan)

          • Cult of Mac interviewed AltStore developer Riley Testut, and he was very happy with the changes — appleinsider.com/…

          • There has been strong criticism from those you would expect — www.cultofmac.com/…

            • Spotify had pre-announced that they would be making alternative payment methods available once the DMA forced Apple to allow it, then, when Apple revealed the details their CEO reacted very angrily and seemed to row back from the earlier promise — appleinsider.com/… & appleinsider.com/…
            • Epic's Tim Sweeney is mad about Apple's EU App Store concessions — appleinsider.com/…
            • Meta joins list of companies that disapprove of Apple's DMA response — appleinsider.com/…
            • Microsoft latest to weigh in on Apple's EU App Store rules with disapproval — appleinsider.com/…

  3. The Mac turns 40!

    • The Computer History Museum hosted a three-panel event moderated by David Pogue — Insanely Great: The Apple Mac at 40 — www.youtube.com/…
    • Apple execs praise 'unbelievable' 40 years of Macs — appleinsider.com/…
    • New website showcases high-quality photos of every Mac released — www.cultofmac.com/… (mac40th.com](https://mac40th.com/))
    • Forty years of the Mac, the computer for the rest of us — appleinsider.com/…
    • Look back in time at Apple's original Mac development team — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Shares the Secret of Why the 40-Year-Old Mac Still Rules — www.wired.com/…
    • Apple Macintosh Turns 40: A look back at 10 important milestones in the Mac's history — www.intego.com/…
    • A wild and wooly take on the history of Macintosh computers — www.cultofmac.com/…

  4. Vision Pro Launches in the US for $3,499 — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple Releases a Guided Tour of Vision Pro and Shares a Making Of Video — www.macstories.net/… & Get to know Apple Vision Pro with Apple's new video guides — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple Vision Pro is Available for Walk-In Demos Starting Today — www.macobserver.com/… & Skip the Apple Vision Pro demo queues, soon you'll be able to book a slot — appleinsider.com/…

    • The practical details are revealed:

      • What you need to order Apple Vision Pro from the Apple Store online — appleinsider.com/…

      • Apple Vision Pro storage and AppleCare prices revealed — appleinsider.com/… ($3,499 → $3,899 for 256G → 1TB)

      • What comes in the $3499 Apple Vision Pro box — appleinsider.com/…

      • Prescription lenses for Apple Vision Pro are cheaper than expected — appleinsider.com/… ($99 or $149)

        • Related: How Apple Vision Pro deals with Monovision — and what vision problems it can't deal with — appleinsider.com/…

      • Apple Vision Pro has 16GB of memory, potentially 1TB of storage — appleinsider.com/…

      • Apple Vision Pro screen refresh rate is up to 100Hz, it has Bluetooth 5.3, and more technical details — appleinsider.com/…

      • Damaged Apple Vision Pro repairs cost up to $2,399 — appleinsider.com/…

        • Related: Apple Vision Pro is surprisingly durable in first YouTube drop test — appleinsider.com/… — "This is actually stupidly durable" (repeated drops from ceiling height eventually broke the outer glass screen, but the device continued to function normally!)

      • If your Apple Vision Pro gets stolen, Find My won't help you get it back — appleinsider.com/…

    • There are a lot of native apps & dedicated media on launch day, some notable absences, including companies that have explicitly prevented their iPad app from working on Vision OS — appleinsider.com/… & appleinsider.com/…

      • Apple Details Vision Pro's Launch Day Entertainment Options — www.macstories.net/… & Apple Vision Pro immersive titles have begun showing up in Apple TV app ahead of launch — appleinsider.com/…
      • All the Disney+ 3D movies you can watch on Vision Pro — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Explore the Starship Enterprise with Apple Vision Pro — appleinsider.com/…
      • Cool Vision Pro apps, concepts and experiences available on day one — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • More than 600 new spatial apps and games await Vision Pro — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Microsoft 365 apps will be available on Apple Vision Pro at launch — appleinsider.com/…
      • The best Apple Vision Pro productivity apps at launch — appleinsider.com/…
      • A Survey of Popular Apps Currently Compatible With Apple Vision Pro — www.macstories.net/…
      • Not just Adobe Lightroom, but also Adobe Firefly AI are coming to VisionOS — appleinsider.com/…
      • Netflix CEO says Apple Vision Pro market is too insignificant to bother with — appleinsider.com/… & Netflix says use Safari on Apple Vision Pro, because you aren't getting an app — appleinsider.com/…
      • YouTube and Spotify also won't offer any apps on Apple Vision Pro — appleinsider.com/…
      • There is an Apple Vision Pro YouTube viewer app, but it isn't from Google — appleinsider.com/…
      • Related: Unity adds Apple Vision Pro support for all game developers — appleinsider.com/…

    • There are also hardware accessories already, both from Apple & third parties — appleinsider.com/…

      • Belkin will sell Apple Vision Pro battery clip in time for launch — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple have released a special USB-C enabled strap for developers, allowing a permanent connection to a Mac while developing — www.macstories.net/… (it's not cheap at $299!)

    • Reviews, reactions, and opinions:

      • Apple Vision Pro: What you need to know beyond the spec sheet and before you buy — appleinsider.com/…
      • Vision Pro review roundup: ‘Magic’ and ‘a revolution,’ but definitely unfinished — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Apple Vision Pro review roundup: an experience that weighs on you — appleinsider.com/…
      • What Reviewers Have Learned about Apple Vision Pro — www.macstories.net/…
      • John Gruber's review — daringfireball.net/…
      • Joanna Stern's WSJ video review — www.youtube.com/…

Quick Stories

  • iOS 17.3 includes a new Stolen Device Protection feature intended to protect from the spike in iPhone thefts were the attackers first steal or social engineer the passcode before steeling the phone and then using the passcode to change the Apple ID password, disable FindMy & lock users out of their data for ever — appleinsider.com/… (I think it's wise to enable it, and so does Adam Angst at Tidbits)
  • Apple unveils 2024 Black Unity Collection supporting grantees that inspire resilience and creativity — www.apple.com/… & Vibrant new Apple Watch band and face celebrate Black unity — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Now Shazam can name songs even when you wear headphones — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Windows 11 ARM officially supported by M3 Macs running Parallels Desktop — appleinsider.com/…

Legend

item.title: LTA 126: February 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This marathon solo show starts with a lot followups, including Apple Vision Pro & DMA developments. Next we have some legal stories, just two HR stories, and a few highlights from Apple's services and original content. The four main stories are a €1.8Bn fine from the European Commission, the end of Apple's car project, Apple's new Sports app, and a big encryption upgrade for iMessage. Finally, the show finishes with a rundown of some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in February including an M3 MacBook Air and updates to Apple's Windows apps.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta126.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Vision Pro

    • Apple released a detailed description of how visionOS protects users' privacy — appleinsider.com/… (PDF of Apple's Document)

    • Some notably app developments:

      • Looks like YouTube will make an Apple Vision Pro app after all — appleinsider.com/…
      • Webex for Apple Vision Pro officially launches with Persona support — appleinsider.com/…
      • Roblox sees Apple Vision Pro as 'an interesting candidate' for expansion — appleinsider.com/…

    • Vision Pro Teardown Reveals Japan as Leading Parts Supplier — www.macobserver.com/…

  • The Digital Markets Act (DMA) is now in effect and we know a little more about Apple's (still cantankerous) compliance, which is now live — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple’s iMessage is not a “core platform” in EU, so it can stay walled off — arstechnica.com

    • Apple released a document detailing the reasons behind their DMA compliance approach — appleinsider.com/… (PDF of Apple's Document)

    • We now know what the browser selection screen looks like — www.theverge.com/…

    • Apple sneakily got its way on Progressive Web Apps — initially they blocked them because the DMA required Apple to allow any browser engine, and that would make security impossible, everyone lost their minds, so Apple brought them back as Webkit only and everyone but Apple is claiming victory — arstechnica.com/…

    • How iOS Is Determining Eligibility for Alternative App Marketplaces in the European Union — daringfireball.net/…

      • Third-party App Stores will only work for 30 days if you leave the EU — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple updates rules surrounding EU DMA compliance to address developer concerns — appleinsider.com/…

      • No more €1M credit note
      • A one-time-only escape hatch from the new rules and their core platform fee if your app unexpectedly reaches 1M downloads

    • Apple have released their first compliance report: www.apple.com/…

      • It includes some future plans: Apple Wants to Make It “User-Friendly” to Switch From iPhone to Android — www.macobserver.com/… (by 'fall 2025' )

    • Setapp announces beta of iOS app store for the EU — appleinsider.com/…

    • After initially approving a developer account for Epic's Swedish subsidiary, and after Epic announcing an EU-only 3rd-party App Store, Apple killed the account

      • 'Fortnite' will return to the iPhone, but only in the EU — appleinsider.com/…
      • 'Verifiably untrustworthy' Epic Games iOS app store plans in EU killed by Apple — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple's explanation — www.apple.com/…
      • EU tells Apple to justify its blocking of Epic Games — appleinsider.com/…
      • EU DMA architect says Apple seems to want to be fined for non-compliance — appleinsider.com/… (German MEP Andreas Schwab)
      • Apple relents, reinstates Epic Games developer account — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Opinion: John Gruber's takes: Before reversal — daringfireball.net/… & After Reversal — daringfireball.net/…

  • Following on from Tim Cook's teasing of big AI annoucements later in the year during last month's earnings call, there have been some more minor AI developments since:

    • Together with researchers in the University of California, Apple have released an AI image editing model (image + prompt → new image) named MGIE for MLLM-Guided Image Editing — appleinsider.com/… & www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple has built a new generative AI tool for animating images — appleinsider.com/… ('Keyframer', image + prompt → video)
    • Whipsmart: Apple buys 32 AI startups in 2023 — www.cultofmac.com/… (report by Statista)
    • Apple joins Meta, Google, Facebook on new US government AI safety initiative — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Battery Gate is not quite finished yet: Apple to pay $14.4M to settle Canadian 'Batterygate' lawsuit — appleinsider.com/…
  • A win for Apple Watch this month: Apple beats antitrust lawsuit from AliveCor — appleinsider.com/… (ruling by a District Judge, so could be appealed)
  • Apple -v- VirnetX is finally over as the US Supreme Court refuses to hear VirnetX's appear of the overturning of their original win against Apple — appleinsider.com/… (TL;DR, Apple won in the end)
  • Apple sues US Patent Office over augmented reality trademarks — appleinsider.com/… ('Reality Composer' & 'Reality Converter')

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Another member of Jony Ive's core design team departs Apple after 32 years — appleinsider.com/… (Bart Andre)
  • Industrial unrest continues: Hundreds strike at Apple supplier Flex's plant in India — appleinsider.com/… (pay, conditions, and union recognition)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+

    • Content:

      • Apple TV+ snags critically acclaimed Sundance film starring Lily Gladstone — appleinsider.com/… ('Fancy Dance')
      • Watch 51 classic movies for free on Apple TV+ — appleinsider.com/…
      • “Friday Night Baseball” returns to Apple TV+ on March 29 — www.apple.com/…

    • Awards:

      • Apple TV+ 'Lessons in Chemistry' wins at DGA Awards — appleinsider.com/… (Directors Guild of America)
      • 'Killers of the Flower Moon' snags one SAG Award for Apple TV+ — appleinsider.com/… (Screen Actors Guild awarded Best Actress to Lily Gladstone)

    • Related: Netflix ends subscriptions for legacy in-app payment users — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Music

    • Apple Music Replay Updated with Monthly Listening Statistics — www.macstories.net/…
    • Apple Music Debuts Heavy Rotation, A New Daily Made For You Playlist — www.macstories.net/…

  • ApplePay & Apple Card

    • Apple Cash can now be used as a credit card — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple Pay Later loans now appear on your credit report — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple Card, Savings data now available in more third-party budget apps — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: PayPal brings Tap to Pay on iPhone support for its business users — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. The European Commission Fines Apple Over €1.8 Billion — www.macstories.net/…

    • The root cause is Apple's anti-steering rules which prevented music services like Spotify from letting users know they could subscribe cheaper on their website than via in-app-purchase
    • Apple blames Spotify for $1.95 billion fine over "abusive" App store rules — www.bleepingcomputer.com/… (Apple's full response)

  2. After a decade of stops and starts, Apple kills its electric car project — arstechnica.com/…

    • Opinion: How indecision and hubris killed the Apple car — www.cultofmac.com/…

  3. Apple Launches Free Sports App in the US, UK, and Canada — www.macstories.net/…

    • Apple Sports: A free iPhone app to get you the score, fast — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple brings live scores to new Apple Sports app — appleinsider.com/…
    • Hands on: Apple Sports brings a limited experience to tracking your favorite teams — appleinsider.com/…
    • Opinion & Analysis: John Gruber's thoughts on Apple Sporst — daringfireball.net/…

  4. Apple have released PQ3, a major update to iMessage encryption to make it 'Quantum Safe' — security.apple.com/…

    • Apple is hardening iMessage encryption now to protect it from a threat that doesn't exist yet — appleinsider.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple's Self Service Repair expanding to M3 Macs — appleinsider.com/… & Apple expands Self Service Repair for Mac, adds Diagnostics, and updates System Configuration — www.apple.com/…

  • Apple says the iPhone 15 battery is more durable than it originally thought — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple update all their OSes:

    • visionOS 1.1 tries to make Personas less unsettling, plus other Apple OS updates — arstechnica.com
    • iOS 17.4 and iPadOS 17.4 Add Podcast Transcripts, Fix Zero-Day Vulnerabilities — tidbits.com/… (Apple's Press Release about Podcast Transcripts)
    • macOS Sonoma 14.4 now available with podcast captions and new emoji — appleinsider.com/…
    • Migration Assistant gets updated for macOS Sonoma — appleinsider.com/…

  • The MacBook Air gets updated: M3 Processor, Wifi 6E & support for two external displays — appleinsider.com/… & arstechnica.com/… (Apple's Press Release)

    • Early benchmarks show M3 chip gives MacBook Air hefty performance boost — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Opinion: 2024 MacBook Air review roundup: Serious performance boost — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Related: Research from CIRP finds that 90% of Macs sold are now laptops — appleinsider.com/…

  • Select iPhones, Apple Watches Have Slightly Higher Trade-in Values at Apple Now — www.macobserver.com/…

  • The death of iTunes continues with a big update for Apple's Windows apps — www.macstories.net/…

    • Updated version of iCloud for Windows
    • Stand-alone Apple Music, Apple TV, and Apple Devices apps get their first production releases (they had been marked as 'preview')

  • Apple Releases New Spring Colors for iPhone Cases and Watch Bands — www.macstories.net/…

  • No real news out of this year's annual shareholders meeting: Everything went Apple's way at the annual shareholders meeting — appleinsider.com/…
