item.title: LTA 127: March 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This solo show starts with some followups from last month before diving into just a few regulatory and legal stories, some HR and acquisitions news, and a few highlights from Apple's services and original content. The three main stories are the Digital Markets Act (again), the US DOJ's Anti-Trust case against Apple, and some VisionPro Developments. The show finishes with a rundown of some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in March.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta127.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple walks away empty handed at the Oscars — appleinsider.com/… (13 nominations, 10 for Killers of the Flower Moon & 3 for Napoleon)

  • More AI Developments:

    • Apple acquires fundamental AI smarts by buying DarwinAI — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple AI research: ReALM is smaller, faster than GPT-4 when parsing contextual data — appleinsider.com/…
    • Reuters are reporting that Apple has paid Shutterstock somewhere between $25M & $50M for access to millions of photos and videos for AI training — www.cultofmac.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • Oregon governor signs nation’s first right-to-repair bill that bans parts pairing — arstechnica.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Epic: Epic wants Apple held in contempt of court for not following through on removing anti-steering measures — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple speaks out against Epic's contempt of court accusation — appleinsider.com/… (Apple insist they are in compliance and quoted their compliance statement to the court, and the original court ruling to support their POV)

  • With the US Epic-v-Apple case officially over, the case in Australia has been un-paused, and merged with Epic's case against Google in that country (and the court expects it to last months) — appleinsider.com/…

  • Masimo -v- Apple: Apple made their case to the US Court of Appeals requesting that the US International Trade Commission (ITS) ruling against it be overturned on two grounds (listed below), Masimo now get to submit a rebuttal before the court will rule — appleinsider.com/…

    1. Because Masimo didn't actually have a product, just a CAD drawing, the ITC over-stepped their authority
    2. The patents the ITC based their decision on are fundamentally flawed, and were updated by Masimo after the Apple Watch was released in an attempt to "ensnare" Apple's real product

  • Share Holders -v- Apple: Apple have agreed to settle a long-running shareholder lawsuit that claimed Tim Cook mislead investors in Apple's last earnings call in 2018, which led up to a very rare revision of expected revenue in January 2019 – the crux was Cook down-playing problems in the Chinese market in 2018 before blaming those problems for the revision in 2019. The settlement is reported to be $490M, which Apple Insider point out is less than 1 day's earnings (or $61M per word!) — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple lays off 600 employees, mostly from Apple Car project — appleinsider.com/… or Apple’s First Post-Pandemic Layoffs Affect Over 700 Workers — www.macobserver.com/…
  • The Browser Company poaches Apple Safari design team member — appleinsider.com/… (Charlie Deets, apparently one of Safari's two lead designers)
  • Apple's newest hire is another step towards ads in Apple TV+ — appleinsider.com/… (NBCUniversal ad exec Joseph Cady)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Arcade's April additions include two with Apple Vision Pro support — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple TV+ teams up with Lionel Messi for one-month free trial of MLS Season Pass — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Savings gets first ever interest rate cut — appleinsider.com/…
  • Stripe adds Apple Pay Later as a default option for merchants — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  • Probably related to main story 1 or 2 or both: Apple amends its App Review Guidelines world-wide to allow Mini apps, mini games, streaming games, chatbots, plug-ins, and some game emulators — www.macstories.net/…

    "Apps may offer certain software that is not embedded in the binary, specifically HTML5 mini apps and mini games, streaming games, chatbots, and plug-ins. Additionally, retro game console emulator apps can offer to download games"

    • There are a lot of restrictions on the games that can be offered by emulators, including a requirement that the full catalogue of all available games be published at a URL, and depending on interpretation, perhaps only the owners of the original games can offer them in emulation. Users running their own ROMs does not seem to fit the current guidelines — arstechnica.com/…

  1. Apple and the European Commission continue their back-and-forth over the Digital Markets Act (DMA)

    • Apple reversed their revocation of Epic Games' Swedish developer account — daringfireball.net/…

      • Following Apple's reversal, Epic announced it will be opening an EU store with a 12% revenue share with Epic — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Apple continues to loosen restrictions on its EU App Store — sixcolors.com/…

      • Single-vendor app stores will be permitted after all

      • The templates for external payment links are now optional

      • Large developers in good standing (2 years on the App Store & 1M downloads in previous year) will be permitted to distribute apps directly from their websites without any App Store (apps will still need notarisation, so not true side-loading)

        • The feature has appeared in the iOS 17.5 beta — appleinsider.com/…

    • The EU held a public 'workshop' where all parties could air their opinions on Apple's compliance, or lack there of, with the commission and Apple – Apple defended their position, but did admit something needs to be done about the possibility of a viral app bankrupting a small developer because of the Core Platform Fee — appleinsider.com/…

    • A few days after the workshop the EU officially launched violation investigations into Apple, Google & Meta: appleinsider.com/…, sixcolors.com/… & arstechnica.com/…

      • Full text of the complaints — ec.europa.eu/…

      • The Commissions Concerns Regarding Apple:

        • Is Apple's new European fee structure in compliance with the DMA?
        • Has Apple sufficiently loosened their anti-steering rules in Europe?
        • Is Apple's browser choice screen good enough?
        • Does Apple allow enough apps to be un-installed?

    • Related: Following the EC's massive €1.84Bn fine last month over anticompetitive practices in streaming music, Apple have added an entitlement to the App Store to allow Music streaming services in Europe to link out to their website for payments, and even to ask for email addresses to contact users directly (but as with similar payment processing opt-outs, Apple still expect a 27% cut of the revenue) — www.reuters.com/…

      • There are reports the EU are not happy that this change is sufficient, and are investigating, but there has been no official announcement (yet?) — appleinsider.com/…

  2. The US DOJ joins the fray! — sues Apple for Anti-trust

    • US DOJ attacks nearly every aspect of Apple's business in massive antitrust suit — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple CarPlay is anticompetitive, too, US lawsuit alleges — www.theverge.com/…

    • Apple responds to DOJ antitrust lawsuit by refuting every claim — appleinsider.com/…

    • The DOJ's 5 Headline Allegations:

      1. Apple does not allow Super Apps in the App Store
      2. Apple unfairly limits game-streaming services
      3. Apple unfairly denies 3rd-party messaging apps access to SMS
      4. Apple unfairly diminishes the functionality of non-Apple smart watches
      5. Apple unfairly limits digital wallets

    • The case has been brought under the Sherman Antitrust Act of 1890(!!!), which doesn't actually define what a monopoly is, but case law in different courts falls in a range mostly between 70% & 80% with one case saying it might be possible for there to be a monopoly from as low as 55% in some cases.

      • Apple's current share of units in the US is about 64%, and it's world-wide unit share is about 23%
      • The DOJ's case states Apple's market provenance not in unit sales as has been the case in all previous suits, but in revenue share, which puts Apple at 65%
      • The DOJ go further than flipping to a novel measure, and invent a new market 'performance smartphones', and they say Apple has a 70% share of this market

    • Analysis: Understanding the DOJ's Antitrust Complaint Against Apple — www.macstories.net/…

    • Opinion:

      • Gruber's critique of AG Garland's remarks regarding wallets (it shows the DOJ just do not understand how electronic payments work), and market share (they're seriously reaching) — daringfireball.net/…
      • U.S. versus Apple: A first reaction — sixcolors.com/…
      • Apple will crush the DoJ in court if Garland sticks with outdated arguments — appleinsider.com/…
      • Why the DOJ’s antitrust lawsuit against Apple is weak — www.cultofmac.com/…

  3. Some notable Apple Vision Pro/visionOS Developments

    • VisionOS gets a nice update with Spatial Personas — sixcolors.com/…

      • In FaceTime users can now break out of their frames, and share a 3D space with each other
      • With SharePlay, participants can share a single 3D space with each other, and enjoy content, or, work on a shared document or thing
      • The personas also look a lot better than their did in version 1.0 of the feature

    • Other AR/VR platforms are coming on board with VisionOS

      • NVIDIA's shared VR environment technology is coming to Apple Vision Pro — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple Vision Pro gains Niantic tech to open up more AR experiences — appleinsider.com/…

    • The Apple Vision Pro is on its way to China soon(ish)?

      • Tim Cook says China will get Apple Vision Pro later in 2024 — appleinsider.com/…
      • China’s Tencent throws its massive weight behind Vision Pro — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Related: there's still one hurdle in Apple's way though: Apple’s Vision Pro Trademark Headache in China Isn’t Going Anywhere — www.macobserver.com/… (Huawei own the Chinese trademark for 'Vision Pro', and they don't seem at all interested in giving it up, and Apple's application for a trademark on 'Apple Vision Pro' is still under review)

Quick Stories

  • Some nice updates to Apple's website:

    • Apple now has a good landing page to find manuals, specs, and downloads — appleinsider.com/…
    • New Apple Website Helps You Find out Why You Should Upgrade Your iPhone — www.macobserver.com/…

  • iWork 14 brings useful tweaks to Pages, Numbers and Keynote — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple Quietly Adds 15W Qi2 Wireless Charging Support to iPhone 12 — www.macobserver.com/…

  • WWDC 2024 Scheduled for June 10–14 — tidbits.com/… (Apple's Press Release)

    • New ‘Apple Developer’ YouTube Channel Debuts Ahead of WWDC 2024 — www.macobserver.com/…
    • 350 Swift Student Challenge winners awarded AirPods Max, chance to attend WWDC — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Apple has a new Swift tutorials webpage for budding developers — appleinsider.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.title: LTA 128: April 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This solo show starts with some followups from last month before diving into just a few regulatory and legal stories, some HR and acquisitions news, and a few highlights from Apple's services and original content. The three main stories are some nice changes to how Apple will facilitate repairs, the arrival of vintage game emulators on iOS, and Apple's Q2 2024 earnings call. The show finishes with a rundown of some other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in April.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta128.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • The buzz around Apple & AI continues:

    • Apple’s Ferret-UI helps AI use your iPhone — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple releases eight small AI language models aimed at on-device use — arstechnica.com
    • Apple has bought a French firm to help get AI processing on the iPhone — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple has poached dozens of Google AI experts for its Zurich lab — appleinsider.com/…

  • The work to diversify Apple's supply chain continues:

    • Apple Now Assembles 1 in 7 of iPhones in India, Numbers Only To Increase — www.macobserver.com/…
    • TSMC will build third Arizona fab after winning $6.6B in CHIPS funding — arstechnica.com
    • Tim Cook promises Indonesia that Apple will consider manufacturing there — appleinsider.com/…
    • Tim Cook visits Singapore as Apple invests in a $250 million AI campus expansion — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple's complex relationship with China continues: Apple Forced to Pull WhatsApp and Threads from China App Store — www.macobserver.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • The Digital Markets Act (DMA) continues to drive Apple news:

    • Beta versions of iOS 17.5 include support for website-based app distribution in the EU, so we can now see how it works, developers are cranky at the amount of warnings screens users see, and one security researcher warns that it may inadvertently expose EU iOS users to cross-site tracking — appleinsider.com/…, www.macobserver.com/… & www.mysk.blog/…

    • The European Commission has ruled that because it is depended on by enough business users, iPadOS does fall under the DMA after all, giving Apple 6 months to comply, which Apple have confirmed they will do — www.macobserver.com/… & www.macstories.net/…

    • Apple announced their promised changes to the controversial Core Technology Fee (CTF) that applies to developers who opt for Apple's EU-only iOS app store terms — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Zero-profit developers like hobbyists and charities are now completely exempted — it's not about the app, it's about the developer, and if you make money by putting ads in your apps you are definitely not zero-profit (this addresses the 'my kid made a great app that went viral and now I own Apple a small fortune' problem)
      • Small developers (<€10M annual revenue) get an on-ramp to the CTF via a three-year exemption, and if they poke over the €10M mark within those three years, the CTF is called at €1M

    • Reporting by Reuters and others suggests the iOS browser choice screen mandated by the DMA may be having an effect, users seem to be choosing privacy-focused browsers, and Opera is reporting 63% growth — arstechnica.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…

    • The first third-party app store in the EU goes live with the launch of Riley Testut's AltStore PAL — appleinsider.com/… & rileytestut.com/…

  • The European Central Bank has sent and open letter to the European Commission arguing that Apple's proposed changes to address anti-trust concerns are not sufficient to facilitate its plans for the Digital Euro — appleinsider.com/…

  • The EU's long-in-progress right to repair directive has finally passed, now each of the 27 member states must implement specific laws to implement it in their own nations — appleinsider.com/… (for the most part it looks like all Apple will have to do to comply is offer what they currently sell as AppleCare+ as their standard warranty within the EU)

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Epic: Apple have responded to the suit Epic filed last month alleging Apple is not complying with the anti-steering ruling Epic managed to win against it, they insist they are in full compliance with the court's order — appleinsider.com/…
  • “Batterygate” Strikes Again: Canadian Users Could Receive $150 From Apple — www.macobserver.com/…
  • The UK's Competition Appeal Tribunal has denied Apple's request to have a class action suit on behalf of developers alleging Apple's app store fees are anticompetitive dismissed, so the case will proceed — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Unionisation Efforts Continue: New Jersey Apple Store files to unionize — appleinsider.com/… (to date, 5 stores in the US have filed to unionise, 2 have completed the process)
  • Apple bids farewell to Frank Casanova after pivotal 36-year tenure — appleinsider.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+:

    • Apple TV+ bags big British awards for Slow Horses and Silo — www.cultofmac.com/… (4 BAFTA Television Craft Awards, Slow Horses for editing & sound, and Silo for production design & original music)
    • Related: More than 60 IHG hotels in North America now have AirPlay-compatible TVs in-room — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple expands its repair options — www.apple.com/…

    • Apple will allow reuse of iPhone parts for repairs, with a notable catch — arstechnica.com

      • Starting with new iPhones 'this fall'
      • Biometric sensors can be re-used
      • Calibration can happen on-device
      • No need to enter serial numbers when ordering replacement parts (other than main logic board)
      • The device's parts history screen will show users what parts have been replaced and what their provenance is
      • Parts from devices marked as stolen will be blocked from working by activation lock, so this change won't create a new opportunity for phone thieves

    • Apple hardware chief John Ternus insists parts pairing is not evil — appleinsider.com/…

  2. After last month's App Store rules change, emulators for vintage games consoles start arriving on iOS:

    • Things get off to a rocky start with the very first emulator being a short-lived ad-riddled knockoff of Riley Testut's GBA4iOS — appleinsider.com/…

    • Things don't go much better for the second emulator, this time the app is legitimate, but the developer gets cold feet and pulls their NES emulator 'out of fear', presumably about being sued by Nintendo — First NES emulator for iPhone approved by Apple but pulled by developer — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Third time would appear to be a charm, with Riley Testut's Delta emulator being the first to launch and stay launched — www.macstories.net/… (distribution in the EU is exclusively through the AltStore!)

      • Later in the month we learned Delta is coming to the iPad too — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Related: How to Load Your Game Boy Games Onto the iPhone to Play in the Delta Emulator — www.macstories.net/…

    • Provenance plans to bring Sony & Sega console emulation to the App Store — appleinsider.com/…

    • Any many more … Retro gold rush: these emulators are coming to the App Store soon — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: Why a GameCube/Wii emulator may not be possible on the iOS App Store — arstechnica.com/… (App Store rules ban Just in-time Compilation, AKA JIT)

  3. Apple's Q2 2024 Earnings Call — www.apple.com/…

    • Investor Highlights:

      • Quarterly Revenue of $90.8Bn, down 4% YoY (Apple had guided that there would be a substantial revenue drop, so not a 'miss')
      • $23.6Bn quarterly profit
      • Quarterly earnings per diluted share of $1.53
      • Dividend of $0.25, up 4%
      • $110Bn stock buy-back

    • Product Highlights:

      • iPad revenue of $5.6Bn down 17% YoY to lowest level in 4 years

      • iPhone revenue of $46Bn, down 10% YoY (as expected by analysts)

        • Related: iPhone sales drop 10% as Samsung steadies and Chinese rivals grow — appleinsider.com/… (world-wide Q1 2024 from IDC)
        • Related: Apple's iPhone skid in China continues, with another big hit to start 2024 — appleinsider.com/… & After Losing the Top Spot Internationally, iPhone Sales Drop by 1/5th in China, Worst Since COVID — www.macobserver.com/… (Counterpoint Research comparing Q1 2023 sales revenue in China to Q1 2024, down 19%)
        • Related: New iPhone activations hit a six-year low in the US — www.cultofmac.com/… (US carrier activations for Q1 from CIRP, down to 33% from 40% YaQ)

      • Wearables etc. revenue of $7.9Bn, down 10% YoY

      • Mac revenue of $7.5Bn, up 4% YoY

      • Services revenue of $23.9Bn, up 14% YoY

    • The usual excellent graphs from Jason Snell — sixcolors.com/…

    • Transcript of Tim Cook's comments — sixcolors.com/…

      • Apple Vision Pro a big hit in enterprise — appleinsider.com/… (over half of Fortune 500 companies have purchased some)
      • Apple CEO Tim Cook bullish on China, thinking long-term — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple believes in ‘transformative power and promise of AI’ — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Analysis:

      • Apple blows away Wall Street earnings estimates, even with weak China iPhone sales — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple charms investors with record $110B stock buyback, dividend hike — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple’s Q2 2024 earnings reveal a drop in iPhone, iPad sales — arstechnica.com

Quick Stories

  • Apple's program for notifying victims of state-level attacks has expanded to include victims of grey-market spyware apps, or as Apple calls them 'mercenary spyware', and users in 92 countries have received such warnings from Apple — techcrunch.com/…

    • Beware: scammers have started to send fake versions of these notifications — www.intego.com/…

  • Apple has released three new sets of headphones under its Beats brand:

    • Beats Solo 4 headphones review: Great audio quality and features — appleinsider.com/…
    • New Beats Solo Buds offers budget-friendly audio in a tiny case — appleinsider.com/…
    • Beats launches new Beats Fit Pro edition in collaboration with Alo Yoga — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Store’s ‘Shop with a Specialist over Video’ Now Available on iPhone — www.macobserver.com/… (was web-only feature, still US-only )

  • Apple Watch is FDA's first-ever approved digital AFib history device — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple uses Earth Day to release it's latest environmental report and highlight some environmental progress — www.apple.com/… (PDF download)

    • Apple ramps up investment in clean energy and water around the world — www.apple.com/… (now 18GW of clean electricity, up 3x since 2020, and 12Bn gallons fresh water saved last year)
    • Apple cuts greenhouse gas emissions in half — www.apple.com/… (over 55% reduction since 2015)

  • Apple Announces May 7th Let Loose Event — www.macstories.net/… (based on the art work, it seems obvious this is an iPad-centric event)

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.title: LTA 129: May 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This solo show starts with some followups from last month before diving into just a few regulatory and legal stories, some HR and acquisitions news, and a few highlights from Apple's services and original content. The three main stories are some impressive up-coming accessibility features, Apple's "Let Loose" iPad event, and Microsoft's new Copilot+ PCs. The show finishes with a rundown of a few other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in May.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta129.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Evidence in Epic Games' complaint that Apple is not complying with the one small part of it’s US case against the company has revealed that just 0.1% of developers are choosing to use Apple’s new 3rd-party payment option in the US — www.macobserver.com/… (Also, Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers seems sceptical about Apple’s motives, which might probe problematic as the case evolves)
  • The Vision Pro continues to make ripples:
    • Marvel’s ‘What If…? - an Immersive Story’ coming to Apple Vision Pro on May 30 — appleinsider.com/…
      • Review: “What If?” shows off the Vision Pro’s strengths — sixcolors.com/…
    • Three VR game staples have arrived on Apple Vision Pro — appleinsider.com/… (Job Simulator, its follow-up Vacation Simulator, and tabletop survival RPG Demeo)
    • Apple Vision Pro earns prestigious Black Pencil design award — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple’s 2024 Design Awards have a new Spatial Computing category — appleinsider.com/…
  • The rise of the retro game emulators continues:
    • Original PlayStation games come to iPhone with new Gamma emulator — appleinsider.com/…
    • App Store emulator surge continues, this time for PlayStation Portable games — appleinsider.com/… (PPSSPP)
    • This new app on the App Store emulates 38 different retro game platforms — appleinsider.com/… (RetroArch)
      • RetroArch emulator adds support for DOS games, and more — appleinsider.com/…
      • RetroArch has also been released for Apple TV — arstechnica.com/…
      • But it seems more powerful emulators won’t follow RetroArch onto Apple TV: Apple TV hardware storage limits will keep most emulators away — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • The UK passes its version of the EU’s Digital Markets Act — www.engadget.com/… (broadly similar, but named the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Bill, AKA DMCC)
  • Apple fires back at DOJ antitrust case, calls for immediate dismissal — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple takes EU to court over $2 billion Apple Music fine — appleinsider.com/…
  • fallout from the Digital Markets Act (DMA) continues:
    • The Spotify-led trade group Digital Music Europe has written to the European Commission alleging that Apple is not complying with the Digital Markets Act (DMA) — appleinsider.com/… (somewhat ironically the group claims to be in favour of ‘light touch regulation’!)
    • First alternative to Apple Wallet is ready to launch in EU — appleinsider.com/… (UK firm Curve says it’s ready to go once Apple’s promised APIs arrive)
    • iOS 17.5 puts direct app distribution via the web live — appleinsider.com/…
  • Related: Apple have released their latest App Store transparency report, touting the sheer volume of abuse they have stopped: App Store stopped over $7 billion in potentially fraudulent transactions in four years — www.apple.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple gets another App Store antitrust win, this time in China — appleinsider.com/… (a single developer sued Apple & lost)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple Retail in the US remains hostile to unions to the point of illegality:
    • US Labor Board rules Apple illegally interrogated retail staff in NYC — appleinsider.com/…
    • Maryland Apple Store employees to vote on strike, citing unmet demands — appleinsider.com/… (Towson Apple Store)
      • New video highlights ongoing struggles between Apple and union members — appleinsider.com/…
    • NJ Short Hills Apple Store votes down unionization effort — appleinsider.com/…
  • Head of Apple TV+ marketing Ricky Strauss is leaving — appleinsider.com/… (Only at Apple since January 2023, previously at Disney & Hulu)
  • Apple loses another designer who worked in Jony Ive’s core team — appleinsider.com/… (Duncan Kerr, with Apple since 1999. Likely simply aging out rather than some kind of problem, but notable that very few of the original Ive dream-team now remain)
  • Apple’s new diversity exec hails from Bank of America — appleinsider.com/… (Cynthia Bowman)
  • A notable job advert: Apple Seeks Android Engineers to Finally Bring Apple TV+ on Androids — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Announces New and Updated Apple Arcade Games Coming in May and June — www.macstories.net/… (including VisionPro games for the first time!)
  • Apple Music:
    • Apple Music Adds Shazam Radio Spins Charts and a New Industry Program — www.macstories.net/… (Playlist based on what the global top 200 radio stations are playing)
    • Apple Music 100 best albums countdown completes: 1 to 100 — www.cultofmac.com/… (Apple Press Release)
  • Apple Pay:
    • Merchants in Japan can finally use Tap to Pay for iPhone — appleinsider.com/…
    • Canadian firms finally get Tap to Pay on iPhone — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Rolls out Support for Paris Transit Passes in Wallet Just in Time for the Olympics — www.macstories.net/… (Apple Press Release)

Main Stories

  1. Apple Marks Global Accessibility Awareness Day with a Preview of OS Features Coming Later This Year — www.macstories.net/… (Apple Press Release)
    • Eye Tracking to move focus without the need for extra hardware
    • Vocal Shortcuts
    • Music haptics
    • Vision pro live captioning (add subtitles to the real world!)
    • Apple Announces New Feature to Combat Motion Sickness on Moving Vehicles — www.macobserver.com/…
  2. Apple’s ‘Let Loose’ Event
    • Apple’s May 2024 Let Loose Event: Replay Today’s Keynote — www.macstories.net/…
    • Watch Apple’s ‘Let Loose’ event in just 90 seconds — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple’s May 2024 Let Loose Event: By the Numbers — www.macstories.net/… (All the specs gathered together by John Voorhees)
    • New iPads
      • iPad Air gets a faster processor and a supersized 13-inch option — appleinsider.com/… (Apple Press Release)
        • Industrial design looks like previous generation iPad Pros
        • Apple’s new M2 iPad Air has a nine-core GPU, despite original claims to the contrary — appleinsider.com/…
        • iFixit’s Teardown Video Offers an Inside Peek at the New 13-Inch iPad Air — www.macobserver.com/…
        • Reviews:
          • 2024 iPad Air reviews roundup: Bigger, and probably ‘pro’ enough — www.cultofmac.com/…
          • M2 iPad Air review: The everything iPad — arstechnica.com
          • iPad Air hands on: A return to an affordable large-format iPad — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple Announces New 11" and 13" iPad Pros — www.macstories.net/… (Apple Press Release)
        • New iPad Pro with beautiful OLED display and M4 chip is ‘thinnest Apple product ever’ — www.cultofmac.com/…
        • Apple Unveils M4 Chip, 1.5x Faster Than M2, 38 Trillion Operations per Second — www.macobserver.com/… (Apple Press release)
        • Apple’s new iPad Pro gets M4 power, advanced Tandem OLED screens — appleinsider.com/…
        • Refresh Rate on the New iPad Pros Can Go as Low as 10Hz — www.macobserver.com/…
        • First M4 iPad Pro benchmarks show 21% performance increase over M3 — www.cultofmac.com/…
        • Crazy-thin iPad Pro models hold up under early bend tests — www.cultofmac.com/…
        • M4 iPad Pro teardown finds easier-to-access battery, glimpses of Tandem OLED design — arstechnica.com
        • Confirmed: Redesign makes M4 iPad Pro incompatible with older cases, keyboards, styli — www.cultofmac.com/… & If you’re buying a new iPad Pro, your old magnetic stand won’t work — appleinsider.com/…
        • Reviews:
          • New iPad Pro review roundup: impressive performance held back by iPadOS — appleinsider.com/…
          • iPad Pro hands on: Luxury technology in an impossibly-thin package — appleinsider.com/…
          • M4 iPad Pro review: Well, now you’re just showing off — arstechnica.com
          • John Gruber — daringfireball.net/…
      • New iPads make it much easier to manage battery health — www.cultofmac.com/… (same features as newer iPhones have)
      • 2024 iPad Pro and iPad Air ditch the physical SIM slot for good — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Apple makes breaking your new iPad’s screen a little less painful — appleinsider.com/… ($29 screen replacement with Apple Care+, down from $49)
      • Opinion: Does the iPad lineup make sense now? Yes and no — sixcolors.com/…
      • Related:
        • Apple drops the price of its 10th generation iPad to $349 — appleinsider.com/… (↓$100)
        • Apple kills $329 iPad with home button, Lightning port — arstechnica.com
        • Apple’s iPad upgrades march Lightning one step closer to death — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Pencil Pro adds ‘squeeze’ gesture, haptic feedback, Find My and more — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • This Apple Pencil Pro feature surprises and delights users — www.cultofmac.com/… (Tool shadow)
      • Apple Pencil Pro Packaging Arrives in Five Different Flavors — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Bummer! New iPads won’t work with old Apple Pencil. — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Related & Useful: Which Apple Pencil works with my iPad? — www.intego.com/… (New Pencil Pro only works on new M2 iPad Airs & M4 iPad Pros)
    • New Keyboards
      • New Magic Keyboard for iPad Pro features a bigger glass trackpad with haptic feedback — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • New Apple aluminum Magic Keyboard introduces backlit keys & function bar — appleinsider.com/…
    • Not in Keynote: The Smart Folio also got redesigned to support a range of angles instead of a single angle — sixcolors.com/…
    • Final Cut Pro adds live multi-camera recording on iPad and AI on Mac — www.cultofmac.com/… (Apple Press Release)
      • Related: The ‘Let Loose’ event was the first to be edited on iPad using Final Cut Pro — appleinsider.com/…
    • Logic Pro updates bring powerful new tools for music-makers — www.cultofmac.com/… (Apple Press Release)
      • Mostly AI features
      • Cross-platform update for Mac & iPad
    • Apple’s plastic-free packaging means pack-in logo stickers are going away — arstechnica.com (stores will have some stickers on hand for customers who complain)
  3. Microsoft launches first and third-party Arm-based laptops with dedicated AI processors branded Copilot+ PCs — blogs.microsoft.com/…
    • Recall feature stores screenshots of everything you do and uses those to train Copilot on everything you’ve been doing so you can ask it questions about your past actions (it’s a privacy nightmare!)
    • Microsoft Claims the New Surface Pro is Faster Than the 15” M3 MacBook Pro — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related Opinion:
      • John Gruber’s initial take — daringfireball.net/…
      • Taking Aim at Apple’s Fanless MacBook Airs With Fans — daringfireball.net/…
      • Why Apple should steal Microsoft’s Flex keyboard design for iPad — www.cultofmac.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple and Google deliver support for unwanted tracking alerts in iOS and Android — www.apple.com/…
  • Apple have launched their Pride 2024 line with just one new Solo Loop band and some wallpapers — www.apple.com/…
  • Reminder: WWDC is rapidly approaching, and the keynote will be at 10am Pacific on the 10th of June, with the Platforms State of the Union at 1pm — www.apple.com/…
    • 2024 ADA Finalists Announced — www.macstories.net/…
    • Related: Dive into app & game development with new ‘Apple Pathways’ hub — appleinsider.com/…
