item.title: LTA 130: June 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This jumbo solo show starts with a few followups from last month before diving into just a few regulatory legal stories, some HR news, and a few highlights from Apple's services and original content. The five main stories are a big-picture overview of WWDC, a look at the software announcement from WWDC, the Apple Intelligence announcement at WWDC, the preliminary finding that Apple is in breach of the DMA, and Apple's "Longevity by Design" initiative. The show finishes with a rundown of two other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in June.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta130.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Vision Pro developments:
    • The broader rollout of Vision Pro has started — www.cultofmac.com/… ( but not Ireland )
      • Launched in China, Hong Kong, Japan and Singapore
      • Available for pre-order in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, and the UK
    • Apps continue to arrive on Vision Pro:
      • Experience T20 World Cup on Apple Vision Pro with ICC’s New Immersive App — www.macobserver.com/…
      • There are now two ways to stream Steam VR games to Apple Vision Pro — appleinsider.com/… (ALVR & iVRy)
      • ‘Warped Kart Racers’ and ‘Cityscapes: Sim Builder’ Hit Apple Vision Pro as Spatial Titles — www.macobserver.com/…
  • The (disappointingly slow) rollout of AirPlay for hotels continues: iPhone and iPad Users Can Now AirPlay to Samsung Hotel TVs — www.macobserver.com/…
  • The contours of Apple’s tolerance of emulation on iOS become clearer:
    • Open Source PC Emulator UTM Blocked by Apple for Notarization, Including Through EU Marketplaces — daringfireball.net/…
    • Apple rejects PC emulators on the iOS App Store — arstechnica.com (iDos)
    • Apple has drawn a fuzzy line about what counts as console emulation on iPhone — appleinsider.com/… (Apple: “PC is not a console”)

Notable Numbers

  • Regulatory Rundown

  • Japan’s parliament has approved a law that will force third party App Stores on Apple & Google — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: consoles are exempt — daringfireball.net/…
  • Apple fined in South Korea for collecting users' data without their consent — appleinsider.com/… (Google also fined, and not clear what either has supposedly done wrong)
  • Four more states are jumping onto the DOJ’s antitrust suit against Apple — appleinsider.com/…
  • Recommended Read: All of the active antitrust cases Apple is fighting around the world — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Female employees launch a new Class Action suit against Apple:
    • Proposed class action lawsuit accuses Apple of underpaying women — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple punishes women for same behaviors that get men promoted, lawsuit says — arstechnica.com

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Pay will be able to be used from any browser on any OS with the help of a QR code later this year — www.macobserver.com/…
  • Apple Pay Later is being discontinued (just 10 months old!), Apple’s new plan is to integrate with third-party providers — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Possibly for regulatory reasons — arstechnica.com/…
  • Apple Books now offers Reese’s Book Club audiobook recommendations — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple)
  • Seven new games launch on Apple Arcade, including Outlanders 2: Second Nature — Apple
    • Related: Apple Offering Popular Games for up to 75% Discount on Mac App Store — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: First iPhone game-streaming service brings 1,300 retro classics — www.cultofmac.com/… (Antstream)

      Main Stories

  • WWDC — Big-Picture
    • Apple’s 2024 Design Award winners run the gamut of classic puzzle games to immersive experiences — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple)
    • Watch Apple’s WWDC24 keynote in just 90 seconds — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • WWDC24 Highlights — Apple
    • Strong focus on privacy across the board: Apple extends its privacy leadership with new updates across its platforms — Apple
      • Top 5 security and privacy features of macOS Sequoia, iOS 18, and iPadOS 18 — www.intego.com/…
      • WWDC Session: What’s new in privacy — developer.apple.com/…
      • Better control over contact sharing — www.macobserver.com/… ( WWDC Session)
      • Automatic passkey upgrades
    • Continued focus on gaming:
      • New Game Mode will boost iPhone and iPad gaming performance — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Developers Can Now Build Bigger Games and Apps for iOS 18 and tvOS 18 — www.macobserver.com/…
      • macOS 15 to Reduce Storage Requirements During App Installation — www.macobserver.com/… (used to need 2x which was a problem for big games)
      • macOS Sequoia brings version 2 of Apple’s Game Porting Toolkit — appleinsider.com/…
      • Related:
        • ‘Resident Evil 7: Biohazard’ coming to iPad, iPhone, and Mac — appleinsider.com/…
        • Assassin’s Creed Mirage Arrives on iOS and iPadOS, But You May Not Be Able to Play It — www.macobserver.com/… (requires quite beefy and recent devices)
        • ‘Zenless Zone Zero’ officially lands on iPhone & iPad on July 4 — appleinsider.com/…
        • Opinion: Why AAA games promoted by Apple flop in the App Store — appleinsider.com/… (Analysis by MobileGamer.biz suggests major titles don’t do well financially on Apple’s platforms)
  • WWDC — Software Upgrades
    • Services features — Apple
      • All the Changes in Maps: Curated Hikes, Offline Mapping, Custom Walking Routes, and More — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple Wallet — www.macobserver.com/…
        • Tap to Cash – transfer Apple Cash by tapping phones — www.cultofmac.com/…
        • Enhanced Event Tickets can show key information about the event with live updates
      • Apple TV+ gets Insights feature (like Amazon Prime’s X-Ray feature) on Apple TV Originals — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple ID will become Apple Account
    • Cross-Platform Apps & Features
      • The passwords feature in the settings app becomes a stand-alone app — www.macobserver.com/…
        • iOS 18 Passwords app can’t import passwords, but macOS can — appleinsider.com/…
        • Review: Apple Passwords App: Great for Passwords, But Not Your All-in-One Solution — www.macobserver.com/…
      • The Photos app gets a major re-design and some new features — appleinsider.com/…
        • The Photos app gets Clean Up, an on-device generative AI tool for removing unwanted elements in photos similar to Adobe’s Generative Fill — appleinsider.com/…
      • Safari’s Reader mode gets some tweaks across all the platforms — appleinsider.com/…
      • Messages gets some tweaks — www.cultofmac.com/…
        • Send Later: How to Schedule a Message in iOS 18, iPadOS 18, and macOS Sequoia — www.macobserver.com/…
        • Emoji Tapback
        • How To Animate Text in Messages iOS 18, iPadOS 18, macOS 15 — www.macobserver.com/…
        • (iPhone-only) Messages via Satellite — appleinsider.com/… (no longer just for emergencies)
      • Reminders & Calendars are better integrated on all platforms — appleinsider.com/…
      • The Settings app gets another re-work — www.macobserver.com/…
      • iCloud files can be marked for permanent download on Mac, iOS & iPadOS — appleinsider.com/…
      • Training Load and screen customisations come to Workouts on watchOS & iOS
    • AirPods to Get Head Nod Controls, Improved Call Quality, and Spatial Audio in Gaming — www.macobserver.com/… ( Apple)
    • Apple Home — Apple
      • HomeKit
        • Guest access
        • Shareplay for HomePods
        • Robot vacuums in the Home app
        • Door locks with UWB chips will be able to be unlocked hands-free
        • It will be possible to manually specify which of capable devices will act as your home hub — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple TV/TV OS
        • The 8 Best Features in tvOS 18 — www.macobserver.com/…
        • On-device Siri
        • Automatic subtitles on mute
        • Review: tvOS 18: The MacStories Overview — www.macstories.net/…
    • CarPlay — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple CarPlay 2.0 Will Be Highly Customizable to Match Automakers’ Styles — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Related: Apple CarPlay to Soon Appear on Motorcycles — www.macobserver.com/… (Nepali EV startup Yatri Motorcycles)
    • VisionOS 2 — www.macstories.net/… ( Apple)
      • System-wide gestures
      • Better virtual Mac displays (equivalent to 2 4K displays) — arstechnica.com/…
      • Apple Releases Tools For Bringing iOS or iPadOS Games to visionOS — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Review: visionOS 2 offers small, but promising, steps forward — sixcolors.com/…
    • WatchOS 11 — www.macstories.net/… & appleinsider.com/… ( Apple)
      • Bento breakdown: what Apple wants you to know about watchOS 11 — appleinsider.com/…
      • Live Activities come to the watch — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Vitals app for better view of health info
      • Check In comes to the watch
      • Apple Watch gets automatic sleep tracking with watchOS 11 — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Custom Ring Tones — www.macobserver.com/…
      • watchOS 11 will run on Apple Watch 6 and newer models — www.macobserver.com/…
    • iOS & iPadOS 18
      • HomeScreen improvements – darkmode icons, tinted icons, and put icons anywhere in the grid — appleinsider.com/…, www.macobserver.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
      • You can now lock any app so it requires a biometric unlock, and, you can even hide them — appleinsider.com/…
      • Control Centre gets a re-design to make it easier to drill down into more details by just swiping further — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • SharePlay is being expanded to support easy screen sharing with remote control — www.macobserver.com/…
      • The new AccessorySetupKit API will make it easier to pair devices (other vendors will be able to support the same kind of experience we now get with AirPods) — www.macobserver.com/…
      • The Files app can format external drives — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • These are all the devices compatible with iOS 18 and iPadOS 18 — arstechnica.com
      • Review: iOS and iPadOS 18: The MacStories Overview — www.macstories.net/…
      • iOS 18 only ( Apple)
        • Everything new in iOS 18 coming this fall — appleinsider.com/…
        • iOS 18 changes just about everything about lock screen controls — appleinsider.com/… (the tyranny of the flashlight and built-in camera is over!)
        • iPhone gets RCS for better texting with Androids — www.cultofmac.com/…
        • Apple’s Journal app is getting new features in iOS 18, but it’s still not on iPad — appleinsider.com/…
        • How to use Vehicle Motion Cues in iOS 18 to reduce motion sickness — appleinsider.com/…
        • iPhone finally gains T9 dialing with iOS 18 — www.cultofmac.com/…
        • iOS 18 allows iPhone to display the time even with dead battery — www.cultofmac.com/…
        • iOS 18 dramatically accelerates iPhone 15 Pro Max neural processing — appleinsider.com/…
        • iOS 18 will run on iPhone XS and newer models — www.macobserver.com/…
      • iPadOS 18 only ( Apple)
        • The iPad finally gets a calculator, but not just any calculator – ML-powered Maths Notes — www.cultofmac.com/… & appleinsider.com/…
        • Smart Script – improves your hand writing in notes while still making it look like yours — www.cultofmac.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…
        • iPadOS 18 Will Run on iPad 7th Gen and Newer Models — www.macobserver.com/…
        • Review: iPadOS 18: A Disappointment in the Shadow of macOS? — www.macobserver.com/…
    • macOS 15 Sequoia — www.macstories.net/… ( Apple)
      • Bento breakdown: What’s new in macOS Sequoia — appleinsider.com/…
      • How To Use Window Tiling in macOS 15 Sequoia — www.macobserver.com/…
      • iPhone Mirroring (screen & notifications)
      • All of your presentations will get better in macOS Sequoia — appleinsider.com/… (Presenter Preview & Background Replacements from the menubar)
      • macOS 15 Gets a Headphone Functionality That Has Been on iPhones Since 2020 — www.macobserver.com/… (Headphone Accommodations, an accessibility feature for tuning audio frequency distributions)
      • Apple honors original icon designer Susan Kare in macOS Sequoia wallpaper — appleinsider.com/…
      • MacBook Air gets hosed, other models hold steady in macOS 15 as Intel support fades — arstechnica.com
  • WWDC — Apple unveils “Apple Intelligence” AI features for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS — arstechnica.com (Apple’s Press Release)
    • Platforms State of the Union explains Apple Intelligence and new OS features — www.cultofmac.com/… ( Watch on YouTube)
    • Fundamental Improvements to Siri — appleinsider.com/… & macobserver.com/…
      • WWDC session: Bring your app to Siri — developer.apple.com/…
      • Uses foundation models to better understand language — allows for interruptions, re-phrasings, and related queries
      • Uses an on-device Semantic Index to understand the context of the information on your phone — huge privacy advantage over using large LLMs
      • Builds on the existing App Intents framework to allow apps to expose their functionality to Siri ( WWDC Session)
    • System-wide writing assistance tools — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Rewrite, proofread & summarise
      • WWDC session: Get started with Writing Tools — developer.apple.com/…
    • Priority Notifications & Message Summaries — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple Intelligence brings live recording and transcription to the Phone app in iOS 18 — appleinsider.com/…
    • Safari surfaces web page highlights, summaries and video control — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Image Playground and Genmoji bring AI images to iMessage and more — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Apple’s Image Playground is a new system-wide AI-powered image generation tool — appleinsider.com/…
      • How Apple will label AI-generated images made with Image Playground — appleinsider.com/…
      • Genmoji will allow custom AI-created emojis in iOS 18, and might resurrect Memoji — appleinsider.com/…
      • How To Create Custom Emojis with Genmoji on iOS 18 — www.macobserver.com/…
      • WWDC Session: Bring expression to your app with Genmoji — developer.apple.com/…
    • Third-Party LLM Integrations (initially just ChatGPT)
      • ChatGPT Now Integrated Into iOS 18, iPadOS 18, macOS Sequoia, and Siri — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Report: Apple isn’t paying OpenAI for ChatGPT integration into OSes — arstechnica.com
      • Opinion: Apple and OpenAI currently have the most misunderstood partnership in tech — arstechnica.com
    • Copilot-like AI assistance in XCode — Apple
    • Privacy by-design
      • Most processing is on-device, then on Apple’s cloud built on Apple Silicon with hardware protections to ensure privacy, and only out to traditional LLMs when integrations are enabled, and specific permission is given each time, and even then, through an anonymising relay
      • Apple’s AI promise: “Your data is never stored or made accessible to Apple” — arstechnica.com
      • Apple Users’ AI Data Will Be Minimally Sent to Cloud, To Be Destroyed After Processing — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple’s detailed description of how Private Cloud Compute works — security.apple.com/…
    • Training does include the public web
      • Excluding your website from Apple’s AI crawler — sixcolors.com/…
    • The rollout will be slow and limited
      • Most of Apple Intelligence Features Won’t Arrive Until 2025 — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple Intelligence - what Macs, iPads, and iPhones are required — appleinsider.com/…
      • No, your Apple TV, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro aren’t getting Apple Intelligence — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple’s Press Engagement:
      • Tim Cook: Privacy Sets Apple Intelligence Apart, Though It Could Still Hallucinate — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Tim Cook chats Apple Intelligence, Privacy, and More with Marques Brownlee — www.macobserver.com/…
      • The Talk Show Live From WWDC 2024 — daringfireball.net/… (with John Giannandrea, Craig Federighi & Greg Joswiak)
    • Related:
      • Apple Developer Academy gets new Artificial Intelligence curriculum — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple)
      • Apple researchers add 20 more open-source models to improve text and image AI — appleinsider.com/…
    • Opinion & Analysis:
      • Apple Intelligence Explained: The Cutting-Edge AI Technology Behind the Magic — www.maginative.com/… ⭐
      • Preparing for the era of orchestrated apps — sixcolors.com/… ⭐
      • John Gruber’s Analysis — daringfireball.net/… ⭐
      • Why you shouldn’t fear Apple Intelligence — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Apple Intelligence & Private Cloud Compute are Apple’s answer to generative AI — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple enters AI arms race with new Apple Intelligence feature — www.bleepingcomputer.com/…
      • Apple Intelligence is AI, done Apple’s way — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Apple Intelligence: The MacStories Overview — www.macstories.net/…
      • OK, fine, here’s Apple Intelligence — sixcolors.com/…
  • Big Digital Markets Act (DMA) headaches for Apple
    • The EU Commission issues a preliminary ruling that Apple’s anti-steering rules are violating the Digital Markets Act (DMA) — sixcolors.com/… ( EU Commission)
      • Apple has the right to respond
      • The final decision will come in March 2025
      • The DMA allows for fines of up to 10% of global revenue, so about $38Bn — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Analysis: John Gruber’s break-down of the commission’s statement — [daringfireball.net/…](https://daringfireball.net/linked/2024/06/24/ec-dings-apple
    • In the same statement the EU Commission also announced and investigation into the Core Technology Fee
    • Apple have said they will not be rolling out Apple Intelligence to the EU initially over fears it might be interpreted as not complying with DMA — appleinsider.com/…
      • Two other features will also not be available to EU users, at least initially – iPhone screen mirroring on the Mac & SharePlay screen sharing — arstechnica.com/…
      • Related: EU commissioner Margrethe Vestager made a comment in an interview that was critical, but the questioner didn’t understand the question from the audience and it was a short off-the-cuff comment, it’s being reported with more significance than it probably deserves by many — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple’s ‘Longevity by Design’ initiative — PDF Download
    • Apple’s ‘longevity by design’ initiative is a balance between repairability & secure engineering — appleinsider.com/…
    • Repairing iPhones to Get Easier; Apple Opens Up to Third-Party Parts — www.macobserver.com/…
      • When a third-party part is used there will be a notification on next boot
      • The settings all will permanently show that a third-party part is in use
      • Battery stats (with a disclaimer) will be shown for third-party batteries
      • TrueTone will be enable-able on third-party displays, but results may vary
    • Apple’s iPhone & Mac self-service repair program is expanding to Europe — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple PR)
      • 32 countries, including the UK
      • Canada will follow in 2025
      • Covers all 42 products currently covered in the US (iPhone, Mac & Studio Display)
      • Total coverage is now 33 countries and 24 languages
    • Better calibration for third-party components and easier sourcing of official repair parts — www.cultofmac.com/…

      Quick Stories

  • Apple Back to School deals on Mac and iPad get you up to $150 gift card — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Apple’s new ‘Help Me Choose’ quiz helps users find the right Mac — appleinsider.com/… (I took the quiz and it recommend the Apple Studio I own )

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

Emoji Meaning
A press release or official statement.
A link to audio content, probably a podcast.
flag The story is particularly relevant to people living in a specific country, or, the organisation the story is about is affiliated with the government of a specific country.
A link to graphical content, probably a chart, graph, or diagram.
A link to an article behind a pay-wall.
A pinned story, i.e. one to keep an eye on that’s likely to develop into something significant in the future.

item.title: LTA 131: July 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This unusual solo show starts with a few followups from last month before diving into just a few regulatory legal stories, one piece of HR news, and a few highlights (and a lowlight) from Apple's services and original content. Because it's the so-called 'silly season', there's just one main story, Apple's Q3 2024 earnings call. The show finishes with a rundown of a few other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in July.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta131.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple offers the first public betas of iOS 18 and the other fall operating systems — appleinsider.com/…

  • As expected, Apple's Back to School promo has rolled out to more countries beyond just the US: Apple’s Back to School Promo Comes to Europe, Asia, and the Middle East — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Apple Intelligence Developments:

    • Apple iOS 18.1 Beta previews Apple Intelligence for the first time — www.bleepingcomputer.com/…

    • Apple Will “Share the Results of AI Tests” With Public and Govt — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Apple in talks with the EU and China for Apple Intelligence rollout — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Early reviews are trickling in, but it's too early in the beta process to draw any meaningful conclusions:

      • Hands on: Siri starts to get better thanks to Apple Intelligence — appleinsider.com/…

        • Apple Intelligence vs Grammarly — AI powered text tool showdown — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Vision Pro Developments:

    • Apple Revamps Vision Pro Demos with Personalized Content and New Features — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple Unveils New Shows for Apple Immersive Video — www.macobserver.com/…

  • PC Gaming Emulators on iOS:

    • Apple changed it's mind on UTM SE: Apple permits first PC emulator for iOS into the App Store — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple clarifies its stance on emulating PC games: PC emulators are now explicitly allowed on the iPhone and iPad — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: * How to run Linux and Windows on iPhone and iPad — www.cultofmac.com/… * How To Download and Install UTM on iPhone & iPad: 3 Methods — www.macobserver.com/…

  • After some initial Hiccoughs, Epic Games returns to iOS in Europe:

    • Apple green lights Epic Games Store in rapid reversal — appleinsider.com/… (not launched yet, but now coming soon)
    • Fortnite heads for iPhone via Europe’s AltStore — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Related: The AltStore PAL Marketplace is adding Torrent Clients and Other Third-Party Apps. — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Vision Pro’s App Store gains support for alternative payment methods in EU — www.cultofmac.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • Apple settles EU probe by opening up its mobile payments system — arstechnica.com

  • India's antitrust regulator has decided that Apple abuses its market dominance — appleinsider.com/… (not clear what this will mean yet)

  • Spain launches antitrust investigation over Apple's App Store practices — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: Apple Threatens Tencent and ByteDance with App Store Removal Over Payment Loopholes — www.macobserver.com/…

  • UK opens probe into risks of using Apple Wallet and rivals — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • DOJ -v- Apple: Apple defends business practices in motion to dismiss DOJ lawsuit — appleinsider.com/…
  • AliveCor -v- Apple: AliveCor suffers another loss in Apple Watch ECG patent battle — appleinsider.com/… (US CBP finds Apple's re-designed ECG does not violate AliveCor patents)
  • Apple beats lawsuit over forcing developers to use its closed ecosystem — appleinsider.com/… (potential class action suit in CA tossed)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Former Apple hardware engineer joins Rivian — appleinsider.com/… (Jeff Alves, was Apple's Director of Hardware Engineering and was with Apple for 11 years, now Rivian's Senior Director of Battery Engineering)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+:

    • Apple TV+ gifts PlayStation owners a three-month trial offer — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple TV+ earns a whopping 72 Emmy nominations — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Leagues Cup returns to MLS Season Pass on Apple TV on July 26 — www.apple.com/…
    • Apple and Major League Baseball announce August “Friday Night Baseball” schedule — www.apple.com/…
    • Related: Apple TV+ is Now 6th Biggest Streaming Service in the US — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Apple Arcade:

    • Temple Run: Legends and 2 more exciting games race onto Apple Arcade — www.cultofmac.com/… ( Apple Press release)
    • Related: an in-depth investigation of how developers are faring with Apple Arcade reveals a decidedly mixed bag — mobilegamer.biz/… * From: "We were able to sign a good deal for our titles which covered our whole development budget" & "Whatever anyone else says, the advances were fantastic. They were off the charts compared to what we’re used to being paid. And you got royalties on top of that" * To: a five-month payment back-log, "We can go weeks without hearing from Apple at all and their general response time to emails is three weeks, if they reply at all", "We’re supposed to be able to ask product, technical and commercial questions, but often half the Apple team won’t turn up and when they do they have no idea what’s going on and can’t answer our questions, either because they don’t have any knowledge on how to answer it, or are not able to share that info for confidentiality reasons", and even some describing working with Apple as like being in "an abusive relationship"

  • Apple Maps on the web launches in beta — www.apple.com/…

  • iPhone Emergency SOS via satellite feature expands to Japan — www.cultofmac.com/…

Main Story: Apple's Q3 2024 Earnings Call — www.apple.com/…

  • This is Tim: Complete Q3 2024 analyst call transcript — sixcolors.com/…

  • Sample of headline takes:

    • Apple reports record revenues despite stagnant iPhone sales — arstechnica.com
    • Apple results: Quarterly record, all-time high in Services — sixcolors.com/…
    • Apple's third quarter 2024 results show return to growth, with Wall Street beat — appleinsider.com/…
    • Strong iPad sales help return Apple to revenue growth — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Excellent Analysis:

    • How Apple's quietest quarter shouted back at Wall Street — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple’s Q3 2024 Record Revenues Surprise Tim Cook — tidbits.com/…

  • Noteworthy Opinion: Existential thoughts about Apple’s reliance on Services revenue — sixcolors.com/…

  • A Related Number from CIRP: Apple Users Are Holding Onto Their Devices for Longer Than Ever — www.macobserver.com/…

    "The data reveals a big increase in the number of users keeping their iPhones, iPads, and Macs for more than two years. For iPhones, 71% of recent buyers had a previous phone older than two years, up from 63% in 2020. Similarly, 68% of new Mac owners had a previous computer older than two years, compared to 59% just four years ago."

Quick Stories

  • Minor Apple Hardware Releases:

    • Apple's Beats releases a re-vamped version of the iconic Beats Pill speaker — www.macrumors.com/…

      • Related: The new Beats Pill: exclusive interview with Apple’s Oliver Schusser — www.wallpaper.com/…

    • Beats Launches Solo 4 Headphones in a Limited “Minecraft” Edition — www.macobserver.com/…

    • HomePod mini ditches space gray in favor of new midnight color — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple Press Release)

  • This month's Apple OS updates bring dual external display support to the M3 MacBook — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple Refreshes the Apple Store App, Brings New “Go Further” Tab — www.macobserver.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.title: LTA 132: August 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

This solo show starts with a quick followup from recent months before diving into just a few regulatory stories, one quick legal story, quite a bit of HR news, and some highlights from Apple's services and original content. The four main stories are the impact of Google being judge an illegal search monopoly on Apple, Apple's assault on Patreon, Apple's continuing journey towards DMA compliance, and the continuing rollout of Apple Intelligence. The show finishes with a rundown of a few other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in August.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta132.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • The rise of the emulators continues: Classic PC game emulation is back on the iPhone with iDOS 3 release — arstechnica.com

Regulatory Rundown

  • Apple reportedly succeeds in getting the un-published anti-trust finding against it by the Competition Commission of India (CCI) thrown out on a technicality — appleinsider.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…(the final is reported as containing privileged and sensitive information, and Apple are also said to have other criticisms, chiefly that their 5% market share is too small for them to be a monopoly)

    • Related: India says Apple is the fastest-growing firm in the country over the last 50 years — appleinsider.com/…

  • UK drops App Store investigation, says it has better things to do — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • University of Wisconsin denied new trial in decade-long chip patent battle against Apple — appleinsider.com/… (this case may finally be over )

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple is doing some substantial staff reorganisations:

    • Apple lays off about 100 services employees across Apple Books, News — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple give 121 workers the choice to move to Austin Texas or lose their jobs as they close down their Data Operations Annotations team in San Diego — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Apple splits App Store team in two, introduces new leadership — arstechnica.com/…

    • Current App Store Vice President Matt Fischer is leaving Apple
    • Carson Oliver will lead the Apple App Store division
    • Ann Thai will lead a new alternative app store team

  • Effective from the start of 2025, Kevan Parekh will replace Luca Maestri as Apple's Chief Financial Officer (CFO) — appleinsider.com/… & arstechnica.com/…

    • "Maestri will continue to lead the Corporate Services teams, including information systems and technology, information security, and real estate and development, reporting to Apple CEO Tim Cook" — Apple PR
    • Kevan Parekh joined Apple in 2013, and is Apple's current VP of Financial Planning & Analysis.
    • A nice tribute to Maestri from Jason Snell: Bye, Luca (sort of) — sixcolors.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+:

    • Apple, Major League Baseball announce September “Friday Night Baseball” schedule — Apple PR

    • Apple has cut back the theatrical release for Wolf (an action comedy starring George Clooney & Brad Pitt) from thousands of cinemas across the US to just a limited 1-week run — www.macobserver.com/…

      • Additional Unconfirmed Reporting: Apple is scaling back their movie ambitions to just one or two big titles a year, and caping the budgets for other movies at $80M.

  • Apple Arcade: NFL Retro Bowl ’25, an exciting collaboration between the NFL and the hit App Store game, comes exclusively to Apple Arcade — Apple PR

  • Apple Music now lets you export playlists to YouTube Music — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple Maps Look Around is coming to cities in Morocco, Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Lebanon, China, Belarus, Turkey, Bulgaria, Mexico & Slovakia — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Podcasts Is Now Available as a Web App — www.macstories.net/…

  • Apple Wallet: Digital Drivers licenses & state IDs are coming to California & Hawaii — Apple PR & appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Card: Apple offers all-time high $300 welcome bonus for new Apple Card signups — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: Apple Card is still best in its customer satisfaction category for four straight years — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Cash: To comply with US financial regulations, users will need to complete identity verification to make transfers of $500 or more from October — www.macobserver.com/…

Main Stories

  1. The Judge in the DOJ Anti-trust case against Google has ruled that they have an illegal monopoly — appleinsider.com/…

    • Next steps: Google will appeal this initial finding, but the case moves on to litigating the remedy
    • Google’s Search Engine Deal with Apple Deemed a Monopoly — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple VP: No Bing, even if Microsoft “give us the whole company” — www.macobserver.com/… (Eddy Cue testimony)
    • Expert Analysis: All the possible ways to destroy Google’s monopoly in search — arstechnica.com
    • Analysis: Google's Antitrust Loss, Why Apple Doesn't Just Build a Search Engine, and What Comes Next — www.macstories.net/… (it would be more difficult and expensive that many assume)
    • Opinion: Existential thoughts about Apple’s reliance on Services revenue — sixcolors.com/… (Apple's definition of services does not line up with what users think of as services, and services profit is almost equal to all hardware profit)
    • Opinion: Why Apple’s dodgy deal with Google should have ended years ago — www.cultofmac.com/… (The Google deal makes a mockery of Apple's privacy promises)

  2. Apple force Patreon to completely change their payment structure in their iOS App (TL;DR, creators like me will lose 30% ) — Patreon PR

    • Patreon have until November to switch app pledges of support made via the iOS app to Apple's billing system, requiring changes to the subscription types creators can offer (e.g. per-creation plans are impossible), and requiring a 30% cut on all subscriptions to Apple (yes, 30%, because in total, Patreon 'makes' more than a $1M)

    • Patreon’s iOS App Will (Now) Be Forced to Use In-App Purchasing Instead of Its Safari-Based System — pxlnv.com/…

    • Opinion: John Gruber's takes — daringfireball.net/… & daringfireball.net/…

      • "The whole notion of a platform like Patreon just doesn’t fit with the App Store’s model of taking a fee out of every single transaction for digital goods or services"
      • "This might epitomize the way Apple can be penny-wise but pound-foolish when it comes to the App Store … I refuse to believe it’s worth the further degradation of Apple’s brand …"

    • Opinion: The price of payments - by Hamish McKenzie — on.substack.com/… (Creator platforms should be a special category on the App Store)

  3. Apple's journey to EU Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance continues:

    • Apple alters App Store linking rules and fee structure in EU — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Apps can provide links to alternative deals and payments outside the App Store mechanism, and Apple don’t get to enforce design limitations.

      • Users will get the power to disable Apple’s warning when using external payment providers

      • All developers, regardless of whether they opted for the standard developer agreement or the special EU one can use external links (within the EU)

      • Regardless the agreement the developer chose, there is always an Initial Acquisition Fee of 5% on sales made through a link within a year of installation.

      • All developers also pay a Store Services Fee, but the rate varies depending on the chosen developer agreement (remember, developers under the standard agreement don’t pay the Core Technology Fee, but developers under the EU agreement do):

        • Under the standard agreement the fee is 20%, reduced to 7% for members of the App Store Small Business Program, or a subscription renewal after the first year.
        • Under the EU agreement the fee is 10%, dropping to 5% in the same circumstances.

      • Spotify, Epic Games call Apple’s latest EU App Store changes ‘confusing’ — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Analysis & Opinion: Apple Announces New Fee Structure and Updated Guidelines for Apps in the EU That Link Out to the Web for Purchases — daringfireball.net/… ("a convoluted mess of a compliance plan for a convoluted mess of a law")

    • iOS 18 will bring big changes to app defaults in the EU — www.macstories.net/… & www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Browser choice screen changes:

        • Links will now have icons and short App Store descriptions, and a link to the browser’s App Store page.
        • Install and download can be done from the choice screen with progress indicator.
        • The new browser will replace Safari in the Dock or on the Home Screen.

      • In iOS 18 EU users will be able to assign their own default apps for:

        • Dialling phone numbers
        • Adding Call spam filter
        • Sending messages
        • Navigating with maps
        • Managing passwords
        • Using alternative keyboards
        • Translating text

      • Just about every default app will become un-installable, the exceptions being Settings and Phone, that means EU users will be able to remove:

        • Apple’s App Store
        • The default Messages app
        • Apple’s Camera & Photos apps
        • Safari

    • The roll out of third-party app stores continues

      • Thanks to a commitment from Epic Games to cover the Core Technology Fee, the first 3rd-party store, Riley Testut's AltStore PAL becomes free — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Epic Games Store goes live for EU iPhone users — appleinsider.com/…
      • Opinion: Apple is still standing in the way of Epic’s app store — www.theverge.com/… (Apple's EU fee structure means Epic finds it very hard to attract other devs to their store)

    • Related: After Years of Legal Wrangling, Apple Now Allows Spotify to Show EU Users Pricing in App, and Inform Them They Can Sign Up on the Web — daringfireball.net/…

      • Spotify are not opting to use the new rules for external links, they’re opting for the new Music Streaming Services Entitlement Apple announced in response to the streaming music antitrust ruling earlier this year that has nothing to do with the DMA.
      • Spotify can add text, but not links.

    • Related: Having agreed to open access the NFC chip in iPhones for EU developers last month to settle an antitrust investigation that pre-dates the DMA, Apple has announced a similar program for developers in some other countries — Apple PR, appleinsider.com/…, www.macobserver.com/… & arstechnica.com

      • Starting in iOS 18.1, developers in Australia, Brazil, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, the U.K., and the U.S will be able to request access to a new NFC and SE entitlement (other counties will follow, but no timescale given).
      • The new entitlement will provide access to NFC & Secure Element API enabling secure and private use of NFC for contactless payments, car keys, public transit, corporate badges, student IDs, home keys, hotel keys, merchant loyalty and rewards cards, and event tickets (government IDs to will get support later).
      • Users can open the matching app to use NFC, and there will be an option to change the default app brought up by double-clicking the lock button.
      • Developers need to enter an additional commercial agreement with Apple and there will be associated fees (no details provided yet).

  4. The work to roll out Apple Intelligence continues

    • More Apple Intelligence betas are released:

      • Apple Intelligence Photo Clean Up shows up in iOS 18.1 beta — appleinsider.com/…
      • Users Outside the US Can Now Test Apple Intelligent, but EU Users Still Cant — www.macobserver.com/… (testers outside the US can now leave their region as-is, but still need to change their Siri language to EN-US to use Apple Intelligence)

    • Apple released an academic paper describing their foundation model, and the results of their tests of the model against leading competitors like GPT-4 & Llama: Apple Intelligence Foundation Language Models — arxiv.org/…

      • Apple's model is on a par with the competition for writing
      • Apple's model is ahead of the competition in terms of function calling, i.e. doing things based on user prompts
      • Apple's model is noticeably safer than the competition
      • Analysis & Opinion: Apple shows why it’s ahead in AI, not behind — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Related: Discovered Apple Intelligence prompts show Apple's attempt at preventing AI disaster — appleinsider.com/…

    • Reporting from WIRED finds that many major sites have updated their robots.txt file to block Apple Intelligence (and other AI scrapers) — www.wired.com/…

      • Including Facebook, Instagram, Craigslist, Tumblr, The New York Times, The Financial Times, The Atlantic, Vox Media, the USA Today network, and Condé Nast (who own many media sites, including WIRED)

Quick Stories

  • Some environmental initiatives from Apple:

    • Apple to reclaim wetlands near its Iowa data center — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple honors 108 years of the National Park Service with Apple Pay donations — appleinsider.com/…

  • Customers can now extend AppleCare+ up to 45 days after it expires — appleinsider.com/… (in Australia, Austria, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the United States)

  • New Beats firmware brings audio sharing to Beats Studio Pro — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple collaborates with Kim Kardashian on limited-edition Beats Studio Pro — appleinsider.com/… (Three shades of apparently fashionable brown)

  • Apple Sports app piles on new features in time for football season — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple announces “Glowtime” event on September 9 — sixcolors.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.title: LTA 133: September 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

The show starts with some quick followup on a few long-running stories covered in recent months before diving into some regulatory stories, a few legal stories, a little HR news, and some highlights from Apple's services and original content. The three main stories are Apple's "It's Glow Time" event, the release of the latest OSes, and repairability. The show finishes with a rundown of a few other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in September.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta133.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Two important tax rulings for Apple:

    • The final ruling from the EU's highest court is in – Apple do have to pay the €2.4Bn fine for their tax arrangements in Ireland which has been sitting in escrow since the original ruling in 2016 — www.bbc.com/…
    • Cupertino wins a battle but loses the war over California's Apple tax ruling — appleinsider.com/… (The city gets to keep the taxes it's collected so far, but they were not actually OK, so they won't get to continue)

  • The slow rollout of digital IDs continues: California becomes eighth state to support IDs in Wallet app — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple continues its work to diversify it's supply chain:

    • iPhone 16s (but not 16 pros) will be assembled in Brazil — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple Expands US Manufacturing with TSMC and Amkor in Arizona — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple starts making iPhone 16 Pro in India — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple does hit a bump in the road though: Apple might rely on China for iPhone parts after fire destroys Indian factory — www.cultofmac.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • After Epic, Microsoft Criticizes Apple’s App Store Policies — www.macobserver.com/… (in filing to Competition & Markets Authority investigation into cloud gaming)

  • California governor vetoes major AI safety bill — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • EU To Work With Apple for 6 Months For iOS Interoperability — www.macobserver.com/… (This is one to watch, bureaucrats getting involved in low-down tech decisions often ends very badly)

  • Apple has complied with it's DMA requirements and made 3rd-party app stores available for iPadOS in the EU — www.macstories.net/…

    • Related: Setapp Mobile launches its EU app storefront in open beta — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Third-party Epic Games Store now available on iPad for EU users — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple has filed to drop it's case against the grey-hat security company NSO Group (of Pegasus spyware infamy) because it fears discovery will do more to harm Apple users' security than a victory could — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple beats patent troll, wins suit over Secure Enclave tech — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple -v- Epic:

    • Apple is denied a last-minute request for a delay in producing documents, and gets reprimanded by the judge — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Apple has filed a 32 page request that the case be dismissed, citing two new precedents it says undermine the original finding against Apple's anti-steering rules — appleinsider.com/… (the details are complicated!)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple Oklahoma City union secures new contract with pay hikes, better working conditions — appleinsider.com/…

  • The National Labour Relations Board (NLRB) has filed a formal complaint against Apple — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple is accused of forcing employees to sign illegal confidentiality, non-compete, and non-disclosure agreements
    • The complaint also alleges that Apple over-enforced social media and misconduct policies

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple Music:

    • Apple Music Vibes with Five New Mood Stations — www.macstories.net/…(Feel Good, Energy, Relax, Focus & Feeling Blue)
    • Apple Music Classical adds thousands of booklets to album listings — appleinsider.com/… (goes to version 2.0)

  • Apple TV+:

    • Apple awarded 8 Creative Arts Emmys (from 72 nominations) — appleinsider.com/…

      • Outstanding Contemporary Hairstyling: The Morning Show
      • Outstanding Contemporary Makeup (non-prosthetic): "The Morning Show
      • Outstanding Original Main Title Theme Music: Palm Royale
      • Outstanding Music Composition for a Limited Series: Lessons in Chemistry
      • Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Limited Series: Masters of the Air
      • Outstanding Directing for a Documentary: Girls Slate
      • Outstanding Cinematography: Girls Slate

    • Apple's latest movie Wolfs with Brad Pitt & George Clooney becomes the most-watched move on Apple TV+ ever — appleinsider.com/…

      • Related unconfirmed report: After Failures, Apple To Do Most Movies With Budget Under $100M — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Apple continues to add games: Eight games join Apple Arcade, including Balatro+ and NBA 2K25 Arcade Edition — Apple PR

  • Apple Podcasts gets some updates:

    • A new category and an editorial section named Series Essentials to highlight limited series podcasts — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Support for translations in 8 more languages — appleinsider.com/… (Dutch, Danish, Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, Italian, Portuguese & Brazilian Portuguese)

Main Stories

  1. Apple’s It's Glow Time event

    • Apple's September 2024 Glowtime Event: Replay Today's Keynote — www.macstories.net/…

    • Watch Apple’s ‘It’s Glowtime’ event in just 90 seconds — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Apple's press releases about the event, in order:

      • Apple introduces AirPods 4 and the world’s first all-in-one hearing health experience with AirPods Pro 2 — Apple PR

        • FDA approves AirPods hearing aid functionality — sixcolors.com/…
        • Physical Button on AirPods Eliminated; Gets a New Pairing Process — www.macobserver.com/…
        • ‘We’ve got to make it happen’: How Apple designed AirPods 4 for effective ANC — www.engadget.com/…
        • Related: Apple changes up AirPods Max colors, swaps in USB-C — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Apple Watch Ultra 2 now available in black titanium — Apple PR

        • Apple Unveiled the Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 2 With Dual-Frequency GPS — www.macobserver.com/…
        • Apple actually released a lot of new bands: A complete guide to all of Apple's new bands for the Apple Watches — appleinsider.com/…

      • Introducing Apple Watch Series 10 — Apple PR

        • Apple Watch S10 Can Detect Sleep Apnea but Not Blood Oxygen — www.macobserver.com/…
        • How Apple remade the Watch: “We're not afraid of the new at all” — www.gq-magazine.co.uk/…
        • Review: Apple Watch 10: The best gets gloriously better [Review] — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Apple Intelligence comes to iPhone, iPad, and Mac starting next month — Apple PR

        • Apple introduces new Visual Intelligence lookup for iPhone 16 — www.cultofmac.com/…

        • Apple Intelligence Promises Better AI Privacy. Here’s How It Actually Works — www.wired.com/…

        • A good overview of where Apple Intelligence will and won't be launching — www.macobserver.com/…

        • Apple Intelligence to gain support for even more languages in 2025 — www.cultofmac.com/… — English (India), English (Singapore), German, Italian, Korean, Portuguese & Vietnamese

          • An interesting observation from John Gruber, while Europeans will get Apple Intelligence on the Mac, this does not mean it's coming to the iPhone or iPad — daringfireball.net/…

        • Apple's new OS public betas offer a glimpse of Apple Intelligence — appleinsider.com/… & 2nd Public Betas of iOS 18.1, iPadOS 18.1, and macOS Sequoia 15.1 Are Out — www.macobserver.com/…

        • Hands-on with the first 10 Apple Intelligence features — www.cultofmac.com/…

        • Related: Apple Sticks to Climate Goals; Google Wavers Due to AI Demands — www.macobserver.com/…

        • Related: Both Apple & Meta decline to join the EU's voluntary AI pact — appleinsider.com/…

        • Related Analysis: Nilay Patel's iPhone 16 Pro Review Addresses the Nilay-Patel-iest of Questions: What Is a Photo? — daringfireball.net/…
