item.title: LTA 134: October 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

The show starts with some quick followup on a few recently covered and long-running stories before diving into a pair of regulatory stories, one legal story, quite a lot of HR & acquisition news, and some highlights from Apple's services and original content. The four main stories are the refreshed iPad mini, the launch of Apple Intelligence, the new M4 Macs, and Apple's Q4 2024 earnings. The show finishes with a rundown of a few other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in October.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta134.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • New AirPods Pro 2 firmware has been released enabling the promised hearing test and hearing aid features in some countries — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: Apple shares a look inside it's advanced audio labs — www.cultofmac.com/… & Apple PR
    • Review: What It's Like to Hear Better with AirPods Pro 2 — www.macstories.net/…
    • Review: Taking the AirPods Pro hearing test — sixcolors.com/…

  • The first, and probably most important, company adds support for Apple Wallet's new Enhanced Tickets feature in iOS 18: Ticketmaster — www.macobserver.com/…

  • The slow rollout of the Vision Pro continues: Apple Vision Pro to launch in South Korea and UAE this November — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Related: Apple Releases Immersive Short Film Submerged and Announces Upcoming Immersive Content — www.macstories.net/…
    • Related: Cisco brings Spatial Meetings to Apple Vision Pro with native Webex app — appleinsider.com/…

  • China remains complicated for Apple:

    • Tensions escalate as China arrests Foxconn staff at key Apple factory — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple's largest research lab outside the US opens in China — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple's growth in India continues: Apple Stores in Apple’s Fastest Growing Market to Get Triple Next Year — www.macobserver.com/… (3 new stores)

Regulatory Rundown

  • Apple Cannot Sell iPhone 16 in Indonesia As Investment Targets Missed by $15M — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Related: Indonesia bans sales of Google phones days after blocking Apple's iPhone 16 — www.reuters.com/…
    • Related: Indonesia requests Apple block Temu from the App Store — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple and Goldman Sachs hit with $90 million penalty over Apple Card — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple -v- Masimo: Apple technically get a win as a jury finds that old Masimo watches violate Apple patents, award Apple the minimum possible in damages, $250 — appleinsider.com/…, www.macobserver.com/… & daringfireball.net/…

    • The jury also found that current Masimo watches do not violate Apple's patents
    • Opinion: this is a Pyrrhic victory, because Apple lost the actually important part of the case, the current devices. Had Masimo's current devices been found to violate Apple patents then Apple could have used that as leverage to resolve the import ban blocking blood oxygen features in US Apple Watches.

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple's global chief of procurement to retire after 24 years — appleinsider.com/… (Dan Rosckes)

  • Apple's former hardware chief and current Apple Vision Pro lead is retiring — appleinsider.com/… (Dan Riccio)

  • Chief People Officer leaves Apple after short 20 month tenure — appleinsider.com/… (Carol Surface, Deirdre O'Brien resuming her old responsibilities again)

    • Related: Apple's relationship with its American workers remains turbulent:

      • Maryland Apple Store staff file for union election — appleinsider.com/…
      • NLRB accuses Apple of illegally restricting workers' social media use — appleinsider.com/… (National Labour Relations Board)
      • Apple still suppresses employees discussing pay equity, says Labor Board — appleinsider.com/… (a second NLRB investigation this month!)

    • Related: Apple HR exodus continues with recruitment exec departure — appleinsider.com/… (VP Sjoerd Gehring)

  • Apple acquires brilliant image-editing app Pixelmator. What now? — www.cultofmac.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+:

    • Apple TV+ comes to Amazon Prime Video — sixcolors.com/…
    • Lionel Messi’s historic MLS Cup Playoffs debut to stream free on MLS Season Pass on Apple TV — Apple PR
    • Related: You can no longer subscribe to Disney+ and Hulu through Apple — www.cultofmac.com/… (to avoid the Apple Tax)

  • Apple Music: Bands can turn concert set lists into Apple Music playlists — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Pay: (the service turned 10 this month!)

    • Apple Pay adds Klarna installments now, PayPal balances later — appleinsider.com/…

    • Tap to Pay on iPhone expands to more European countries — Apple PR (receiving payments directly on iPhone)

      • This is about merchants recieving tap-to-pay payments using just an iPhone as the point-of-sale terminal, not about regular folks using Apple Pay to pay for things!
      • Austria, Czech Republic, Ireland, Romania, and Sweden

    • Related: Here’s Why Apple Pay Is Still Not Available in Apple’s Fastest-Growing Market: India — www.macobserver.com/… (TL;DR incompatible regulations & privacy concerns)

  • Apple Wallet: Iowa rolls out support for driver's licenses, IDs in Wallet app — appleinsider.com/…

  • Messages:

    • Apple Business Connect extends to online firms, adds branding features — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple PR)
    • Roadside Assistance via Satellite expands into the UK — appleinsider.com/… (with Green Flag as the partner)
    • Related: Apple makes $1.1 billion commitment to expand satellite messaging — appleinsider.com/… (Apple is paying GlobeStar to expand it's satellite network, and taking a 20% stake in the company)
  • Apple Car Key to unlock Volvo, Audi, Polestar vehicles soon — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple refreshed the iPad Mini — Apple PR

    • The New iPad Mini Is Here With iPhone 15 Pro’s Chip and Apple Intelligence — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Opinion: The new iPad mini’s surprising not-new processor — sixcolors.com/…
    • Review & Opinion: iPad mini Review: The Third Place — www.macstories.net/… (an interesting take — the device has an important niche)
    • Review: Hands-on with the 2024 iPad mini: Spot the differences — arstechnica.com/…
    • Review: iPad mini 7 review roundup: Better in small ways — www.cultofmac.com/…

  2. Apple Intelligence Launches — Apple PR

    • Lead-up: Tim Cook reapplies ‘not first, but best’ mantra to Apple Intelligence — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Apple Intelligence launched in US English

      • On iPhones & iPads with iOS 18.1 — appleinsider.com/…
      • On Macs with macOS Sequoia 15.1 — appleinsider.com/… ( surprise! also in EU!)

    • Apple has shared more of the launch road-map — appleinsider.com/… & www.macstories.net/…

      • After surprisingly getting Apple Intelligence on the Mac in the EU on launch day, the EU will get Apple Intelligence on iOS in April 2025

      • At launch Apple Intelligence is US-English only, but more variants of English are coming in December — Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa & UK

      • In April 2025 more languages will become available — Chinese, English variants for India & Singapore, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, Vietnamese

      • The follow features will be added in December:

        • Custom re-writing styles in writing tools
        • ChatGPT in writing tools
        • Image Playgrounds
        • Genmoji
        • Visual Intelligence (camera-initiated search)

    • Launched Features:

      • Basic new Siri (new animation, and memory between requests) — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • How to use Apple Intelligence writing tools — www.intego.com/…
      • Notification Summaries
      • Image Cleanup
      • Photo Search
      • Photo Memories
      • Suggested replies
      • Phone call transcriptions
      • The Reduce Interruptions focus mode
      • Siri Apple Product Knowledge
      • Type to Siri (without the old accessibility tools trick)

    • As promised, Apple are opening up Private Cloud Compute to security researchers — www.bleepingcomputer.com/…

    • Related: WSJ: Apple’s Craig Federighi Explains Apple Intelligence Delays, Siri’s Future and More — YouTube (Joanna Stern interview)

    • Opinion: Apple's Commitment to AI Is Clear, But Its Execution Is Uneven — www.macstories.net/…

    • Opinion & Review: Apple Intelligence .1 Review: A small start of something big? — sixcolors.com/…

    • Related: Apple's study proves that LLM-based AI models are flawed because they cannot reason — appleinsider.com/…

  3. New Macs — no event, but a week of press releases & videos

    • Watch Apple’s M4 Mac announcements in just 90 seconds — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • The M4 family expands to include the M4 Pro & M4 Max — Apple PR

      • Apple’s M4, M4 Pro, and M4 Max compared to past generations, and to each other — arstechnica.com/…
      • M4 Pro and Max benchmarks show M2 Ultra who’s boss — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Apple updated the MacBook Airs to 16GB baseline RAM — sixcolors.com/…

    • Updated iMacs — Apple PR

      • Notable changes

        • M4 CPU
        • 16GB baseline RAM
        • Updated colours
        • Option for nano-textured glass

      • New 24-inch iMac adds M4 chip, nano-texture glass option — appleinsider.com/…

      • New M4 iMac delivers major speed boost — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Updated MacBook Pros — Apple PR

      • Key changes:

        • M4, M4 Pro & M4 Max CPUs
        • 16GB baseline RAM
        • Brighter screen (600 → 1K nits)
        • Option for nano-textured glass
        • An extra Thunderbolt port (now has ports on both sides)
        • The M4 Max & Pro have Thunderbolt 5
        • Related: Apple released their first Thunderbolt 5 Cable — www.cultofmac.com/… ($159)

      • Apple refreshes MacBook Pro lineup with M4 chips, introduces the M4 Max — arstechnica.com/…

      • Apple introduces new MacBook Pros with M4 chips, brighter screen — sixcolors.com/…

    • All new MacMinis — Apple PR

      • Apple's Launch Video — YouYube

      • Key changes:

        • New smaller form factor

          • 3 thunderbolt 4 ports, and HDMI port, and Ethernet at the back
          • 2 USB-C ports and the audio jack at the front, but
          • The power button in on the bottom — appleinsider.com/…
          • Related: the internet explodes with hacks to 'fix' the problem — appleinsider.com/…
          • M4, & M4 Pro CPUs
          • 16GB baseline RAM

        • Smaller Mac mini Powered by M4 and M4 Pro Chips — tidbits.com/…

        • M4 Mac mini vs M2 Mac mini compared: Leaner and meaner — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple updates 'Magic' accessories to USB-C, included with M4 iMac — appleinsider.com/…

      • Related: the charge port remains on the bottom of the Magic Mouse, so that controversy rolls on — appleinsider.com/…

  4. Apple’s Q4 2024 Earnings — Apple PR

    • The numbers:

      • Quarterly revenue of $94.9 billion (up 6% YoY)
      • Quarterly diluted earnings per share of $0.97 (would have been $1.64, up 12% YoY were it not for last month’s EU judgement on Irish taxes)

    • Detailed Graphs to put it all in context — sixcolors.com/…

    • The call:

      • This is Tim, that was Luca: Apple’s Q4 results phone call, transcribed — sixcolors.com/…
      • Tim Cook bids farewell to Luca Maestri on his last earnings call — appleinsider.com/…
      • Tim Cook says users are updating to iOS 18.1 at twice the rate of iOS 17.1 — appleinsider.com/… (answer to question about how Apple Intelligence is doing)
      • Apple Reports All-Time High in Active Users Worldwide — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Apple beats Wall Street predictions with record-breaking iPhone sales revenue — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple Sets Q4 2024 Revenue Record on Services and iPhone Growth — tidbits.com/…

    • Opinion: Apple's fourth quarter earnings were decent, but the holiday quarter will be vital — appleinsider.com/…

Quick Stories

  • iCloud.com updated with dark mode, customization options, and tweaked UI— appleinsider.com/…
  • AI effects and text captions are coming to Final Cut Pro — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple’s Swift Student Challenge to open in February 2025 — Apple
  • Beats partners with Kim Kardashian on new Beats Pill colors — appleinsider.com/…
  • New iPhone 14 Plus service program offers free repair for camera problem — www.cultofmac.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.title: LTA 135: November 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

The show starts with some quick followup on a few recently covered and long-running stories before diving into a big serving of regulatory stories, a handful legal story, just one piece of HR news, and some highlights from Apple's services and original content. The three main stories are a new security feature that appeared unannounced in iOS 18.1, 3rd-party sharing for Find My, and some updates to Apple's Pro apps. The show finishes with a rundown of a few other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in November.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta135.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • AirPods Pro 2 hearing tests and protection features come to France, though not the hearing aid functionality, at last not yet — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Intelligence developments:

    • Developers can begin work on an app intent system that will make Siri smarter in 2025 — appleinsider.com/…
    • A high-ranking Chinese Official has said foreign companies need to use Chinese LLMs unless they want to do through an extremely difficult approval process, the statement coincided with a trip to China by Tim Cook, reportedly lobby for approval of Apple Intelligence in the country — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Related: Google Gemini Live takes on Siri via a standalone iOS app — appleinsider.com/…

  • The Matter standard continues to evolve, V1.4 released — appleinsider.com/… (New devices types include home battery & EV-charging devices, heat pumps, water heaters, and in-wall controllers for lights, fans, etc.)

  • Apple's RCS support gets a little better with emoji reactions from Android devices now being displayed just like those from iOS devices — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Apple continues to diversity away from China and develop production in India:

    • Tata to Acquire Majority Stake in Taiwanese Pegatron’s iPhone Plant in India — www.macobserver.com/…
    • Foxconn India drops recruitment discrimination against married women — appleinsider.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • Apple's attempts to re-gain access to the Indonesian market for the iPhone 16 have not gone well:

    • Apple to increase Indonesia investment tenfold to appeal iPhone 16 ban — appleinsider.com/… ($10M → $100M)
    • Indonesia Rejects Apple’s $100M Investment Proposal Because Apple Invested 160x More in Vietnam — www.macobserver.com/… (per government minister)

  • India Rejects Apple’s Request to Suspend Antitrust Investigation Report — www.macobserver.com/… (Apple had previously succeeded in suspending the report over claims it leaked proprietary information)

  • The European Commission continues it's focus on Apple:

    • Apple have released their first Digital Markets Act (DMA) Compliance Report that includes iPadOS, and the European Commission released a statement saying they are carefully evaluating it and emphasising the possible penalties if Apple are found wanting:

      • European regulators evaluate iPadOS changes for compliance with Digital Markets Act — appleinsider.com/…
      • The public version of Apple's report — www.apple.com/… (PDF)

    • Following an investigation by national authorities in Ireland, Belgium & Germany the Commission has notified Apple that the geo-blocking within Apple Media Services (App Store, Apple Arcade, Music, iTunes Store, Books and Podcasts) breach EU anti-geo-blocking laws — European Commission PR

      • The scope of Europe's law is internal to Europe, so I believe a lot of the analysis on American sites is misunderstanding what is being demanded — it is not about Apple allowing Europeans to watch American Netflix, but about Belgians being able to watch German Netflix, Irish people being able to download French apps, and so on. (Example of the kind of reporting I believe is wrong: EU's latest demand on Apple about geolocking is unforgivably naive — appleinsider.com/…)

    • Related: Apple suppliers are also in the cross-hairs: Corning faces antitrust actions for its Gorilla Glass dominance — arstechnica.com/…

    • EU drops four-year Apple audiobook probe after complaint is withdrawn — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple's browser rules deemed anticompetitive, says UK competition body — appleinsider.com/…

  • The US Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) have announced that they will start supervising large digital wallet providers, and Apple Pay is very likely to come under scrutiny — appleinsider.com/… & www.macobserver.com/…

  • Brazilian Antitrust Regulator Orders Apple to Lift App Store Payment Restrictions — www.macobserver.com/…

Legal Latest

  • A judge in an existing class action suite against Apple over the App Store has approved an expansion of the class to cover more customers over more years — www.macobserver.com/…

  • The well known consumer advocacy group Which! is suing Apple for £3Bn over the alleged anti-competitive nature of iCloud — appleinsider.com/…

    The argument is that "iOS has a monopoly" and that Apple has used that "dominance to gain an unfair advantage in related markets, like the cloud storage market." Specifically, Apple is accused of making it difficult to use alternative suppliers.

  • DOJ -v- Apple: Apple have presented their arguments that the entire case should be thrown out, we now await a judgement — appleinsider.com/… (the bar is very high for Apple here, so success seems unlikely)

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple prompts Molly Anderson from Head of Industrial Design to VP of Industrial Design — www.macobserver.com/…

    • The VP of Industrial Desk title was last held by Evan Hankey
    • Design had been reporting to COO Jeff Williams as an interim measure since Hankey left

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • It's awards & rankings time!

    • Apple reveals 45 app and game finalists for the 2024 App Store Awards — Apple PR

      • A nice overview: Apple Announces 45 App Store Awards Finalists for 2024 — www.macstories.net/…
      • Apple shares the most popular podcasts of 2024 — Apple PR

    • Top Apple Podcast charts for 2024 show what everyone's been listening to — appleinsider.com/… * Per-country rankings

      • Billie Eilish is Apple Music’s Artist of the Year for 2024 — Apple PR

  • Apple Music Classical is now available in CarPlay — appleinsider.com/…

  • Have happier holidays with 15 new Apple Arcade games — www.cultofmac.com/… ( Apple PR)

  • Apple Pay:

    • Apple Pay officially launches in Paraguay — appleinsider.com/…
    • Tap-to-Pay for merchants (receiving payments) comes to New Zealand — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. iOS 18.1 brought a new security feature to iPhones: Inactivity Reboot — www.bleepingcomputer.com/…

    • iOS devices that have been locked for longer than a few days now automatically reboot to put themselves into the more secure before first unlock mode.

  2. Apple’s Find My enables users to share the location of lost items with third parties — Apple PR

    • Find My's Share Item Location will help airlines find your luggage — appleinsider.com/… (including Air Canada, British Airways, Delta Air Lines, Qantas, Virgin Atlantic, and even Aer Lingus )

  3. Apple updates it's Pro Apps

    • Final Cut Pro 11 begins a new chapter for video editing on Mac — Apple PR

      • Final Cut Pro 11 Has Apple Intelligence’s Image Clean Up, But For Videos — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple Unveils Final Cut Pro 11 with AI Features and Spatial Video Editing — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Apple also updated Logic Pro, adding Quantec Room Simulation — appleinsider.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple slashes MacBook Pro speaker repair costs — appleinsider.com/…

  • The campaign group Toxic-Free Future has released their 2024  Retailer Report Card, and Apple tops the rankings — appleinsider.com/…

    • The report's aims:

      "The 2024 Retailer Report Card grades the largest retailers in the U.S. and Canada on their actions to eliminate highly hazardous chemicals and plastics and replace them with safer solutions."

    • Apple was the only company to get an A grade with a score of 84%, the next closest retailers are Sephora & Walmart with 69% & 65%

  • Apple have extended their return periods again, from 8 November items can be returned until January 8th (usual policy is 2 weeks) — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Related: from November 29th to December 8th Apple Pay transactions in Apple's stores will support Product RED — www.cultofmac.com/… (to mark world AIDS day on 1 Dec)

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.title: LTA 136: December 2024
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

The show starts with some quick followup on a few recently covered and long-running stories before diving into the regulatory and legal stories, a little HR news, and some highlights from Apple's services and original content. The three main stories are conflict mineral complaints filed against Apple, the latest OS point-releases, and the continued rollout of Apple Intelligence. The show finishes with a rundown of a few other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in December.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta136.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple's Indonesia iPhone 16 ban drama will probably end with $1 billion investment — appleinsider.com/…

  • Airlines actually started rolling out support for AirTags to help locate lost luggage in time for the holiday travel chaos: United Airlines and Air Canada first to offer official support for AirTag link sharing — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Vision Pro global rollout continues with Taiwan on December 17 — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: Third episode of 'Adventure' immersive video series dives onto Apple Vision Pro — appleinsider.com/…
    • Related: Popular Science’s Innovation of the Year Award Goes to Apple Vision Pro — www.macobserver.com/…

Regulatory Rundown

  • EU regulators continued to focus in Apple in December:

    • EU Seeks Input on iOS and iPadOS Interoperability — www.macstories.net/… (part of DMA enforcement process)
    • EU could force Apple to open AirDrop and AirPlay to Android — www.cultofmac.com/… (also under the DMA)
    • Apple accuses Meta of abusing DMA interoperability requests to breach user privacy — www.reuters.com/… & appleinsider.com/… (Interestingly, Apple is asking the commission to implement the DMA so that interoperability respects another big EU law, the GDPR)

  • Regulatory scrutiny and enforcement may be slow and plodding, but it does cause real changes eventually:

    • USB-C gets a bit more universal as the EU’s mandate goes into effect — arstechnica.com/…

      • Related: Apple ceases iPhone 14, third-gen iPhone SE sales in the EU — appleinsider.com/…

    • Norway gets world's first Apple Pay alternative for iPhone — appleinsider.com/… (thanks to EU regulations forcing Apple to open up access to the NFC chip)

    • The Delta emulator for iOS becomes the first app in the US Apple App Store to make use of the new External Purchase Link Entitlement, allowing users click on a link within the app to support the development of the app on Patreon — www.macstories.net/…

Legal Latest

  • Apple agrees to $95M settlement to end privacy lawsuit over Siri recordings — appleinsider.com/… ($20 per-user-per-device, over incorrect 'hey Siri' triggers and human review of random sample of Siri interactions)

    • Related: Just to prove some of these class action suits do sometimes get a little money into people's pockets: Users Report Receiving Checks from Peters v Apple Settlement — www.macobserver.com/… ($47.86 per user, part of $25M settlement for misleading users about in-app subscription sharing within an Apple Family)

  • Apple hit with $1.2Bn lawsuit after killing controversial CSAM-detecting tool — arstechnica.com/… (Class action by abuse survivors)

  • Brazil antitrust ruling against Apple overturned by Federal Justice — appleinsider.com/… (mandated 3rd-party App Store Payments)

  • The US 9th circuit court of appeals has rejected an appeal to overturn the dismissal of a class action case that claimed Apple was tricking users into having to upgrade to paid iCloud plans, most probably killing the case — appleinsider.com/… (The argument was that it's impossible to live on the 5GB base plan, so the free iCloud is a lie, unfortunately, many of the actual plaintiffs were successfully using the free plan, making the whole case look as dumb as I think it was )

  • The DOJ -v- Google anti-trust case over the company's search monopoly moved forward with Google filing a remedies proposal it doesn't believe it should implement simply to allow its appeal of the actual original ruling to proceed — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: In a court filing supporting Google Apple senior VP Eddie Cue has stated that Apple have no interest in making their own search engine — appleinsider.com/…

  • Suggested Reading: Apple’s Year in Court: A Recap of 2024’s Most Notable Lawsuits — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple Sued for Having Power to Spy on Employees’ Personal Lives — www.macobserver.com/…

    • CA state suit filed by Apple employees

    • Claim is that Apple effectively force staff to simultaneously:

      • Use personal devices for work
      • Use personal Apple IDs on those personal devices
      • Install monitoring software giving Apple control of those devices and visibility into the data on them

  • As of January 1st 2025, it's Official, after many years sterling service, Luca Maestri is no longer Apple's CFO, as Kevan Parekh officially assumed the role — www.macobserver.com/…

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple's look back at 2024 continued in December:

    • 'Hysterical' named Apple Podcasts top new show of 2024 — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple Books celebrates 2024 with collections and Year in Review — appleinsider.com/…
    • Adobe Lightroom, Balatro+ honored in Apple's App Store Awards — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple PR)
    • Apple Reveals the Top App Store App and Game Downloads of 2024 — www.macstories.net/… Apple PR

  • Apple Music Radio taps big talent for three new stations — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple PR)

  • Apple TV+:

    • Apple TV+ kicks off 2025 with free streaming weekend — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Apple TV+ notches record 29 Children’s & Family Emmy nominations — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Health:

    • New Year update to Apple Fitness+ adds Strava integration — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple PR)
    • Apple To Expand AirPods Pro 2 Hearing Health Availability to UAE, UK + 7 More — www.macobserver.com/… (Cyprus, Czechia, France, Italy, Luxembourg, Romania, and Spain)
    • How Apple Watch will bring healther nights to Brazil with sleep apnea detection — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple continues to rapidly expand support for receiving payments on iPhones via Tap-to-Pay:

    • iPhone Tap to Pay comes to the UAE — www.cultofmac.com/…
    • Tap to Pay on iPhone comes to Chile and Egypt — appleinsider.com/…

  • Puerto Rico joins U.S. states that let driver’s licenses go in Apple Wallet — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple Delays HomeKit Support for Robot Vacuums to 2025 — www.macobserver.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple accused of covering up war crimes by willfully using Congo conflict minerals — appleinsider.com/…

    • A formalisation of a campaign that has been building for some months with criminal complaints filed in Belgium & France by the Democratic Republic of the Congo
    • Accusations revolve around tin, tungsten & tantalum, known as the three Ts
    • Apple uses certifications by the ITSCI to verify the minerals in its supply-chain are ethically source, and the suits allege that these certifications are meaningless, and that everyone knows that, including Apple
    • This argument is supported by that fact that Apple is also a member of the RMI (Responsible Minerals Initiative), and the RMI have denounced the ITSCI certifications as fraudulent, yet Apple still relied on ITSCI certifications in its 2023 supply-chain report

  2. Apple issued another round of important minor-version OS updates including significant improvements beyond the Apple Intelligence Rollout (next story):

    • iOS 18.2 — www.cultofmac.com/…, www.macobserver.com/… & www.macstories.net/… ⭐️

      • New centralised page for setting all default apps (Settings → Apps → Default Apps)

      • EU citizens now have the ability to delete more stock apps (Photos, Safari, Messages, Camera & App Store)

      • The promised AirTag location sharing

      • The rather marmite new email categorisation feature

      • Some asked-for improvements for the new Camera Control feature on iPhones 16 Pro

      • Daily Sudoku Puzzles in Apple News+

      • Layered Voice Memos on iPhones 16 Pro — appleinsider.com/…

        • Apple Shows Off Layered Recordings in Voice Memos with the Help of Michael Bublé and Carly Pearce — www.macstories.net/…

    • Snoopy screensavers arrive on Apple TV with tvOS 18.2 — appleinsider.com/…

    • New visionOS 2.2 brings widescreen Mac to Apple Vision Pro — appleinsider.com/…

  3. Apple Intelligence continues to roll out — Apple PR

    • New English language regional dialects released for Australia, Canada, New Zealand, South Africa & the UK

    • Initial limited rollout in EU (if you change your language to English UK )

    • Apple exec launches Apple Intelligence in Australia — appleinsider.com/…

    • New features for existing users — appleinsider.com/…

      • Image Playground (macOS & iOS) — appleinsider.com/…

      • Genmoji (macOS & iOS)

      • Magic wand tool in Apple Notes generates images based on existing note content (text and images)

      • Writing Tools enhancement: Re-write tool now accepts arbitary prompts instead of offering just three pre-defined style options

      • ChatGPT integration (iOS & macOS) — www.macobserver.com/…

        • Analysis: Apple Intelligence in iOS 18.2: A Deep Dive into Working with Siri and ChatGPT, Together — www.macstories.net/… ⭐️

      • Visual Intelligence on iPhones 16

      • Review: iOS 18.2/macOS 15.2 Review: Picture not so perfect? — sixcolors.com/…

    • Numbers, Pages, and Keynote gain Apple Intelligence smarts — appleinsider.com/…

    • Summaries prove to be a poor fit for news apps!

      • BBC cries foul over Apple Intelligence headline notification summarizations — appleinsider.com/…
      • Apple faces pressure to drop AI news summaries after false headline — www.cultofmac.com/…
      • Users can already disable summaries on an app-by-app basis, but I think the only fix here is to allow News apps an OS-level opt-out, you can't have an LLM re-writing carefully constructed and fact-critical news headlines!

    • Related: Apple-Nvidia collaboration triples speed of AI model production — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: Apple says it uses Amazon's custom AI chips — www.cnbc.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Beats launches Sunrise Pink and Twilight Blue cases for the iPhone 16 range — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple sells limited-edition Year of the Snake AirPods 4 in China — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple Takes Over iCloud Passwords Add-On for Firefox — tidbits.com/… (makes Apple Passwords just that little bit better a service)
  • Web version of Apple Maps adds Look Around street-view feature — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Microsoft simplifies file transfers between iPhone and Windows PC — www.cultofmac.com/…
  • Apple to report holiday quarter earnings on January 30, 2025 — appleinsider.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

wp:comment.wp:comment_author: Suno API
wp:comment.wp:comment_content: This is such a well-rounded recap of Apple’s 2024 developments! I’m particularly intrigued by the EU interoperability demands—how do you see Apple balancing these requirements with their commitment to user privacy under GDPR?

wp:comment.wp:comment_author: Bart Busschots
wp:comment.wp:comment_content:
Thanks!
My best guess is that Apple will use the GDPR to push back as much as they can against being forced to go further than they want with interoperability demands, especially from egregious ones like those from Meta, and that it will do exactly as much as the EU orders them, and not a darn thing more!

item.title: LTA 137: January 2025
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bbusschots

The show starts with some quick followup on a few recently covered and long-running stories before diving into the regulatory and legal stories, a little HR news, and some highlights from Apple's services and original content. The three main stories are President Trump's impact on Apple, the latest OS point-releases, and Apple's Q1 2025 earnings call. The show finishes with a rundown of a few other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in January.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta137.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Turns out Apple's Indonesia problems were not over after all. Last month I shared reports that the government were about to accept Apple's updated proposal, but it didn't work out like that:

    • Indonesia says Apple's $1 billion investment isn't enough to lift iPhone 16 ban — appleinsider.com/…
    • Later in the month relevant minister again said a deal was close — www.macobserver.com/… (no developments since)

  • Belgium has appointed a magistrate to investigate the allegations against Apple alleging it uses conflict minerals filed by the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, initiating the formal legal process — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Goldman Sachs long-running off-the-recored grumblings about Apple Card got on the record: Goldman Sachs CEO says Apple card partnership may end before 2030 — www.reuters.com/…

    • Related Unconfirmed Report: Apple Card may get taken over by Barclays, Synchrony — appleinsider.com/…

  • January 2025 was a mixed month for Apple's on-going supply-chain diversification efforts:

    • TSMC's Arizona plant starts making a second Apple chip — appleinsider.com/… (Unconfirmed report, and the chip in question is a SiP for Apple Watch)
    • Apple Chip Supplier TSMC’s US Plant To Not Get Latest Chip Before Taiwan — www.macobserver.com/… (CEO admitted there were delays in getting the US factories ready for producing the very latest chips for Apple)
    • China hinders moving iPhone assembly to other countries — www.cultofmac.com/… (Unconfirmed report of bureaucratic hurdles being to slow things down)

Regulatory Rundown

  • UK opens probe into Google’s and Apple’s mobile platforms — arstechnica.com/… (

    • Competition and Markets Authority are investigating whether the two companies have strategic market status under the new CMA (Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act)

  • More trouble for Apple in Brazil: Privacy nightmare FaceApp causes Apple & Google to be fined in Brazil — appleinsider.com/… (App was published to the local app stores without even a privacy policy in Portuguese!)

Legal Latest

  • DOJ -v- Google: Apple becomes involved in the remedies phase of the trial (Google were found guilty of breaching the Sherman Act last year with their search engine)

    • Judge tells Apple it's too late to intervene in Google monopoly case — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple hits back at judge with demand for Google search dominance trial delay — appleinsider.com/…

  • UK trial over Apple's App Store fees seeks $1.83B fine — appleinsider.com/… (4 year old class action has been allowed to proceed)

  • Apple and Amazon get $600 million UK price fixing lawsuit dismissed — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple have settled another class action suit, this time over swelling batteries in early Apple Watches (up to and including the series 3), and for just $20M — www.macobserver.com/… (affected US Apple Watch owners can claim their slicer of the pie at WatchSettlement.com)

  • M. Night Shyamalan beats $81 million plagiarism accusation over 'Servant' — appleinsider.com/…

Apple HR & Acquisition News

  • Apple's attempts to block a class action suit alleging gender pay discrimination have failed, the case will go to trial — arstechnica.com/…
  • Apple Intelligence & Siri team getting a boost from fixer Kim Vorrath — appleinsider.com/… (project manager with a long history of getting big projects delivered within Apple)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+

    • With the start of the 30th Major League Soccer season in the US, Apple roll out yet more soccer features — Apple PR & www.macobserver.com/…

      • MLS Season Pass will be available in over 100 countries this time
      • New Sunday Night Soccer featured game each week
      • Soccer-loving T-Mobile customers get Apple’s MLS Season Pass as a free bonus — www.cultofmac.com/… (T-Mobile postpaid & Metro by T-Mobile subscribers)
      • Apple adds Xfinity, DirecTV as MLS Season Pass distributors — sixcolors.com/… (by-passes Apple TV app!)
      • Related: Apple brings TV broadcast info and more soccer coverage to Apple Sports — appleinsider.com/…

    • More French-language programming coming to Apple TV+ in EU countries — appleinsider.com/… (deal signed with the French government)

    • Oscar nominations completely snub Apple TV+ — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple Delays Next-Generation CarPlay Launch, Continues Development with Automakers — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Synchrony Pay Later coming soon to Apple Pay — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Arcade launches into 2025 with 10 new games, including PGA TOUR Pro Golf — Apple PR

  • Apple Wallet:

    • Illinois will implement digital IDs and driver's licenses for Apple Wallet in 2025 — appleinsider.com/…
    • UK moves driver’s licenses into new wallet app — www.cultofmac.com/… (But not using the ISO standards Apple & Google are using the US — appleinsider.com/…)

Main Stories

  1. President Trump's Effect on Apple

    • In the lead up to the inauguration, and on inauguration day itself the CEOs of major tech firms were unusually prominent:

      • Tim Cook is donating $1 million to Trump’s inauguration […] — www.theverge.com/…

        • Personal donation from Cook, no donation at all from Apple
        • For comparison, for the Biden inauguration Cook donated nothing and Apple just $43,200) — daringfireball.net/…

      • Tim Cook joins big tech leaders for Trump's inauguration — appleinsider.com/…

      • US senators question big tech, including Apple, on the reason behind inauguration donations — appleinsider.com/… (Concerns about quid-pro-quos in terms of regulatory changes etc.)

      • Editorial: My interpretation was that it was pandering to a notoriously transactional president with a history of feuding with CEOs that irked him

    • At a pre-inauguration rally President-elect Trump made an un-substantiated boast involving Apple: Trump claims Tim Cook has committed Apple to massive US investment — appleinsider.com/…

      • "'I spoke with Tim Cook of Apple,' said Trump. 'He said they're going to make a massive investment in the United States because of our big election win.'"
      • There is no evidence to back up this assertion, and no comment from Apple.

    • Despite a lot of campaign and transition time bluster, no Apple-affecting tariffs have materialised yet — appleinsider.com/…

      • Editorial: the threat of sanctions may be more useful as leverage over both Apple and China than the political value of actually doing them, which will inevitably result in higher prices for US consumers

    • Both Apple and President Trump are heavily involved in the bit-partisan TikTok divestment mandate signed into law by President Biden which came into effect the day before Trump's inauguration: Here’s Why You Still Cannot Download TikTok From App Store — www.macobserver.com/…

      • Apple Removes TikTok and Other ByteDance Apps from US App Store — www.macobserver.com/… (as did Google)
      • After 1 day of outage: TikTok is back up in the US after Trump says he will extend deadline — www.bleepingcomputer.com/… (apps not restored to Apple or Google's stores)
      • Later in the month one ByteDance-owned app (MarvelSnap) does come back into the stores after some ownership changes — appleinsider.com/…
      • Opinion: A legal analysis of the legal effect of the executive order the new president issued to bring TikTok back online — www.lawfaremedia.org/… (TL;DR, president's can't overrule laws, and Trump's promise not to enforce the law has no legal standing, breaking the law would open companies up to massive potential exposure)

    • President Trump signed many executive orders in his first days in power, and those around re-naming geographic features have impacted on Apple and other map-publishers:

      • The president ordered the re-naming of Denali (tallest mountain in the US) back to Mount McKinley, since this is an entirely American feature, that change is likely to be adopted on most maps of the US once it flows through the bureaucratic process.
      • The president also ordered that the international Gulf of Mexico be re-named to the 'Gulf of America', given this is international waters, and that multiple nations border this body of water, this is much more controversial.
      • Apple did not instantly update Apple Maps, and within hours that became news: Apple Maps still calls it the Gulf of Mexico, and politicians are upset — appleinsider.com/…
      • Later in the month Apple started to make changes: Apple Maps shows users the Gulf of Mexico when searching for 'Gulf of America' — appleinsider.com/…
      • Related Analysis: An interesting look at how the open source community is handling the issue: OpenStreetMap Community Discussion on How to Handle the U.S. Federal Government's Imminent Designation of the Gulf of Mexico as the 'Gulf of America' — daringfireball.net/…

  2. Apple released the next round of OS point updates in January, mostly continuing the rollout of Apple Intelligence — www.macstories.net/… & appleinsider.com/…

    • One notable common feature was a refinement of notification summaries triggered by high-profile failures to summarise notifications from news apps:

      • Unusually, Apple previewed the changes — arstechnica.com/…

        • As a stop-gap Apple promised to disable summaries for news apps in the short-to-medium term
        • Apple promised UI tweaks to make summaries stand out more

      • The delivered changes over-delivered on the preview a little — sixcolors.com/…

        • The beta-nature of the feature is emphasised more in messages to users, and the settings screens show an explicit warning that summaries "may contain errors"
        • The rendering of summaries was updated to make them stand out more from regular notifications, with a nice use of italics to make them feel less certain and authoritative
        • UI was added to disable summaries for an app right from a summary (rather than needing to go to the settings app and navigate to the relevant setting)
        • Apple delivered on the promise to disable summaries for news apps for the moment

      • Analysis: LLMs aren’t always bad at writing news headlines — sixcolors.com/… (Examples of other AIs performing much better than Apple Intelligence)

      • Opinion: Apple Intelligence summaries might get warning labels. That’s not enough. — sixcolors.com/…

      • Related Analysis & Opinion: When Are Summaries Valuable? — tidbits.com/…

    • Apple are now confident enough in their infrastructure and the maturity of the product to enable Apple Intelligence by default (users can still disable it globally, or by-feature) — tidbits.com/…

    • Macs get fun custom Genmoji with macOS Sequoia 15.3 — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • How Visual Intelligence gets more powerful on iPhone 16 in iOS 18.3 — appleinsider.com/…

    • Note that even as the next WWDC gets closer than the previous, we're still waiting for many promised features, including improved Siri and personal context — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Related: Apple joins AI hardware standards consortium to improve server performance — appleinsider.com/…

  3. Q1 2025 Earnings Call — Apple PR

    • This is Tim (and Kevan!): Apple’s Q1 results call, transcribed — sixcolors.com/…

    • The earnings in graphs and context: Apple’s reports record revenue for Q1 2025 — sixcolors.com/…

      • Jason Snell & Dan Moren go through the graphs live on YouTube — [youtube.com/…](https://youtube.com/live/j6iczwW_-mc?si=mLabASHwRK7wjspe

    • Best summary: Despite iPhone Decline, Apple’s Q1 2025 Sets Revenue Records — tidbits.com/…

    • In Apple’s first-quarter earnings, the Mac leads the way in sales growth — arstechnica.com/…

      • Related: Mac Computers Gaining Ground in Small Businesses, New Report Shows — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Services buoy slumping iPhone sales in record-breaking holiday quarter earnings — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple has more than 2.35 billion active devices, up 550 million since 2022 — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple highlighted that their numbers show better iPhone 16 upgrade rates in countries that do have Apple Intelligence compared to those that don't — appleinsider.com/…

      • Related: Apple also reminded us that more languages are coming in April including "French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and simplified Chinese, as well as localised English to Singapore and India" — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Analysis:

      • John Gruber — "Apple’s overall sales in China have been trending down for 3 years now. It looks to me like Apple has peaked there"

      • Mind-melting stats from Apple’s profitable earnings call — www.cultofmac.com/…

        • "Apple’s gross margins were 46% for the quarter. As a general rule, businesses aim for 10% to 15% gross margins … It’s helped hugely by Apple’s Services division, which reported $26 billion in revenues and 75% gross margins"
        • "Phone revenues actually fell last quarter … to a measly $69.1 billion"
        • "As Cook said during the call, 'iPad overall grew 15% for the quarter, and it was more driven by iPad Air and the entry-level iPad than it was the top level iPad.'"
        • "revenue from Mac sales jumped an impressive 16% versus the same quarter of the previous year to just under $9 billion … 'The M4 based products are so compelling that it’s driving both upgrades at the double digit level, and it’s driving switchers at a double digit level,' said Apple’s CEO"
        • "iPad and Apple Watch are attracting tons of new Apple users … Cook and co. said more than 50% of sales of both Apple Watch and iPad were to new customers, not upgraders"
        • "Revenue from services like Apple Pay and Apple TV+ grew 14% year over year to set a new record … well over a billion paid subscriptions"
        • "India is Apple’s next gigantic growth market"

    • Related:

      • Apple Loses Top Spot in China’s Phone Market — www.macobserver.com/…
      • Apple Stock Declined To Its Worst in 5 Months Amid Weak iPhone Sales in China — www.macobserver.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple introduces the 2025 Black Unity Collection — Apple PR

    • Wallpapers & new Black Unity Sport Loop Apple Watch Band
    • Apple's Black Unity Apple Watch band uses a color-changing loop effect — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple moves to open-source, unify Swift component across platforms — appleinsider.com/…

  • American T-Mobile iPhone users can now join the carrier's beta service providing SMS over satellite via StarLink — www.macobserver.com/… (Previously Android-only)

  • Apple expands its India retail presence with Apple Store app — appleinsider.com/…

  • NVIDIA Announces GeForce NOW Cloud Gaming for Apple Vision Pro — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Game Porting Toolkit 2 exits beta to help developers move to macOS — appleinsider.com/…

  • Razer Launches PC Remote Play for Streaming PC Games to the iPhone, iPad, and Other Devices — www.macstories.net/…

  • Apple's 2025 annual shareholder meeting is on February 25 — appleinsider.com/…

Legend

Note: When the textual description of a link is part of the link it is the title of the page being linked to, when the text describing a link is not part of the link it is a description written by Bart.

item.title: LTA 138: February 2025
item.dc:creator: bbusschots
item.content:encoded:
Panel:

  • Bart Busschots (host) - @bartb.ie

The show starts with some quick followup on a few recently covered and long-running stories before diving into the regulatory and legal stories, and some highlights from Apple's services and original content. The four main stories are Apple's first full month under President Trump's second tenure, the UK's attempt to secretly back-door iCloud, loads of new and updated Apple devices, and a re-vamp of Apple's child safety features. The show finishes with a rundown of a few other quick Apple-related stories that made the news in February.

You'll find detailed show notes below the fold, and if you enjoy this free show, please consider clicking on the donate button at the top of the left side bar - the show is free for you to listen to, but not for Bart to Produce!

[audio mp3="https://media.lets-talk.ie/lta/lta138.mp3"]

Updates & Followup

Quick updates to long-running stories the show continues to track, and to stories covered in recent shows.

  • Apple's attempts to delay the remedies phase of the US DOJ antitrust case against Google over search was denied shortly after the previous episode was recorded — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: The case continued, and the DOJ have now filed their formal proposals, requesting the deals like the one with Apple be ended, and that Google sell off chrome — appleinsider.com/… (Biden-era demand that Google divest from AI investments dropped in this updated Trump-era filing)

  • Apple enables AirPods Pro 2 Hearing Aid feature in the UK — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple continued their drive towards facilitating repairs by adding manuals for the new M4 Macs — appleinsider.com/…

  • Having previously made a mockery of itself by attempting to ban AirTags on luggage, Lufthansa has joined the growing number of airlines supporting Apple's new location sharing feature for FindMy items — appleinsider.com/…

  • The iOS 18.4 betas revealed the Apple Intelligence features that are on the way soon, and Apple formally announced more official rollouts for April (none of them new that I could see) — Apple PR

    • Notably absent from the betas were the Siri enhancements everyone is eagerly awaiting (App Intents & personal data model)

      • Unusually, Apple chose to respond to the hew-and-cry from the the technorati with a statement to prominent apple bloggers to say the features were proving more difficult than expected and would need more time, and they would be "rolling them out in the coming year" — daringfireball.net/… (Some media are interpreting that as next calendar year, but Gruber and others think next OS cycle)
      • Analysis: Good insights from Federico Viticci — www.macstories.net/…

    • Related: Apple Intelligence for China comes a little closer: Apple will use Alibaba to power iPhone’s AI services in China — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Apple Aims to Launch AI Features in China by May 2025 — www.macobserver.com/… (Unconfirmed report)
      • Alibaba to manipulate Apple Intelligence output in China for censorship — appleinsider.com/… (Unconfirmed but very credible report)

Regulatory Rundown

  • Two nice illustrations that regulatory scrutiny can make real-world differences:

    • The Digital Services Act has it's first really concrete effect on iOS app availability in the EU, with a porn app being successfully notarised and published on the AltStore — www.bleepingcomputer.com/…

      • Rather cheekily, the developers tag it as 'approved' by Apple, they quickly respond to make clear they most certainly do not approve! — www.macrumors.com/…
      • Related: Apple updated the language used to inform developers their apps have been notarised: 'approved for distribution' → 'ready for distribution' — mastodon.social/…

    • Google Play Books now links out to website & avoids Apple's 30% cut — appleinsider.com/…

  • There finally seems to be light at the end of the tunnel for Apple in Indonesia, the company has reached a deal with the Indonesian government to get the iPhone 16 range certified in the country, including a 10x greater investment than first offered — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Indonesia starts to lift iPhone 16 ban, but hurdles remain — appleinsider.com/…

  • South Korea Fines Apple for Unauthorized Data Transfer of 40M Users — www.macobserver.com/…

    • The most notable detail is the criticism from the authorities over Apple's failure to answer questions
    • Apple won't comment on $3.2 million fine for mishandling data in South Korea — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple forcefully refutes UK's claims about mobile browsing — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple Faces Antitrust Scrutiny in Germany Over App Tracking Transparency — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Editorial by Bart: another dumb special-interest case putting profits funded by privacy invasion over user privacy, similar things are under way in France

  • Brazil gives Apple 90 days to enable third-party app marketplaces on iOS — appleinsider.com/…

Legal Latest

  • The Congolese government's case file against Apple in France and Belgium has been dismissed in France — appleinsider.com/…
  • The UK's Court of Appeal has rejected Apple's request to dismiss a $1 billion lawsuit over cutting the performance of an iPhone 6 and other models with chemically depleted batteries — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple defeats US consumer lawsuit over iCloud storage, for now — www.reuters.com/…
  • Apple beats 'Tetris' movie lawsuit — appleinsider.com/…
  • Apple wins patent battle against AliveCor, avoids potential Apple Watch import ban — appleinsider.com/… (Apple not infringing on patents with it's current ECG design, or with Afib Detection, but case could be appealed)

Apple Services & Original Content Highlights

  • Apple TV+:

    • The Apple TV app is now available on Android — Apple PR

      • It's not just a clunky port, Apple have made a truly native app for the platform — daringfireball.net/…

    • MLS kicks off 30th season with new ways to watch & exclusive perks on Apple TV — appleinsider.com/… ( Apple PR)

      • MLS is introducing custom Apple TV sleeve patches on every first-team player's jersey
      • New Sunday Night Soccer program to highlight one match in greater detail

    • Apple TV+ show is bought by another streamer for the first time — appleinsider.com/… ( Suspicion bought by UK streamer ITVX)

    • MLB 'Friday Night Baseball' returns to Apple TV+ on March 28 — appleinsider.com/…

  • Recipes Are Coming to Apple's News+ Service — www.macstories.net/…

  • Apple Music 1's newest DJ is King Charles III on 'The King's Music Room' — appleinsider.com/…

Main Stories

  1. Apple's first full month in the second Trump Era

    • Apple appears to be appeasing Trump

      • Despite it still being completely illegal, Apple (and Google) have returned TikTok to the app store — daringfireball.net/…

      • Apple & Google both comply with Trump's executive order to rename the Gulf of Mexico — www.macobserver.com/…

        • US users see only 'Gulf of America'
        • Mexican users see only 'Gulf of Mexico'
        • Rest of the world forced to see both names 'Gulf of Mexico (Gulf of America)'
        • Opinion by Bart: this just dumb, and by only showing US users a name no one else on planet earth uses, Apple have made their maps useless for their only true purpose, helping people find things! Also, forcing the dumb American name on all the rest of us is insulting. Tim Cook is clearly putting capitulating to a petty wanna-be dictator over the Apple user experience. Shame on him

      • Apple & Tim Cook return to X

        • Apple is once again advertising on X, more than a year after stopping all ads on the platform — appleinsider.com/…
        • Apple's Tim Cook Teases February 19th Event on X — www.macstories.net/…
        • Tim Cook teases the imminent launch of a new MacBook Air — appleinsider.com/… (also on X)
        • Editorial by Bart: Apple left X for a really good reason — the platform was associating their brand with literal Nazis! That hasn't changed, Apple have just swallowed their principles, presumably out of fear or in the deluded hope these kinds of tokens will mollify Trump in some, which are both terrible justifications. Trump is best understood as a selfish bullying man-child — if you give anything, he smells weakness, and just demands more. Nothing will ever be enough, and he'll just keep bullying Apple regardless.

      • One notable counter-example offering a ray of hope: Apple shareholders reject proposal to scrap company’s diversity programs — apnews.com/… (97% voted against )

        • Trump blasts Apple after Tim Cook doubles down on diversity — www.cultofmac.com/…

    • Trump's long threatened tariffs on China went into effect on March 4th – 20% (addition of another 10% on existing 10% from first Trump term) and no exemption for Apple — abcnews.go.com/… & www.nytimes.com/…

    • A Bank of America study highlights the obvious: Trump's tariffs could drive up iPhone prices by about 10% — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: India prepares for Trump trade disruption by cutting import taxes for Apple & others — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: China threatens App Store probe in retaliation for trade tensions — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: Apple pledges record-breaking $500 billion investment in the US — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Analysis: this appears to be just spin on the expected continued trajectory Apple was already on, aimed to mollify Trump — appleinsider.com/… & daringfireball.net/…

  2. Credible reports have emerged that the UK government has issued Apple with a secret order to break iCloud Advanced Protection globally to facilitate surveillance under it's controversial Investigatory Powers Act (IPA) — appleinsider.com/…

    • Under this law it is illegal for Apple to publicly acknowledge having received an order
    • The law also mandates that companies comply with orders, even while they appeal them to a secret tribunal
    • UK's iPhone spying backdoor demand sparks bipartisan US lawmaker anger — appleinsider.com/…
    • Apple removed the option to enable Advanced Data Protection in the UK saying it was 'unable' to offer the service — arstechnica.com/… (about the most they could legally say to confirm the reporting)
    • Washington Post: 'Biden Justice Department Downplayed U.K. Demand for Apple "Back Door"' — daringfireball.net/…
    • Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard suggests UK broke agreement in secretly asking Apple to build iCloud backdoor — 9to5mac.com/… (CLOUD Act)
    • Apple goes to court to fight UK demand for iCloud encryption backdoor — appleinsider.com/… (Unconfirmed report since confirmation would be literally illegal!)
    • Opinion: John Gruber's take — daringfireball.net/… (Aligns with Bart's views)

  3. Lots of Apple hardware updates

    • iPhone 16e — Apple PR & Product Page

      • Apple announces “iPhone 16e” to replace iPhone SE, starts at $599 for 128GB — arstechnica.com/…

      • Apple C1 Is Here, Its First In-House Cellular Modem — www.macobserver.com/…

        • Apple's C1 modem is the first step towards 'a platform for generations,' executives say — appleinsider.com/…
        • Apple's C1 modem signals the end of its Qualcomm dependence — appleinsider.com/…
        • Apple's C1 modem breaks no records for speed, but is exceptionally power efficient — appleinsider.com/… (About en-par with other chips in terms of data throughput in the bands it supports)

      • Everything Apple stripped out of iPhone 16 to make the iPhone 16e — www.cultofmac.com/…

        • No MagSafe

          • There are already workarounds: No MagSafe, No Problem: iPhone 16e Cases That Fix It — www.macobserver.com/…

        • no wide angle or telephoto, just single lens with 2x modes

        • no camera control button

        • no dynamic island, older notch design instead

        • No UWB or thread radios, and no wifi 7 (just wifi 6)

        • Presumably binned version of A18 with one fewer GPU core (5 rather than 6) — www.macobserver.com/…

          • Related: Core design: How chip binning helps Apple offer A18 variants — appleinsider.com/…

        • more basic display with 800nits max rather than 1,000 for the regular iPhone 16, and 2,000 for the pros, and an older less robust glass

        • No colour options — just black or white (but there are $39 colourful cases)

      • iPhone 16e teardown reveals surprisingly repairable design but can’t answer key question — www.cultofmac.com/… (7 out of 10 repairability score)

        • Neither battery design nor C1 Modem provide a hardware explanation for the lack of MagSafe

      • iPhone 16e vs iPhone SE 3: A quantum leap forward — appleinsider.com/…

      • iPhone 16e vs iPhone 16: A new Apple Intelligence-powered entry-level option — appleinsider.com/…

      • iPhone SE, iPhone 14, iPhone 14 Plus are all retired with iPhone 16e launch — appleinsider.com/…

      • Apple has officially killed off the Home Button — appleinsider.com/…

      • Opinion, analysis & reviews:

        • iPhone 16e focuses on real needs for regular people — appleinsider.com/… (This aligns with my take)
        • More than a name change: iPhone 16e isn't the iPhone SE 4 — appleinsider.com/…
        • iPhone 16e review: The most expensive cheap iPhone yet — arstechnica.com/…
        • Some first thoughts about the iPhone 16e — sixcolors.com/…
        • Thoughts and Observations on Today’s iPhone 16e Announcement — daringfireball.net/…
        • The iPhone 16e — daringfireball.net/… (Another take that aligns with my opinions)
        • iPhone 16e review roundup: an okay, if compromised, device without a market — appleinsider.com/… (A good summary of much of the Technorati's take, and I think they're completely wrong!)
        • iPhone 16e review roundup: Bare bones but capable, with long battery life — www.cultofmac.com/… (A summary of the better media takes)

    • iPad & iPad Air Updates — Apple PR

      • Apple Speed Bumps iPads: iPad Air Goes M3, iPad Gets an A16 — tidbits.com/…

      • iPad 11 chip upgrade does not bring Apple Intelligence — www.cultofmac.com/…

      • Apple releases new Smart Folio alongside new iPad — appleinsider.com/…

      • Apple Reveals New Magic Keyboard for iPad Air — www.macstories.net/…

        • Adds 14 key function row
        • Larger trackpad
        • Hinge design from 1Pad Pro keyboard
        • Only one colour, white, and still no back-lit keys

      • iPad Air and iPad Go Green With 100% Recycled Materials and Carbon Neutral Goals — www.macobserver.com/…

      • The iPad Air Officially Marks the End of Apple’s 64GB Era — www.macobserver.com/…

      • Analysis: Apple's new iPad updates are not dramatic, but don't need to be — appleinsider.com/…

    • Updated MacBook Air — Apple PR

      • MacBook Air gets the M4, a new blue color, up to 32GB of RAM, and a $100 price cut — arstechnica.com/…
      • New M4 MacBook Air fixes the line's biggest problem — appleinsider.com/… (Supports 2 external displays)
      • M4 MacBook Air Has 50% Extra Maximum RAM Compared to M3 MacBook Air — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Updated Mac Studio — Apple PR

      • Apple have released the M3 Ultra as an option with the Mac Studio — Apple PR

        • Apple says not every Apple Silicon generation will get an Ultra — appleinsider.com/…
        • Apple Says It’s Double; but Difference Between M4 Max vs M3 Ultra Is Marginal — www.macobserver.com/… (Benchmarks show that the M3 Ultra only makes sense if you will actually make use of more than 40 GPUs simultaneously, so for really pro use-cases)

      • New Mac Studio spans the generations with M4 Max, M3 Ultra chips — sixcolors.com/…

  4. Apple announces child protection improvements — www.cultofmac.com/… & appleinsider.com/…

    • Good Summary: Apple Aims to Boost Child Privacy with New Age-Related Controls — tidbits.com/…

      • Improved child account setup
      • More fine-grained and clearly defined age ranges
      • More detailed metadata requirements from developers to give parents better visibility and control
      • privacy-preserving settings and APIs for sharing broad age ranges in configurations and within apps, especially reader-type apps

    • Apple’s Updated Age Ratings Explained: What’s Changing and Why it Matters — www.macobserver.com/…

    • Related: Nice guide on Apple's current child protection features — www.macobserver.com/…

Quick Stories

  • Apple released their spring lineup of iPhone & Apple Watch accessories:

    • Four colors addded to iPhone 16 Silicone Case with MagSafe collection — appleinsider.com/…
    • Hermes Apple Watch band lineup expands with bold colors & classic designs — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple releases a new iOS app to help people host parties, Apple Invites — Apple PR

    • Key features:

      • iCloud+ required to host a party, anyone can be a guest, even non-iPhone users via a web interface
      • Does the basic RSVP stuff
      • Guests get directions and a weather forecast
      • All guests can contribute to a shared photo & video album
      • Guests who have Apple Music can contribute to a shared playlist

    • How the new Apple Invites app works, and when you want to use it — appleinsider.com/…

    • How To Use Apple Invites (Complete Guide) — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Apple released a rare sneak-peak video of some robots they're experimenting with in their labs, and their big focus is giving their movements personality — sixcolors.com/…

    • Related: Apple are advertising jobs for people with robotics expertise to work on their home products — appleinsider.com/…

  • Apple now lets you transfer purchases from one Apple Account to another — appleinsider.com/…

    • Apple Account Purchase Migration Doesn't Transfer TestFlight Enrollments — daringfireball.net/…

  • Apple has started a transition away from pre-paid AppleCare+ to a subscription mode – retail stores no longer offer pre-paid, but Apple's website still does — appleinsider.com/…

    • Related: AppleCare+ for iPhone is now more expensive in the US — www.cultofmac.com/…

  • Apple Sports app adds Nascar support just in time for Daytona 500 — appleinsider.com/…

  • iOS Update Enables “Critical Messages” via SMS — www.macobserver.com/…

  • Beats Releases the Powerbeats Pro 2 with H2 Chip and Heart Rate Monitoring — www.macstories.net/…

    • Reviewers rip Powerbeats Pro 2 heart rate monitoring — www.cultofmac.com/… (not accurate and when paired to gym equipment, can't play audio!)

  • Finally: Adobe Photoshop comes to iPhone — www.cultofmac.com/…
